papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：corner transfer matrix renormalization group algorithm（角转移矩阵重正化群算法）、infinite spiral projected entangled pair states ansatz（无限螺旋投影纠缠对态变分法）。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上的 $J_{1}$-$J_{2}$ 反铁磁 XY 模型，具体研究其基态性质与相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了该模型的主要磁相（Néel相、Ising相、共线相和非公度螺旋相）及其随 $J_{2}/J_{1}$ 比值变化的相变过程；发现二聚化态的能量系统性地高于共线相，且共线相随 $J_{2}/J_{1}$ 增大通过二级相变转变为非公度螺旋相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了该模型的主要磁相（Néel相、Ising相、共线相和非公度螺旋相）及其随 $J_{2}/J_{1}$ 比值变化的相变过程；发现二聚化态的能量系统性地高于共线相，且共线相随 $J_{2}/J_{1}$ 增大通过二级相变转变为非公度螺旋相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双位点单胞的角转移矩阵重正化群算法（CTMRG）和无限螺旋投影纠缠对态（infinite spiral PEPS）变分法进行数值计算。

papers.title: Signatures of Gaussian superconducting fluctuations in nonlocal noise magnetometry
papers.abstract: We calculate the two-point magnetic noise spectrum arising from Gaussian superconducting fluctuations, a quantity directly measurable by spin qubit pairs such as nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond. The analysis utilizes the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory, reflecting the direct contribution of fluctuating Cooper pairs to the current correlations and consequent magnetic noise. We treat both two-dimensional systems and wires, considering them in equilibrium and under a uniform electric field. The signal is expected to be strongest in high-temperature superconductors, and we contrast our findings with the predicted signatures of a vortex liquid to offer an additional route to elucidate the nature of fluctuations in these systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“calculate”“utilizes the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory”等关键词，属于理论计算与分析，未提及实验数据或数值模拟。；研究对象：高斯型超导涨落引起的两点磁噪声谱，具体针对二维系统和导线（wire），并考虑平衡态及均匀电场下的情况。材料方面重点关注高温超导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过含时金兹堡-朗道理论计算，发现高斯超导涨落可产生可直接测量的两点磁噪声信号，该信号在高温超导体中最强，且其特征与涡旋液体的预测信号不同，为区分超导涨落本质提供了新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过含时金兹堡-朗道理论计算，发现高斯超导涨落可产生可直接测量的两点磁噪声信号，该信号在高温超导体中最强，且其特征与涡旋液体的预测信号不同，为区分超导涨落本质提供了新途径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时金兹堡-朗道理论（time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory），计算涨落库珀对对电流关联函数及由此产生的磁噪声谱。

papers.title: Generalized Hydrodynamics of Bloch Oscillations in the Absence of a Lattice
papers.abstract: Objects subjected to a constant force generally increase their velocity over time. This expectation fails whenever their energy is a smooth and periodic function of momentum, resulting in periodic Bloch oscillations instead. Periodic dispersions, typical of lattice systems, can also emerge in continuum media through strong interactions. Here, we study the phenomenon of such Bloch oscillations in the absence of a lattice in a paradigmatic model of integrable quantum gases: the two-component Yang-Gaudin model. We derive a generalized-hydrodynamic theory of Bloch oscillations for a finite density of impurities embedded in a homogeneous interacting background, which we show to persist superimposed to a drift due to the acceleration of the center of mass. Moreover, we show the single-impurity oscillation period is renormalized at finite impurity density when two-magnon bound states are populated. Our results are relevant for ultracold atom experiments, where impurities can be created at controllable densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive a generalized-hydrodynamic theory”（推导广义流体动力学理论），属于理论推导。；研究对象：研究在无晶格系统中由恒定力驱动的布洛赫振荡现象，具体体系为可积量子气体中的双组分Yang-Gaudin模型（杂质嵌入均匀相互作用背景）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无晶格的连续介质中，强相互作用可导致类似晶格系统的周期性色散关系，从而产生布洛赫振荡；有限杂质密度下，单杂质振荡周期因双磁子束缚态的存在而发生重整化，且振荡叠加在质心加速导致的漂移之上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无晶格的连续介质中，强相互作用可导致类似晶格系统的周期性色散关系，从而产生布洛赫振荡；有限杂质密度下，单杂质振荡周期因双磁子束缚态的存在而发生重整化，且振荡叠加在质心加速导致的漂移之上。；创新点：首次在无晶格的连续可积量子气体模型中（Yang-Gaudin模型）理论预言并描述了布洛赫振荡现象，并揭示了有限杂质密度下双磁子束缚态对振荡周期的重整化效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义流体动力学（Generalized Hydrodynamics）理论框架，对有限密度杂质在均匀相互作用背景中的布洛赫振荡进行解析推导。

papers.title: Imaging stripe dynamics in trilayer nickelate La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$
papers.abstract: Since the discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in nickelate superconductors, it is an open question how closely the superconducting state resembles that of cuprate superconductors. One salient feature of the phase diagram of the high-temperature cuprate superconductors is stripe order. Despite their prevalence, real-space imaging has been limited to the charge sector. Here we use spin-polarised scanning tunnelling microscopy to visualize the local magnetic and charge distribution emerging due to a stripe order in the trilayer nickelate La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. The stripe order exhibits a four unit cell periodicity, closely resembling that seen in cuprates, and opens a near-complete $\sim66\mathrm{meV}$ gap at the Fermi level. Crucially, discrete phase slips can be triggered by tunneling electrons above a $\sim 20\mathrm{meV}$ threshold, allowing imaging of stripe dynamics at the atomic scale. These results highlight the importance of correlation physics driving stripe-like orders in lanthanum nickelates with striking similarities to the cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了spin-polarised scanning tunnelling microscopy（自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜）进行实验观测。；研究对象：三层镍氧化物La₄Ni₃O₁₀中的条纹序（stripe order）及其动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中观测到与铜氧化物超导体高度相似的四倍晶胞周期条纹序，该条纹序在费米能级处打开约66 meV的近完全能隙；通过隧穿电子可触发离散的相位滑移，首次在原子尺度实现了对条纹动力学的成像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中观测到与铜氧化物超导体高度相似的四倍晶胞周期条纹序，该条纹序在费米能级处打开约66 meV的近完全能隙；通过隧穿电子可触发离散的相位滑移，首次在原子尺度实现了对条纹动力学的成像。；创新点：首次在实空间同时成像了镍氧化物中条纹序的磁性和电荷分布，并实现了原子尺度条纹动力学的直接观测，揭示了与铜氧化物超导体在条纹序方面的显著相似性。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜（spin-polarised STM），用于同时观测局域磁性和电荷分布；通过隧穿电子激发实现条纹相位滑移的操控与成像。

papers.title: Detecting vortex motion through spatially correlated nonequilibrium noise
papers.abstract: Resistive transport near a superconducting phase can arise from the motion of normal-state quasiparticles or that of vortices. The conductivity alone does not distinguish between these mechanisms. We propose an unambiguous method for telling them apart, using the recently developed experimental tool of covariance magnetometry, which uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to probe real-time spatiotemporal correlations in magnetic noise. Our key insight is that, under an applied current, the underlying charge carriers leave a directional fingerprint in the spatially correlated magnetic noise above the sample: ordinary electric carriers drift parallel to the current, whereas vortices, owing to the Magnus force, drift perpendicular to it. The noise covariance detects this anisotropy and identifies the vortex-driven nature of transport. We compute the noise correlations expected for a representative thin-film superconductor and demonstrate that the anisotropic signal is well within the reach of current experimental capabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose an unambiguous method, compute the noise correlations, demonstrate）；研究对象：超导相附近电阻输运中涡旋运动与正常态准粒子运动的区分，具体为薄膜超导体中涡旋运动产生的空间关联非平衡噪声。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量样品上方磁噪声的空间关联（协方差磁强计），可区分电流驱动下涡旋运动（垂直于电流方向漂移）与正常载流子运动（平行于电流方向漂移），从而明确识别输运的涡旋驱动本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量样品上方磁噪声的空间关联（协方差磁强计），可区分电流驱动下涡旋运动（垂直于电流方向漂移）与正常载流子运动（平行于电流方向漂移），从而明确识别输运的涡旋驱动本质。；创新点：提出利用磁噪声空间关联的方向性指纹（各向异性）作为区分涡旋运动与正常载流子运动的无歧义实验判据，并证明该信号在当前实验能力可及范围内。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算与数值模拟：基于协方差磁强计（利用金刚石氮-空位中心探测实时时空磁噪声关联），计算代表性薄膜超导体中涡旋运动产生的噪声协方差各向异性信号。

papers.title: Stochastic trajectories and excursions in a double quantum dot system
papers.abstract: We investigate the trajectory-level dynamics of a double quantum dot system using the newly developed formalism of stochastic excursions. This approach extends full counting statistics by enabling a filtering of complex trajectories into sub-trajectories, which provide access to the intricate correlations between thermodynamic currents and excursion times. Counting observables are the main object of study in the stochastic excursion framework. Those are defined as a linear combination of transition counts multiplied by their assigned weights within one excursion. For three main counting observables -- charge current, dynamical activity, and entropy production -- we compute averages and noise contributions and show how they provide insights into the operation of the double quantum dot system. At the trajectory level, we analyze outcome distributions for transport and connect the results with trade-offs between successful and unsuccessful events that shape overall performance. We further introduce state observables, which depend on the state visited rather than the transition itself, and discuss the population of the two dots, as well as their correlations. Finally, we discuss thermodynamics of precision through thermo-kinetic uncertainty relations, showing how current precision in different regimes is fundamentally constrained either by entropy production or by dynamical activity. Altogether, our work is a case study that highlights the utility of the excursion framework as a toolkit to analyze many quantities of interest and to uncover the structure of nonequilibrium fluctuations. Moreover, it also suggests new avenues for refining uncertainty relations and understanding transport in mesoscopic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formalism of stochastic excursions、full counting statistics、trajectory-level dynamics。；研究对象：双量子点系统中的随机轨迹与子轨迹（excursions）动力学，具体研究电荷流、动力学活性和熵产生等输运观测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用随机子轨迹框架，揭示了双量子点系统中热力学流与子轨迹时间之间的复杂关联，并展示了不同输运观测量（电荷流、动力学活性、熵产生）的平均值与噪声特性如何受成功与失败事件之间的权衡影响；同时通过热力学-动力学不确定关系，指出电流精度在不同参数区域分别受熵产生或动力学活性的基本约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用随机子轨迹框架，揭示了双量子点系统中热力学流与子轨迹时间之间的复杂关联，并展示了不同输运观测量（电荷流、动力学活性、熵产生）的平均值与噪声特性如何受成功与失败事件之间的权衡影响；同时通过热力学-动力学不确定关系，指出电流精度在不同参数区域分别受熵产生或动力学活性的基本约束。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机子轨迹（stochastic excursions）形式论，该框架扩展了全计数统计，通过将复杂轨迹过滤为子轨迹来研究观测量（如电荷流、动力学活性、熵产生）的统计性质，并引入状态观测量（依赖于访问态而非跃迁本身）分析双量子点布居及其关联。

papers.title: Interpretable Computer Vision for Defect Detection in X-ray Tomography of Aerospace SiC/SiC Composites
papers.abstract: Non-destructive testing of aerospace SiC/SiC composites via X-ray computed tomography (XCT) relies on expert visual assessment, with current workflows offering limited traceability for accept/reject decisions. Deep convolutional networks can automate defect detection, yet their black-box nature conflicts with the transparency that industrial inspection practice demands. To close this gap, we introduce p-ResNet-50, a convolutional framework extended with a prototype layer that couples high detection accuracy with case-based explanations. Six learned prototypes are explicitly aligned with expert-defined semantic categories-healthy matrix, matrix--air interfaces, pores, line-like defects, and mixed morphologies-so that every classification is traceable to a physically meaningful reference. Two novel regularisation terms, anchor-based and medoid-based, tether prototypes to expert-selected patches and prevent prototype collapse, addressing a known limitation of prototype networks. Latent-space analysis via UMAP delineates semantically coherent sub-domains and maps zones of uncertainty where misclassifications concentrate, giving inspectors an explicit picture of where the model is-and is not-reliable. The framework is validated on an XCT patch dataset of approximately 12,000 patches extracted from four defect-rich SiC/SiC laboratory specimens. Taking a black-box ResNet-50 as a baseline (ROC-AUC = 0.991), the prototype extension achieves comparable performance (accuracy 0.957 vs. 0.959; ROC-AUC 0.994 vs. 0.993) while trading a slight reduction in sensitivity for higher precision and specificity. Each decision is backed by representative evidence patches, and the model explicitly flags its uncertainty regions. Beyond defect mapping, the framework establishes a reusable methodology for embedding domain-expert knowledge into prototype networks, applicable to other XCT inspection scenarios requiring traceable, auditable decisions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：X-ray computed tomography (XCT)、defect detection、validation on XCT patch dataset）；研究对象：航空用SiC/SiC复合材料（陶瓷基复合材料）中的缺陷检测，具体涉及X射线断层扫描图像中的缺陷类型（如孔隙、线状缺陷、混合形貌等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入原型层（prototype layer）的卷积神经网络p-ResNet-50在保持与黑箱ResNet-50相当检测精度（准确率0.957 vs 0.959；ROC-AUC 0.994 vs 0.993）的同时，实现了可解释的缺陷检测，每个分类决策均可追溯至物理有意义的参考原型，并明确标出模型的不确定区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入原型层（prototype layer）的卷积神经网络p-ResNet-50在保持与黑箱ResNet-50相当检测精度（准确率0.957 vs 0.959；ROC-AUC 0.994 vs 0.993）的同时，实现了可解释的缺陷检测，每个分类决策均可追溯至物理有意义的参考原型，并明确标出模型的不确定区域。；创新点：将原型网络应用于工业XCT缺陷检测，通过锚定专家定义语义类别（健康基体、基体-空气界面、孔隙、线状缺陷、混合形貌）实现可追溯决策，并引入两种正则化项解决原型网络的原型坍缩问题，同时明确量化模型的不确定性区域。
papers.method_zh: 使用扩展了原型层的卷积神经网络p-ResNet-50，结合两种新型正则化项（anchor-based和medoid-based）防止原型坍缩；通过UMAP进行潜在空间分析；在约12,000个XCT图像块数据集上验证，以黑箱ResNet-50为基线对比性能。

papers.title: Concurrent enforcement of polyconvexity and true-stress-true-strain monotonicity in incompressible isotropic hyperelasticity: application to neural network constitutive models
papers.abstract: The design of physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs) for the purposes of constitutive modeling has received considerable attention as of late for a variety of material behaviors. Here, we revisit the classical framework of isotropic incompressible hyperelasticity in light of recent advances in the study of constitutive inequalities. We show that polyconvexity implies true-stress-true-strain monotonicity for a large class of incompressible strain-energy functions. The resulting elastic law obeys the physically reasonable Legendre-Hadamard (or ellipticity) condition as well as the notion of increasing stress with increasing strain. These results then inform the architecture of four distinct PANNs which are subsequently calibrated to three different sets of experimental data each. We show that different PANN parametrizations - satisfying the same constitutive constraints a priori - have varying approximation power for the description of material behavior. Moreover, even when distinct parametrizations perform comparatively well within the calibration regime, they show pronounced differences in extrapolation. This observation motivates a critical discussion about the predictive power of PANNs which also has implications for the modeling of more complex material behavior by virtue of neural networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：constitutive inequalities、polyconvexity、neural network constitutive models）；研究对象：不可压缩各向同性超弹性材料，以及基于物理增强神经网络（PANNs）的本构建模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一大类不可压缩应变能函数，多凸性（polyconvexity）蕴含真应力-真应变单调性，从而同时满足Legendre-Hadamard条件（椭圆性）和应力随应变增加的性质；不同PANNs参数化在满足相同本构约束时，对材料行为的逼近能力和外推预测能力存在显著差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一大类不可压缩应变能函数，多凸性（polyconvexity）蕴含真应力-真应变单调性，从而同时满足Legendre-Hadamard条件（椭圆性）和应力随应变增加的性质；不同PANNs参数化在满足相同本构约束时，对材料行为的逼近能力和外推预测能力存在显著差异。；创新点：将经典的本构不等式（多凸性、单调性）系统性地引入PANNs架构设计，并揭示了满足相同先验约束的不同参数化在逼近和外推上的差异，对神经网络本构模型的预测能力进行了批判性讨论。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（证明多凸性与真应力-真应变单调性的蕴含关系），并结合神经网络架构设计（四种不同的PANNs），用三组实验数据对网络进行标定和比较。

papers.title: Stringy T-duality on the lattice and the twisted Villain model
papers.abstract: We address the question of whether dualities formulated in continuum field theory can be realised exactly at finite lattice spacing, rather than only emerging in the infrared. In this context, we construct a lattice framework for a genuinely stringy form of T-duality. We extend the exact lattice T-duality of the compact boson to curved backgrounds with non-trivial circle fibrations, where the duality is no longer exhausted by the familiar exchange of momentum and winding, but also involves global topological data. To this end, we define the twisted Villain model, which couples the lattice fibre field to cochains encoding the bundle connection and the fibre-horizontal component of the $B$-field. We realise this structure in lattice models for several fibred backgrounds and recover the characteristic bundle-flux exchange of T-duality. Using a half-gauging procedure, we derive the associated lattice defect action and show that it defines a topological defect. This establishes that the distinctive topological features of T-duality on curved manifolds can be captured exactly in a lattice model, implying that this duality is not tied to a particular continuum representation is present in lattice-regularised models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice framework、duality、topological defect、half-gauging procedure。；研究对象：格点规范理论中的弦论T-对偶性，具体研究具有非平凡圆纤维丛的弯曲背景（如纤维化流形）上的紧致玻色子模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了“扭曲Villain模型”，证明在有限格点间距下可以精确实现弯曲流形上的弦论T-对偶性，该对偶性不仅涉及动量与缠绕模式的交换，还包含全局拓扑数据（如丛通量交换），且该对偶性在格点正则化模型中天然存在，而非仅出现在红外极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了“扭曲Villain模型”，证明在有限格点间距下可以精确实现弯曲流形上的弦论T-对偶性，该对偶性不仅涉及动量与缠绕模式的交换，还包含全局拓扑数据（如丛通量交换），且该对偶性在格点正则化模型中天然存在，而非仅出现在红外极限。；创新点：将紧致玻色子的精确格点T-对偶性推广到具有非平凡圆纤维丛的弯曲背景，首次在格点模型中实现了弯曲流形上T-对偶性的全局拓扑特征（如丛通量交换），表明该对偶性并非连续场论所独有。
papers.method_zh: 采用格点场论方法，定义扭曲Villain模型，将格点纤维场与表示丛联络和B场纤维-水平分量的上链耦合；通过半规范固定（half-gauging）程序推导格点缺陷作用量，并证明其定义了一个拓扑缺陷。

papers.title: Accelerated "on-the-fly" coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics: Impact of nuclear quantum effects on an asymmetric proton
papers.abstract: We present an accelerated ``on-the-fly'' coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) method for finite-temperature simulations in which electron correlation and nuclear quantum effects are treated simultaneously. The approach is based on our quantum ring-polymer contraction (qRPC) technique, in which the inexpensive Hartree-Fock potential is evaluated on the full ring-polymer, while the expensive coupled-cluster correction is evaluated on the centroid only. This qRPC decomposition is combined with a second-generation Car-Parrinello-like dynamics of the Hartree-Fock reference and a basis-consistent extrapolation of the coupled-cluster and de-excitation amplitudes. The combination of all three acceleration layers is essential for making correlated PIMD calculations feasible. We apply the method to a proton shared by water and formaldehyde. Relative to classical nuclei, nuclear quantum effects broaden covalent X--H bond-length distributions, reduce the bias of the shared proton toward formaldehyde, and shift the mean proton-transfer coordinate from 0.206 to 0.135A. The probability of finding the proton closer to formaldehyde decreases from 81.7$\%$ to 61.1$\%$. The corresponding nuclear magnetic shielding tensors show that electron correlation and nuclear quantum effects are of comparable magnitude and can act in opposite directions. These results demonstrate that predictive simulations of asymmetric hydrogen bonds require a simultaneous treatment of correlated electronic structure and nuclear quantum fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD)、finite-temperature simulations、on-the-fly。；研究对象：一个由水和甲醛共享的不对称质子（asymmetric proton）体系，具体研究该氢键体系中核量子效应对质子行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 核量子效应会拓宽共价X-H键长分布，降低共享质子偏向甲醛的倾向，使平均质子转移坐标从0.206 Å移至0.135 Å，质子更靠近甲醛的概率从81.7%降至61.1%。电子关联与核量子效应大小相当且可能方向相反，因此对不对称氢键的预测性模拟必须同时处理两者。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：核量子效应会拓宽共价X-H键长分布，降低共享质子偏向甲醛的倾向，使平均质子转移坐标从0.206 Å移至0.135 Å，质子更靠近甲醛的概率从81.7%降至61.1%。电子关联与核量子效应大小相当且可能方向相反，因此对不对称氢键的预测性模拟必须同时处理两者。；创新点：通过三重加速策略（qRPC分解、类Car-Parrinello动力学、基组一致外推）首次实现了“即时”耦合簇级别的路径积分分子动力学模拟，使得在有限温度下同时处理电子关联和核量子效应成为可能，并应用于实际的不对称质子转移体系。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种加速的“即时”耦合簇路径积分分子动力学（accelerated “on-the-fly” coupled-cluster PIMD）方法。该方法基于量子环聚合物收缩（qRPC）技术：在完整环聚合物上计算廉价的Hartree-Fock势，仅在质心上计算昂贵的耦合簇修正。同时结合了第二代类Car-Parrinello动力学处理Hartree-Fock参考态，以及基组一致的耦合簇和去激发振幅外推。三个加速层共同使关联PIMD计算变得可行。

papers.title: Spin Hall effect and Berry curvature of gravitons from quantum field theory
papers.abstract: Based on quantum field theory of linearized gravity, we formulate the Wigner function for right- and left-handed gravitons. By applying the Wigner transformation to the second-order metric perturbations in the graviton energy-momentum tensor obtained from the Einstein-Hilbert action, we demonstrate the emergence of the spin Hall effect of gravitons in curved spacetime. This effect originates from the Berry curvature of gravitons, which has opposite signs for right- and left-handed helicities, and leads to a helicity-dependent splitting of the graviton energy Hall current. The magnitude of this splitting is found to be exactly twice that of the corresponding spin Hall current for photons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum field theory（量子场论）、Wigner function（维格纳函数）、formulate（构建理论框架）。；研究对象：引力子的自旋霍尔效应及其贝里曲率，具体为在弯曲时空中传播的右旋与左旋引力子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引力子在弯曲时空中会出现自旋霍尔效应，该效应源于引力子具有相反符号的贝里曲率，导致引力子能量霍尔电流发生依赖于螺旋度的分裂，且分裂幅度恰好是光子对应自旋霍尔电流的两倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引力子在弯曲时空中会出现自旋霍尔效应，该效应源于引力子具有相反符号的贝里曲率，导致引力子能量霍尔电流发生依赖于螺旋度的分裂，且分裂幅度恰好是光子对应自旋霍尔电流的两倍。；创新点：首次从量子场论框架出发，严格证明了引力子自旋霍尔效应的存在，并定量给出其与光子自旋霍尔效应的倍数关系（2倍）。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化引力的量子场论，构建了右旋与左旋引力子的维格纳函数；通过对爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量导出的引力子能量-动量张量中的二阶度规扰动进行维格纳变换，推导出弯曲时空中的自旋霍尔效应。

papers.title: Engineering Tunable Synthetic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Chains in Liquid Crystal Microcavities
papers.abstract: Optical microcavities have emerged as a powerful platform for emulating topological phases challenging to realize in conventional materials, offering precise control over dispersion, light confinement, and interactions. Among them, liquid crystal microcavities (LCMCs) offer exceptional tunability at room temperature, enabling voltage-controlled polarisation splitting, photonic spin-orbit coupling, and photonic potentials generated by self-assembled textures, such as cholesteric torons and uniform lying helix (ULH). Here, we design a LCMC hosting a dimerized ULH texture and show that the corresponding photonic potential describes two coupled Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chains with orthogonal linear polarisations, acting as an effective pseudospin degree of freedom. The applied voltage tunes the interchain coupling, enabling polarisation-dependent interactions. These results establish LCMCs as a versatile platform for tunable synthetic topological Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：design、show、results establish）；研究对象：液晶微腔中可调谐的合成Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，具体为二聚化均匀躺卧螺旋（ULH）织构中的光子势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在液晶微腔中设计了一种二聚化ULH织构，其对应的光子势可描述为两条具有正交线偏振（作为有效赝自旋自由度）的耦合SSH链，且外加电压可调控链间耦合，实现偏振依赖的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在液晶微腔中设计了一种二聚化ULH织构，其对应的光子势可描述为两条具有正交线偏振（作为有效赝自旋自由度）的耦合SSH链，且外加电压可调控链间耦合，实现偏振依赖的相互作用。；创新点：首次在液晶微腔中实现可调谐的合成SSH链，并利用偏振作为赝自旋自由度，通过电压调控链间耦合，为可调谐合成拓扑哈密顿量提供了通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 通过设计液晶微腔中的二聚化ULH织构，利用电压控制偏振分裂、光子自旋-轨道耦合及自组装织构（如胆甾相环和ULH）产生的光子势，实验构建并调控合成拓扑哈密顿量。

papers.title: Near-Field Vibrational Energy Transfer for Mid-Infrared Upconversion in Plasmonic Nanogaps
papers.abstract: Förster energy transfer underpins modern photonics, yet establishing an analogous vibrational pathway in the mid-infrared (MIR) remains highly challenging, as sub-picosecond intramolecular vibrational redistribution (IVR) suppresses intermolecular coupling. Here we demonstrate vibrational donor--acceptor transfer in the MIR and subsequent upconversion to visible luminescence enabled by sub-2 nm plasmonic nanogaps. The extreme lateral field confinement in metal--molecule--metal ring cavities defined by self-assembled molecular spacers couples efficiently to in-plane molecular dipoles. Continuous-wave MIR excitation selectively populates $-\mathrm{C}\equiv\mathrm{N}$ vibrational donors, and plasmon-enhanced near-field coupling transfers this energy to nearby electronic acceptors, generating anti-Stokes visible emission under low power densities. Upconversion efficiencies exceeding $0.3\%$ are observed, limited by competition between the plasmon-mediated transfer rate and IVR. These results show that extreme plasmonic confinement can redirect molecular vibrational relaxation pathways, opening a route toward vibrational nanophotonics, intermolecular interactions for bioimaging, and room-temperature MIR detection based on molecular degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验观测结果（如“demonstrate vibrational donor–acceptor transfer”“generating anti-Stokes visible emission”“Upconversion efficiencies exceeding 0.3% are observed”），并涉及具体实验结构（plasmonic nanogaps、metal–molecule–metal ring cavities）。；研究对象：基于等离激元纳米间隙的中红外（MIR）振动能量转移与上转换现象，具体体系为金属-分子-金属环形腔中自组装分子间隔层所定义的亚2纳米间隙，涉及-C≡N振动供体与电子受体之间的能量转移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙中，实现了中红外振动供体-受体间的能量转移，并进一步上转换为可见光发光，上转换效率超过0.3%。该过程受等离激元介导的转移速率与分子内振动再分布（IVR）之间的竞争限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙中，实现了中红外振动供体-受体间的能量转移，并进一步上转换为可见光发光，上转换效率超过0.3%。该过程受等离激元介导的转移速率与分子内振动再分布（IVR）之间的竞争限制。；创新点：首次在分子振动层面实现中红外Förster型能量转移，并利用极端等离激元局域场重新定向分子振动弛豫路径，克服了亚皮秒级分子内振动再分布对分子间耦合的抑制。
papers.method_zh: 采用自组装分子间隔层构建金属-分子-金属环形腔，形成亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙；利用连续波中红外激光选择性激发-C≡N振动供体；通过等离激元增强的近场耦合实现能量转移，并测量反斯托克斯可见发光。

papers.title: Universal logic gates for coupled period-doubling systems
papers.abstract: We propose a general architecture for universal logic operations using NAND and NOR gates on classical information encoded in period-doubled states of periodically-driven systems. The protocol involves applying a single pulse that simultaneously couple two input nodes with an output node. We show that the states of the nodes can be precisely controlled by tuning the coupling strength and pulse duration, allowing for robust logic gate operation. To highlight the universality of the protocol, we demonstrate its applicability on different systems, such as classical networks of dissi- pative parametric oscillators (DPO), quantum networks of Kerr parametric oscillators (KPO), and the periodically-driven open Dicke lattice model (DLM) emulating discrete time crystals (DTCs). We identify the parameter regimes in which the logic gate architecture is valid, and we showcase its robustness in the presence of fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出通用架构和协议，并通过理论分析展示不同系统（DPO、KPO、DLM）的适用性，未提及具体实验操作或数值计算细节。；研究对象：周期驱动系统中倍频态（period-doubled states）编码的经典信息，具体体系包括：耗散参量振荡器（DPO）经典网络、Kerr参量振荡器（KPO）量子网络、以及模拟离散时间晶体（DTCs）的周期驱动开放Dicke晶格模型（DLM）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时耦合两个输入节点与一个输出节点的单脉冲，并调节耦合强度和脉冲持续时间，可在倍频态上实现NAND和NOR通用逻辑门操作，且该架构对涨落具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时耦合两个输入节点与一个输出节点的单脉冲，并调节耦合强度和脉冲持续时间，可在倍频态上实现NAND和NOR通用逻辑门操作，且该架构对涨落具有鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于周期驱动系统的倍频态，通过单脉冲耦合节点，分析耦合强度与脉冲持续时间对节点状态的控制，并识别逻辑门有效的参数区间。

papers.title: Ultrafast Nano-Imaging and Optical Control of Hyperbolic Phonon Polaritons at hBN/WS$_2$ Heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Manipulating nanoscale light-matter interactions on ultrafast time scales is indispensable for future polaritonic devices. Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in van der Waals materials enable deep subwavelength confinement of electromagnetic fields in the infrared region and long-distance propagation of polaritonic waves. However, achieving ultrafast imaging and optical control of HPhPs remains a major challenge. Here, we demonstrate the direct observation of transient modulation of HPhPs induced by local photocarrier generation in WS$_2$/hBN heterostructures using ultrafast infrared scanning near-field optical microscopy. We implement grating-based spectral filtering of broadband near-field scattering to simultaneously achieve nanoscale and femtosecond spatiotemporal resolution together with fine spectral selectivity. This ultrafast nano-imaging technique reveals that photocarriers in WS$_2$ modulate the polaritonic field amplitudes and wavelengths of HPhPs in hBN. Theoretical simulations corroborate that these changes arise from photoinduced changes in WS$_2$ dielectric properties. This approach offers a versatile platform for exploring ultrafast polaritonic dynamics at the nanoscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：ultrafast infrared scanning near-field optical microscopy（超快红外扫描近场光学显微镜）、direct observation（直接观测）、theoretical simulations（理论模拟辅助）。；研究对象：WS₂/hBN 异质结中的双曲声子极化激元（HPhPs），具体研究光生载流子对 hBN 中 HPhPs 的瞬态调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用超快红外近场光学显微镜，直接观测到 WS₂ 层中光生载流子对 hBN 中双曲声子极化激元的场振幅和波长的瞬态调制，证实该调制源于 WS₂ 介电性质的光致变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用超快红外近场光学显微镜，直接观测到 WS₂ 层中光生载流子对 hBN 中双曲声子极化激元的场振幅和波长的瞬态调制，证实该调制源于 WS₂ 介电性质的光致变化。；创新点：首次实现了对双曲声子极化激元的超快成像与光学控制，克服了此前无法同时获得纳米空间、飞秒时间分辨及光谱选择性的技术瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 超快红外扫描近场光学显微镜（ultrafast infrared scanning near-field optical microscopy），结合基于光栅的宽带近场散射光谱滤波（grating-based spectral filtering of broadband near-field scattering），实现纳米级空间分辨率、飞秒级时间分辨率及精细光谱选择性。理论模拟用于验证实验结果。

papers.title: Prebiotic magnetite enables chirality-magnetic surface feedback
papers.abstract: The emergence of biomolecular homochirality requires both an initial symmetry-breaking event and a mechanism to amplify and preserve a chiral imbalance. Magnetic minerals have been shown to function as chiral agents through the chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect and may have enabled homochirality on early Earth, yet the magnetic properties of magnetite formed under realistic prebiotic conditions remain unexplored. Here we show that magnetite synthesized through two geochemically plausible pathways - UV-driven photo-oxidation and nitrite-mediated oxidation of Fe(II) - produces particles dominated by single-vortex and multi-vortex magnetic domain states. Magnetic measurements and electron microscopy confirm that these populations differ markedly from the nano-fabricated thin-film substrates conventionally used in previous CISS experiments. Using 3D micromagnetic simulations, we demonstrate that single-domain and vortex-state grains undergo irreversible, exchange-driven re-magnetization when interacting with spin-polarized homochiral compounds. This magnetic irreversibility provides a robust mechanism for storing and reinforcing weak chiral bias, suggesting that prebiotic magnetite could have contributed to the emergence and stabilization of persistent chiral bias on the early Earth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。关键词：synthesized（合成）、magnetic measurements（磁性测量）、electron microscopy（电子显微镜）、3D micromagnetic simulations（三维微磁模拟）。；研究对象：前生物条件下合成的磁铁矿（magnetite）及其与手性分子相互作用产生的磁性-手性表面反馈机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两种前生物地球化学途径合成的磁铁矿颗粒主要处于单涡旋和多涡旋磁畴态，其与自旋极化手性化合物相互作用时会发生不可逆的交换驱动再磁化，从而为存储和增强弱手性偏差提供稳健机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两种前生物地球化学途径合成的磁铁矿颗粒主要处于单涡旋和多涡旋磁畴态，其与自旋极化手性化合物相互作用时会发生不可逆的交换驱动再磁化，从而为存储和增强弱手性偏差提供稳健机制。；创新点：首次研究了在真实前生物条件下合成的磁铁矿（而非传统纳米制备薄膜）的磁畴结构，并揭示了其通过不可逆再磁化过程放大和稳定早期地球手性偏差的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用紫外驱动光氧化和亚硝酸盐介导氧化两种地球化学途径合成磁铁矿，并使用磁性测量和电子显微镜表征颗粒的磁畴态；计算上采用三维微磁模拟研究单畴和涡旋态颗粒与自旋极化手性化合物相互作用时的磁化行为。

papers.title: Subsystem relaxation and a calibrated sampling diagnostic for programmable quantum annealers
papers.abstract: Programmable quantum annealers are used as open-system samplers, but it is unclear when reverse annealing erases preparation memory and what the readout represents. Here we implement a subsystem-environment protocol on two D-Wave quantum annealers, varying environment size, coupling, disorder, preparation, geometry and QPU generation. A six-qubit subsystem becomes initial-state independent when the environment is large or strongly coupled, while quenched disorder and atypical environment states arrest relaxation. Pairing the memory order parameter with the distance to a calibrated conditional-Boltzmann reference yields a diagnostic that flags rare wrong-basin trapping memory loss alone misses; memory-retaining conditions stay far from the reference (median 0.35). Relaxed ferromagnetic readouts are near-deterministic, so small distances there are a consistency check, not a thermometric test. In a mixed-frustration benchmark, the local-update model practitioners assume mispredicts QPU relaxation roughly sevenfold, whereas non-local classical sampling recovers it. We provide a subsystem-level validation protocol for quantum-annealer sampling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：implement on two D-Wave quantum annealers, varying environment size, coupling, disorder, preparation, geometry and QPU generation）；研究对象：可编程量子退火器中的子系统弛豫行为，具体为D-Wave量子退火器上六量子比特子系统在开放系统采样中的初始态记忆擦除与读出表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当环境足够大或耦合强时，六量子比特子系统变得与初始态无关；淬火无序和非典型环境态会阻止弛豫。通过记忆序参量与校准条件玻尔兹曼参考的距离，可诊断出仅靠记忆丢失无法发现的罕见错误阱捕获。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当环境足够大或耦合强时，六量子比特子系统变得与初始态无关；淬火无序和非典型环境态会阻止弛豫。通过记忆序参量与校准条件玻尔兹曼参考的距离，可诊断出仅靠记忆丢失无法发现的罕见错误阱捕获。；创新点：提出了一个子系统级别的验证协议，用于诊断量子退火器采样是否真正弛豫，并揭示了局部更新模型对QPU弛豫的预测偏差约七倍，而非局域经典采样能恢复实际行为。
papers.method_zh: 在两种D-Wave量子退火器上实施子系统-环境协议，系统改变环境大小、耦合强度、无序程度、初始态制备、几何构型及量子处理单元（QPU）代次；使用记忆序参量和校准条件玻尔兹曼参考距离作为诊断工具；对比局部更新模型与非局域经典采样的预测结果。

papers.title: Translation-invariant quantum low-density parity-check codes from compactified fracton models
papers.abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes with translation symmetry and local checks have been studied extensively, leading to a wide variety of fracton codes in three or more dimensions which lack a complete unifying picture. Recently, the study of translation-invariant codes with long-range checks has revealed impressive performance for small fixed-size instances in two dimensions. Here, we provide a unifying picture for a large family of translation-invariant codes, both local and long-range, that captures many fracton codes and all Abelian Two-Block Group Algebra (A2BGA) codes, including the Bivariate Bicycle (BB) codes. The balanced product structure of A2BGA codes leads to a local parent code that is a hypergraph product fracton model in a higher dimension. Different compactifications of a parent code produce a wide variety of descendant codes which provides a unifying picture for their properties. In particular, all BB codes with the same check weight are derived from a single parent hypergraph product fracton model. This construction allows us to extend Wang and Pryadko's code-parameter bounds for Generalized Bicycle codes to A2BGA codes. We conjecture that the transversal gates and energy barriers of the translation-invariant descendant codes are limited by those of their parent fracton models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：translation-invariant codes、fracton models、balanced product、compactifications。；研究对象：量子纠错码，具体为具有平移不变性的量子低密度奇偶校验码（LDPC码），包括分形子码（fracton codes）和阿贝尔双块群代数（A2BGA）码（如双变量自行车（BB）码）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过平衡积结构，所有A2BGA码（包括BB码）可以统一地视为一个高维超图积分形子模型的紧致化（compactification）后代，从而为一大类平移不变码（包括局域和长程校验码）提供了统一的理论框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过平衡积结构，所有A2BGA码（包括BB码）可以统一地视为一个高维超图积分形子模型的紧致化（compactification）后代，从而为一大类平移不变码（包括局域和长程校验码）提供了统一的理论框架。；创新点：首次将A2BGA码（包括BB码）与高维分形子模型通过紧致化建立统一联系，揭示了不同平移不变码之间的结构关联，并推广了码参数界限。摘要未明确说明是否首次提出该统一图像，但明确给出了这一新构造。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与数学分析：利用平衡积（balanced product）结构将A2BGA码映射到高维超图积（hypergraph product）分形子模型，并通过不同紧致化方式生成后代码；将广义自行车码的码参数界限推广至A2BGA码。

papers.title: Floquet-Engineered Odd-Parity Altermagnetic Higher-Order Topology in a Two-Dimensional Antiferromagnet Cr$_2$CH$_2$
papers.abstract: Periodic driving provides a platform to dynamically tailor quantum states of matter, yet its impact on symmetry-protected topological phases remains incompletely understood. Here, we demonstrate that periodic driving enables the realization of an odd-parity altermagnetic (AM) higher-order topological insulator (HOTI) phase in the Cr$_2$CH$_2$ monolayer. In equilibrium, Cr$_2$CH$_2$ is a 2D antiferromagnetic (AFM) HOTI protected by $\mathcal C_3$ rotational symmetry, characterized by a symmetry indicator $χ^{(3)}$ = $\{-2,1\}$ and robust corner states. Under circularly polarized light (CPL), the system develops a f-wave altermagnetic state governed by the symmetry $[C_{2}||\overline{3}_{001}]$ with odd-parity spin splitting. Despite substantial Floquet-induced band renormalization, the $\mathcal C_3$-protected corner states remain intact over a broad range of driving strengths, highlighting the altermagnetic higher-order topology under Floquet driving. As the light intensity increases, the system gradually evolves into an altermagnetic semimetallic state. These results establish a direct connection between magnetism and topology in a periodically driven AFM system, offering a route toward the control of coupled spin and topological transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、realization、characterized by symmetry indicator、Floquet driving、band renormalization）；研究对象：二维反铁磁单层材料 Cr₂CH₂ 中的 Floquet 工程化奇宇称交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在圆偏振光驱动下，Cr₂CH₂ 单层从平衡态的反铁磁高阶拓扑绝缘体转变为具有奇宇称自旋劈裂的 f 波交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体，且 C₃ 旋转对称性保护的角态在较宽驱动强度范围内保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在圆偏振光驱动下，Cr₂CH₂ 单层从平衡态的反铁磁高阶拓扑绝缘体转变为具有奇宇称自旋劈裂的 f 波交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体，且 C₃ 旋转对称性保护的角态在较宽驱动强度范围内保持稳定。；创新点：首次在周期性驱动的反铁磁体系中实现奇宇称交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体，建立了光驱动下磁性与拓扑之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性指标分析（χ⁽³⁾ = {-2,1}）和 Floquet 能带重整化理论，通过圆偏振光周期性驱动实现非平衡态拓扑相变。

papers.title: Importance of nuclear quantum effects on the structure of supercooled water around its liquid--liquid critical point
papers.abstract: Supercooled water is expected to exhibit a liquid--liquid phase transition between low- and high-density liquid states, possibly terminating in a liquid--liquid critical point in the experimentally difficult no man's land. Because the hydrogen atoms are light, nuclear quantum effects (NQE) may alter the structural signatures used to identify this transition. Here, we compare classical molecular dynamics and path-integral molecular dynamics simulations of a flexible q-TIP4P/F-like water model in the deeply supercooled regime. The classical simulations show a pronounced density change at 180 K between 180 and 220 MPa, whereas the path-integral simulations exhibit a smoother pressure dependence. Radial distribution functions and bond-order parameters show that NQE broaden pair correlations, reduce the tetrahedral order of the first hydration shell, and slightly increase the Steinhardt $Q_6$ parameter. These results demonstrate that NQE modify both low- and high-density liquid structures and therefore need to be included when interpreting structural signatures of the liquid--liquid transition in supercooled water.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations、path-integral molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：过冷水在液-液临界点附近的结构，特别是核量子效应对低密度和高密度液体结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 核量子效应会显著改变过冷水中用于识别液-液相变的结构特征，包括展宽对关联函数、降低第一水合层的四面体有序度，并略微增加Steinhardt Q₆参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：核量子效应会显著改变过冷水中用于识别液-液相变的结构特征，包括展宽对关联函数、降低第一水合层的四面体有序度，并略微增加Steinhardt Q₆参数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典分子动力学和路径积分分子动力学模拟，使用类q-TIP4P/F的柔性水模型，在深度过冷条件下进行比较研究。

papers.title: On the single field formulation in magnetostatics
papers.abstract: We systematically discuss the equivalence of two variational formulations of magnetostatics, in terms of magnetization and magnetic field on the one hand and the single field formulation using only magnetic induction. To demonstrate that this link is stable also when the magnetic laws are coupled with other variational static models, elasticity is included in the models as well. Interestingly, despite the fact that the corresponding magnetoelastic energy densities in the material can be computed via Legendre-Fenchel transform in the magnetic state variables, the two formulations are not linked by standard convex duality on the level of the functionals. In addition, convexity and coercivity of the given functional are neither required for the transformation nor always preserved by it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确讨论“变分公式的等价性”、“Legendre-Fenchel变换”、“凸对偶”等理论框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：静磁学中的变分公式，特别是以磁化强度与磁场为变量的公式与仅用磁感应强度的单场公式之间的等价性，并进一步将弹性力学耦合进模型，研究磁弹耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管磁弹能量密度可通过Legendre-Fenchel变换在磁状态变量间相互转换，但两种变分公式在泛函层面上并不通过标准的凸对偶性相联系；此外，给定泛函的凸性和强制性既不是变换的必要条件，也不一定在变换后得以保持。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管磁弹能量密度可通过Legendre-Fenchel变换在磁状态变量间相互转换，但两种变分公式在泛函层面上并不通过标准的凸对偶性相联系；此外，给定泛函的凸性和强制性既不是变换的必要条件，也不一定在变换后得以保持。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过变分法、Legendre-Fenchel变换以及凸分析工具，系统比较两种静磁学变分公式的等价性，并引入弹性力学模型进行耦合分析。

papers.title: Spectral fringes without subcycles in Schwinger pair production and Dirac materials
papers.abstract: Spectral fringes in Schwinger pair creation are usually attributed to structured driving, such as carrier oscillations, pulse trains, or multiple creation events. We show that pronounced fringes can arise even for smooth, carrier-free single-lobe electric-field pulses. Two bell-shaped profiles that are nearly indistinguishable in real time - a Gaussian pulse and a weakly deformed variant - produce qualitatively different longitudinal momentum spectra in the nonadiabatic crossover: the Gaussian spectrum remains smooth, whereas the deformed pulse develops strong fringes as the Keldysh parameter approaches unity. Exact numerical solutions in scalar and spinor QED agree with a semiclassical turning-point analysis and trace the effect to a turning-point dominance transition, where the leading saddle becomes irrelevant and subleading contributions interfere. We demonstrate the same mechanism in a solid-state Schwinger analog described by a gapped two-dimensional Dirac model relevant to epitaxial graphene on SiC, and discuss an energy-resolved pump-probe route to observing the predicted modulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“半经典转折点分析”“精确数值解”“标量和旋量QED”，以及“固体施温格模拟”的理论模型。；研究对象：施温格电子-正电子对产生过程中的光谱条纹现象，以及固体中类似施温格效应的二维狄拉克材料（如外延石墨烯/SiC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使使用平滑、无载波振荡的单瓣电场脉冲（如高斯脉冲），在非绝热交叉区域（凯尔迪什参数接近1）也能产生显著的光谱条纹；该条纹源于转折点主导性转变，即主鞍点失效后次主导贡献之间的干涉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使使用平滑、无载波振荡的单瓣电场脉冲（如高斯脉冲），在非绝热交叉区域（凯尔迪什参数接近1）也能产生显著的光谱条纹；该条纹源于转折点主导性转变，即主鞍点失效后次主导贡献之间的干涉。；创新点：推翻了“光谱条纹必须由结构化驱动（如载波振荡、脉冲序列或多产生事件）引起”的普遍认知，揭示了平滑单瓣脉冲在特定非绝热条件下也能产生条纹的新机制，并在固体狄拉克材料中验证了该机制的可观测性。
papers.method_zh: 采用标量和旋量量子电动力学（QED）的精确数值解，结合半经典转折点分析方法；在固体模拟中，使用带隙的二维狄拉克模型（适用于SiC上外延石墨烯）进行数值求解。

papers.title: Informational blueprints reveal condition-dependent gene regulatory architectures
papers.abstract: While coding regions in the genome have a direct interpretation in terms of protein products, significant fractions are non-coding and yet control essential biological functions. Unlike the genetic code, there is no "lookup table" that identifies where regulatory proteins, known as transcription factors (TFs), bind. Here, we extract these binding sites by distilling sequences of nucleotide letters into collective coordinates (hyperletters) representing the binding sites that are active under specific environmental conditions. Going beyond local information footprints between individual bases and expression levels, our $\textit{information blueprint}$ algorithm compresses the global information by optimising filters that simultaneously scan an entire promoter sequence. Inspired by renormalisation-group techniques, we identify TF binding sites as coarse-grained variables combining groups of correlated mutations with the highest collective impact on gene expression. We validate our approach on experimental data for $\textit{E. coli}$ and discover novel regulatory elements illustrating its deployment at scale across growth conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：algorithm（算法）、coarse-grained variables（粗粒化变量）、renormalisation-group techniques（重正化群技术）。；研究对象：基因调控序列，具体为大肠杆菌（E. coli）中转录因子（TF）的结合位点，以及这些位点在不同环境条件下的活性变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“信息蓝图”（information blueprint）的算法，能够从DNA序列中提取出在特定环境条件下活跃的转录因子结合位点，并发现这些位点作为粗粒化变量对基因表达具有最高的集体影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“信息蓝图”（information blueprint）的算法，能够从DNA序列中提取出在特定环境条件下活跃的转录因子结合位点，并发现这些位点作为粗粒化变量对基因表达具有最高的集体影响。；创新点：超越了传统的基于单个碱基与表达水平之间局部信息足迹的方法，首次实现了对全局信息的压缩，并利用粗粒化变量（结合位点）来捕捉多个相关突变对基因表达的集体影响。摘要未突出说明与已有重正化群方法在生物信息学中的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用受重正化群技术启发的信息压缩算法，通过优化滤波器同时扫描整个启动子序列，将核苷酸字母序列蒸馏为集体坐标（超字母），从而识别转录因子结合位点。

papers.title: Collective excitations in quantum gravity condensates
papers.abstract: A central open problem in quantum gravity is to understand how continuum spacetime emerges from quantum-geometric degrees of freedom in a background-independent setting. A many-body perspective suggests that spacetime emerges as a hydrodynamic phase of many atoms of quantum geometry. This idea underlies several approaches to quantum gravity, and it has been explicitly realised in the group field theory formalism. However, quantum fluctuations beyond the mean-field regime remain largely unexplored. We fill this gap by importing Bogolyubov theory to quantum gravity condensates, showing that leading beyond-mean-field effects manifest as collective excitations, in direct analogy with phonons in laboratory BECs. We implement the construction in a tractable group field theory model, where condensates of quantum-geometric atoms reproduce nonsingular expanding cosmologies, and derive the leading beyond-mean-field corrections to the emergent Friedmann dynamics. These results identify a new class of quantum-gravity excitations and establish a controlled bridge between microscopic quantum-gravitational dynamics, many-body collective phenomena, and signatures of spacetime emergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bogolyubov理论、群场论、平均场近似。；研究对象：量子引力凝聚体中的集体激发，以及由此产生的时空涌现现象。具体体系为群场论框架下的量子几何原子凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将Bogolyubov理论引入量子引力凝聚体，发现超越平均场的主要效应表现为集体激发，与实验室玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的声子直接类似。这些激发对涌现的弗里德曼宇宙学动力学产生了可推导的修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将Bogolyubov理论引入量子引力凝聚体，发现超越平均场的主要效应表现为集体激发，与实验室玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的声子直接类似。这些激发对涌现的弗里德曼宇宙学动力学产生了可推导的修正。；创新点：首次系统地探索了量子引力凝聚体中平均场之外的量子涨落，将其识别为一种新型的量子引力集体激发，并在微观量子引力动力学、多体集体现象与时空涌现信号之间建立了可控的桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogolyubov理论框架，在可解的群场论模型中进行计算。该模型中的量子几何原子凝聚体能够复现非奇异的膨胀宇宙学，研究在此基础上推导了超越平均场修正。

papers.title: Noise-induced Simulability Transition from Operator Scrambling
papers.abstract: The complexity of simulating quantum many-body dynamics, or quantum computations, in the Heisenberg picture is governed by the scrambling of initially simple operators into superpositions of exponentially many Pauli strings. The corresponding expansion coefficients define the Pauli spectrum, whose structure controls the performance of classical algorithms based on truncating Pauli expansions. Here we determine the finite-depth Pauli spectrum of random quantum circuits, both in the noiseless case and in the presence of local noise, through its moments, given by the operator stabilizer Rényi entropies. In noiseless circuits, we uncover a hierarchy in the approach to the fully scrambled regime: low moments equilibrate at relatively short depths, while higher moments, which are sensitive to rare, large-amplitude Pauli coefficients, require parametrically larger depths. In noisy circuits, scrambling competes with an effective suppression of operator spreading. Above a critical error per cycle $γ_c N=\mathcal{O}(1)$, the operator fails to reach the fully scrambled distribution and remains supported on an atypically sparse subset of Pauli strings. Conversely, below this scale, we rigorously show that classical simulation remains exponentially hard, demonstrating that finite noise does not automatically imply classical simulability. The resulting noise-induced transition in operator complexity therefore delineates the boundary between intrinsically hard quantum dynamics and those that remain classically accessible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要进行理论分析（“determine the Pauli spectrum”、“rigorously show”），未提及实验或具体计算模拟细节。；研究对象：量子多体动力学（或量子计算）在Heisenberg绘景下的经典模拟复杂度，具体研究随机量子电路中算符的Pauli谱（由算符稳定子Rényi熵刻画）在无噪声和有噪声情况下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无噪声电路中，Pauli谱的不同阶矩（对应不同Rényi熵）达到完全混沌（scrambled）所需的电路深度存在层级差异。在有噪声电路中，存在一个由每周期错误率γ_c N = O(1)界定的噪声诱导的相变：高于此阈值，算符无法达到完全混沌分布，经典模拟变得可行；低于此阈值，经典模拟仍然指数困难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无噪声电路中，Pauli谱的不同阶矩（对应不同Rényi熵）达到完全混沌（scrambled）所需的电路深度存在层级差异。在有噪声电路中，存在一个由每周期错误率γ_c N = O(1)界定的噪声诱导的相变：高于此阈值，算符无法达到完全混沌分布，经典模拟变得可行；低于此阈值，经典模拟仍然指数困难。；创新点：揭示了噪声诱导的算符复杂度相变，并严格证明了有限噪声并不自动意味着经典可模拟性，从而划定了本质上困难的量子动力学与经典可访问的动力学之间的边界。同时，发现了无噪声电路中不同阶矩达到混沌的不同深度标度。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算随机量子电路（无噪声和存在局域噪声）的算符稳定子Rényi熵的矩（moments），来分析有限深度下的Pauli谱结构。采用了严格的数学证明（rigorously show）来论证噪声阈值下的经典模拟复杂度。

papers.title: Bifurcation of the quasi-stationary velocity of strongly discrete transition waves driven by gravity
papers.abstract: Transition waves are common in multistable mechanical metamaterials, and the dynamics of weakly discrete transition waves under driving forces have been extensively discussed. However, as lattice effects become more pronounced, strongly discrete transition waves may exhibit dynamics that cannot be predicted by the continuum limit. Here, by tilting a bistable chain, we introduce a gravitational perturbation term into the dynamical equations, under which the transition waves are continuously accelerated. In the strongly discrete regime, we find that transition waves under gravitational driving possess quasi-stationary velocity plateaus (QSVPs), and the number of these plateaus first increases and then decreases as the tilt angle increases. We theoretically elucidate that the emergence of the velocity plateaus originates from the balance between gravitational driving and phonon radiation. In further analysis, the theoretical model reveals that the balance point undergoes a bifurcation at the radiation resonance, which leads to a change in the number of velocity plateaus. Our study extends the investigation of transition waves into the strongly discrete regime, and the emergence of multiple velocity plateaus opens up new possibilities for programmable solitary waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“theoretically elucidate”“theoretical model reveals”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：强离散双稳态机械超材料链中的过渡波，在重力驱动下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强离散体系中，重力驱动的过渡波存在准稳态速度平台，且平台数量随倾斜角增大先增后减；该现象源于重力驱动与声子辐射之间的平衡，且平衡点在辐射共振处发生分岔，导致平台数量变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强离散体系中，重力驱动的过渡波存在准稳态速度平台，且平台数量随倾斜角增大先增后减；该现象源于重力驱动与声子辐射之间的平衡，且平衡点在辐射共振处发生分岔，导致平台数量变化。；创新点：将过渡波的研究拓展到强离散区域，发现并解释了多个准稳态速度平台的存在及其分岔行为，为可编程孤子波提供了新可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：通过倾斜双稳态链引入重力扰动项，建立动力学方程；分析准稳态速度平台的出现条件，并利用辐射共振理论解释平衡点的分岔行为。

papers.title: Systematic study of one-point kinetic energy density functionals for atomic nuclei
papers.abstract: To explore the applicability of orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT) in nuclear physics, we perform a systematic benchmark of 36 one-point kinetic energy density functionals, which are originally developed for electron systems in condensed matter physics. It is found that the direct use of the original parameters for electron systems leads to inconsistent performance, with certain functionals exhibiting physically unacceptable asymptotic behaviors. However, through parameter re-optimization targeting nuclear densities, different mathematical forms of generalized gradient approximation (GGA) functionals converge to a consistent root-mean-square error of approximately 13 MeV. From a physical perspective, this consistent behavior signifies that the optimized semi-local GGAs have successfully captured the macroscopic, liquid-drop-like background of the nucleus, while the residual deviations appear as periodic oscillations at the magic numbers that could reflect the quantum shell effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT)、systematic benchmark、parameter re-optimization。；研究对象：原子核的动能密度泛函，具体为36种原本用于凝聚态物理电子系统的一点位动能密度泛函在核物理中的适用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过参数重新优化，不同数学形式的广义梯度近似（GGA）泛函在核密度目标下收敛到约13 MeV的均方根误差；优化后的半局域GGA成功捕捉了原子核的宏观液滴背景，而剩余偏差在幻数处呈现周期性振荡，反映了量子壳层效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过参数重新优化，不同数学形式的广义梯度近似（GGA）泛函在核密度目标下收敛到约13 MeV的均方根误差；优化后的半局域GGA成功捕捉了原子核的宏观液滴背景，而剩余偏差在幻数处呈现周期性振荡，反映了量子壳层效应。；创新点：将原本用于凝聚态电子系统的动能密度泛函系统性地引入核物理领域，并通过参数重优化揭示了半局域泛函在描述原子核宏观-微观结构（液滴背景+壳层振荡）中的能力与局限。
papers.method_zh: 对36种一点位动能密度泛函进行系统基准测试，直接使用原电子系统参数与针对核密度重新优化参数两种方案，比较其性能，并分析广义梯度近似（GGA）泛函的数学形式与误差行为。

papers.title: Geometric Brownian motion with intermittent entries and exits
papers.abstract: We study a generalized geometric Brownian motion framework that incorporates both entries of new units and exit mechanisms for the current population, extending earlier stochastic resetting models where these rates are treated as identical. The model captures realistic features observed in many economic observables, which can be explained as market-driven firm entries/exits, worker inflow/outflow, and income growth/loss. This model is not conservative and, despite the asymmetry in the entry and exit rates, we find that the system eventually relaxes to a stationary distribution. Moreover, our analysis reveals three distinct dynamical regimes in the moments of the distribution, arising from the interplay between volatility, drift, entry, and exit rates. We further derive the survival probability and the mean first-passage time associated with the observed variable reaching certain threshold under the competing entry-exit processes. Interestingly, we identify an optimal exit rate that minimizes the mean first-passage time, providing insights into how entry and exit policies can influence the outcome of the system. These results should be useful for understanding the long-run behavior of economic systems in which growth, volatility, entry, and exit jointly shape the evolution of heterogeneous units.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalized geometric Brownian motion framework、stochastic resetting models、analysis、derive。；研究对象：一种广义几何布朗运动模型，该模型包含新单元的进入和现有单元的退出机制，用于描述经济系统中由市场驱动的企业进入/退出、工人流入/流出、收入增长/损失等非保守过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管进入和退出速率不对称，系统最终会弛豫到平稳分布；并且存在由波动率、漂移、进入和退出速率共同决定的三个不同动力学区域；同时发现存在一个最优退出速率，可最小化平均首达时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管进入和退出速率不对称，系统最终会弛豫到平稳分布；并且存在由波动率、漂移、进入和退出速率共同决定的三个不同动力学区域；同时发现存在一个最优退出速率，可最小化平均首达时间。；创新点：扩展了早期随机重置模型中将进入和退出速率视为相同的假设，引入了非对称的进入和退出机制，并揭示了由此产生的多区域动力学行为及最优退出策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机过程理论框架，对广义几何布朗运动模型进行解析分析，推导了平稳分布、生存概率和平均首达时间等统计量。

papers.title: Can machine learning for quantum-gas experiments be explainable?
authors: I. B. Spielman amd J. P. Zwolak
papers.abstract: Virtually all aspects of many-body atomic physics are challenging: experiments are technically demanding, datasets have become enormous, and the memory and CPU requirements for classical simulation of generic quantum systems often scale exponentially with system size. Machine learning (ML) methods are already assisting in each of these areas and are poised to become transformative. Here, we focus on two specific applications of ML to cold-atom-based quantum simulators. These devices generally generate data in the form of images; we first showcase denoising of raw images and then identify solitonic waves in Bose-Einstein condensates. In both of these examples, we comment on the interplay between performance, model complexity, and interpretability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。关键词：machine learning (ML)、classical simulation、quantum-gas experiments、quantum simulators。；研究对象：冷原子量子模拟器中的多体原子物理系统，具体包括：Bose-Einstein condensates（玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体）中的孤子波识别，以及原始图像的降噪处理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机器学习方法可有效应用于冷原子量子模拟器的图像降噪和孤子波识别，且性能、模型复杂度与可解释性之间存在需要权衡的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机器学习方法可有效应用于冷原子量子模拟器的图像降噪和孤子波识别，且性能、模型复杂度与可解释性之间存在需要权衡的关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但文中指出，该工作聚焦于ML在冷原子量子模拟器中的两个具体应用，并特别讨论了性能、模型复杂度与可解释性之间的相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习方法。具体包括：对原始图像进行降噪处理，以及识别玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的孤子波。摘要未明确说明具体使用的ML模型类型（如CNN、自编码器等）。

papers.title: Effect of electric current on optical response of viscous electron-hole plasma
papers.abstract: The influence of the Hall voltage on the photoluminescence of a dense hydrodynamic electron-hole plasma laser generated in a mesoscopic n-doped GaAs channel under intense laser excitation is studied. Laser excitation induces an interband current determined by the recombination of photogenerated electron-hole pairs. As a result, background electrons drifting under the influence of the Hall voltage form an effective Hall current. The Coulomb drag caused by the Hall current causes the accumulation of light holes, leading to the appearance of a double photoluminescence line formed by the recombination of excitons and trions. In contrast, in the absence of a Hall current, the shift in the photoluminescence energy associated with heavy holes occurs due to the electric field created by the Hall potential difference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“激光激发”“光致发光”“霍尔电压”等实验观测手段，并描述了实验条件下的物理现象。；研究对象：介观尺度n掺杂GaAs通道中，在强激光激发下产生的稠密流体动力学电子-空穴等离子体的光学响应，特别是电流对光致发光的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 霍尔电流通过库仑拖曳导致轻空穴积累，从而形成由激子和三子复合产生的双光致发光谱线；而在无霍尔电流时，霍尔电势差产生的电场导致与重空穴相关的光致发光能量移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：霍尔电流通过库仑拖曳导致轻空穴积累，从而形成由激子和三子复合产生的双光致发光谱线；而在无霍尔电流时，霍尔电势差产生的电场导致与重空穴相关的光致发光能量移动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：强激光激发产生稠密电子-空穴等离子体，测量光致发光光谱，并结合霍尔电压施加与霍尔电流的调控。

papers.title: Electronic mechanism of sub-100-fs demagnetization induced by a femtosecond light pulse
papers.abstract: A quantitative understanding of the processes that trigger light-induced demagnetization on ultrashort timescales is crucial for achieving an ultrafast, radiation-controlled magnetic response in materials. This milestone is essential for developing next-generation magnetic storage devices and ultrafast magnetic switches. In this theoretical study, we investigated demagnetization triggered in a single magnetic domain by light pulses ranging from a few to a few tens of femtoseconds in duration, with photon energies spanning the optical and X-ray regimes, under strongly non-equilibrium conditions. We predicted a loss of magnetization in the sub-100-fs range in all cases, primarily due to the excitation of the electronic system and the subsequent redistribution of electrons within the magneto-sensitive band. The considered timescales were too short for phonon-mediated processes or inter-site Heisenberg exchange processes to contribute significantly. These findings pave the way for highly accurate, radiation-driven magnetization control in magnetic materials at sub-100-femtosecond timescales with potential practical applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical study、predicted、strongly non-equilibrium conditions。；研究对象：单磁畴（single magnetic domain）在飞秒光脉冲（光子能量覆盖光学至X射线波段）激发下的超快退磁现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在亚100飞秒时间尺度内，所有情况下均预测到磁化强度损失，主要归因于电子系统的激发及电子在磁敏能带内的重新分布，而非声子或海森堡交换过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在亚100飞秒时间尺度内，所有情况下均预测到磁化强度损失，主要归因于电子系统的激发及电子在磁敏能带内的重新分布，而非声子或海森堡交换过程。；创新点：揭示了在亚100飞秒时间尺度上，电子激发本身即可直接导致退磁，无需依赖声子或自旋交换等慢过程，为辐射驱动的超快磁化控制提供了新机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于强非平衡条件下的电子激发与磁敏能带内电子再分布机制，未使用具体数值计算方法（如DFT等），摘要未明确说明具体理论框架。

papers.title: Phase dynamics and dissipation in tunnel ferromagnetic Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: We investigate tunnel ferromagnetic Josephson junctions based on Superconductor-Insulator-thin superconductor-Ferromagnet-Superconductor multilayers. A comparative study of their electrodynamic properties is performed for junctions with niobium and aluminum (Al) electrodes, featuring different ferromagnetic interlayer materials and lateral dimensions ranging from the micrometric to the submicrometric scale. The parameters extracted from the fitting of the current-voltage characteristics using the tunnel junction microscopic model are found to be consistent with those independently estimated from switching current distribution measurements. Submicrometric Al-based devices exhibit electrodynamic properties comparable to those implemented in state-of-the-art transmon qubits and display clear signatures of quantum phase diffusion. The strong agreement between transport modelling and escape dynamics establishes a robust framework for describing hybrid ferromagnetic Josephson junctions consistent with their energy scales and supports their potential integration into superconducting quantum and classical digital circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：investigate, comparative study, measurements, current-voltage characteristics, switching current distribution measurements）；研究对象：隧道铁磁约瑟夫森结，具体为基于超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（S-I-s-F-S）多层膜结构的器件，包含不同电极材料（铌和铝）和不同铁磁夹层材料，尺寸从微米到亚微米。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 亚微米尺寸的铝基器件展现出与当前最先进transmon量子比特相当的电动力学特性，并具有清晰的量子相位扩散特征。输运建模与逃逸动力学之间的高度一致性为描述混合铁磁约瑟夫森结建立了稳健框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：亚微米尺寸的铝基器件展现出与当前最先进transmon量子比特相当的电动力学特性，并具有清晰的量子相位扩散特征。输运建模与逃逸动力学之间的高度一致性为描述混合铁磁约瑟夫森结建立了稳健框架。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用电流-电压特性曲线拟合（基于隧道结微观模型）和开关电流分布测量两种独立方法提取参数并进行对比。器件制备涉及超导/绝缘/铁磁多层膜结构。

papers.title: Defect Control via Cu Enrichment Enhances Multifunctional Properties in the Polar Semiconductor Cu1+xMn1-ySiTe3
papers.abstract: Polar materials have recently attracted significant interest due to their rich multifunctional properties. The chalcogenide polar semiconductor Cu1-xMn1+ySiTe3 (Cu-deficient) is an emerging multiferroic system in which electric polarization is coupled to magnetization. However, its macroscopic ferroelectric polarization is strongly suppressed due to the presence of a high density of stacking faults. In this work, we demonstrate that these crystal defects, likely originating from non-stoichiometry, can be substantially reduced by increasing the Cu content. Cu-enriched samples, Cu1+xMn1-ySiTe3, crystallize in a noncentrosymmetric monoclinic structure (space group Pm) as the Cu-deficient counterpart but show a nearly stacking-fault-free phase, which is attributed to the emergence of an interstitial site. Consequently, the Cu-enriched samples show a pronounced enhancement of the second-harmonic generation (SHG) response compared to Cu-deficient compositions. Magnetically, the Cu-enriched crystals retain long-range antiferromagnetic order with a Neel temperature of TN ~ 33 K without a glassy state but manifest a distinct spin-flop transition along the polar b-axis that is absent in the Cu-deficient compositions. Furthermore, the electronic ground state evolves from insulating to doped semiconducting behavior upon Cu enrichment. Together, these results establish this material system as a unique and versatile platform for elucidating the interplay among composition, crystal defects, and multifunctional properties, offering a route to design magnetic polar systems with tunable quantum functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了样品制备（Cu-enriched samples）、结构表征（crystallize in...）、非线性光学测量（SHG）、磁学测量（long-range antiferromagnetic order, spin-flop transition）以及电输运测量（insulating to doped semiconducting behavior）。；研究对象：极性半导体材料 Cu₁₊ₓMn₁₋ySiTe₃（富铜组分），及其与缺铜组分 Cu₁₋ₓMn₁₊ySiTe₃ 的对比。具体物理现象包括：晶体缺陷（堆垛层错）的控制、铁电性、非线性光学响应、反铁磁序与自旋翻转相变、以及电子基态从绝缘体到掺杂半导体的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过增加 Cu 含量（富铜化）可以显著减少 Cu₁₋ₓMn₁₊ySiTe₃ 中由非化学计量比引起的高密度堆垛层错，从而大幅增强其二阶非线性光学响应（SHG），并诱导出沿极性 b 轴的自旋翻转相变，同时将电子基态从绝缘体调控为掺杂半导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过增加 Cu 含量（富铜化）可以显著减少 Cu₁₋ₓMn₁₊ySiTe₃ 中由非化学计量比引起的高密度堆垛层错，从而大幅增强其二阶非线性光学响应（SHG），并诱导出沿极性 b 轴的自旋翻转相变，同时将电子基态从绝缘体调控为掺杂半导体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，核心创新在于发现并实验验证了通过富铜化引入间隙位来抑制堆垛层错这一缺陷控制策略，从而在同一个材料体系中实现了对铁电性、磁性和电子输运性质的多功能协同调控。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：1）样品合成（通过调控 Cu 含量制备不同化学计量比的单晶）；2）结构表征（X射线衍射确定空间群为 Pm）；3）非线性光学测试（二次谐波产生 SHG）；4）磁学性质测量（确定奈尔温度 TN ~ 33 K，观测自旋翻转转变）；5）电输运测量（判断电子基态性质）。

papers.title: A geometry-first tutorial for time-resolved morphological analysis with PyPETANA
papers.abstract: We present a step-by-step, reproducible tutorial for PyPETANA, an open-source Python framework for geometry-first, time-resolved quantification of evolving morphology from image data. Starting from time-lapse video input, the tutorial demonstrates how to extract binary masks, compute time-resolved geometric observables including area, perimeter, circularity, and effective fractal dimensions, and analyze their temporal evolution. The workflow emphasizes direct reconstruction of morphology from images without assuming microscopic growth mechanisms. In addition to compactness-sensitive geometric descriptors, the framework supports multiscale boundary analysis through supersampled box-counting methods applied to filled morphologies and finite-width boundary bands. The benchmark suite further demonstrates applicability to invasive tumor morphologies and multiscale boundary evolution in time-resolved cancer-growth interfaces. This tutorial accompanies the computational workflow underlying arXiv:2602.05958 and provides a reproducible foundation for geometry-based analysis of evolving non-equilibrium morphologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。判断依据关键词：open-source Python framework、geometry-first quantification、computational workflow。；研究对象：论文研究的是从图像数据中提取的随时间演化的非平衡形态（evolving non-equilibrium morphologies），具体示例包括侵入性肿瘤形态和癌症生长界面的多尺度边界演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个用于时间分辨形态学分析的几何优先开源框架PyPETANA及其可复现教程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个用于时间分辨形态学分析的几何优先开源框架PyPETANA及其可复现教程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的创新点，但框架强调“几何优先”和“不假设微观生长机制”的直接形态重建，以及提供可复现的基准教程。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何优先（geometry-first）的图像分析方法：从延时视频输入中提取二值掩膜，计算时间分辨的几何可观测量（面积、周长、圆形度、有效分形维数），并通过超采样盒计数方法对填充形态和有限宽度边界带进行多尺度边界分析。整个工作流不假设微观生长机制。

papers.title: Charge order on a triangular lattice with Mott physics and arbitrary charge density
papers.abstract: Triangular-lattice systems attract a lot of attention due to various frustration-induced and strongly correlated effects. Here, we focus on the charge-ordering phenomenon by means of investigation of the extended Hubbard model with dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). By considering the intersite nearest-neighbor interaction we have found a very rich phase diagram that contains large number of features, phases, and phase transitions. Among them are pinball-liquid (PL) phases where we distinguish charge-transfer-driven and Mott-localization-driven PLs; phase transitions that change their order as model parameters evolve (from discontinuous to continuous); very strong particle-hole asymmetry. Various features of the phase diagram are found to be better understood by means of the simple mean-field approximation (MFA). Moreover, besides helping with interpretation of the phase diagram, the MFA results together with results for the atomic-limit model are found to be able to set rather good expectations on how the DMFT phase diagram should look like. Nevertheless, a few features were not expected and are found within the DMFT, such as a small-region intermediate metallic phase on an electron-doped side of the phase diagram.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT)、mean-field approximation (MFA)、extended Hubbard model。；研究对象：三角晶格上的电荷有序现象，具体研究扩展Hubbard模型在任意电荷密度下的行为，重点关注Mott物理与最近邻相互作用的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过DMFT计算发现三角晶格扩展Hubbard模型具有极其丰富的相图，包含多种相和相变，特别是区分了电荷转移驱动和Mott局域化驱动的两种“弹珠液体”（pinball-liquid）相，并在电子掺杂侧发现了一个小区域的中间金属相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过DMFT计算发现三角晶格扩展Hubbard模型具有极其丰富的相图，包含多种相和相变，特别是区分了电荷转移驱动和Mott局域化驱动的两种“弹珠液体”（pinball-liquid）相，并在电子掺杂侧发现了一个小区域的中间金属相。；创新点：首次在三角晶格扩展Hubbard模型中系统区分了两种不同物理起源的弹珠液体相，并发现DMFT相图中存在MFA和原子极限模型未能预期的电子掺杂侧中间金属相。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）求解扩展Hubbard模型（包含最近邻库仑相互作用），并结合简单平均场近似（MFA）和原子极限模型分析进行对比与解释。

papers.title: Localization of a quantum particle in a classical one-component plasma.III. Mutual coherence and coherence degradation in Coulomb-disordered media
papers.abstract: We derive the mutual coherence function of an electron beam propagating through a static or dynamic Coulomb-disordered medium and show that its decay introduces an intrinsic coherence-reduction mechanism relevant for electron microscopy in Coulomb-disordered media. Using the Efimov path-integral formalism, the coherence length $ρ_c$ is expressed through the same disorder correlator that governs the single-particle localization length $\ell$. For both a static electrolyte and a dynamic plasma we obtain a universal relation $ρ_c \sim λ_D \sqrt{\ell/L}$, where $λ_D$ is the Debye length and $L$ the sample thickness. In the static case $\ell\propto k^{2}$ (electron momentum), whereas in the dynamic slow-particle regime $\ell\propto k$, leading to qualitatively different energy dependences of the coherence scale. The ion thermal velocity cancels out in the final expression, demonstrating a formal connection between transverse coherence decay and longitudinal localization phenomena. Exact analytical results are given for the phase structure function of a model electrolyte, and numerical estimates indicate that disorder-induced phase decorrelation may contribute appreciably to the attenuation of high-spatial-frequency contrast under experimentally relevant liquid-cell electron microscopy conditions. Possible implications for cryo-EM, disordered liquids, soft condensed matter, and biological media are discussed. In an appendix we extend the theory to the relativistic regime relevant for transmission electron microscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Efimov路径积分形式”、“推导”、“解析结果”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：电子束在经典单组分等离子体（静态或动态库仑无序介质）中传播时的相互相干性及相干退化现象，具体涉及液池电子显微镜、冷冻电镜、无序液体、软凝聚态及生物介质等体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出电子束在库仑无序介质中的相互相干函数，发现相干长度ρ_c与单粒子局域化长度ℓ之间存在普适关系ρ_c ~ λ_D √(ℓ/L)（λ_D为德拜长度，L为样品厚度），且静态与动态无序介质中相干尺度对电子动量的依赖关系不同（静态ℓ∝k²，动态慢粒子区ℓ∝k）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出电子束在库仑无序介质中的相互相干函数，发现相干长度ρ_c与单粒子局域化长度ℓ之间存在普适关系ρ_c ~ λ_D √(ℓ/L)（λ_D为德拜长度，L为样品厚度），且静态与动态无序介质中相干尺度对电子动量的依赖关系不同（静态ℓ∝k²，动态慢粒子区ℓ∝k）。；创新点：建立了横向相干退化与纵向局域化现象之间的形式联系，并发现离子热速度在最终表达式中抵消；首次指出无序诱导的相位退相干在液池电镜实验条件下可能显著衰减高空间频率对比度。
papers.method_zh: 采用Efimov路径积分形式，通过无序关联函数将相干长度与单粒子局域化长度联系起来；对模型电解质给出相位结构函数的精确解析结果；附录中将理论推广至相对论区域（适用于透射电子显微镜）。

papers.title: Bilayer crystals in a polar-molecules system
papers.abstract: We investigate the finite-temperature phase diagram of polar molecules confined in a quasi-two-dimensional geometry by a harmonic potential along the polarization axis. We employ Quantum Monte Carlo simulations to explore the strongly correlated regime accessible with current experimental setups. By tuning temperature and confinement strength, we identify a rich set of phases, including normal fluid, superfluid, supersolid, cluster crystal, and bilayer crystal states. Our results reveal the emergence of crystallization upon increasing temperature, highlighting the nontrivial role of thermal fluctuations in dipolar systems. In particular, we show that a bilayer crystal with one molecule per lattice site can be stabilized by varying the confinement strength at fixed interaction. Moreover, we show evidence of layering of superfluid states with phase coherence between the two layers. These findings provide insight into the interplay between interactions, confinement, and temperature in low-dimensional dipolar systems, and suggest new directions for engineering quantum phases with ultracold polar molecules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Quantum Monte Carlo simulations（量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：极性分子体系在准二维几何结构中的有限温度相图，具体为沿极化轴方向受简谐势约束的极性分子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节温度和约束强度，发现了正常流体、超流体、超固体、团簇晶体和双层晶体等多种相态；特别是，在固定相互作用下改变约束强度可稳定每个格点一个分子的双层晶体，且超流体态在两层之间具有相位相干性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节温度和约束强度，发现了正常流体、超流体、超固体、团簇晶体和双层晶体等多种相态；特别是，在固定相互作用下改变约束强度可稳定每个格点一个分子的双层晶体，且超流体态在两层之间具有相位相干性。；创新点：揭示了在偶极体系中温度升高反而诱导结晶的反直觉现象，并展示了通过约束强度调控实现双层晶体相的新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子蒙特卡洛（Quantum Monte Carlo）模拟，研究强关联区域，并系统扫描温度和约束强度参数空间。

papers.title: Interlayer electronic coherence links magnetism and superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates
papers.abstract: The extent to which electronic dimensionality influences magnetism and superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates remains unsettled. Here we report high-precision crystallographic-axis-resolved dc transport measurements on high-quality single crystals of bilayer and trilayer RP nickelates. Using a six-terminal geometry, we self-consistently determine the intrinsic in-plane ($ρ_\parallel$) and out-of-plane ($ρ_\bot$) resistivities on the same crystal, while minimizing uncertainties associated with current redistribution in highly anisotropic conductors. We uncover strong intrinsic electronic anisotropy in both bilayer and trilayer nickelates, in contrast to the weak anisotropy inferred from conventional four-probe measurements. Moreover, $ρ_\bot$ exhibits a nonmonotonic temperature dependence, revealing a universal coherent-to-incoherent crossover in interlayer transport. Across the RP nickelate series, the maximum superconducting transition temperature ($T_c$) observed under pressure is inversely correlated with the ambient-pressure resistivity anisotropy, suggesting that stronger interlayer electronic coherence is favorable for superconductivity. In addition, $ρ_\bot$ serves as an exceptionally sensitive and selective probe of magnetic and density-wave orders, exhibiting pronounced anomalies, whereas only weak signatures are observed in $ρ_\parallel$. Our results highlight interlayer coherence as a key organizing parameter that both tracks the relevant magnetic correlations and is closely tied to superconductivity, providing stringent constraints on microscopic theories of high-$T_c$ superconductivity in nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“dc transport measurements”、“six-terminal geometry”、“high-quality single crystals”。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) 相镍氧化物（具体为双层和三层RP镍酸盐）的电子各向异性、层间电子相干性、磁性/密度波序与超导电性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在RP镍酸盐中，层间电子相干性是一个关键的组织参数，它既能追踪相关的磁关联，又与超导电性紧密相关：更强的层间电子相干性有利于超导，而层间电阻率（ρ⊥）是探测磁性和密度波序的极其灵敏且选择性的探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在RP镍酸盐中，层间电子相干性是一个关键的组织参数，它既能追踪相关的磁关联，又与超导电性紧密相关：更强的层间电子相干性有利于超导，而层间电阻率（ρ⊥）是探测磁性和密度波序的极其灵敏且选择性的探针。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，创新点包括：1）通过六端法测量揭示了与常规四探针法推断的弱各向异性相反的强本征电子各向异性；2）发现面外电阻率（ρ⊥）呈现非单调温度依赖，揭示了层间输运中普遍的相干-非相干交叉行为；3）建立了常压电阻率各向异性与压力下最大超导转变温度（Tc）的反比关系，并指出ρ⊥是比ρ∥更灵敏的磁/密度波序探针。
papers.method_zh: 对高质量双层和三层RP镍酸盐单晶进行了高精度的晶轴分辨直流输运测量。采用六端电极几何构型，在同一块晶体上自洽地确定本征面内电阻率（ρ∥）和面外电阻率（ρ⊥），从而最小化高各向异性导体中电流重分布带来的不确定性。

papers.title: Probing Dielectric Screening in van der Waals Heterostructures via Pressure-Tuned Exciton Rydberg Series
papers.abstract: Excitons in two-dimensional semiconductors are directly exposed to the environment and are sensitive to the dielectric properties of their surrounding. Here, we show that the Rydberg series of excited states of excitons in a monolayer WSe$_2$ encapsulated in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) can be used to probe the pressure-induced modifications of the surrounding dielectric properties. We propose a model based on the pressure induced evolution of the interlayer distances in this van der Waals heterostructure and on the bulk dielectric properties of hBN. This approach allows a direct measurement of the dielectric constant of pressurized hBN and establishes a new methodology for dielectric sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Probing、show、propose a model、allows a direct measurement）；研究对象：单层WSe₂封装在六方氮化硼（hBN）中的范德华异质结，以及压力调控下的激子里德伯系列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过压力调控单层WSe₂中激子的里德伯系列，可以探测周围介电环境的变化，并直接测量加压下hBN的介电常数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过压力调控单层WSe₂中激子的里德伯系列，可以探测周围介电环境的变化，并直接测量加压下hBN的介电常数。；创新点：提出了一种利用激子里德伯系列作为介电传感探针的新方法，通过压力调控直接测量hBN的介电常数。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用压力调控范德华异质结中的层间距，并结合基于层间距演化和hBN体介电性质的理论模型，分析激子激发态能级变化。

papers.title: Termination-Preserved Ultra-high Tunneling Magnetoresistance in Altermagnetic KV2Se2O
papers.abstract: Altermagnets exhibit nonrelativistic spin splitting without net magnetization, establishing a new platform for next-generation spintronic devices. Although altermagnetic tunnel junctions (AMTJs) represent the most promising realizations, their practical applications are hindered by low tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) ratios and strong sensitivity to interfacial configurations. Here, we systematically explore the transport properties and microscopic mechanisms of AMTJs based on the recently discovered d-wave altermagnet KV2Se2O. Using first-principles calculations and orbital-resolved analysis, we demonstrate that the synergy between compressed nodal-point like spin-degenerate channels and coplanar interfacial magnetic order yields an ultra-high intrinsic TMR above 105% for all interfacial terminations. More importantly, K-termination effectively preserves bulk spin polarization through its unique passivation characteristics, leading to an ultra-high TMR up to 1012%. These results identify the coupling between momentum-space topology and interfacial passivation provides a reliable strategy for realizing giant magnetoresistive responses in altermagnetic spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、轨道分辨分析（orbital-resolved analysis）。；研究对象：基于d波交变磁体KV2Se2O的交变磁隧道结（AMTJ）的输运性质及微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压缩节点状自旋简并通道与共面界面磁序的协同作用，在所有界面终止构型下均产生超过105%的超高本征隧穿磁电阻（TMR）；K终止界面通过独特的钝化特性保留体自旋极化，使TMR高达1012%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压缩节点状自旋简并通道与共面界面磁序的协同作用，在所有界面终止构型下均产生超过105%的超高本征隧穿磁电阻（TMR）；K终止界面通过独特的钝化特性保留体自旋极化，使TMR高达1012%。；创新点：揭示了动量空间拓扑与界面钝化之间的耦合可作为实现交变磁自旋电子器件中巨磁电阻响应的可靠策略。摘要未突出说明与已有AMTJ工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合轨道分辨分析（orbital-resolved analysis）。

papers.title: Spatially-Localized Second Harmonic Generation via Spin Wave Concentration in Patterned YIG Structures
papers.abstract: The anisotropic dispersion and inherent nonlinearity of magnetostatic spin waves in thin films and confined structures provide unique opportunities for implementation in next-generation magnonic devices for data and signal processing. A particular challenge is to establish an effective means to locally generate higher harmonics and subsequently exploit them while avoiding extraneous nonlinear losses. Here we demonstrate that deterministically and locally tuning the dispersion relation by geometric confinement through standard patterning processes, allows the creation spatially localized, high-intensity magnons hundreds of $μm$ or even further from the excitation source. The local intensity obtained in passive, lithographically patterned YIG funnel structures is sufficient to achieve second harmonic generation in localized regions via conventional magnon scattering processes. We verify these effects are truly nonlinear processes by direct measurement and comparison of the 1-$ω$ and 2-$ω$ magnon signals as determined by highly sensitive frequency- and spatially-resolved SNS-MOKE technique. This lays the foundation for using similar devices in future magnon-based infrastructures to localize and enhance sensitivity of readout, downstream magnon-based logic operations, and for other higher harmonic generation-related phenomena and low-power magnonics applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“直接测量”“SNS-MOKE技术”等实验手段，并对比了1-ω和2-ω信号。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜中通过几何图案化（漏斗结构）实现的局域自旋波（磁静自旋波）及其二次谐波产生现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过标准光刻工艺对YIG进行几何约束（漏斗结构），可以确定性地局域调控自旋波的色散关系，从而在距离激发源数百微米甚至更远处产生空间局域化的高强度磁子，并实现局域二次谐波产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过标准光刻工艺对YIG进行几何约束（漏斗结构），可以确定性地局域调控自旋波的色散关系，从而在距离激发源数百微米甚至更远处产生空间局域化的高强度磁子，并实现局域二次谐波产生。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用标准光刻工艺制备图案化YIG漏斗结构；使用高灵敏度的频率和空间分辨的SNS-MOKE（扫描氮空位中心磁光克尔效应）技术直接测量1-ω和2-ω磁子信号，以验证非线性过程。

papers.title: Spin-caloritronic signatures of soft magnons in bilayer CrSBr
papers.abstract: Spin transport in magnetic insulators is often treated by assuming that magnons carry a fixed spin angular momentum of $\hbar$, which does not hold in general, however. Here we calculate the magnon spin angular momentum of a layered antiferromagnet as a function of applied magnetic field and wave vector. We show that the triaxial anisotropy and intralayer dipolar interactions in bilayer CrSBr renormalize the magnon spin angular momentum, which diverges upon field-induced magnon softening. This divergence gives rise to a pronounced peak in the thermal spin Seebeck response and provides a clear spin-caloritronic signature of soft magnons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：calculate（计算）、show（理论推导）、renormalize（重整化）、diverges（发散）。；研究对象：双层CrSBr中的软磁振子（soft magnons）及其自旋角动量，以及由此产生的自旋热电子学（spin-caloritronic）效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层CrSBr中，三轴各向异性和层内偶极相互作用会重整化磁振子的自旋角动量，使其在磁场诱导的磁振子软化（softening）时发散，并在热自旋塞贝克响应（thermal spin Seebeck response）中产生一个显著的峰，从而为软磁振子提供清晰的自旋热电子学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层CrSBr中，三轴各向异性和层内偶极相互作用会重整化磁振子的自旋角动量，使其在磁场诱导的磁振子软化（softening）时发散，并在热自旋塞贝克响应（thermal spin Seebeck response）中产生一个显著的峰，从而为软磁振子提供清晰的自旋热电子学特征。；创新点：揭示了在一般反铁磁体中磁振子并不总是携带固定自旋角动量（ħ），并首次指出软磁振子的自旋角动量发散可作为自旋热电子学中的可观测特征信号。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论计算，研究了层状反铁磁体中磁振子自旋角动量随外加磁场和波矢的变化关系。具体考虑了双层CrSBr的三轴各向异性和层内偶极相互作用对磁振子自旋角动量的重整化效应。

papers.title: Accelerating charging dynamics of electric double-layer capacitors
papers.abstract: Electric double-layer capacitors (EDLCs), consisting of an ionic fluid between two metallic electrodes, are electrochemical energy storage devices complementary to batteries, allowing for a faster charge/discharge.
