The charging dynamics in response to a voltage step features a variety of regimes and relaxation timescales, depending on the applied voltage and the various lengths characterizing the system, most importantly the inter-electrode distance and the Debye length over which electrostatic effects are screened in the electrolyte. Inspired by recent works on "shortcut to adiabaticity" in colloidal systems, here we investigate the possibility to control the charge and discharge of planar EDLCs using time-dependent voltages. Specifically, our aim is to achieve a full charge or discharge within a finite time shorter than their intrinsic relaxation timescales. Within the Poisson-Nernst-Planck model and the small-voltage regime, we derive time-dependent protocols that can eliminate an arbitrary number of relaxation modes. This permits to approach the equilibrium charged state within a finite time, that can be in practice an order of magnitude faster than the natural equilibration time. We illustrate the relevance and efficacy of the method on polynomial drivings and show that the surface charge density, charge-density profiles, and global deviation from equilibrium (quantified by a Kullback-Leibler-like divergence) can all be significantly accelerated, even for driving times comparable to or shorter than the natural RC time of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“within the Poisson-Nernst-Planck model”、“derive time-dependent protocols”，属于理论推导与数值模拟。；研究对象：平面型双电层电容器（EDLCs）的充电动力学，具体为离子液体在金属电极之间的响应行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计随时间变化的电压协议，可以在比系统固有弛豫时间短一个数量级的时间内实现双电层电容器的完全充电或放电，显著加速充电动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计随时间变化的电压协议，可以在比系统固有弛豫时间短一个数量级的时间内实现双电层电容器的完全充电或放电，显著加速充电动力学。；创新点：受“绝热捷径”概念启发，首次将时间依赖电压控制策略应用于平面EDLCs的充放电过程，实现了超越系统自然RC时间的加速充电。
papers.method_zh: 基于Poisson-Nernst-Planck（PNP）模型，在小电压近似下推导出可消除任意数量弛豫模式的时间依赖电压协议，并通过多项式驱动示例验证了表面电荷密度、电荷密度分布及全局偏离平衡（用类Kullback-Leibler散度量化）的加速效果。

papers.title: Frustration from Localized Zhang-Rice States: A Unified Theory of Doping-Driven Magnetic Transitions in Cuprates
papers.abstract: The microscopic mechanism by which doped holes disrupt the antiferromagnetic order is one of the fundamental questions in cuprates. In this work, we propose a unified microscopic theory in which doped holes form spatially localized Zhang-Rice singlets which actively mediate emergent spin exchange. Rather than acting as simple non-magnetic vacancies, these localized states introduce emergent next-nearest $J_2$ and third-nearest $J_3$ neighbor superexchanges. This dopant-induced exchange pathway generates significant magnetic frustration, naturally explaining the rapid collapse of the Néel AFM order and the emergence of a spin-glass phase on the hole-doped side. Our findings provide a comprehensive framework for understanding the complex doping-driven magnetic phase transitions and magnetic electron-hole asymmetry in lightly doped cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a unified microscopic theory（提出统一的微观理论）、emergent spin exchange（涌现自旋交换）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：铜氧化物超导体（cuprates）中，掺杂空穴（doped holes）破坏反铁磁有序的微观机制，以及由此引发的磁性相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 掺杂的空穴并非简单的非磁性空位，而是形成局域的Zhang-Rice单态，这些局域态会引入新的次近邻（J2）和第三近邻（J3）超交换作用，从而产生显著的磁阻挫，这自然解释了空穴掺杂侧奈尔反铁磁序的快速坍塌和自旋玻璃相的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：掺杂的空穴并非简单的非磁性空位，而是形成局域的Zhang-Rice单态，这些局域态会引入新的次近邻（J2）和第三近邻（J3）超交换作用，从而产生显著的磁阻挫，这自然解释了空穴掺杂侧奈尔反铁磁序的快速坍塌和自旋玻璃相的出现。；创新点：该工作将掺杂空穴从传统的“非磁性空位”图像提升为“主动调控自旋交换的局域态”，通过引入掺杂诱导的磁阻挫机制，为理解铜氧化物中掺杂驱动的复杂磁性相变和电子-空穴不对称性提供了一个统一的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模。具体提出了一个统一的微观理论，其中掺杂空穴形成空间局域的Zhang-Rice单态，并以此为基础推导出掺杂诱导的磁交换路径（emergent next-nearest J2 and third-nearest J3 neighbor superexchanges）。

papers.title: Direction-selective triplet pairing and spin-edge locking in altermagnetic metals
papers.abstract: We investigate self-consistent unconventional superconductivity in a two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnetic metal. We find that momentum-dependent altermagnetic spin splitting suppresses opposite-spin singlet pairing and stabilizes highly anisotropic equal-spin triplet order. In the spin-conserving limit, this directional triplet pairing gives rise to nearly dispersionless Majorana boundary states associated with effective one-dimensional topological channels. Rashba spin-orbit coupling mixes spin sectors, activates additional pairing components, and drives the system into a mixed-parity superconducting state with dispersive Majorana boundary states. The spin-resolved boundary spectra further reveal a characteristic locking between boundary orientation and spin polarization, reflecting the underlying altermagnetic symmetry. These results identify altermagnetic spin splitting as an intrinsic mechanism for selecting unconventional pairing and generating spin-resolved Majorana boundary states without external magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”、“We find”、“These results identify”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及任何实验手段或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：二维d波交变磁金属中的非常规超导电性。具体研究了交变磁自旋劈裂对超导配对对称性的影响，以及由此产生的拓扑边界态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁金属中动量依赖的自旋劈裂会抑制自旋单态配对，并稳定高度各向异性的等自旋三重态序。该三重态配对在自旋守恒极限下产生近乎无色散的马约拉纳边界态，且边界态的自旋极化与边界取向存在特征性的锁定关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁金属中动量依赖的自旋劈裂会抑制自旋单态配对，并稳定高度各向异性的等自旋三重态序。该三重态配对在自旋守恒极限下产生近乎无色散的马约拉纳边界态，且边界态的自旋极化与边界取向存在特征性的锁定关系。；创新点：揭示了交变磁自旋劈裂本身（无需外加磁场）可作为内在机制，用于选择非常规（三重态）配对并产生自旋分辨的马约拉纳边界态。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比或潜在材料实现方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体采用了自洽的非常规超导理论框架，在二维d波交变磁金属模型中求解超导序参量，并分析了自旋守恒极限和存在Rashba自旋轨道耦合两种情况下的边界态能谱和自旋结构。

papers.title: Epitaxial growth and magnetic phase transitions in non-centrosymmetric EuPdSi$_3$ thin films
papers.abstract: Non-centrosymmetric magnetic materials are a promising platform for stabilizing chiral spin textures, such as skyrmions and cycloidal magnetic states. This is particularly true in epitaxial thin film geometries, where strain and interface effects offer additional control. Herein, we report on the first epitaxial thin films of EuPdSi$_3$ grown by molecular beam epitaxy on MgO(001). X-ray diffraction confirms an epitaxial relationship of tetragonal EuPdSi$_3$ in the BaNiSn$_3$ structure with out-of-plane c-axis orientation and parallel in-plane a-axes. Hard x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals a stable Eu valence of 2.0, yielding a large magnetic moment of approximately 7 $μ_B$ per Eu atom in accordance with Hund's rule. Owing to the non-centrosymmetric crystal structure, non-collinear magnetic states such as Néel-type skyrmions and cycloidal phases are allowed by symmetry. Electronic transport measurements reveal two magnetic phase transitions at 19 K and 15 K in zero applied field. Under magnetic fields applied along the crystallographic [100] and [001] directions, distinct temperature dependent magnetic phases emerge, demonstrating the sensitivity of the magnetic ground state to field orientation in epitaxial EuPdSi$_3$ thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：epitaxial thin films、molecular beam epitaxy、X-ray diffraction、hard x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy、electronic transport measurements。；研究对象：非中心对称磁性材料EuPdSi₃的外延薄膜，具体研究其晶体结构、电子态、磁相变及磁场取向对磁基态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次成功制备了EuPdSi₃外延薄膜，发现其在零场下存在两个磁相变（19 K和15 K），且磁场沿不同晶向时出现不同的温度依赖磁相，表明磁基态对磁场取向高度敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次成功制备了EuPdSi₃外延薄膜，发现其在零场下存在两个磁相变（19 K和15 K），且磁场沿不同晶向时出现不同的温度依赖磁相，表明磁基态对磁场取向高度敏感。；创新点：首次报道了非中心对称EuPdSi₃的外延薄膜生长，并揭示了其磁场取向依赖的复杂磁相变行为，为在该体系中实现Néel型斯格明子等非共线磁结构提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）在MgO(001)衬底上生长薄膜；X射线衍射（XRD）确定外延关系与晶体取向；硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）测定Eu价态；电子输运测量（电阻率）探测磁相变及磁场下的相图。

papers.title: Spin and orbital mixing of edge states in a quantum Hall system proximitized by a superconductor
papers.abstract: We investigate the formation and transport properties of chiral Andreev edge states in a two-dimensional quantum Hall system proximitized by a superconductor. By numerically modeling the system using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations, we analyze the non-local conductance and transmission probabilities of multimode and spinful systems. We demonstrate that the Andreev reflection process induces a mixing of the quantum Hall edge modes at higher filling factors, a phenomenon strictly prohibited in clean, purely electronic systems. When incorporating the Zeeman interaction, we show that the Andreev edge states split into uncoupled spin species, maintaining spin orthogonality that prevents mixing between opposite spin sectors. Furthermore, we explore the impact of Rashba spin-orbit coupling. While the spin-orbit interaction alone causes slight spin depolarization, its combination with an in-plane magnetic field drives complex spin mixing among all chiral Andreev bands, fundamentally altering the conductance oscillations. Finally, we reveal that the electron transmission probabilities exhibit robust degeneracies, which emerge as a direct consequence of the unitarity constraints and the particle-hole symmetry of the system's scattering matrix in a magnetic field and the presence of spin-orbit interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically modeling the system using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations”，并分析非局域电导和透射概率，属于数值模拟与理论分析。；研究对象：超导体邻近效应下的二维量子霍尔系统中的手征安德烈夫边缘态。具体体系为多模、自旋分辨的量子霍尔系统与超导体耦合形成的异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 安德烈夫反射过程会在高填充因子下混合量子霍尔边缘模式，而纯电子系统中严格禁止这种混合；自旋轨道耦合与面内磁场共同作用可导致所有手征安德烈夫能带间的复杂自旋混合，从而改变电导振荡行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：安德烈夫反射过程会在高填充因子下混合量子霍尔边缘模式，而纯电子系统中严格禁止这种混合；自旋轨道耦合与面内磁场共同作用可导致所有手征安德烈夫能带间的复杂自旋混合，从而改变电导振荡行为。；创新点：揭示了超导邻近效应下量子霍尔边缘态的自旋与轨道混合机制，特别是Zeeman相互作用、Rashba自旋轨道耦合及其与面内磁场的协同效应对安德烈夫边缘态自旋结构的影响，以及电子透射概率中由幺正性和粒子-空穴对称性导致的鲁棒简并性。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）方程的数值建模，计算非局域电导和透射概率，分析散射矩阵的幺正性约束和粒子-空穴对称性。

papers.title: Qumus: Realization of An Embodied AI Quantum Material Experimentalist
papers.abstract: While modern Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) have demonstrated transformative capabilities in digital domains, the realization of embodied AI capable of real-world scientific discovery remains a difficult frontier. The advancements are hindered by the inherent complexity of integrating high-level reasoning, multimodal information processing and real-time physical execution. Here we introduce Qumus, the first AI quantum materials experimentalist. Physically embodied within a robotic mini-laboratory, Qumus is an intelligent, multimodal, and multi-agent system designed for the creation and nano-processing of atomically thin two-dimensional (2D) materials and stacked van der Waals (vdW) structures. Qumus autonomously navigates the full scientific cycle, from hypothesis generation and protocol planning to multi-step experimental execution, result analysis and reporting, acting as an experimentalist. Markedly, the system has achieved, for the first time, the AI-creation of graphene, as well as the first AI-fabrication of complex nanodevices including atomically thin field-effect transistors via vdW stacking. Qumus excels at these tasks by demonstrating autonomous error correction and closed-loop experimentation. Our results establish a generalizable framework for self-improving embodied AI systems that learn directly from the quantum world, opening a pathway toward accelerated discovery in quantum materials, electronics and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+AI系统开发）。关键词：embodied AI、robotic mini-laboratory、multi-agent system、experimental execution。；研究对象：原子级薄层二维材料（如石墨烯）及其范德华异质结构，以及基于这些材料的纳米器件（如原子级薄场效应晶体管）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实现了由AI自主完成石墨烯的制备以及复杂纳米器件（如通过范德华堆叠的原子级薄场效应晶体管）的制造，并展示了自主纠错和闭环实验能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实现了由AI自主完成石墨烯的制备以及复杂纳米器件（如通过范德华堆叠的原子级薄场效应晶体管）的制造，并展示了自主纠错和闭环实验能力。；创新点：首次将具身AI系统应用于量子材料实验，实现了从数字推理到物理实验的闭环自主操作，并成功制造出石墨烯和复杂纳米器件，建立了可泛化的自改进型具身AI框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用具身AI系统（Qumus），集成于机器人微型实验室中，结合多模态信息处理、多智能体架构，自主完成从假设生成、实验方案规划、多步实验执行、结果分析到报告撰写的完整科学循环。

papers.title: A study of the dimer-trimer crossover in a driven three-component Fermi gas
papers.abstract: We develop an Effective Field Theory (EFT) for a system with three distinguishable atomic species and present a variational calculation of the two and three-body binding energies in vacuum and in the presence of a single Fermi sea. Specifically, we consider the case where the interaction between first two atomic species is externally driven so as to produce a (non-universal) closed-channel dimer whose coupling can be controlled independently of all other interactions. We then model the remaining interactions as a contact interaction between the dimer and a third atomic species which forms the medium. We derive analytical expressions for the dimer and trimer binding energies in vacuum and in medium, and in the latter case we predict a crossing between the dimer and trimer branches as a function of the atom-dimer scattering length, analogous to the usual polaron and molecule problem. Furthermore, we show that the position of this crossing can be controlled by varying the atom-atom coupling that results from the external drive and we discuss the implications of these findings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Effective Field Theory (EFT)、variational calculation、analytical expressions。；研究对象：一个由三种可区分原子物种组成的费米气体系统，具体研究在真空中和存在单一费米海时，二体（二聚体）与三体（三聚体）束缚能的交叉行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在存在费米海的情况下，二聚体与三聚体的能支会随着原子-二聚体散射长度发生交叉，且该交叉点的位置可以通过外部驱动产生的原子-原子耦合进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在存在费米海的情况下，二聚体与三聚体的能支会随着原子-二聚体散射长度发生交叉，且该交叉点的位置可以通过外部驱动产生的原子-原子耦合进行调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效场论（EFT）框架，结合变分法计算真空和介质中的二体与三体束缚能。具体建模为：前两种原子通过外部驱动产生一个非普适的闭通道二聚体，其耦合可独立调控；该二聚体与第三种原子（构成介质）之间的剩余相互作用被建模为接触相互作用。

papers.title: Metastable Cu$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ -- Completing the copper chromium delafossite series through soft chemistry
papers.abstract: In the layered copper chromium dichalcogenide series CuCr$X_2$, the oxide, the sulfide, and the selenide analogues have been reported, but the telluride CuCrTe$_2$ has remained unsynthesized so far. Here, we report the synthesis of Cu$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ ($x \approx 0.3$), which forms only within a narrow temperature window near 90 °C by solvothermal cation exchange of K$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ ($x \approx 0.3$) and CuBr. Cu$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ undergoes a magnetostructural transition to an antiferromagnetic state at $T_\mathrm{N}=239$ K, a Néel temperature that is high relative to other $A$CrTe$_2$ phases and comparable to that of ferromagnetic, fully-deintercalated CrTe$_2$. Cu$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ is metastable and decomposes at temperatures as low as 250 °C to form spinel CuCr$_2$Te$_4$. These results highlight the importance of low-temperature topochemical routes for accessing metastable Cu(I)-containing tellurides that are inaccessible by conventional solid-state synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“synthesis”、“solvothermal cation exchange”、“decomposes”等表明是实验合成与表征工作。；研究对象：铜铬碲化物Cu₁₋ₓCrTe₂（x≈0.3），一种层状铜铬二硫族化合物系列中此前未合成的碲化物相，属于亚稳态铜(I)碲化物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过溶剂热阳离子交换法成功合成了Cu₁₋ₓCrTe₂，该材料在239 K发生磁结构转变进入反铁磁态，其奈尔温度高于其他ACrTe₂相，且与完全脱嵌的CrTe₂的铁磁转变温度相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过溶剂热阳离子交换法成功合成了Cu₁₋ₓCrTe₂，该材料在239 K发生磁结构转变进入反铁磁态，其奈尔温度高于其他ACrTe₂相，且与完全脱嵌的CrTe₂的铁磁转变温度相当。；创新点：首次合成了铜铬二硫族化合物系列中缺失的碲化物成员CuCrTe₂（实际为缺铜相Cu₁₋ₓCrTe₂），证明了低温拓扑化学路线在获取传统固相合成无法得到的亚稳态Cu(I)碲化物中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 溶剂热阳离子交换法：以K₁₋ₓCrTe₂（x≈0.3）和CuBr为前驱体，在约90 °C的窄温度窗口内进行反应。通过磁化率测量确定磁相变温度，通过热分解实验（250 °C分解为尖晶石相CuCr₂Te₄）表征其亚稳性。

papers.title: Coherent modeling of double-folded ring polymers and their underlying random tree structure
authors: Pieter H. W. van der Hoek
papers.abstract: Topologically constrained genome-like polymers often double-fold into tree-like configurations, which can be modelled on the level of folded (ring) polymers or on the level of the underlying random trees. For both descriptions, we have recently obtained expressions for the configurational entropy in ensembles with controlled branching activity. Here we demonstrate that they are equivalent up to a contribution originating from the number of distinct wrappings of a single tree. This allows us to develop a coherent framework for freely switching between the two representations. Importantly, the equivalence extends to interacting systems provided the interactions are treated consistently on the tree and on the ring level. To demonstrate the utility of the scheme, we introduce a generalization of the Amoeba Monte Carlo algorithm capable of generating the required ensembles of trees with fluctuating sizes. While the tree algorithm reproduces results obtained by dynamic simulations of the corresponding ring model, it is $O(N)$ faster for the purpose of sampling static properties and leverages the utility of the ring model for the study of dynamical properties, when used for the preparation of equilibrated starting states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要提到“获得构型熵表达式”“发展统一框架”“引入蒙特卡洛算法推广”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合。；研究对象：双折叠环状聚合物及其对应的随机树结构，用于模拟拓扑约束的类基因组聚合物（如染色体折叠）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在受控分支活性系综中，环状聚合物描述与随机树描述在构型熵上等价，仅相差一个与单棵树不同缠绕方式数量相关的贡献；该等价性在一致处理相互作用时仍成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在受控分支活性系综中，环状聚合物描述与随机树描述在构型熵上等价，仅相差一个与单棵树不同缠绕方式数量相关的贡献；该等价性在一致处理相互作用时仍成立。；创新点：首次证明环聚合物与随机树两种描述在构型熵上的等价性，并建立可自由切换的统一框架；提出的树算法在采样静态性质时比环模型动力学模拟快O(N)倍，同时可用于制备平衡起始态以研究动力学性质。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导构型熵表达式，建立环与树两种表示之间的统一框架；推广Amoeba蒙特卡洛算法，生成大小可变的树系综，并与环模型的动力学模拟结果对比。

papers.title: Ordering, correlation functions and phase transitions in molecular systems
papers.abstract: Although the classical density functional theory (DFT) of inhomogeneous fluids was formulated more than four decades ago, its application to broken symmetry phases of molecular systems remained a challenge. Approximate free energy functionals proposed in the past failed to give accurate description of relative stability of phases, phase transitions, and of properties arising due to broken symmetry. In a DFT pair correlation functions (PCFs) play a fundamental role. While in the case of homogeneous fluids, PCFs are routinely determined using experimental, theoretical or simulation methods, determination of PCFs of broken symmetry phases remained a problem. Breaking of symmetry at the transition point gives rise a new contribution to correlation functions which may differ significantly from that of the coexisting higher symmetry phase. We review methods which have been developed in the last few years to calculate PCFs of broken symmetry phases and their inclusion in the expressions of the grand potential and the intrinsic free-energy. This leads to formulation of an exact DFT. We describe application of the theory to freezing of variety of fluids into ordered phases and transition from an ordered phase of higher symmetry to a phase of lower symmetry. Comparison of results found from different versions of DFT and simulations reveal their accuracy. A brief description of basics of statistical mechanics is included to make the article self-contained.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论经典密度泛函理论（DFT）的公式化、近似自由能泛函的局限性，以及相关函数和相变的理论方法，未涉及实验或模拟数据。；研究对象：分子系统中的有序化、关联函数与相变，具体包括从均匀流体到有序相的冻结过程，以及从高对称有序相到低对称有序相的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在对称性破缺相中，关联函数（PCFs）在相变点会产生与共存高对称相显著不同的新贡献；通过将破缺相的PCFs纳入巨势和本征自由能表达式，可构建精确的密度泛函理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在对称性破缺相中，关联函数（PCFs）在相变点会产生与共存高对称相显著不同的新贡献；通过将破缺相的PCFs纳入巨势和本征自由能表达式，可构建精确的密度泛函理论。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出过去近似自由能泛函无法准确描述破缺相的相对稳定性、相变及性质，而本文综述的方法通过精确处理破缺相PCFs，实现了对上述问题的改进描述。
papers.method_zh: 经典密度泛函理论（DFT）框架，重点综述了近年来发展的计算对称性破缺相中成对关联函数（PCFs）的方法，并将其整合到巨势和本征自由能表达式中，形成精确DFT。文中还包含统计力学基础简述。

papers.title: Kapitza-like modulation of near-field radiative heat transfer
papers.abstract: We introduce a Kapitza-like mechanism for the near-field radiative heat transfer and show that fast modulation of any parameter controlling the flux, such as the vacuum gap or a material response, produces a quadratic, time-averaged correction in the slow thermal dynamics. This correction splits into a frequency-independent static term and a low-pass dynamical term, yielding sizable modulation-induced temperature shifts and modified effective thermal conductances that can stabilize or destabilize the steady state. Applying the theory to gap modulation between SiC slabs, we derive analytical scaling laws and predict temperature shifts that are fully measurable with existing experimental platforms, requiring only readily accessible low modulation frequencies of order $Ω\approx 10^4~\mathrm{rad/s}$. Our results establish a thermal analogue of the Kapitza mechanism and provide a general route for controlling radiative heat flow in micro- and nanoscale platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“introduce a mechanism”“derive analytical scaling laws”“predict”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：近场辐射热传递中的调制效应，具体以SiC平板之间的真空间隙调制为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 快速调制控制近场辐射热流的参数（如真空间隙或材料响应）会产生一个与调制频率平方成正比的时间平均修正项，该修正项可导致显著的温度偏移并改变有效热导，从而稳定或失稳稳态，建立了热学中的Kapitza类比机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：快速调制控制近场辐射热流的参数（如真空间隙或材料响应）会产生一个与调制频率平方成正比的时间平均修正项，该修正项可导致显著的温度偏移并改变有效热导，从而稳定或失稳稳态，建立了热学中的Kapitza类比机制。；创新点：首次提出近场辐射热传递中的Kapitza-like机制，即通过快速调制产生可观测的稳态温度偏移和有效热导变化，且所需调制频率（约10^4 rad/s）在现有实验平台上完全可实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于近场辐射热传递的涨落电动力学理论，引入参数（如间隙）的快速时间调制，推导出热动力学方程中时间平均的二次修正项，并给出频率无关的静态项和低通动态项的解析标度律。

papers.title: Tuning the Charge Transfer of Transition Metal Dichalcogenides via Misfit Layer Compounds
papers.abstract: Misfit layer compounds (MLCs) are a versatile platform for exploring the electronic phase diagram of two dimensional (2D) materials beyond the limits of conventional gating techniques. This work demonstrates the precise tunability of electron doping in NbSe2 monolayers through chemical alloying within the rocksalt layer of (LaxPb1xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2 heterostructures. By combining first principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations with angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we prove that the rocksalt unit acts as an universal electron donor. We show that varying the La Pb ratio results in a rigid Fermi level shift, still preserving the NbSe2 electronic structure. Crucially, photon energy dependent ARPES confirms that the NbSe2 layers nearly maintain their intrinsic 2D character and orbital identity within the three dimensional misfit. This study establishes MLCs as a reliable platform for engineering emergent states in 2D transition metal dichalcogenides through precise stoichiometric control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：结合了第一性原理DFT计算与ARPES实验。；研究对象：过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDs）中的NbSe₂单层，通过（LaₓPb₁₋ₓSe）₁.₁₄(NbSe₂)₂错配层化合物（MLCs）实现电荷转移调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变（LaₓPb₁₋ₓSe）岩盐层中La/Pb比例，可精确调控NbSe₂单层的电子掺杂浓度，实现刚性能级移动，同时保持NbSe₂的电子结构及二维特性不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变（LaₓPb₁₋ₓSe）岩盐层中La/Pb比例，可精确调控NbSe₂单层的电子掺杂浓度，实现刚性能级移动，同时保持NbSe₂的电子结构及二维特性不变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验；光子能量依赖的ARPES用于验证二维特性。

papers.title: Energy-Weighted Site Percolation in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: We study a generalization of two-dimensional site percolation by assigning an energy cost $\varepsilon$ to bonds between nearest-neighbor occupied sites. This leads to a competition between entropy-driven cluster growth and energetic suppression (or enhancement) of connectivity. Varying $\varepsilon$ continuously interpolates between dense ferromagnetic-like clusters, ordinary classical percolation, and a dilute regime of minimally connected isolated clusters. Using Monte Carlo simulations and real-space renormalization-group (RG) methods, we show that bond energy shifts the percolation threshold smoothly. We define an energy-weighted correlation length that remains finite at the classical site occupation threshold ($p_c(\varepsilon=0)$) and shrinks with increasing $\varepsilon$, capturing the energetic suppression of large-scale connectivity. The cluster size distribution exhibits an energy-dependent cutoff that drives the transition from percolation-like clusters to isolated clusters. A real-space RG with Kadanoff block recursions reveals a systematic evolution of the correlation-length exponent $ν$ from $ν=1/2$ (dense clusters) to $ν=4/3$ (classical percolation), approaching $ν=1$ (minimally connected isolated clusters), in agreement with Coulomb-gas predictions for loop models where bond energy renormalizes loop fugacity. For large values of \(\varepsilon\) (isotropic case), the suppression of nearest-neighbor bonds results in the emergence of antiferromagnetic sub-lattice ordering at high densities. Additionally, anisotropic bond energies lead to directionally selective cluster growth. Finally, we also discuss a lattice gas RG approach and scenarios where bond energy is renormalized across different scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations, real-space renormalization-group (RG) methods, Coulomb-gas predictions。；研究对象：二维格点上的能量加权渗流（energy-weighted site percolation）模型，即给最近邻占据位点之间的键赋予能量成本ε，研究由此导致的渗流行为变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 键能ε平滑地移动渗流阈值，并改变关联长度指数ν：从ν=1/2（密集铁磁团簇）经ν=4/3（经典渗流）趋向ν=1（最小连接孤立团簇），与环模型中键能重整化环游动性的Coulomb-gas预言一致。大ε下出现反铁磁子晶格有序，各向异性键能导致方向选择性团簇生长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：键能ε平滑地移动渗流阈值，并改变关联长度指数ν：从ν=1/2（密集铁磁团簇）经ν=4/3（经典渗流）趋向ν=1（最小连接孤立团簇），与环模型中键能重整化环游动性的Coulomb-gas预言一致。大ε下出现反铁磁子晶格有序，各向异性键能导致方向选择性团簇生长。；创新点：将渗流模型推广为包含键能权重，系统研究了能量与熵竞争对渗流阈值、关联长度、团簇尺寸分布及临界指数的影响，并揭示了各向同性大ε下的反铁磁有序和各向异性下的定向生长行为。摘要未突出说明与已有渗流变体模型的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 蒙特卡洛模拟、实空间重整化群（Kadanoff块递归）、晶格气重整化群方法，并与Coulomb-gas理论预言进行对比。

papers.title: Jones-Roberts solitary waves and the onset of rotation in a spherical surface condensate
papers.abstract: The nonlinear excitations underlying the onset of rotation in a dilute Bose-Einstein condensate confined to a thin spherical shell are studied. These excitations correspond to solitary waves rotating about the sphere at constant angular speed: at low speeds they appear as dipoles of singly quantized vortices with opposite circulation, while at higher speeds they evolve into vortex-free Jones-Roberts solitons. With further increase of the angular speed, these excitations hybridize with equatorially confined modes whose azimuthal wave number is set by the sphere radius measured in units of the healing length. The propagation speed of these modes is shown to play the role of a Landau critical velocity, thereby setting the upper limiting angular speed of the entire Jones-Roberts family.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“studied”、“appear as”、“evolve into”、“shown to play the role”等理论分析与推导性描述，未提及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：限制在薄球壳上的稀薄玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中，旋转开始时的非线性激发（孤立波），具体包括Jones-Roberts孤立波、涡旋偶极子以及赤道局域模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在球壳BEC中，旋转的起始由一系列非线性激发（孤立波）驱动：低速时为反向环量单量子涡旋偶极子，高速时演变为无涡的Jones-Roberts孤立子；进一步增加角速度时，这些激发与赤道局域模混合，后者的传播速度作为Landau临界速度，决定了整个Jones-Roberts孤立波族的上限角速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在球壳BEC中，旋转的起始由一系列非线性激发（孤立波）驱动：低速时为反向环量单量子涡旋偶极子，高速时演变为无涡的Jones-Roberts孤立子；进一步增加角速度时，这些激发与赤道局域模混合，后者的传播速度作为Landau临界速度，决定了整个Jones-Roberts孤立波族的上限角速度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于Gross-Pitaevskii方程或类似平均场理论，通过分析孤立波在球面上的恒定角速度旋转行为，以及其与赤道局域模的杂交条件，推导出Landau临界速度。

papers.title: Strong nanomechanical Duffing nonlinearity and interactions induced through cavity optomechanics
papers.abstract: Nonlinearity is a key resource in both classical and quantum signal processing. Nonlinear nanomechanical elements have found applications ranging from sensing to computing, while networks of nonlinear resonators, as well as nonlinearly coupled networks of linear resonators, constitute promising platforms for simulating complex dynamics. Here, we experimentally demonstrate an approach to realizing strong mechanical nonlinearity in nanomechanical resonators, fully controlled through optical laser drives. The mechanism exploits the nonlinearity of the radiation-pressure interaction in a cavity optomechanical system, which gives rise to a nonlinear optical spring effect. The resulting Duffing nonlinearity is conveniently tunable in strength via pump laser power, while its sign is controlled by laser detuning. Moreover, we demonstrate that the nonlinear optical spring mediates effective interactions between mechanical modes coupled to a common cavity, inducing tunable nonlinear interactions between them that impact spectral response and dynamics. These results establish cavity optomechanics as a versatile and in-situ reconfigurable platform for engineering nonlinear dynamics in resonators and networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimentally demonstrate、optical laser drives、pump laser power、laser detuning。；研究对象：基于腔光力学系统的纳米机械谐振器中的强非线性效应，具体为通过辐射压相互作用诱导的Duffing非线性，以及机械模式之间的有效非线性相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过激光驱动完全控制腔光力学系统，实现了可调谐的强机械Duffing非线性，并进一步展示了该非线性光学弹簧效应可诱导共用同一光腔的机械模式之间的有效非线性相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过激光驱动完全控制腔光力学系统，实现了可调谐的强机械Duffing非线性，并进一步展示了该非线性光学弹簧效应可诱导共用同一光腔的机械模式之间的有效非线性相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心创新在于利用腔光力学机制原位、可重构地实现并调控纳米机械谐振器的强Duffing非线性，以及由此产生的机械模式间可调非线性相互作用，为非线性动力学工程提供了通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用腔光力学系统，利用辐射压相互作用的非线性产生非线性光学弹簧效应；通过改变泵浦激光功率调节非线性强度，通过改变激光失谐控制非线性的符号。

papers.title: Coalescence of Polymer Droplets Moving on a Surface with Stiffness Gradient
papers.abstract: Here, we study the coalescence of two droplets that are moving in the same direction on a soft surface; the motion of the droplets is caused by a gradient in the surface stiffness. As reference, stationary coalescence of the same droplets is also studied on the corresponding uniform surfaces for different stiffness values. To describe the coalescence phenomenon on a surface with stiffness gradient, a relevant range of velocity ratios of the leading and the trailing droplet was considered to elucidate the effect of this parameter on coalescence. Moreover, to analyze the dynamics of the process, the temporal growth of the bridge height $(h)$ was investigated, which follows a power law $(h \sim t^α)$, before eventually attaining a constant value. The obtained values of $α$ show a transition from a higher to a lower value as a function of time, pointing to the presence of two distinct power-law growth regimes, where the transition signifies the crossover from the capillarity-dominated regime to the viscoelasticty-dominated regime of coalescence. In addition, varying attractive strengths for droplet--droplet and intra-droplet interactions were considered. The results indicate that both the dynamics and the degree of the coalescence strongly depend on these interaction parameters. Thus, we anticipate that our results will shed more light on the durotaxis-driven coalescence of polymeric droplets for various relevant system parameters, which will have practical implications for applications ranging from microfluidics to ink-jet printing, where substrate properties may vary. In addition, results may add to the fundamental understanding of the interactions among multicellular aggregates moving on biological surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：study（研究）、describe（描述）、analyze（分析）、power law（幂律）、regime（区间）。；研究对象：在具有刚度梯度的软表面上同向运动的两个聚合物液滴的聚并现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴聚并过程中桥接高度随时间呈幂律增长（h ~ t^α），且存在从毛细主导区向粘弹性主导区的两个不同幂律增长区间的转变；液滴-液滴及液滴内部相互作用的强度对聚并动力学和程度有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴聚并过程中桥接高度随时间呈幂律增长（h ~ t^α），且存在从毛细主导区向粘弹性主导区的两个不同幂律增长区间的转变；液滴-液滴及液滴内部相互作用的强度对聚并动力学和程度有显著影响。；创新点：首次系统研究了由表面刚度梯度驱动的液滴运动（趋硬性）对聚合物液滴聚并过程的影响，并揭示了速度比和相互作用参数在其中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟或理论建模方法，研究了不同表面刚度下静止液滴的聚并作为参考，并针对刚度梯度表面上的运动液滴，考虑了前后液滴速度比的影响，分析了桥接高度的时间演化及相互作用参数的变化。

papers.title: Quantum geometry induced anomalous chiral transport and hidden symmetry breaking in centrosymmetric 2M-WS2
papers.abstract: Chirality, a widely existing material property in nature involving the breaking of the left-right symmetry, has profound influences in various fields of natural sciences. Nonlinear response, such as electronic magnetochiral anisotropy (eMChA), has been recognized as a sensitive probe for the effects of symmetry breaking and nontrivial quantum geometries in solids. So far, observations of eMChA have primarily been limited to inversion-symmetry broken materials. Here, we report a remarkable chiral transport in centrosymmetric candidate topological superconductor 2M-WS2 flakes observed via second-harmonic generation under an out-of-plane magnetic field. More importantly, the eMChA becomes significant around the crossover temperature TFL ~ 25 K from the Fermi liquid (FL) to strange metal (SM) in the normal state, which interestingly echoes with the anomalously large Nernst response at the same temperature in bulk 2M-WS2. These observations reveal a direct correspondence between the nonlinear response, Nernst response, and FL-SM transition in 2M-WS2. Theoretical analysis indicates that nontrivial quantum geometry is behind the simultaneous response of eMChA and Nernst effects in 2M-WS2 and the contribution from the orbital magnetic moment at the Fermi surface becomes significant during the FL-SM transition. Based on first-principles calculations, a thick-layer-sliding mechanism with minimal energy gain in 2M-WS2 provides one possibility for the generation of such nontrivial quantum geometry. The intertwined physics of remarkable eMChA, Nernst response, and FL-SM transition make 2M-WS2 a rare quantum platform to study the chiral transport and unexplored phenomena in strange metals, which may shed light on the trans-century, unresolved scientific issue in unconventional high-temperature superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论分析）。判断依据：摘要明确报告了在2M-WS2薄片中观测到的“remarkable chiral transport”（显著手性输运）和“second-harmonic generation”（二次谐波产生）等实验现象，并基于第一性原理计算进行理论解释。；研究对象：中心对称候选拓扑超导体2M-WS2薄片中的反常手性输运现象，特别是电子磁手征各向异性（eMChA）及其与费米液体-奇异金属（FL-SM）转变的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称材料2M-WS2中观测到了由面外磁场诱导的显著手性输运（eMChA），该效应在费米液体到奇异金属的转变温度（~25 K）附近变得显著，并与该温度下异常大的能斯特效应直接对应。理论分析表明，非平庸的量子几何是这些现象背后的共同根源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称材料2M-WS2中观测到了由面外磁场诱导的显著手性输运（eMChA），该效应在费米液体到奇异金属的转变温度（~25 K）附近变得显著，并与该温度下异常大的能斯特效应直接对应。理论分析表明，非平庸的量子几何是这些现象背后的共同根源。；创新点：首次在具有中心对称性的材料（2M-WS2）中观测到显著的电子磁手征各向异性（eMChA），打破了此前eMChA主要局限于反演对称性破缺材料的认知。同时，该工作揭示了eMChA、能斯特效应与费米液体-奇异金属转变之间的直接对应关系，为研究奇异金属中的手性输运和非常规高温超导等未解之谜提供了新的量子平台。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：在2M-WS2薄片中测量面外磁场下的二次谐波产生（second-harmonic generation），以此探测电子磁手征各向异性（eMChA）。

papers.title: Why hole polaron formation on oxygen is limiting the Fermi level in Fe acceptor doped BaTiO$_{3}$ under oxidizing conditions
papers.abstract: Oxidizing Fe-doped BaTiO$_3$ is commonly expected to convert substitutional Fe$^{3+}$ acceptors into formal Fe$^{4+}$ centers. Yet, the experimentally accessible picture based on electron-paramagnetic resonance (EPR) is dominated by Fe$^{3+}$-related signatures, while Fe$^{4+}$ is not a straightforward observable. Here we show that this apparent discrepancy reflects the preferred location of the oxidizing hole: not on Fe, but on oxygen. Using density-functional theory with with occupation-matrix control and a piecewise-linearity-based Hubbard correction (DFT+$U$) for O-2$p$ states, we find that an oxygen-centered hole polaron is forming a Fe$^{3+}$-O$^{-}$ complex that is lower in energy than the formal Fe$^{4+}$ configuration. Our results identify ligand-hole formation as a favorable charge-compensation mechanism in oxidized Fe-doped BaTiO$_3$ and provide an explanation for the predominance of Fe$^{3+}$-based centers in spectroscopy. More broadly, they show how oxygen polarons can limit Fermi-level shifts and control the electronic response of acceptor-doped ferroelectric perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：使用密度泛函理论（DFT+U）进行第一性原理计算，无实验数据报道。；研究对象：Fe 受主掺杂的 BaTiO₃ 在氧化条件下空穴极化子的形成机制，特别是氧上极化子与 Fe 价态变化之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在氧化条件下，Fe 掺杂 BaTiO₃ 中氧化空穴更倾向于局域在氧原子上形成 Fe³⁺-O⁻ 复合体，而非形成形式上的 Fe⁴⁺ 中心。这一氧极化子机制解释了为何电子顺磁共振（EPR）实验中主要观察到 Fe³⁺ 信号，并限制了费米能级的移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在氧化条件下，Fe 掺杂 BaTiO₃ 中氧化空穴更倾向于局域在氧原子上形成 Fe³⁺-O⁻ 复合体，而非形成形式上的 Fe⁴⁺ 中心。这一氧极化子机制解释了为何电子顺磁共振（EPR）实验中主要观察到 Fe³⁺ 信号，并限制了费米能级的移动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用具有占据矩阵控制和基于分段线性修正的 Hubbard 校正的密度泛函理论（DFT+U），专门针对 O-2p 态进行校正。

papers.title: Modulating hydrodynamic flow by modifying the active patch of a colloid
papers.abstract: We have developed a simulation model to study the hydrodynamic flow fields around Brownian colloidal particles with an active surface patch. Hydrodynamics is introduced by modeling low-Reynolds-number fluid flows around a colloid using multi-particle collision (MPC) dynamics and allowing momentum exchange between the MPC fluid and the colloid. This approach provides good estimates of both near- and far-field flows around the colloid. The size of the active patch is varied to generate different fluid flow fields around the colloid. In this framework, the fluid in the vicinity of the active patch is driven radially away from (or toward) the surface, and an equal and opposite momentum is imparted to the colloid to ensure momentum conservation. The resulting surface-driven flow generates self-propulsion of the particle, thereby converting an otherwise Brownian colloid into an active Brownian particle. Interestingly, as we systematically vary the surface area of the active patch on the colloid, the nature of the generated flow field changes from that of a pusher to a puller. To model such surface activity-driven flows, we developed a hybrid boundary condition that ensures a no-slip condition while incorporating momentum exchange between the flowing fluid and the colloid surface. This scheme integrates the advantages of bounce-back and stochastic boundary conditions while mitigating their respective limitations. Thus, in future studies, the effective hydrodynamic interactions between an active and a passive colloid, or between two active colloids, can be modulated by adjusting the size of the active patch.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“simulation model”、“multi-particle collision (MPC) dynamics”、“hybrid boundary condition”。；研究对象：具有活性表面斑块的布朗胶体粒子及其周围的流体动力学流场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统改变胶体上活性斑块的面积，可以调控其周围流体流场的性质，使其从“推手型”（pusher）转变为“拉手型”（puller），从而将普通布朗粒子转化为活性布朗粒子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统改变胶体上活性斑块的面积，可以调控其周围流体流场的性质，使其从“推手型”（pusher）转变为“拉手型”（puller），从而将普通布朗粒子转化为活性布朗粒子。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用多粒子碰撞（MPC）动力学模拟低雷诺数流体，并引入混合边界条件（结合反弹与随机边界条件的优点）实现流体与胶体表面的动量交换，同时保证无滑移条件。

papers.title: Pressure Effects on CeMnSi: Evolution of Ce 4f and Mn 3d Electronic States and Negative Thermal Expansion
papers.abstract: We investigated pressure effects on the nontrivial heavy-fermion antiferromagnet CeMnSi by means of electrical resistivity and powder X-ray diffraction. With increasing pressure, the antiferromagnetic order of Mn (T_N ~ 240 K at ambient pressure) is rapidly suppressed and disappears at P_c ~ 1.3 GPa. Instead, a pressure-induced anomaly appears at T_M ~ 97 K and shifts to higher temperatures with increasing pressure. The switching of the Mn magnetic state may reflect a modification of the magnetic symmetry of the system, which could influence the stability of the heavy-fermion state. In the low-pressure region, non-Fermi-liquid-like behavior characterized by nearly T-linear resistivity is observed around 0.7 GPa. In addition, the resistivity shows a marked reduction below T_M and a qualitative change toward more metallic behavior above the structural transition pressure P_s ~ 5.7 GPa. At ambient pressure, CeMnSi exhibits negative thermal expansion below ~40 K, which is absent in LaMnSi, supporting the formation of a heavy-fermion ground state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“by means of electrical resistivity and powder X-ray diffraction”（电阻率和粉末X射线衍射实验手段）。；研究对象：重费米子反铁磁体CeMnSi，具体研究压力对其Ce 4f和Mn 3d电子态的影响，以及负热膨胀现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力可快速抑制Mn的反铁磁序（在约1.3 GPa消失），并诱导出新的压力相关异常（T_M ~ 97 K）；在约0.7 GPa附近观察到非费米液体行为（近T线性电阻率）；CeMnSi在约40 K以下存在负热膨胀，支持重费米子基态的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力可快速抑制Mn的反铁磁序（在约1.3 GPa消失），并诱导出新的压力相关异常（T_M ~ 97 K）；在约0.7 GPa附近观察到非费米液体行为（近T线性电阻率）；CeMnSi在约40 K以下存在负热膨胀，支持重费米子基态的形成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 电阻率测量（电输运）和粉末X射线衍射（结构表征），通过施加不同压力研究电子态和结构变化。

papers.title: Short-range order in the CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy from cluster expansion
papers.abstract: We investigate the short-range order (SRO) and phase stability of the equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy using cluster expansion supplemented by an eigen-decomposition analysis of the SRO parameters. Our results reveal that the primary ordering behavior is determined by strong Cr-Cr repulsive interactions, complemented by attractive heteroatomic Cr-$X$ pairs in the first nearest-neighbor shell. This chemical affinity is consistent with the emergence of ordered local environments and appears to be a major contributor to the primary order-disorder transition. At lower temperatures, the spectral SRO analysis suggests two additional lower-temperature instabilities: a collective ordering instability and an Fe-rich local clustering instability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：cluster expansion、eigen-decomposition analysis、spectral SRO analysis）；研究对象：等原子比CoCrFeMnNi高熵合金的短程有序（SRO）与相稳定性
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 第一近邻壳层中强烈的Cr-Cr排斥相互作用与异类Cr-X吸引相互作用共同决定了主要的有序化行为，并在低温下存在两种额外不稳定性：集体有序化不稳定性与富Fe局域团簇不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：第一近邻壳层中强烈的Cr-Cr排斥相互作用与异类Cr-X吸引相互作用共同决定了主要的有序化行为，并在低温下存在两种额外不稳定性：集体有序化不稳定性与富Fe局域团簇不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明
papers.method_zh: 团簇展开方法，辅以SRO参数的本征分解分析（eigen-decomposition analysis）与谱分析（spectral SRO analysis）

papers.title: First-principles investigation of small polarons in rhombohedral NaNbO$_{3}$
papers.abstract: Sodium niobate (NaNbO$_{3}$) is a perovskite oxide and a key component of emerging lead-free antiferroelectric capacitors for high-energy-density applications. However, its performance can be hindered by irreversible phase transitions and leakage currents associated with low electrical resistivity. Defect and doping engineering offers a potential way to overcome these problems, but its use requires a detailed understanding of electronic, ionic, and polaron charge-compensation mechanisms, where the role of polarons remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the stability of small hole and electron polarons in rhombohedral NaNbO$_{3}$, which is a structurally well-defined model system that avoids lattice-dynamical instabilities. Trapping energies are calculated using density-functional theory corrected by a Hubbard $U$, using the enforced-piecewise-linearity approach including finite-size scaling. For the small hole-polaron centered on O-2$p$ orbital, we find a trapping energy of $-$0.65 (eV) and an adiabatic migration barrier of 0.32 (eV) determined by nudged-elastic-band calculations. In contrast, we show that excess electrons do not self-trap on Nb-4$d$ orbitals, reflecting weak electron-phonon coupling in the conduction band manifold. These results identify oxygen as an intrinsic hole trap in NaNbO$_{3}$ and highlight the importance of including hole polarons in defect models of NaNbO$_{3}$-based electroceramics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“first-principles investigation”、“density-functional theory”、“nudged-elastic-band calculations”。；研究对象：菱方相铌酸钠（NaNbO₃）中的小极化子（包括空穴极化子和电子极化子）的稳定性与迁移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧原子上的小空穴极化子在菱方相NaNbO₃中稳定存在，其俘获能为-0.65 eV，绝热迁移势垒为0.32 eV；而多余电子不会在Nb-4d轨道上自陷，表明导带中电子-声子耦合较弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧原子上的小空穴极化子在菱方相NaNbO₃中稳定存在，其俘获能为-0.65 eV，绝热迁移势垒为0.32 eV；而多余电子不会在Nb-4d轨道上自陷，表明导带中电子-声子耦合较弱。；创新点：首次在结构明确且无晶格动力学不稳定的菱方相NaNbO₃中系统计算了小极化子的稳定性，揭示了氧作为本征空穴陷阱的作用，并指出在缺陷模型中必须考虑空穴极化子。
papers.method_zh: 采用Hubbard U修正的密度泛函理论（DFT+U），结合强制分段线性方法（enforced-piecewise-linearity approach）并考虑有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）计算俘获能；使用微动弹性带方法（nudged-elastic-band）计算绝热迁移势垒。

papers.title: Localization of a quantum particle in a classical one-component plasma. II. Dynamic Disorder and Temporal Decorrelation
papers.abstract: We extend the static theory of disorder-induced exponential decay of the averaged Green function of a quantum charged particle in a classical one-component plasma to the dynamic regime by incorporating the temporal evolution of the ionic density fluctuations within the random phase approximation. The dynamic potential correlator is derived from the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and the Kramers--Kronig relations. Within the eikonal (straight-line) approximation, the effective disorder strength is expressed through the dielectric function of the ion plasma. For particles moving faster than the ion thermal speed, the static Coulomb logarithm is recovered, with the large-distance cutoff replaced by the dynamic scale $v/ω_{pi}$. For slow particles, the Coulomb logarithm disappears completely and the disorder strength becomes proportional to the velocity, leading to a fundamentally different scaling of the localization length. In particular, the strong-disorder length diverges as $k^{-1/3}$ for $v\ll v_{\mathrm{th}}$, whereas it saturates in the static limit, indicating that ultra-slow particles are not exponentially localized in a dynamic plasma. A crossover between the quasi-static and dynamic regimes occurs when the particle speed becomes comparable to the ion thermal speed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论扩展、随机相位近似、eikonal近似、解析推导。；研究对象：经典单组分等离子体中带电量子粒子的动态局域化问题，具体研究离子密度涨落的时间演化对粒子平均格林函数指数衰减的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 慢速粒子（速度远小于离子热速度）在动态等离子体中不会发生指数局域化，其强无序长度发散为 \( k^{-1/3} \) 标度，与静态极限下的饱和行为根本不同；准静态与动态 regime 的交叉发生在粒子速度与离子热速度相当的时候。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：慢速粒子（速度远小于离子热速度）在动态等离子体中不会发生指数局域化，其强无序长度发散为 \( k^{-1/3} \) 标度，与静态极限下的饱和行为根本不同；准静态与动态 regime 的交叉发生在粒子速度与离子热速度相当的时候。；创新点：将静态无序诱导的指数衰减理论推广到动态 regime，揭示了动态无序对局域化长度的全新标度行为（如慢速粒子的 \( k^{-1/3} \) 发散），并指出超慢粒子在动态等离子体中不会指数局域化。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机相位近似描述离子密度涨落的时间演化；利用涨落-耗散定理和Kramers-Kronig关系推导动态势关联函数；采用eikonal（直线路径）近似将有效无序强度表达为离子等离子体介电函数的形式。

papers.title: High-Density Horizontal Arrays of Single-Chirality Carbon Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Highly ordered high-density arrays of single-chirality single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are greatly desired for exploring the intrinsic anisotropic properties and collective performance of such 1-dimensional (1D) nanomaterials. Here we present a Marangoni flow-induced self-assembly (MISA) strategy to fabricate monolayered SWCNT arrays achieving a packing density of ~200 ${μm}^{-1}$ and a 2-dimensional order parameter ($S_{2\mathrm{D}}$) of ~0.95. Relying on its general compatibility with both organic and aqueous dispersions, we prepare single-chirality and enantiomer-pure SWCNT arrays from organic and aqueous dispersions resulting from the sorting processes. The anisotropic optical and electrical properties of the arrays are demonstrated by the polarization-dependent Rabi splitting as well as polarized near-infrared light emission and detection. With the great tolerance to solutions, substrates, and materials, as well as the feasibility and controllability, MISA shows great potential in the assembly of 1D nanomaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：self-assembly（自组装）、fabricate（制备）、demonstrated（展示）、polarization-dependent（偏振依赖）等实验操作与表征。；研究对象：单壁碳纳米管（SWCNTs）的高密度水平阵列，特别是单一手性（single-chirality）和对映体纯（enantiomer-pure）的碳纳米管阵列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过马兰戈尼流诱导自组装（MISA）策略，成功制备了堆积密度约200 μm⁻¹、二维有序参数约0.95的单层碳纳米管阵列，并实现了单一手性及对映体纯阵列的构建，展示了其各向异性的光学与电学性质（如偏振依赖的拉比劈裂、偏振近红外光发射与探测）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过马兰戈尼流诱导自组装（MISA）策略，成功制备了堆积密度约200 μm⁻¹、二维有序参数约0.95的单层碳纳米管阵列，并实现了单一手性及对映体纯阵列的构建，展示了其各向异性的光学与电学性质（如偏振依赖的拉比劈裂、偏振近红外光发射与探测）。；创新点：提出了一种对溶液、基底和材料具有高度容忍性、且可控性强的自组装方法（MISA），能够同时实现高密度、高有序度以及单一手性/对映体纯的碳纳米管阵列制备，克服了传统组装方法在普适性和手性控制上的局限。
papers.method_zh: 马兰戈尼流诱导自组装（MISA）策略；利用该策略对有机和水性分散液的普适兼容性，结合手性分选过程获得的分散液制备阵列；通过偏振依赖的光学与电学测量表征各向异性性质。

papers.title: Characterisation of fire-damaged batteries,implications for recycling
papers.abstract: As lithium-ion battery demand grows, so do fire safety challenges. Despite this, research on fire-damaged batteries remains limited. This study explores the distribution of valuable metals (such as Ni, Mn, Co, Cu) in two types of waste derived from lithium-ion nickel-manganese-cobalt oxide batteries (NMC811), black mass (BM) and fire-damaged waste (FD). It emphasizes that cobalt, manganese, and nickel-rich NMC811 particles are predominantly found in smaller particle size fractions (<125 microns), where they can account for up to 85 percent of total metal content. Fire-damaged (FD) batteries show a similar, though less pronounced, trend. Evidence of structural degradation suggests that fire temperatures exceeded 500°C; however, the presence of residual organic binders indicates that heat was unevenly distributed during the fire. FD batteries become friable and easily fragment into fine particles, which can hinder the effective separation of copper and aluminium current collectors, increasing their presence in processed material. The inclusion of FD batteries in standard BM processing introduces variability in output composition, potentially lowering the concentration of high-value NMC811 materials present. To maintain product quality and recycling output values, it is recommended that FD batteries are processed separately. Alternatively, particle size separation may allow for tailored outputs aligned with specific customer requirements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：explores the distribution、evidence of structural degradation、processing。；研究对象：锂离子电池（NMC811型）的两种废弃物：黑质（black mass, BM）和火灾损坏废弃物（fire-damaged waste, FD），重点关注其中贵金属（Ni, Mn, Co, Cu）的分布与回收特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 火灾损坏电池中的NMC811颗粒主要富集在小于125微米的细颗粒组分中（金属含量可达85%），但火灾导致的结构降解（温度超过500°C）使电池变脆易碎，增加了铜铝集流体在加工材料中的混入，从而降低高价值NMC811材料的浓度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：火灾损坏电池中的NMC811颗粒主要富集在小于125微米的细颗粒组分中（金属含量可达85%），但火灾导致的结构降解（温度超过500°C）使电池变脆易碎，增加了铜铝集流体在加工材料中的混入，从而降低高价值NMC811材料的浓度。；创新点：系统对比了火灾损坏电池与常规黑质在金属分布和加工特性上的差异，并首次提出将火灾损坏电池单独处理或通过颗粒尺寸分离来优化回收产出的建议。
papers.method_zh: 对黑质和火灾损坏废弃物进行颗粒尺寸分级与金属含量分析；通过结构降解证据推断火灾温度（>500°C）；观察残留有机粘合剂以判断热量分布不均匀性；分析颗粒脆性对铜铝分离效率的影响。

papers.title: Amoeboid cell migration and shape dynamics driven by actin polymerization
papers.abstract: Cell migration is fundamental to development, tissue organization, immune response, and disease progression. Amoeboid motility is distinguished by rapid motion and strongly fluctuating cell shapes, reflecting the intrinsically nonlinear nature of active living matter far from equilibrium. Here we introduce a minimal active-shell model of an amoeboid cell that couples actin polymerization, cortical flows, and membrane deformation through nonlocal mechanical interactions. The model gives rise to a rich spectrum of emergent behaviors. A symmetric non-motile state can spontaneously break symmetry and transition toward persistent directed migration driven solely by polymerization-induced retrograde flow, even in the absence of shape deformation. Increasing activity further triggers a cascade of dynamical states, including circular trajectories, oscillatory zigzag motion, and irregular chaotic-like migration with fluctuating protrusions and multi-lobed morphologies. Although these migratory modes are observed experimentally in distinct cellular contexts, our results show that they can emerge from the same underlying physical mechanism, providing a unified framework for amoeboid dynamics. Notably, contractile stresses induced by molecular motors are not required to generate spontaneous motility, polarity, or complex migration patterns. Our findings highlight how collective active processes at the cellular scale can self-organize into complex dynamical states, revealing generic principles of nonlinear behavior in living systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：active-shell model、minimal model、nonlocal mechanical interactions）；研究对象：阿米巴样细胞迁移及其形状动力学，具体涉及肌动蛋白聚合、皮层流与膜变形之间的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅由肌动蛋白聚合驱动的逆行流即可自发产生对称性破缺和定向迁移，无需分子马达产生的收缩应力；随着活性增强，系统可涌现出圆形轨迹、振荡锯齿运动及混沌样迁移等多种复杂动力学状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅由肌动蛋白聚合驱动的逆行流即可自发产生对称性破缺和定向迁移，无需分子马达产生的收缩应力；随着活性增强，系统可涌现出圆形轨迹、振荡锯齿运动及混沌样迁移等多种复杂动力学状态。；创新点：揭示了多种实验观察到的阿米巴迁移模式（如圆形轨迹、锯齿运动、混沌迁移）可源自同一物理机制，并证明分子马达产生的收缩应力并非产生自发迁移、极性或复杂运动模式的必要条件。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个最小活性壳模型（minimal active-shell model），通过非局域力学相互作用耦合肌动蛋白聚合、皮层流和膜变形，进行理论分析与数值模拟。

papers.title: Taming the 3D Wilson-Fisher Fixed Point via Nonlocal Effective Action
papers.abstract: We present a novel Renormalization Group (RG) framework based on a nonlocal effective action ansatz to tame the strong coupling dynamics of the three-dimensional relativistic $φ^{4}$ theory. By implementing a Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, we decouple the quartic interaction into a system of the primary field $φ$ and an auxiliary field $\varphi \sim φ^2$. Rather than freezing the intermediate scaling dimensions, the nonlocality of our effective action allows both exponents $Δ_φ$ and $Δ_{\varphi}$ to act as fully independent, unconstrained dynamical variables.This nonlocal propagator framework plays a critical role in the RG flow: evaluating self-energies and vertex fluctuations up to the three-loop order, the nonlocality drives precise structural cross-cancellations among multi-loop fluctuations near the Gaussian limit. Solving the resulting closed two-variable master equations isolates a robust, non-trivial physical fixed point at $Δ_φ^{*} \approx 0.981$ and $Δ_{\varphi}^{*} \approx 0.415$. These dynamic exponents yield a kinematic anomalous dimension $η_φ \approx 0.038$, an energy operator dimension $Δ_{φ^2} \approx 1.417$, and-via mass deformation-a thermal correlation length exponent $ν\approx 0.6317$, demonstrating exceptional quantitative agreement with high-precision Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) and conformal bootstrap benchmarks. Our results rigorously confirm that unfreezing the nonlocal degrees of freedom successfully eliminates the systematic truncation errors inherent to conventional local ansatz treatments, simultaneously resolving both the static scaling and thermodynamic flows of the Wilson-Fisher universality class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出新型重整化群框架、非局域有效作用量、解析计算与方程求解。；研究对象：三维相对论性φ⁴理论中的Wilson-Fisher不动点，属于统计场论与相变普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非局域有效作用量框架，成功解除了传统局域处理中中间标度维度的冻结约束，得到了一个稳健的非平庸物理不动点，其临界指数（η_φ≈0.038，ν≈0.6317）与高精度量子蒙特卡洛和共形自举基准结果高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非局域有效作用量框架，成功解除了传统局域处理中中间标度维度的冻结约束，得到了一个稳健的非平庸物理不动点，其临界指数（η_φ≈0.038，ν≈0.6317）与高精度量子蒙特卡洛和共形自举基准结果高度一致。；创新点：首次在重整化群框架中允许非局域自由度完全独立地作为动力学变量，而非冻结中间标度维度，从而消除了传统局域作用量处理中固有的系统截断误差。
papers.method_zh: 基于非局域有效作用量假设的重整化群框架；采用Hubbard-Stratonovich变换将四次相互作用解耦为主场φ和辅助场φ~φ²的系统；自能和顶点涨落计算至三圈阶；求解封闭的双变量主方程。

papers.title: Confinement-controlled pattern selection in a finite population-imbalanced dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: We study the ground-state density patterns of a population-imbalanced two-component dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate confined in a circular quasi-two-dimensional box. Using a mean-field model, we map out phase diagrams as functions of the axial confinement, interaction imbalance, and population ratio. The system supports a rich sequence of stationary morphologies, including a nearly uniform pancake state, pancake-droplet and ring-droplet coexistence states, droplet arrays, and concentric rings. These patterns show a close structural correspondence to microphase-separated morphologies in diblock-copolymer systems, with the population imbalance acting as an effective volume fraction that selects the pattern topology. Analysis of the density profiles and structure factors reveals that the modulated states possess an intrinsic nonzero characteristic wave vector, which remains essentially unchanged when the box size is varied. We also find that the characteristic pattern spacing scales linearly with the axial confinement length, indicating that the transverse thickness of the condensate controls the effective in-plane length scale. In a finite circular box, this smooth scaling is interrupted by discrete steps, reflecting geometric frustration and the integer locking of the number of rings or droplets. Our results show that box-trapped dipolar mixtures provide a controllable platform for studying finite-size pattern selection and nonlocal microphase formation in quantum fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：mean-field model（平均场模型）、phase diagrams（相图）、analysis of density profiles and structure factors（密度分布与结构因子分析）。；研究对象：有限尺寸圆盘状准二维势阱中，粒子数不平衡的双组分偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate）的基态密度图案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统支持从均匀薄饼态到液滴阵列、同心环等一系列稳态形貌，其图案拓扑由粒子数不平衡（等效于嵌段共聚物中的有效体积分数）决定；特征图案间距与轴向束缚长度呈线性关系，但在有限圆盒中受几何阻挫和整数锁定影响出现离散台阶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统支持从均匀薄饼态到液滴阵列、同心环等一系列稳态形貌，其图案拓扑由粒子数不平衡（等效于嵌段共聚物中的有效体积分数）决定；特征图案间距与轴向束缚长度呈线性关系，但在有限圆盒中受几何阻挫和整数锁定影响出现离散台阶。；创新点：揭示了有限尺寸圆盒中偶极混合气体与嵌段共聚物微相分离形貌之间的结构对应关系，并发现轴向束缚长度（即凝聚体横向厚度）是控制面内图案尺度的关键参数，同时观察到有限尺寸效应导致的离散化图案选择。
papers.method_zh: 采用平均场模型（mean-field model）数值求解基态，通过扫描轴向束缚强度、相互作用不平衡度和粒子数比绘制相图，并分析密度分布与结构因子以提取特征波矢。

papers.title: Perturbation Theory of the Free Energy via the Mesoscopic Combined Partition Function
papers.abstract: We develop a systematic perturbation theory for the Helmholtz free energy of a classical $N$-body system within the mesoscopic framework of~\cite{OsanoMeso,OsanoExtensivity}. The combined coarse-graining operator $\mathcal{C}=\mathcal{C}_x\circ\mathcal{C}_p$ acting on single-particle phase space partitions it into product cells $C_{i,α}=V_i\timesΠ_α$ and generates a mesoscopic partition function $\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}(λ)$ whose reference level factorises by the multinomial theorem: $\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}^{(0)}=(Z_1^{(0)})^N$. Perturbation theory for $\mathcal{F}_{\rm meso}(λ)=-k_BT\ln\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}(λ)$ in the inter-cell perturbation $\mathcal{V}_{\rm meso}$ yields the mesoscopic Gibbs--Bogoliubov inequality and an exact coupling-parameter integration formula. The full free energy satisfies \begin{equation*} F(λ)=\mathcal{F}_{\rm meso}(λ)-k_BT\!\sum_{i<j}I(i,j;λ)+O\!\left(|Λ|\ell^{-d}e^{-2\ell/ξ}\right), \end{equation*} where the inter-cell mutual informations $I(i,j;λ)$ are the corrections identified in the extensivity analysis. The first-order theory recovers the van der Waals equation and the Barker--Henderson result; the second-order term converges to the structure-factor formula in the fine-cell limit. For long-range interactions, factorisation fails, and the mutual-information corrections quantify the resulting non-extensivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbation theory（微扰理论）、mesoscopic framework（介观框架）、free energy（自由能）。；研究对象：经典N体系统的亥姆霍兹自由能，以及介观粗粒化方法下的微扰理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过介观组合配分函数，建立了自由能的系统微扰理论，并发现互信息修正是非广延性的量化来源；一阶理论可恢复范德瓦尔斯方程和Barker-Henderson结果，二阶项在细胞极限下收敛至结构因子公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过介观组合配分函数，建立了自由能的系统微扰理论，并发现互信息修正是非广延性的量化来源；一阶理论可恢复范德瓦尔斯方程和Barker-Henderson结果，二阶项在细胞极限下收敛至结构因子公式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于介观框架（参考文献OsanoMeso, OsanoExtensivity），引入组合粗粒化算符 \(\mathcal{C}=\mathcal{C}_x\circ\mathcal{C}_p\) 对单粒子相空间进行乘积胞划分，构建介观配分函数 \(\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}(\lambda)\)，并利用多胞微扰 \(\mathcal{V}_{\rm meso}\) 进行微扰展开，推导出介观Gibbs-Bogoliubov不等式和精确耦合参数积分公式。

papers.title: Weak Fragmentation and Thermalization in a Dipole-Conserving Bose-Hubbard Chain
papers.abstract: We study Hilbert-space fragmentation and thermalization in a one-dimensional dipole-conserving Bose-Hubbard chain. By analyzing the structure of the Hamiltonian matrix in the Fock basis, we show that the system exhibits weak Hilbert-space fragmentation. We further construct an exponentially large family of frozen product states and derive analytical upper and lower bounds on their number. Using exact diagonalization, we examine the consequences of weak fragmentation for eigenstate half-chain entanglement, density relaxation dynamics, and level statistics. All these quantities reveal a transition from a weak eigenstate thermalization regime to a nonergodic regime with increasing on-site interaction strength. These results show that weak Hilbert-space fragmentation \textit{does not} preclude quantum chaos or thermalization, and provides a minimal platform for studying the interplay of dipole conservation, weak fragmentation, and ergodicity breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：分析哈密顿量矩阵结构、精确对角化、解析上下界推导）；研究对象：一维偶极矩守恒的Bose-Hubbard链中的希尔伯特空间碎片化与热化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱希尔伯特空间碎片化并不排除量子混沌或热化，且随着在位相互作用强度增加，系统从弱本征态热化区域过渡到非遍历区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱希尔伯特空间碎片化并不排除量子混沌或热化，且随着在位相互作用强度增加，系统从弱本征态热化区域过渡到非遍历区域。；创新点：首次在偶极矩守恒Bose-Hubbard模型中系统揭示了弱碎片化与遍历性破缺的关联，并证明弱碎片化体系仍可存在量子混沌与热化。
papers.method_zh: 通过Fock基下哈密顿量矩阵结构分析、解析推导冻结乘积态数量的上下界、精确对角化计算本征态半链纠缠熵、密度弛豫动力学和能级统计。

papers.title: Strong-coupling anisotropic superconductivity in hexagonal HfRuAs from anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive theoretical investigation of the superconducting (SC) properties of hexagonal HfRuAs ($h$-HfRuAs) by solving anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg (ME) equations with the inputs from \textit{ab initio} calculations of electronic structure, phonon dispersion and electron phonon coupling matrix elements. The calculated Eliashberg spectral function reveals strong electron--phonon coupling (EPC) with a constant $λ\approx 1.56$, dominated by low-frequency phonon modes associated primarily with Hf and Ru vibrations. The SC state is characterized by a single anisotropic gap with overall $s$-wave symmetry, as evidenced by the fully gapped quasiparticle density of states. The momentum-resolved EPC and SC gap exhibit pronounced anisotropy across different Fermi surface sheets, with the largest variations occurring on the hole-like bands. The SC gap is centered around $Δ\approx 2.9$ meV with a spread of $\sim 0.8$ meV, indicating significant multiband anisotropy. The resulting gap ratio $2Δ(0)/k_B T_c \approx 4.2$ exceeds the BCS weak-coupling limit, establishing $h$-HfRuAs as a strong-coupling superconductor. The calculated transition temperature, $T_c$, agrees in the order of magnitude with experiments. Overall, our results identify $h$-HfRuAs as a phonon-mediated, strongly coupled anisotropic superconductor and provide detailed insights into the role of momentum-dependent electron--phonon interactions in determining its SC properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：*ab initio* calculations、anisotropic Migdal–Eliashberg equations、electronic structure、phonon dispersion。；研究对象：六方相HfRuAs（\(h\)-HfRuAs）的超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: \(h\)-HfRuAs是一种强耦合、各向异性的声子介导超导体，具有单一各向异性s波超导能隙，能隙比\(2\Delta(0)/k_B T_c \approx 4.2\)超过BCS弱耦合极限，表明其强耦合特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：\(h\)-HfRuAs是一种强耦合、各向异性的声子介导超导体，具有单一各向异性s波超导能隙，能隙比\(2\Delta(0)/k_B T_c \approx 4.2\)超过BCS弱耦合极限，表明其强耦合特性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（电子结构、声子色散、电声耦合矩阵元）输入，求解各向异性Migdal–Eliashberg方程。

papers.title: Localization Transitions in a Half-Filled Helical Aubry-André Model
papers.abstract: We study localization in a one-dimensional quasiperiodic lattice obtained by extending the Aubry-André model with an additional $N$th-neighbor hopping term of strength $J_{N}$. This long-range tunneling couples successive windings of an effective helical chain and introduces a second control parameter beyond the quasiperiodic potential strength $Δ$. Working with noninteracting fermions (typically at half filling), we diagnose the delocalization-localization transition using extensions of the modern theory of polarization. Specifically, we compute the polarization amplitudes of the many-body Slater-determinant ground state and construct a geometric Binder cumulant from polarization amplitudes. The critical potential where the localization transition happens is extracted from the sign change (zero crossing) of the geometric Binder cumulant. We map critical potential as a function of $J_N$ and the helical range $N$, finding that stronger helical hopping generally stabilizes the extended phase (shifting critical potential upward), while the $N$-dependence can display pronounced commensurability-induced spikes. We further compare the geometric Binder cumulant with the Fermi gap, which remains near zero at small values of potential and opens in the same parameter regime where the geometric Binder cumulant departs from extended phase. Finally, to take a controlled thermodynamic limit along Fibonacci system sizes, we employ a Zeckendorf-shift construction that fixes the many-body sector consistently as system size goes to infinity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“研究局域化”“诊断相变”“计算极化振幅”“构造几何Binder累积量”等理论分析手段，未涉及实验或数值模拟的具体计算细节。；研究对象：一维准周期晶格中的局域化-退局域化相变，具体为半填充的螺旋Aubry-André模型（Helical Aubry-André Model），包含额外N近邻跳跃项。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 更强的螺旋跳跃（即更大的J_N）通常稳定扩展相，使临界势垒上移；临界势垒随N的变化会出现由公度性引起的尖峰。几何Binder累积量的符号变化（过零点）可用于提取局域化相变的临界势垒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：更强的螺旋跳跃（即更大的J_N）通常稳定扩展相，使临界势垒上移；临界势垒随N的变化会出现由公度性引起的尖峰。几何Binder累积量的符号变化（过零点）可用于提取局域化相变的临界势垒。；创新点：将螺旋Aubry-André模型中的长程跳跃（N近邻项）作为第二控制参数，系统研究了其对局域化相变的影响，并揭示了公度性导致的临界势垒尖峰行为。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用现代极化理论的扩展方法，计算多体Slater行列式基态的极化振幅，并构造几何Binder累积量；通过几何Binder累积量的符号变化（过零点）确定局域化相变的临界势垒；利用Zeckendorf-shift构造在斐波那契系统尺寸下取热力学极限，固定多体扇区。

papers.title: Chemo-mechanical coupling stabilizes mixed $\mathrm{Ag}_{x}\mathrm{Cu}_{1-x}\mathrm{GaSe}_{2}$ solar-cell absorbers: Insights from Monte-Carlo simulations assisted by ab initio informed machine-learning potentials
papers.abstract: Alloying Ag into Cu(In,Ga)Se$_2$ has enabled record solar-cell efficiencies ($\sim23.6\%$), yet their long-term stability remains in question because initio calculations predict a Ag-Cu miscibility gap near ambient temperature. By off-lattice Monte-Carlo simulations using a newly developed machine learning (ML) interatomic potential we show that the presence of coherency strain is resolving the controversy between experimental observations and the predicted phase stability. Incorporating elastic energy contributions present in a coherent setup results in complete Ag-Cu miscibility, whereas the expected phase separation occurs in the absence of coherency strains with respect to the end boundary phases, which are mimicked by an incoherent interface with misfit dislocations. The developed ML-MC framework provides a novel approach for resolving discrepancies in thermodynamic stability for systems where mechanical and chemical effects compete.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte-Carlo simulations、ab initio informed machine-learning potentials、off-lattice Monte-Carlo simulations）；研究对象：Ag-Cu合金化的Cu(In,Ga)Se₂太阳能电池吸收层材料，具体为混合相AgₓCu₁₋ₓGaSe₂的化学-力学耦合稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相干应变（coherency strain）存在下，Ag与Cu可实现完全互溶，从而解释了实验观测与第一性原理预测的Ag-Cu混溶间隙之间的矛盾；而无相干应变时则出现预期的相分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相干应变（coherency strain）存在下，Ag与Cu可实现完全互溶，从而解释了实验观测与第一性原理预测的Ag-Cu混溶间隙之间的矛盾；而无相干应变时则出现预期的相分离。；创新点：首次将机器学习势与蒙特卡洛模拟结合，用于解决凝聚态体系中力学与化学效应竞争导致的热力学稳定性争议，为解释实验与理论在相稳定性上的分歧提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于机器学习（ML）原子间势的离格蒙特卡洛（off-lattice Monte-Carlo）模拟，该势函数由第一性原理（ab initio）数据训练得到。通过对比相干界面（无失配位错）与非相干界面（含失配位错）的弹性能量贡献，分析力学与化学效应的竞争。

papers.title: Combinatorial Survey of Structural Phase Distribution and Magnetism in Fe-Ge-Te Composition-spread Thin Film Libraries
papers.abstract: Recently, magnetic 2-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) materials have garnered tremendous attention. The vdW ferromagnet Fe5Ge1Te2 has a Curie temperature Tc of ~ 270 K, which is tailorable by tuning the stoichiometry and the Fe deficiency to reach room temperature. To explore the expanded compositional space, we implemented combinatorial synthesis and high-throughput characterization to investigate the structural phase distribution and ferromagnetism of a Fe-Ge-Te thin film library. The library was prepared by magnetron co-sputtering followed by annealing in vacuum or in an inert environment. Composition and structural phase distribution of the 177 pads in the library were characterized using high-throughput wavelength dispersive spectroscopy (WDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and two-point probe resistance measurements. We leverage unsupervised machine learning to cluster the XRD dataset into groups of compositions with similar structural phases, and further study the ferromagnetic properties via SQUID magnetometry and X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) across different clusters. The results are compared against magnetization and structural models calculated using DFT. Our results demonstrate that the hexagonal crystal structure is a critical prerequisite for ferromagnetism in this system, and that unexplored materials adopting this structure can be efficiently identified as possible ferromagnetic materials using our high-throughput, ML-assisted framework. This workflow based on the combinatorial strategy allows us to rapidly capture the composition-structure-magnetic property map across a broad compositional landscape of novel magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：combinatorial synthesis, high-throughput characterization, magnetron co-sputtering, SQUID, XMCD, DFT计算辅助）；研究对象：Fe-Ge-Te三元体系薄膜库中的结构相分布与铁磁性，特别是与二维范德华铁磁体Fe₅Ge₁Te₂相关的扩展组分空间。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六方晶体结构是该体系中实现铁磁性的关键前提；通过高通量、机器学习辅助的框架，可以高效识别出可能具有铁磁性的未探索材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：六方晶体结构是该体系中实现铁磁性的关键前提；通过高通量、机器学习辅助的框架，可以高效识别出可能具有铁磁性的未探索材料。；创新点：将组合合成、高通量表征与无监督机器学习相结合，系统绘制了Fe-Ge-Te体系宽组分空间内的成分-结构-磁性关系图谱，并验证了六方相作为铁磁性先决条件的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 磁控共溅射制备组分梯度薄膜库（177个pad），真空或惰性气氛退火；高通量波长色散X射线光谱（WDS）表征成分；X射线衍射（XRD）表征结构相；两点探针电阻测量；无监督机器学习对XRD数据进行聚类；SQUID磁强计和X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）研究铁磁性质；DFT计算磁性和结构模型进行对比。

papers.title: Real-time Multi-instrument Autonomous Discovery of Novel Phase-change Memory Materials
papers.abstract: Autonomous labs enable the integration of automated experiment execution, data analysis and decision making. The main challenge remains the integration of diverse data streams from multiple instruments, where the data is often heterogeneous and unsynchronized. The standard learning process of undetermined synthesis-process-structure-property relationships (SPSPR) usually relies on post-experiment analysis after data is fully collected, not during live experiments, and decision making is carried out independently across characterization equipment. Here, we demonstrate the Multi-instrument Autonomous Discovery (MAD) framework -- combining structural property mapping and functional property optimization simultaneously in a closed-loop manner. As an example, we applied MAD to phase change memory (PCM) materials, and, in particular on the Mn-Sb-Te ternary, a previously unexplored materials system for PCM. A multi-output model is employed to merge data from x-ray diffraction (XRD) and electrical resistance measurements simultaneously through a co-regionalization kernel that models the relationship between them. The output probabilistic posterior and uncertainty quantification facilitate decision making with shared knowledge, while the goals are different across tasks. We aimed to maximize the knowledge of crystal structure distribution using non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), while in parallel, we find the composition with the maximum resistance value, an important figure of merit for PCM. Leveraging MAD, we found promising electrical PCMs and identified the SPSPR within 25 closed-loop iterations, corresponding to a seven-fold speed-up. The framework opens a new path of study in large-scale autonomous facilities, where future experiments can be run in parallel together, not independently.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：autonomous labs、automated experiment execution、closed-loop manner、XRD、electrical resistance measurements）；研究对象：相变存储（PCM）材料，具体为Mn-Sb-Te三元体系（此前未在PCM中探索过的材料系统）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多仪器自主发现（MAD）框架，在25次闭环迭代内（速度提升七倍）发现了有前景的PCM材料，并确定了合成-工艺-结构-性能关系（SPSPR）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多仪器自主发现（MAD）框架，在25次闭环迭代内（速度提升七倍）发现了有前景的PCM材料，并确定了合成-工艺-结构-性能关系（SPSPR）。；创新点：实现了多仪器数据流的实时闭环整合（而非事后分析），并在不同任务目标（结构映射与功能优化）下通过共享知识进行决策。
papers.method_zh: 采用多输出模型，通过协同区域化核（co-regionalization kernel）同时融合X射线衍射（XRD）和电阻测量数据；利用非负矩阵分解（NMF）最大化晶体结构分布知识，同时并行寻找最大电阻值的成分（PCM关键品质因数）。

papers.title: Hydrostatic Pressure-Induced Evolution of the Superconducting Transition Temperature of Bi-2212: Insights from First-Principles Calculations
papers.abstract: High-pressure experiments on Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+x}$ (Bi-2212) have reported apparently conflicting evolutions of the superconducting transition temperature $T_c$, ranging from weak enhancement to strong suppression and even a proposed second superconducting dome. To clarify the origin of these discrepancies, we combine first-principles density functional theory calculations with a pressure-dependent low-energy bilayer model solved by the slave-boson mean-field method together with a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless estimate of phase coherence. Our results show that hydrostatic pressure induces a pronounced self-doping effect in Bi-2212: holes are transferred from the Bi-O charge-reservoir layers to the CuO$_2$ superconducting planes, leading to a systematic increase in the effective CuO$_2$-plane hole concentration $δ_x$. At the same time, pressure enhances the pairing scale through the renormalization of the hopping and superexchange parameters. As a consequence, the pressure evolution of $T_c$ is governed by the competition between pressure-enhanced pairing and pressure-driven motion along the common $T_c$-$δ_x$ dome, making $T_c(P)$ highly sensitive to the initial doping state. Even samples with very similar ambient-pressure $T_c$ but slightly different initial doping can therefore display qualitatively different pressure responses. This provides a unified interpretation of a large part of the disparate high-pressure behavior reported for Bi-2212 and suggests that slightly underdoped samples are more favorable than ambient-pressure optimal samples for achieving improved superconducting performance under pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles density functional theory calculations”、“slave-boson mean-field method”、“Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless estimate”。；研究对象：Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊ₓ（Bi-2212）高温超导体在静水压下的超导转变温度（T_c）演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静水压通过自掺杂效应将空穴从Bi-O电荷库层转移到CuO₂超导平面，同时增强配对能标，导致T_c的压力响应由初始掺杂状态决定：轻微欠掺杂样品比常压最优掺杂样品更有利于在压力下提升超导性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静水压通过自掺杂效应将空穴从Bi-O电荷库层转移到CuO₂超导平面，同时增强配对能标，导致T_c的压力响应由初始掺杂状态决定：轻微欠掺杂样品比常压最优掺杂样品更有利于在压力下提升超导性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与压力依赖的低能双层模型，采用奴隶玻色子平均场方法求解，并辅以Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）相相干估计。

papers.title: Multi-rotational switching in a noncollinear antiferromagnet by spin-orbit torque
papers.abstract: Spintronics has advanced through discoveries of various electrically-driven spin dynamics in nanomagnets. Here, we report a novel switching dynamics of spin systems driven by spin-orbit torque, using a noncollinear antiferromagnetic nanodot. With electric pulses spanning a wide range of durations and amplitudes, we find an unconventional insensitivity of a threshold current density to pulse duration in switch-back events. This observation is attributed to a previously unrecognized process, in which the noncollinear antiferromagnetic order undergoes multiple rotations before completing reversal, a phenomenon we term multi-rotational switching. Our theoretical analysis reveals that multi-rotational switching arises from the interplay of three key factors: current-driven coherent rotation of the noncollinear antiferromagnetic order, field-induced reorientation of the uncompensated net magnetization, and thermal fluctuations. These findings establish a microscopic mechanism governing current-induced switching in noncollinear antiferromagnets, a topic of growing interest for next-generation spintronics technologies, opening a new route to controlling antiferromagnetic order in nanodevices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report a novel switching dynamics... using a noncollinear antiferromagnetic nanodot”（实验）以及“Our theoretical analysis reveals...”（理论分析）。；研究对象：非共线反铁磁纳米点中的自旋轨道矩驱动多旋转开关动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新型的开关动力学机制——多旋转开关（multi-rotational switching），即非共线反铁磁序在完成翻转前会经历多次旋转，且开关回跳事件中阈值电流密度对脉冲持续时间表现出非常规的不敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新型的开关动力学机制——多旋转开关（multi-rotational switching），即非共线反铁磁序在完成翻转前会经历多次旋转，且开关回跳事件中阈值电流密度对脉冲持续时间表现出非常规的不敏感性。；创新点：首次识别并命名了“多旋转开关”这一此前未被认识的物理过程，揭示了非共线反铁磁体中电流诱导开关的微观机制，为下一代自旋电子学技术中控制反铁磁序提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用电脉冲（宽范围持续时间和幅度）驱动非共线反铁磁纳米点；理论上通过分析电流驱动的非共线反铁磁序相干旋转、场诱导未补偿净磁化重取向以及热涨落三者之间的相互作用来解释多旋转开关的起源。

papers.title: Exact Organization of Density Matrices and Entanglement Structure in the Kitaev Spin Liquid
papers.abstract: We give an exact form of the density matrix of the spin-1/2 Kitaev spin liquid represented in terms of spin operators and study the entanglement structures of the Kitaev honeycomb model within the spin framework. We show that the density matrix is naturally organized by equivalence classes of string operators associated with the underlying gauge structure of the model. With the explicit form of the density matrix, plus the exact Gauss law of the emergent gauge theory and the exact 1-form Wilson symmetry in the Kitaev model, we demonstrate the existence of the underlying symmetry-resolved block-diagonal structure of the reduced density matrix, which gives rise to the extensive degeneracy in the entanglement spectrum. The block-diagonal structure is then proven to be responsible for the separability of the entanglement entropy into the gauge and matter parts. Furthermore, we extend the formalism to subsystems with an odd number of lattice sites, revealing a relation between the entanglement spectrum and the fermion parity that is seldom mentioned in the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact form、gauge structure、symmetry-resolved block-diagonal structure、entanglement spectrum。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 Kitaev 量子自旋液体，具体为 Kitaev 蜂窝模型中的密度矩阵与纠缠结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文给出了 Kitaev 自旋液体密度矩阵的精确形式，揭示了约化密度矩阵具有由规范结构和1-形式Wilson对称性决定的对称性分辨块对角结构，该结构导致纠缠谱的广泛简并，并解释了纠缠熵可分离为规范部分与物质部分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文给出了 Kitaev 自旋液体密度矩阵的精确形式，揭示了约化密度矩阵具有由规范结构和1-形式Wilson对称性决定的对称性分辨块对角结构，该结构导致纠缠谱的广泛简并，并解释了纠缠熵可分离为规范部分与物质部分。；创新点：首次在自旋框架内给出Kitaev自旋液体密度矩阵的精确形式，并严格证明其由弦算符等价类自然组织；揭示了约化密度矩阵的对称性分辨块对角结构是纠缠熵可分离为规范与物质部分的根源；此外，扩展至奇数格点子系统，揭示了纠缠谱与费米子宇称之间鲜有文献提及的关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于自旋算符的密度矩阵精确形式、弦算符等价类组织、精确高斯定律与1-形式Wilson对称性，并扩展到奇数格点子系统以揭示纠缠谱与费米子宇称的关系。

papers.title: $5/9-$Magnetization Plateau and Spin Supersolidity in YCu$_3$(OD)$_{7-x}$Br$_{2+x}$ under Magnetic Fields up to 120~T
papers.abstract: We performed high-precision magnetization measurements up to 120~T on three compositions of the newly discovered kagome antiferromagnet YCu$_3$(OD)$_{7-x}$Br$_{2+x}$ (YCOB), revealing a previously unobserved 5/9 fractional magnetization plateau. All YCOB samples with different Br$^-$ concentrations exhibit nearly identical magnetization curves below 60~T, whereas the 5/9 plateau appears at markedly different fields in the ultrahigh-field regime. By modeling the experimental data using tensor-network calculations, we derive the effective spin Hamiltonians for the YCOB family with three spatially anisotropic Heisenberg couplings (the 3$J$-type model), which quantitatively reproduces the measured magnetization processes and captures the composition-dependent evolution of the 5/9 plateau. Furthermore, our theoretical analysis suggests the emergence of a spin supersolid phase in the field window between the 1/3 and 5/9 plateaus, which is sensitive to spin exchange parameters and accounts for the significant variation in the critical fields of the 5/9 plateau observed among different YCOB compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。关键词：高精度磁化测量、张量网络计算、有效自旋哈密顿量。；研究对象：新发现的kagome反铁磁体YCu₃(OD)₇₋ₓBr₂₊ₓ（YCOB）及其在高达120 T磁场下的磁化行为，特别是分数磁化平台和自旋超固态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YCOB中首次观测到5/9分数磁化平台，并发现该平台在不同Br⁻浓度样品中出现在显著不同的临界场；理论分析表明在1/3与5/9平台之间的磁场区间可能存在自旋超固态相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在YCOB中首次观测到5/9分数磁化平台，并发现该平台在不同Br⁻浓度样品中出现在显著不同的临界场；理论分析表明在1/3与5/9平台之间的磁场区间可能存在自旋超固态相。；创新点：首次在kagome反铁磁体中发现5/9分数磁化平台，并揭示了该平台对自旋交换参数的敏感性；提出了自旋超固态相的存在，解释了不同组分间5/9平台临界场的显著差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高精度磁化测量（最高120 T）；理论上使用张量网络计算（tensor-network calculations）对实验数据进行建模，推导出具有三个空间各向异性海森堡耦合（3J型模型）的有效自旋哈密顿量。

papers.title: Entropy additivity from exponential decay of correlations: a coarse-grained operator approach
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic extensivity is commonly introduced as a postulate -- the homogeneity of degree one in thermodynamic potentials.
