We provide a constructive derivation of this property from microscopic conditions on the pair potential, without assuming it. Working with the one- and two-particle reduced densities of the $N$-body canonical Gibbs state, we introduce a combined coarse-graining operator $\mathcal{C}$ on single-particle phase space $\mathcal{M}=Λ\times\mathbb{R}^3$, producing dimensionless mesoscopic probabilities over spatial--momentum cells $\{V_i\timesΠ_α\}$. Under three conditions on the pair potential -- stability, temperedness, and exponential cluster decomposition with correlation length $ξ$ -- we show, using the Ursell cluster expansion, that the coarse-grained entropy satisfies \[S_{\mathrm{CG}}=\sum_i S_i+O\!\left(\frac{|Λ|}{\ell^d}e^{-\ell/ξ}\right),\] where $\ell\ggξ$ is the cell diameter. The correction is exponentially suppressed per cell, making entropy additive and recovering the thermodynamic limit of Ruelle and Fisher in explicit operator language. For systems with long-range interactions, where temperedness fails, the correction does not vanish, and non-additivity is quantified through inter-cell mutual information. We further show that spatial averaging does not commute with nonlinear thermodynamic functionals such as the entropy density -- a thermodynamic analogue of the cosmological averaging problem -- and we derive the generalised Euler relation with explicit surface corrections.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“constructive derivation”“Ursell cluster expansion”“operator language”等理论推导术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：经典统计力学中多体系统的热力学广延性（entropy additivity），具体研究由成对势相互作用的多粒子系统在正则系综下的粗粒化熵的可加性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在满足稳定性、温和性及指数级簇分解（关联长度ξ）的成对势条件下，粗粒化熵的修正项随元胞直径ℓ指数衰减（~e^{-ℓ/ξ}），从而在粗粒化操作下实现熵的可加性；对于长程相互作用系统，修正项不消失，非可加性可通过元胞间互信息量化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在满足稳定性、温和性及指数级簇分解（关联长度ξ）的成对势条件下，粗粒化熵的修正项随元胞直径ℓ指数衰减（~e^{-ℓ/ξ}），从而在粗粒化操作下实现熵的可加性；对于长程相互作用系统，修正项不消失，非可加性可通过元胞间互信息量化。；创新点：从微观成对势条件出发，构造性地推导了热力学广延性（熵的一次齐次性），而非将其作为公设引入；揭示了空间平均与非线性热力学泛函（如熵密度）的不对易性，并推导了包含显式表面修正的广义欧拉关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用单粒子相空间上的联合粗粒化算符C，将空间-动量元胞{V_i×Π_α}上的微观概率转化为无量纲介观概率；利用Ursell簇展开对N体正则吉布斯态的一、二粒子约化密度进行解析推导。

papers.title: Anderson Transition and Mobility Edges in a Family of 3D Fractal Lattices
papers.abstract: Anderson localization is fundamentally controlled by dimensionality, yet the nature of the Anderson transition in continuously tunable noninteger dimensions remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce a family of three-dimensional fractal lattices with continuously tunable spectral dimension $d_s\in[2,3]$, providing a controlled platform for studying localization physics beyond integer dimensions and across the lower critical dimension $d_s=2$. Using large-scale finite-size scaling analysis, we systematically investigate the Anderson transition and identify mobility edges throughout the fractal family. The critical disorder strength evolves continuously from $0$ to $16.6$ as the spectral dimension increases from $2$ to $3$. We show that the spectral dimension predominantly governs the universality class of the transition, while the precise critical point is additionally influenced by microscopic geometric details of the underlying fractal lattice. The critical exponent exhibits an approximate inverse dependence on $d_s$, providing quantitative insight into scaling theory in noninteger dimensions. Our results establish tunable fractal lattices as a versatile framework for exploring localization and quantum critical phenomena beyond conventional integer-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“大规模有限尺寸标度分析”（large-scale finite-size scaling analysis）、“标度理论”（scaling theory）。；研究对象：三维分形晶格家族中的安德森局域化相变和迁移率边。具体体系为具有连续可调谱维度 \( d_s \in [2,3] \) 的三维分形晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着谱维度从2增加到3，临界无序强度从0连续演化至16.6。谱维度主要决定了相变的普适类，而临界点还受到分形晶格微观几何细节的影响。临界指数与 \( d_s \) 近似成反比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着谱维度从2增加到3，临界无序强度从0连续演化至16.6。谱维度主要决定了相变的普适类，而临界点还受到分形晶格微观几何细节的影响。临界指数与 \( d_s \) 近似成反比。；创新点：首次在连续可调的非整数维度（谱维度 \( d_s \)）平台上，系统研究了跨越下临界维度（\( d_s=2 \)）的安德森局域化相变，为探索超越整数维系统的局域化和量子临界现象提供了可控框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模有限尺寸标度分析，系统研究了整个分形晶格家族中的安德森相变，并识别了迁移率边。

papers.title: Graph-Theoretic Detection of Hilbert Space Fragmentation
papers.abstract: Hilbert-space fragmentation provides a mechanism for ergodicity breaking in quantum many-body systems even in the absence of disorder, leading to dynamically disconnected sectors and strong memory of initial conditions. However, identifying such structures is often challenging and typically relies on prior knowledge of conservation laws or model-specific analytical insight. Here we introduce an unbiased approach based on spectral graph theory and, within this framework, formulate the concept of nearly fragmented systems, in which perturbative processes couple otherwise fragmented sectors while preserving their dynamical imprint. By representing basis states as vertices and Hamiltonian matrix elements as edges, we map the connectivity structure of the many-body Hilbert space onto a graph and analyze it using tools such as the Laplacian spectrum, Fiedler vectors, and modularity. Exact fragmentation corresponds to disconnected graph components, while nearly fragmented systems manifest as weakly connected communities whose structure can still be resolved spectrally. Applying this framework to the one-dimensional $t$-$J$ model and its perturbations, we demonstrate that graph-theoretic diagnostics reliably identify both fragmented and nearly fragmented Hilbert-space structures and capture the hierarchy of dynamical time scales that governs the system's evolution. We further show that the method extends beyond kinetically constrained models by applying it directly to the Hubbard chain, where it reveals the emergence of nearly decoupled subspaces associated with doublon dynamics and spin configurations. Our results establish the spectral graph analysis as a general and scalable tool for diagnosing fragmentation and approximate dynamical constraints in complex quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectral graph theory（谱图理论）、theoretical framework（理论框架）、unbiased approach（无偏方法）。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的希尔伯特空间碎裂（Hilbert space fragmentation）现象，具体应用于一维t-J模型及其微扰、Hubbard链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谱图理论可以无偏地识别量子多体系统中的精确碎裂和近似碎裂结构，并揭示控制系统演化的动力学时间尺度层次。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谱图理论可以无偏地识别量子多体系统中的精确碎裂和近似碎裂结构，并揭示控制系统演化的动力学时间尺度层次。；创新点：提出了一种无需预先知道守恒律或模型特定解析知识的无偏诊断方法，并首次将“近似碎裂系统”概念形式化，即微扰耦合原本碎裂的扇区但仍保留其动力学印记。该方法可推广至非运动学约束模型（如Hubbard链）。
papers.method_zh: 基于谱图理论，将多体希尔伯特空间的基矢视为图的顶点、哈密顿量矩阵元视为边，利用拉普拉斯谱、Fiedler向量、模块度等图论工具分析图的连通性结构。

papers.title: Indicators for phonon hydrodynamics from first principles predictions of thermal conductivity
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic heat flow, where out-of-equilibrium phonons collectively drift in response to an applied temperature differential, has attracted renewed interest following its experimental observation in graphite at temperatures as high as 300 K. To accelerate discovery of material alternatives to graphite and suitable experimental conditions for realizing this non-Fourier heat flow regime, computationally efficient indicators derived from predictive first principles approaches are necessary. Here we show that the ratio of thermal conductivity ($κ$) obtained from the complete solution of the linearized Peierls-Boltzmann equation (LPBE) for phonon transport ($κ_{LPBE}$), to that from the relaxation time approximation (RTA) for phonon decay ($κ_{RTA}$), is a low cost indicator for phonon hydrodynamics. We show that collectively drifting non-equilibrium phonons amplify the ratio of $κ_{LPBE}$ to $κ_{RTA}$, while a small $κ_{LPBE}/κ_{RTA}$ correlates with predominantly diffusive phonon transport. On the other hand, we find that conventional approaches that rely only on momentum-conserving Normal and momentum-dissipating Umklapp scattering rates, such as the RTA and the Callaway approximations to the LPBE, are inadequate to predict phonon hydrodynamics. Furthermore, our study reveals that the indicator ratio - $κ_{LPBE}/κ_{RTA}$, and therefore the strength of hydrodynamic signatures, decrease with increasing Brillouin zone (BZ) sampling density for several ultrahigh-$κ$ materials at low temperatures, thus underscoring the need for careful BZ sampling convergence studies to ensure robust predictions of phonon hydrodynamics. This computationally inexpensive indicator of phonon hydrodynamics will accelerate the search for new materials that exhibit such unconventional heat flow regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“first principles predictions”（第一性原理预测）、“complete solution of the linearized Peierls-Boltzmann equation”（线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程的完整解）、“computationally efficient indicators”（计算高效的指标）。；研究对象：声子流体动力学（phonon hydrodynamics）现象，具体研究如何通过第一性原理预测的热导率来识别该非傅里叶热流输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热导率比值 \( \kappa_{LPBE}/\kappa_{RTA} \) 是一个低成本且有效的声子流体动力学指示指标：该比值越大，表明集体漂移的非平衡声子越强（即流体动力学特征越显著）；比值越小，则对应以扩散为主的声子输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热导率比值 \( \kappa_{LPBE}/\kappa_{RTA} \) 是一个低成本且有效的声子流体动力学指示指标：该比值越大，表明集体漂移的非平衡声子越强（即流体动力学特征越显著）；比值越小，则对应以扩散为主的声子输运。；创新点：提出了一个计算成本低廉的指示指标（\( \kappa_{LPBE}/\kappa_{RTA} \)），用于快速筛选可能表现出声子流体动力学行为的材料，并指出传统依赖Normal和Umklapp散射率的近似方法（如RTA和Callaway近似）不足以预测该现象。此外，首次揭示了该指标对布里渊区采样密度的敏感性，强调低温和超高热导率材料中需谨慎进行采样收敛性研究。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算，通过完整求解线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程（LPBE）得到热导率 \( \kappa_{LPBE} \)，并与弛豫时间近似（RTA）下的热导率 \( \kappa_{RTA} \) 进行比较。同时对比了Callaway近似等传统方法。

papers.title: Shapiro steps of superfluid Fermi gases in a ring trap across the BCS--BEC crossover
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport properties of a superfluid Fermi gas confined in a ring trap with a moving potential barrier across the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) to Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) crossover. Employing time-dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) equations, we simulate the dynamics of a Josephson junction biased by both DC and AC currents. Over a wide range of interaction strengths, we observe clear low-order Shapiro-step plateaus in the barrier-velocity--chemical-potential-diffenrence, within the phase-coherent regime, where the time-averaged chemical potential difference is quantized in units of $\hbarω/2$. This factor of $1/2$ reflects our convention of defining the chemical potential per single fermion in the BdG framework. Microscopic analysis reveals that these fundamental steps originate from synchronized phase slips mediated by periodic soliton generation at the barrier. Our findings clarify the role of interaction regimes in the nonequilibrium phase dynamics of ring-trapped fermionic superfluids and provide microscopic insights relevant to future studies of atomtronic systems with nontrivial topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“time-dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) equations”进行数值模拟，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：环形势阱中跨越BCS-BEC渡越的费米超流体的输运性质，具体为受直流和交流电流偏置的约瑟夫森结中的Shapiro台阶现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相位相干区域内，观察到势垒速度-化学势差中清晰的低阶Shapiro台阶，其时间平均化学势差以ħω/2为单位量子化；这些台阶源于周期性孤子产生所介导的同步相位滑移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相位相干区域内，观察到势垒速度-化学势差中清晰的低阶Shapiro台阶，其时间平均化学势差以ħω/2为单位量子化；这些台阶源于周期性孤子产生所介导的同步相位滑移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时Bogoliubov--de Gennes（BdG）方程，模拟环形势阱中移动势垒偏置下的约瑟夫森结动力学。

papers.title: Geometric symmetry and size-dependent skyrmion phase transitions in magnetic nanostructures
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay of geometric symmetry, size, and external magnetic fields in regulating individual skyrmion states within magnetic nanostructures. By analyzing nanodisks, nanosquares, and nanorectangles, we demonstrate that rotational symmetry in nanodisks enables rich topological phase transitions, from ferromagnetic states to skyrmions, skyrmioniums, and multi-states, as their diameter increases. In contrast, square and rectangular structures exhibit suppressed topological complexity due to corner-induced demagnetization effects and reduced symmetries. Under perpendicular magnetic fields, nanodisks show field-driven transitions between skyrmionium and skyrmion states. By leveraging asymmetry, square and rectangular nanostructures stabilize skyrmions over a broader parameter range than nanodisks. These findings highlight geometric symmetry as a critical design parameter for tailoring skyrmion stability and functionality in spintronic applications such as multi-state memory and reconfigurable logic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”、“By analyzing”、“demonstrate”等词汇，描述了通过分析不同几何形状的纳米结构来研究拓扑相变，未提及具体的实验制备或测量手段，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：磁性纳米结构中的单个斯格明子（skyrmion）态。具体研究了纳米圆盘、纳米方块和纳米矩形三种不同几何形状的磁性纳米结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米结构的几何对称性是调控斯格明子稳定性和拓扑相变的关键设计参数。圆盘结构因其旋转对称性，随尺寸增大可展现丰富的拓扑相变（铁磁态→斯格明子→斯格明子泡→多态），而方形和矩形结构因角部退磁效应和对称性降低，拓扑复杂性被抑制，但能在更宽的参数范围内稳定斯格明子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米结构的几何对称性是调控斯格明子稳定性和拓扑相变的关键设计参数。圆盘结构因其旋转对称性，随尺寸增大可展现丰富的拓扑相变（铁磁态→斯格明子→斯格明子泡→多态），而方形和矩形结构因角部退磁效应和对称性降低，拓扑复杂性被抑制，但能在更宽的参数范围内稳定斯格明子。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于系统揭示了**几何对称性**（而非仅尺寸或磁场）作为独立的设计自由度，对磁性纳米结构中斯格明子拓扑相变和稳定性的决定性影响，并对比了不同对称性结构（圆盘 vs. 方形/矩形）的截然不同的行为。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析不同几何形状（纳米圆盘、纳米方块、纳米矩形）和尺寸的磁性纳米结构，研究几何对称性、尺寸和外磁场对单个斯格明子态的调控作用。具体方法包括：研究直径变化对圆盘相图的影响；分析角部退磁效应和对称性降低对方形/矩形结构的影响；研究垂直磁场下圆盘中斯格明子泡与斯格明子态之间的场致转变。

papers.title: Temperature-Controlled Resonance in a Heteronuclear Quantum Gas Mixture
papers.abstract: Single-channel resonances are fundamental processes in scattering of atoms, yet their occurrence is largely incidental and lacks systematic control. In this Letter, we propose a mechanism to realize a continuously tunable single-channel resonance by controlling the temperature of the heteronuclear mixture. By extending the Casimir-like mediated interaction to finite temperature, we demonstrate that thermal smearing of the Fermi surface reshapes the effective potential between impurities, giving rise to a temperature-controlled resonance (TCR) over a wide parameter range. As a direct consequence, the resonance position shifts systematically with temperature variation, providing a clear experimental signature of this mechanism. We further investigate the quench dynamics of a Bose gas immersed in a Fermi sea and demonstrate that the observed temperature-dependent loss features in recent experiments are consistent with the TCR mechanism. Our results establish temperature as a simple and experimentally accessible control knob for single-channel resonances in ultracold quantum gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“propose a mechanism”、“demonstrate”、“investigate”，以及未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：异核量子气体混合物中的单通道共振现象，具体为通过温度调控费米海中杂质间的有效相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种通过控制异核混合物温度来实现连续可调单通道共振（TCR）的机制，并证明该机制可解释近期实验中观察到的温度依赖损耗特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种通过控制异核混合物温度来实现连续可调单通道共振（TCR）的机制，并证明该机制可解释近期实验中观察到的温度依赖损耗特征。；创新点：首次提出温度可作为超冷量子气体中单通道共振的简单且实验可调的调控手段，突破了传统单通道共振缺乏系统控制能力的局限。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将Casimir-like介导相互作用推广至有限温度，分析费米面热模糊化对杂质间有效势的修正，并研究玻色气体浸入费米海后的淬火动力学。

papers.title: Lateral hydrodynamics in supported membranes: The Evans-Sackmann model and its extensions
papers.abstract: We review the theoretical development and modern applications of the Evans-Sackmann hydrodynamic model for lateral transport in supported fluid membranes. We first cover the original formulation, emphasizing the linear momentum decay term that captures membrane-substrate coupling mediated by a thin lubricating fluid layer. This coupling term enables quantitative interpretation of tracer diffusion measurements in supported bilayers. Building on this foundation, we survey theoretical extensions that relax standard boundary conditions at the inclusion perimeter, where inclusions refer to embedded objects such as proteins, lipid domains, or tracer particles within the membrane. We discuss the drag of a disk and a liquid domain, as well as the dynamics of membrane phase separation. We further highlight how the supported-membrane mobility tensor serves as a unifying tool for systematic treatments of correlated diffusion, polymer dynamics, phase separation kinetics, and many-body interactions in quasi-two-dimensional environments. Finally, we discuss recent extensions to active and chiral membranes, where odd viscosity provides a transverse hydrodynamic response and offers a possible route for detecting chirality in two-dimensional fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“review the theoretical development”、“theoretical extensions”、“mobility tensor serves as a unifying tool”。；研究对象：支撑膜（supported fluid membranes）中的侧向流体动力学，具体包括膜与基底通过薄润滑流体层的耦合、嵌入物（如蛋白质、脂质域、示踪粒子）的拖曳动力学、膜相分离动力学，以及活性手性膜中的奇粘度效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Evans-Sackmann模型通过引入线性动量衰减项定量描述了支撑膜中示踪扩散实验，其扩展形式（包括修正的边界条件、支撑膜迁移率张量）可系统处理准二维环境中的关联扩散、聚合物动力学、相分离动力学及多体相互作用；奇粘度提供了横向流体动力学响应，为检测二维流体手性提供了可能途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Evans-Sackmann模型通过引入线性动量衰减项定量描述了支撑膜中示踪扩散实验，其扩展形式（包括修正的边界条件、支撑膜迁移率张量）可系统处理准二维环境中的关联扩散、聚合物动力学、相分离动力学及多体相互作用；奇粘度提供了横向流体动力学响应，为检测二维流体手性提供了可能途径。；创新点：系统总结了Evans-Sackmann模型从原始公式到现代扩展的完整理论发展，特别强调了支撑膜迁移率张量作为统一工具处理多种准二维动力学问题，并首次将奇粘度引入支撑膜体系以探测手性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Evans-Sackmann流体动力学模型及其扩展，包括对圆盘和液滴的拖曳力计算、支撑膜迁移率张量的构建，以及奇粘度在活性手性膜中的引入。

papers.title: Quantum Mpemba effect for operators in open systems
papers.abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect concerns with anomalous relaxation of quantum states that evolves either under unitary or non-unitary dynamics. In the context of open quantum systems, while most studies focus on quantum states evolving under completely positive trace-presing dynamics described by the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equation, we demonstrate that an analogous effect can arise at the level of operators. In particular, we show that operators that evolves under the adjoint Liouvillian -- despite not being a trace-preserving map -- can still exhibit a genuine Mpemba effect. We derive general conditions under which this phenomenon can occur and validate our predictions for three different open quantum setups. Our results broaden the scope of the Mpemba effect in quantum systems and provide a framework for controlling the relaxation of physically relevant observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive general conditions”“validate our predictions”等理论推导和验证表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算具体方法。；研究对象：开放量子系统中算符的量子Mpemba效应。具体指在非幺正动力学下，算符（而非量子态）在伴随Liouvillian演化中表现出的反常弛豫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在开放量子系统中，算符在伴随Liouvillian演化下（尽管该映射不保迹）仍可产生真实的Mpemba效应，并推导了该现象发生的一般条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在开放量子系统中，算符在伴随Liouvillian演化下（尽管该映射不保迹）仍可产生真实的Mpemba效应，并推导了该现象发生的一般条件。；创新点：将量子Mpemba效应的研究从通常关注的量子态（在完全正保迹映射下演化）拓展到算符层面（在非保迹的伴随Liouvillian演化下），从而扩大了该效应在量子系统中的适用范围，并为控制物理可观测量弛豫提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad（GKSL）主方程框架，研究伴随Liouvillian作用下算符的弛豫行为；通过推导一般条件，并在三种不同的开放量子体系中进行理论验证。

papers.title: Global resetting and emergent correlations: exit statistics in an interval
papers.abstract: There is considerable current interest in the emergence of statistical correlations within a population of otherwise non-interacting Brownian particles subject to a common fluctuating environment or drive. Examples include global stochastic resetting, switching confining potentials, fluctuating diffusivities, and stochastically gated boundaries. Most studies have focused on the analytical structure of the stationary joint probability density (assuming it exists). In this paper, we extend previous work on the exit statistics of multiple particles in stochastically gated domains to the case of global resetting in an interval with absorbing boundaries at both ends. First, we use a generalised Itô's lemma to derive a hierarchy of boundary value problems (BVPs) for the joint splitting probability that all particles exit from the same end of the interval. The BVPs form a nested sequence with respect to the initial number of particles $M$. We explicitly solve the BVP for a pair of particles ($M=2$) and use this to illustrate the emergence of pairwise correlations. Second, we show how the BVP for the splitting probability of $M$ Brownian particles can be mapped onto the $M$th order moment equation of a stochastic diffusion equation with resetting. We thus establish a general mathematical framework to study exit problems for globally-driven particle systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“generalised Itô's lemma”“boundary value problems (BVPs)”“stochastic diffusion equation”等数学理论工具，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：全局随机重置（global stochastic resetting）下，两端吸收边界区间内多个非相互作用布朗粒子的逃逸统计问题，特别是粒子间涌现的统计相关性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了多个粒子从区间同一端逃逸的联合分裂概率所满足的边界值问题层级结构，并证明该问题可映射为带重置的随机扩散方程的高阶矩方程，从而建立了全局驱动粒子系统逃逸问题的通用数学框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了多个粒子从区间同一端逃逸的联合分裂概率所满足的边界值问题层级结构，并证明该问题可映射为带重置的随机扩散方程的高阶矩方程，从而建立了全局驱动粒子系统逃逸问题的通用数学框架。；创新点：将先前针对随机门控域中多粒子逃逸统计的研究扩展至全局随机重置情形，并揭示了多粒子分裂概率与随机扩散方程高阶矩之间的数学对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义伊藤引理（generalised Itô's lemma）推导边界值问题层级，并显式求解了双粒子（M=2）情形，以此展示成对相关性的涌现；进一步通过映射到随机扩散方程的矩方程建立通用框架。

papers.title: Metal-free heteroatom doping of carbon nitride for enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen peroxide production
papers.abstract: The photocatalytic production of hydrogen peroxide (H$_2$O$_2$) from water is a promising strategy for solar-to-chemical energy conversion. Herein, we investigate the effect of metal-free heteroatom doping (B, O, P, and S) on the structural, electronic, and photocatalytic properties of graphitic carbon nitride (C$_3$N$_4$) for H$_2$O$_2$ production under simulated solar irradiation. While pristine C$_3$N$_4$ exhibits stacked nanosheets, doping induces disorder, partial exfoliation, and changes in interlayer spacing, confirming successful heteroatom incorporation and modification of the electronic and optical properties. Photocatalytic experiments reveal that H$_2$O$_2$ production strongly depends on the sacrificial agent, pH, and reactive-species scavengers. All doped catalysts show enhanced activity compared to pristine C$_3$N$_4$, with 9.6-, 14.8-, 11.0-, and 16.4-fold increases for B-, P-, O-, and S-doped C$_3$N$_4$, respectively. S-doped C$_3$N$_4$ achieved the highest H$_2$O$_2$ production rate of 3022.1 $μ$mol h$^{-1}$ g$^{-1}$ and an apparent quantum yield of 8.1\%, attributed to improved charge separation and optimized selectivity. Mechanistic studies indicate that oxygen activation mainly follows a two-electron (2e$^{-}$) pathway driven by charge-carrier modulation and reactive oxygen species dynamics, with singlet oxygen and photogenerated holes playing a dominant role. In addition, S-doped C$_3$N$_4$ retained over 95\% of its activity after five cycles. These results highlight metal-free heteroatom doping as an effective strategy for sustainable photocatalytic H$_2$O$_2$ generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“Photocatalytic experiments reveal...”、“Mechanistic studies indicate...”、“retained over 95% of its activity after five cycles”等实验表征与性能测试内容。；研究对象：金属自由杂原子（B、O、P、S）掺杂的石墨相氮化碳（C₃N₄）材料，用于光催化产过氧化氢（H₂O₂）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有金属自由杂原子掺杂均显著提升了C₃N₄的光催化产H₂O₂性能，其中S掺杂效果最佳，产率达到3022.1 μmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，表观量子产率为8.1%，且循环稳定性优异（五次循环后活性保持>95%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有金属自由杂原子掺杂均显著提升了C₃N₄的光催化产H₂O₂性能，其中S掺杂效果最佳，产率达到3022.1 μmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，表观量子产率为8.1%，且循环稳定性优异（五次循环后活性保持>95%）。；创新点：系统比较了多种金属自由杂原子（B、O、P、S）掺杂对C₃N₄光催化产H₂O₂性能的影响，并明确S掺杂在电荷分离和选择性优化方面的优势，同时揭示了以单线态氧和光生空穴为主导的两电子氧活化路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用金属自由杂原子（B、O、P、S）掺杂合成改性C₃N₄；通过结构表征（如层间距、无序度、部分剥离等）分析掺杂效果；进行光催化产H₂O₂实验，考察牺牲剂、pH、活性物种捕获剂的影响；通过电荷分离、选择性优化及活性氧物种动力学分析揭示反应机理。

papers.title: Multiple Superconducting Phases in Rhombohedral Heptalayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Crystalline rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) has emerged as an ideal platform for studying unconventional superconductivity. Here, we report the observation of superconductivity in moiréless rhombohedral heptalayer graphene (RHG) at zero magnetic field. The superconducting phases emerge at low displacement electric fields (|D| < 0.2 V/nm) and are symmetrically distributed about D = 0, with one robust state exhibiting zero resistance and two weaker superconducting features. Comparisons with rhombohedral pentalayer graphene (RPG) reveal distinct perpendicular magnetic-field responses, and quantum oscillation measurements indicate that superconductivity in RHG arises from a half-metallic normal state. These results highlight the strong dependence of superconductivity on layer number and electronic structure in RMG systems and provide new insights into its microscopic origin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“我们报道了……的观测结果”（observation）、“量子振荡测量”（quantum oscillation measurements）等实验性描述。；研究对象：无摩尔超晶格的菱方七层石墨烯（Rhombohedral Heptalayer Graphene, RHG）中的超导相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零磁场下，菱方七层石墨烯在低位移电场区域（|D| < 0.2 V/nm）出现了多个超导相，其中一个强健的超导态表现出零电阻，另外两个则较弱。该超导电性源自一个半金属的正常态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零磁场下，菱方七层石墨烯在低位移电场区域（|D| < 0.2 V/nm）出现了多个超导相，其中一个强健的超导态表现出零电阻，另外两个则较弱。该超导电性源自一个半金属的正常态。；创新点：首次在无摩尔超晶格的菱方七层石墨烯中观测到超导电性，并揭示了超导电性对石墨烯层数和电子结构的强依赖性，为理解菱方多层石墨烯体系中超导的微观起源提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 通过施加位移电场（D）调控体系，测量零磁场下的电阻以探测超导相；通过比较与菱方五层石墨烯（RPG）的垂直磁场响应差异，以及进行量子振荡测量来表征正常态的性质。

papers.title: Mpemba effect in a sheared granular gas with velocity-dependent restitution
papers.abstract: We investigate the Mpemba effect in a dilute sheared granular gas with a velocity-dependent restitution coefficient. Using kinetic theory based on Grad's moment method, we analyze the relaxation dynamics following a sudden change in the shear rate. We show that, despite having a higher initial temperature, a system starting from an isotropic state can relax faster than a system prepared in a sheared steady state, demonstrating a clear Mpemba effect in the temperature evolution. We further demonstrate the emergence of a viscosity Mpemba effect, characterized by crossings in the relaxation curves of the shear viscosity. Remarkably, multiple crossings arise due to an additional intrinsic timescale introduced by the velocity dependence of the restitution coefficient, providing a minimal kinetic mechanism for multiple Mpemba effects in driven granular gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic theory（动理学理论）、Grad's moment method（Grad矩方法）、relaxation dynamics（弛豫动力学）。；研究对象：剪切稀薄颗粒气体中的Mpemba效应，具体体系为具有速度依赖恢复系数的稀薄剪切颗粒气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在剪切速率突变后，初始温度更高但处于各向同性态的系统，其温度弛豫速度反而快于初始处于剪切稳态的系统，即出现温度Mpemba效应；同时，剪切粘度的弛豫曲线出现交叉，表明存在粘度Mpemba效应。由于恢复系数对速度的依赖引入了额外的内禀时间尺度，导致弛豫曲线出现多次交叉，从而在驱动颗粒气体中产生多重Mpemba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在剪切速率突变后，初始温度更高但处于各向同性态的系统，其温度弛豫速度反而快于初始处于剪切稳态的系统，即出现温度Mpemba效应；同时，剪切粘度的弛豫曲线出现交叉，表明存在粘度Mpemba效应。由于恢复系数对速度的依赖引入了额外的内禀时间尺度，导致弛豫曲线出现多次交叉，从而在驱动颗粒气体中产生多重Mpemba效应。；创新点：首次在具有速度依赖恢复系数的剪切颗粒气体中同时发现温度Mpemba效应和粘度Mpemba效应，并揭示了恢复系数的速度依赖性作为产生多重Mpemba效应的最小动理学机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于Grad矩方法的动理学理论，分析剪切速率突变后的弛豫动力学。

papers.title: Network analysis for steady-state current fluctuations under finite affinity: Application to Brownian computation
papers.abstract: A graph-theoretic analysis of the steady-state current noise in master equations under a finite thermodynamic force (affinity) is presented. The incidence matrix twisted by a finite affinity is not orthogonal to the standard cycle space, motivating the introduction of twisted circuit matrices to restore the orthogonality. The resulting twisted-cycle matrix yields an interference-like effect, enabling us to express the signal-to-noise ratio as a quadratic optimization problem in terms of twisted-cycle currents. We apply this framework to a Brownian computation model on a tree-like state-transition diagram with exponential backward branching, finite affinity at each step, and a single reset cycle. In the limit of an infinitely long intended computation path $\ell$, the Fano factor of the reset current undergoes a transition from noiseless to Poissonian behavior at an affinity equal to the logarithm of the number of immediate predecessors $α$. This corresponds to an easy-hard transition in the computational time complexity [K. Okajima, K. Hukushima, arXiv:2512.24728 ], which is not captured by the thermodynamic uncertainty relation. This transition point precisely characterizes the thermodynamic costs of logically irreversible computation: in the absence of affinity, the reset cost scales as $\ln \ell$, whereas reaching the transition point requires a thermodynamic force of order $\ln α$ per step to counteract backward branching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：graph-theoretic analysis、quadratic optimization problem、theoretical framework。；研究对象：主方程框架下有限热力学力（亲和力）驱动的稳态电流噪声，以及布朗计算模型（树状状态转移图，指数反向分支，单重置循环）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限长计算路径极限下，重置电流的Fano因子在亲和力等于前驱体数对数时发生从无噪声到泊松行为的转变，对应计算时间复杂度的易-难相变，该相变点精确刻画了逻辑不可逆计算的热力学成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限长计算路径极限下，重置电流的Fano因子在亲和力等于前驱体数对数时发生从无噪声到泊松行为的转变，对应计算时间复杂度的易-难相变，该相变点精确刻画了逻辑不可逆计算的热力学成本。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 图论分析：引入由有限亲和力扭曲的关联矩阵，构造扭曲电路矩阵恢复正交性，将信噪比表达为扭曲循环电流的二次优化问题。应用于布朗计算模型（树状状态转移图，指数反向分支，单重置循环）。

papers.title: Coherent spectroscopy of collective excitations in superfluid helium far from equilibrium
papers.abstract: Ultrafast dynamics of collective excitations in superfluids remains largely unexplored beyond the roton regime, despite its importance for understanding nonequilibrium processes in these systems. Here, we employ ultrafast coherent control with sequences of femtosecond pulses to perform spectroscopy of multiple branches of the Landau excitation spectrum in superfluid helium far from equilibrium. By measuring the time-resolved optical birefringence, we track the nonequilibrium dynamics of maxon pairs and Pitaevskii plateau excitations alongside the previously studied roton pairs, revealing surprisingly strong binding energy of maxon pairs, their extremely short lifetime, and the influence of the quasiparticle effective mass on the phase of the coherent response. These results demonstrate the ability to extract previously inaccessible information about collective excitations in a strongly interacting quantum fluid by probing its nonequilibrium dynamics on femtosecond and picosecond timescales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ultrafast coherent control、femtosecond pulses、time-resolved optical birefringence。；研究对象：远离平衡态的超流氦（superfluid helium）中的集体激发（collective excitations），包括maxon对、Pitaevskii plateau激发以及roton对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验揭示了maxon对具有出乎意料的强结合能、极短的寿命，以及准粒子有效质量对相干响应相位的影响，从而提取了强相互作用量子流体中集体激发的先前无法获取的信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验揭示了maxon对具有出乎意料的强结合能、极短的寿命，以及准粒子有效质量对相干响应相位的影响，从而提取了强相互作用量子流体中集体激发的先前无法获取的信息。；创新点：将超快相干光谱学应用于超流氦中roton区域之外的集体激发（maxon对和Pitaevskii plateau激发），首次在飞秒至皮秒时间尺度上探测其非平衡动力学，并获得了maxon对结合能等关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 采用飞秒脉冲序列进行超快相干控制，并通过时间分辨的光学双折射（time-resolved optical birefringence）测量，追踪超流氦中不同分支的Landau激发谱的非平衡动力学。

papers.title: Lattice Relaxation in Moiré Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: We develop an analytical theory for lattice relaxation in twisted moiré heterobilayers, accounting for lattice mismatch, twist, external biaxial heterostrain, and different elastic constants. Starting from continuum elasticity, we derive the self-consistent equations for the in-plane displacement fields and obtain simple perturbative expressions for the layer-resolved in-plane displacement fields induced by lattice relaxation. We apply our theory to graphene on hBN and representative 2H transition metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers, including MoTe$_2$/WSe$_2$ and WSe$_2$/WS$_2$. Our analytical results agree very well with full numerical solutions over experimentally relevant parameters. We further show that heterobilayers can exhibit a buckling instability near alignment, driven by compressive in-plane strain due to moiré relaxation. Our results provide a simple theoretical framework for incorporating lattice relaxation in realistic moiré heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical theory、continuum elasticity、perturbative expressions。；研究对象：扭曲莫尔异质双层中的晶格弛豫现象，具体包括石墨烯/hBN、MoTe₂/WSe₂和WSe₂/WS₂等代表性异质双层体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个解析理论框架，能够准确描述由晶格失配、扭转、外部双轴异质应变和不同弹性常数引起的层分辨面内位移场；并发现异质双层在接近对齐时可能因莫尔弛豫导致的压缩面内应变而出现屈曲不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个解析理论框架，能够准确描述由晶格失配、扭转、外部双轴异质应变和不同弹性常数引起的层分辨面内位移场；并发现异质双层在接近对齐时可能因莫尔弛豫导致的压缩面内应变而出现屈曲不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于连续弹性理论推导面内位移场的自洽方程，并通过微扰方法获得层分辨位移场的简单解析表达式；将解析结果与完整数值解进行对比验证。

papers.title: Anomalies in the thermal conductivity of honeycomb antiferromagnet MnPS$_{3}$
papers.abstract: Intrinsic two-dimensional magnets serve as a good platform to explore collective, charge-neutral and low-energy excitations. Distinguishing the crucial role of them in experimental aspect remains a challenge for decades. Here, we study the thermal transport in honeycomb antiferromagnet MnPS$_{3}$ with $T_N$=78 K down to very low temperatures (<0.01$T_N$). At high temperatures (>0.1$T_N$), the field dependence of the thermal Hall conductivity exhibits a linear phonon Hall effect and a peak associated with the spin-flop transition due to a strong spin-lattice coupling, well reproducing the previous report (Phys. Rev. B 110, 165147 (2024)). Notably, below 2 K, we find that the field dependence of the thermal Hall conductivity exhibits sign reversals within the spin-flop phase, at which the field dependence of the longitudinal thermal conductivity also shows multiple valleys. We suggest that these anomalies are caused by the redistribution of Berry curvature in magnon bands, demonstrating the superior performance of the thermal Hall measurements to detect the Berry curvature distributions in magnetic insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：thermal transport study、field dependence、thermal Hall conductivity measurements。；研究对象：蜂窝状反铁磁体MnPS₃（奈尔温度T_N=78 K）中的热输运现象，特别是极低温下（<0.01T_N）的热霍尔效应和纵向热导率异常。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极低温（<2 K）下，MnPS₃的热霍尔电导率在自旋翻转相内出现符号反转，同时纵向热导率呈现多个谷值。这些异常源于磁振子能带中贝里曲率的重新分布，表明热霍尔测量是探测磁性绝缘体中贝里曲率分布的有效手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极低温（<2 K）下，MnPS₃的热霍尔电导率在自旋翻转相内出现符号反转，同时纵向热导率呈现多个谷值。这些异常源于磁振子能带中贝里曲率的重新分布，表明热霍尔测量是探测磁性绝缘体中贝里曲率分布的有效手段。；创新点：首次在极低温（<2 K）下观察到MnPS₃热霍尔电导率在自旋翻转相内的符号反转现象，并指出该现象与磁振子能带贝里曲率重新分布相关，超越了此前仅报道高温线性声子霍尔效应和自旋翻转峰的工作（Phys. Rev. B 110, 165147 (2024)）。
papers.method_zh: 热输运测量：在极低温（<0.01T_N）至高温（>0.1T_N）范围内，测量热霍尔电导率和纵向热导率随磁场的变化关系。

papers.title: Universal interface fluctuations in absorbing-state phase transitions
papers.abstract: Despite similarities between models exhibiting absorbing phase transitions (APTs) and those showing Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) growth, the relationship between these universal fluctuations has remained elusive. We numerically study (1+1)-dimensional interfaces of (2+1)-dimensional models showing APTs of directed percolation (DP) and compact directed percolation (CDP) classes with an active boundary, finding a universal crossover from short-time APT-governed fluctuations to long-time KPZ fluctuations. Upon rescaling time and length by the APT correlation time and length, the cumulants of the interface height distributions collapse onto a single scaling function. The fluctuation properties of the discrete Domany-Kinzel model and the continuum stochastic Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov (sFKPP) equation coincide, indicating that the KPZ growth parameters are determined solely by fundamental properties of the APT. For the CDP sFKPP equation, a dimensionless parameter tunes both the critical interface distribution and the KPZ parameters, with the interface properties of the biased voter model recovered in a limiting case. These results uncover a universal crossover in which KPZ fluctuations emerge from APT fluctuations at long times, linking paradigmatic universality classes of nonequilibrium scale-invariant phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically study、scaling function、continuum equation。；研究对象：吸收态相变（APT）中的界面涨落，具体涉及有向逾渗（DP）类和紧致有向逾渗（CDP）类的（2+1）维模型，以及其与Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）生长涨落之间的普适性关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在吸收态相变模型中，界面涨落存在从短时间受APT支配到长时间受KPZ支配的普适交叉行为；KPZ生长参数完全由APT的基本性质决定，且对于CDP类，一个无量纲参数可同时调控临界界面分布和KPZ参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在吸收态相变模型中，界面涨落存在从短时间受APT支配到长时间受KPZ支配的普适交叉行为；KPZ生长参数完全由APT的基本性质决定，且对于CDP类，一个无量纲参数可同时调控临界界面分布和KPZ参数。；创新点：揭示了APT与KPZ两类非平衡标度不变现象之间的普适交叉关系，并证明KPZ涨落参数可由APT的基元性质唯一确定，建立了两个经典普适类之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（1+1）维界面，研究（2+1）维模型中具有活性边界的DP类和CDP类APT；使用离散Domany-Kinzel模型和连续随机Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov（sFKPP）方程进行对比分析；通过重标度时间和长度（利用APT关联时间和关联长度）使界面高度分布累积量坍塌为单一标度函数。

papers.title: Thermal Transport in Defective Uranium Nitride: Effects of Point Defects, Anharmonicity, and Electronic Contributions
papers.abstract: The impact of point defects on thermal transport in uranium nitride (UN) is investigated using a MLIP combined with Green-Kubo (GK) and normal mode analysis (NMA) methods over 300-1500 K. In pristine UN, temperature-dependent calculations of lattice thermal conductivity reveal that four-phonon scattering is essential yet sufficient to accurately capture high temperature anharmonic phonon transport, as evidenced by close agreement between GK and ShengBTE calculations including three- and four-phonon processes. In defective systems, all types of point defects significantly reduce thermal conductivity at low temperature. Mode-resolved analysis further shows that interstitial defects introduce new phonon states due to a stronger local strain effect. Notably, the uranium interstitial leads to strong defect-phonon scattering over broad phonon spectrum, while the other point defects produce more selective scattering, with even reduced phonon scattering for some acoustic modes. The optical contribution to thermal conductivity remains nearly constant in the presence of IU, but decreases with increasing temperature for pristine and the other defect types. The total thermal conductivity, incorporating electron-phonon coupling and an estimated electronic contribution, yields excellent agreement with experiment in the pristine system, with electronic contributions dominating thermal transport above 600 K. Moreover, with defect-electron contribution introduced through a semiclassical electron-defect scattering model, it is found that (i) the total conductivity degradation follows IU, VU, IN, and VN in descending order, and (ii) electron-phonon coupling becomes negligible in defective systems. These results provide a unified understanding of defect-dependent thermal transport in UN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：MLIP、Green-Kubo、NMA、ShengBTE、电子-缺陷散射模型）；研究对象：缺陷氮化铀（UN）中的热输运，具体研究点缺陷（铀间隙IU、铀空位VU、氮间隙IN、氮空位VN）以及非谐性和电子贡献对热导率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在完整UN中，四声子散射是准确描述高温非谐声子输运的必要条件；在缺陷体系中，所有点缺陷均显著降低低温热导率，其中铀间隙（IU）导致宽谱的强缺陷-声子散射，而其他缺陷则产生更具选择性的散射。总热导率与实验吻合良好，电子贡献在600K以上占主导，且缺陷体系中电子-声子耦合可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在完整UN中，四声子散射是准确描述高温非谐声子输运的必要条件；在缺陷体系中，所有点缺陷均显著降低低温热导率，其中铀间隙（IU）导致宽谱的强缺陷-声子散射，而其他缺陷则产生更具选择性的散射。总热导率与实验吻合良好，电子贡献在600K以上占主导，且缺陷体系中电子-声子耦合可忽略。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合机器学习原子间势（MLIP）与Green-Kubo（GK）方法及简正模分析（NMA）方法，在300-1500K温度范围内进行计算。同时使用ShengBTE软件包计算包含三声子和四声子过程的晶格热导率，并引入半经典电子-缺陷散射模型估算缺陷-电子贡献。

papers.title: Ferroelectric polarization controlled orbital Hall conductivity in a higher-order topological insulator: \textit{d1T}-phase monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: The higher-order topological insulator is an extended concept of the conventional topological insulator, which obeys the generalization of the standard bulk-boundary correspondence. In our paper, we predict the monolayer \textit{d1T}-phase transition metal dichalcogenide MoS$_2$ to be a higher-order topological insulator, while also possessing intriguing ferroelectric characteristics. We explicitly demonstrate the nontrivial topological index and reveal the hallmark corner states with quantized fractional charge within the bulk band gap. Second, we show the existence of a nonzero orbital Hall conductivity plateau within the energy gap which is a signature to identify higher-order topology system. Additionally, we investigate the relationship between the ferroelectricity and the orbital Hall conductivity of \textit{d1T} MoS$_2$ and find that the direction of ferroelectric polarization can modulate the positive and negative values of the orbital Hall conductivity $σ_{\rm{OH}}^x$. Our findings provide the theory and material candidate for ferroelectricity tunable orbital Hall effect which is promising to realize the external electric field controllable orbitronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：predict、demonstrate、show、investigate、find。；研究对象：单层 d1T 相过渡金属二硫族化合物 MoS₂，具体研究其作为高阶拓扑绝缘体的性质、铁电特性以及轨道霍尔电导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层 d1T 相 MoS₂ 被预测为一种高阶拓扑绝缘体，同时具有铁电性；其铁电极化方向可以调控轨道霍尔电导的正负值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层 d1T 相 MoS₂ 被预测为一种高阶拓扑绝缘体，同时具有铁电性；其铁电极化方向可以调控轨道霍尔电导的正负值。；创新点：首次将高阶拓扑绝缘体、铁电性与轨道霍尔效应联系起来，提出通过铁电极化调控轨道霍尔电导，为外电场可控的轨道电子学提供了理论依据和材料候选。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论计算展示拓扑不变量，揭示体带隙内的角态及其量子化分数电荷；计算轨道霍尔电导平台，并分析其与铁电极化的关系。摘要未明确说明具体计算软件或方法（如 DFT 类型）。

papers.title: I-V characteristics of SNS junctions with a multivalley normal region
papers.abstract: In multivalley conductors the inter-valley relaxation time $τ_v$ and the inelastic relaxation time $τ_{in}$ may be significantly longer than the intra-valley momentum relaxation time $τ$. We show that this separation of time scales has dramatic effects on the I-V characteristics of SNS junctions with a multivalley normal region. We generalize the Larkin-Ovchinnikov equations describing superconducting kinetics to the case of multivalley superconductors. We use this generalization to obtain a kinetic description of multivalley SNS junctions. We find that at constant voltage bias $V$, the current $I(V)$ is nonmonotonic; it exhibits two peaks of similar magnitude $I_\text{max,1} \sim I_\text{max,2}$ at $V_1 \sim \hbar(eτ_{in})^{-1}$ and $V_2\sim \hbar(eτ_v)^{-1}$, which may greatly exceed the critical current $I_c(T)$. At constant current bias $I$ we find that in a wide interval, $I_c(T) < I \lesssim I_{\text{jump}}$, the nonlinear resistance of the junction is controlled by the long relaxation times and may be several orders of magnitude smaller than the normal state resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”“We generalize”“We use this generalization to obtain a kinetic description”等表述，属于理论推导和模型构建。；研究对象：多谷正常区的超导体-正常金属-超导体（SNS）结的电流-电压（I-V）特性，特别是谷间弛豫时间与能量弛豫时间远大于谷内动量弛豫时间时的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多谷SNS结中，I-V特性呈现非单调行为，在特定电压下出现两个大小相近的电流峰；在恒流偏置下，非线性电阻可远小于正常态电阻，且由长弛豫时间控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多谷SNS结中，I-V特性呈现非单调行为，在特定电压下出现两个大小相近的电流峰；在恒流偏置下，非线性电阻可远小于正常态电阻，且由长弛豫时间控制。；创新点：揭示了多谷导体中不同时间尺度（谷内动量弛豫、谷间弛豫、非弹性弛豫）的分离对SNS结I-V特性的显著影响，并给出了相应的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 推广了描述超导动力学的Larkin-Ovchinnikov方程至多谷超导体情形，并基于此推广建立了多谷SNS结的动力学描述。

papers.title: Competition and coexistence of superconducting symmetries in $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between unconventional magnetism and superconductivity in a model of a $p$-wave magnet on a square lattice. Using a self-consistent Bogoliubov-de-Gennes approach, we analyze the pairing amplitudes, competition, and coexistence of spin-singlet $s$-wave and spin-triplet $p$-wave pairings in the presence of a magnetic texture with a helical structure along the $x$ direction that is repeated in the $y$ direction. We find that the magnetic helix selectively stabilizes different pairing symmetries depending on its orientation and strength. In particular, mixed-spin $p_x$-wave pairing is enhanced at intermediate magnetic couplings and equal-spin $p_y$-wave pairing is robust and insensitive to all coupling intensities. When the multiple order parameters are simultaneously considered, we find regimes of coexistence and competition. Increasing the magnetic coupling drives two quantum phase transitions. The first from dominant spin-singlet $s$-wave to mixed-spin triplet $p_x$-wave pairings in a regime of coexistence. The second from spin-singlet $s$-wave and mixed-spin triplet $p$-wave pairings with total spin projection $S_z=0$ to dominant equal-spin triplet $p_y$-wave pairings with $S_z=\pm1$ in a regime of mutually exclusive superconducting phases. Our results demonstrate that $p$-wave magnetic order does not merely diminish spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductivity but can actively promote and stabilize spin-triplet $p$-wave pairing, both intrinsically and in proximity to spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductors. These findings highlight unconventional magnets as promising materials for realizing robust triplet superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：self-consistent Bogoliubov-de-Gennes approach（自洽Bogoliubov-de-Gennes方法）、模型分析。；研究对象：在正方晶格上具有螺旋磁结构的p波磁体中的超导配对对称性，具体研究自旋单态s波与自旋三重态p波配对的竞争与共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: p波磁序不仅能抑制自旋单态s波超导，还能主动促进并稳定自旋三重态p波配对；磁耦合强度驱动两次量子相变，分别从s波主导到p_x波共存，再到p_y波主导的互斥超导相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：p波磁序不仅能抑制自旋单态s波超导，还能主动促进并稳定自旋三重态p波配对；磁耦合强度驱动两次量子相变，分别从s波主导到p_x波共存，再到p_y波主导的互斥超导相。；创新点：揭示了p波磁序可选择性稳定不同配对对称性（如混合自旋p_x波和等自旋p_y波），并发现p波磁体本身即可作为实现稳健三重态超导的候选材料，而不仅仅是破坏s波超导。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽Bogoliubov-de-Gennes（BdG）方法，在正方晶格p波磁体模型中计算配对振幅，分析不同磁纹理（沿x方向螺旋、y方向重复）下的超导配对对称性。

papers.title: Finite-frequency anomaly-induced electromechanical response of Dirac fermions in deformed graphene
papers.abstract: A deformation of a graphene sheet changes more than the positions of the atoms. In the low-energy Dirac theory it also produces geometric electron-phonon vertices. One of these vertices acts as an emergent phonon gauge field, $\calA_μ$, which couples to the same Dirac current as the electromagnetic vector potential. This shared current vertex gives a direct route from mechanics to electronics: a moving deformation can generate a transverse electric current, and a deformation pattern with emergent phonon flux can bind electric charge. We show that the coefficient of this mixed electromechanical response is the parity-odd current-current correlator of a massive Dirac cone. For an insulating cone the coefficient is the one-cone Chern-Simons value, while for a doped cone in the local regime it is reduced by the Berry curvature factor $m/|μ|$. We apply the response to explicit deformations. A traveling flexural wave generates a transverse second-harmonic current; a static ripple mixed with a dynamic phonon generates a transverse current at the drive frequency; and two non-collinear modes can generate charge modulation through the emergent phonon flux. We keep the spin and valley sum explicit, so the paper shows when the one-cone anomaly becomes a charge current in graphene and when it instead appears in a valley, spin, or spin-valley channel. For sublattice-gapped graphene with a valley-odd deformation gauge coupling, the two valleys add rather than cancel. The experimentally sharp signature is a transverse electrical signal at twice the flexural-wave frequency, with a phase fixed by the sign of the sublattice gap and a gate dependence that crosses over from a gap plateau to a $1/|μ|$ decay. These direction, phase, frequency, and gate-voltage selection rules give clean tests of the anomaly-induced electromechanical channel in deformed graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：论文基于低能狄拉克理论，推导了形变石墨烯中的机电响应系数，并进行了理论计算与分析。；研究对象：形变石墨烯中的狄拉克费米子，具体研究由形变诱导的声子规范场与电子耦合所产生的有限频率机电响应现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，形变石墨烯中由声子规范场与电磁矢量势共享的电流顶点，会导致一种混合的机电响应，其系数由大质量狄拉克锥的奇宇称流-流关联函数决定。对于绝缘锥，该系数为单锥陈-西蒙斯值；对于掺杂锥，则被贝里曲率因子 m/|μ| 所抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，形变石墨烯中由声子规范场与电磁矢量势共享的电流顶点，会导致一种混合的机电响应，其系数由大质量狄拉克锥的奇宇称流-流关联函数决定。对于绝缘锥，该系数为单锥陈-西蒙斯值；对于掺杂锥，则被贝里曲率因子 m/|μ| 所抑制。；创新点：论文系统地展示了在形变石墨烯中，单锥反常如何转化为电荷电流，以及如何出现在谷、自旋或自旋-谷通道中。特别地，对于具有谷奇形变规范耦合的子晶格带隙石墨烯，两个谷的贡献相加而非相消，从而产生可实验观测的明确信号，如横向电信号频率为弯曲波频率的两倍，其相位由子晶格带隙符号决定，栅压依赖从带隙平台过渡到 1/|μ| 衰减。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体使用了低能狄拉克理论框架，计算了形变诱导的声子规范场与电子耦合的关联函数，并分析了不同形变模式（如行进的弯曲波、静态波纹与动态声子混合、非共线模式）下的电流和电荷响应。论文明确保留了自旋和谷指数的求和。

papers.title: Theory of melting lines with a variable enthalpy of fusion
papers.abstract: Conventional derivations of phase boundaries from the Clausius-Clapeyron (CC) relation often employ the constant latent heat approximation to maintain analytical functions of the sublimation and boiling curves. To address the complex thermodynamics of the solid-liquid transition, we develop a two-phase analytical model by modifying the CC equation to account for a variable enthalpy of fusion along the melting line (ML). Our methodology utilizes recent theoretical and experimental progress demonstrating that the isobaric heat capacity of crystalline solids near the melting point features a dominant anharmonic, volume-dependent component. Consequently, the latent heat is correlated to the specific volumes of the coexisting phases. Differentiation of this modified CC relation yields a second-order differential equation governing ML. By imposing appropriate e boundary conditions, physically acceptable approximate parabolic solutions are derived. The parameters of these analytic functions are defined exclusively by fundamental thermophysical properties, including the bulk moduli, thermal expansion coefficients, and specific volumes of the coexisting phases, as well as the isobaric heat capacity of the solid. Our derivation, rooted in solid-state anharmonicity, yields approximate parabolic scaling laws that corroborate with a recent universal model derived from the Phonon Theory of Liquids [K. Trachenko, Phys. Rev. E 109, 034122 (2024)], supporting the universal parabolic nature of melting curves from a completely distinct theoretical foundation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical model、derivation、theoretical foundation。；研究对象：固-液相变（熔化）的相边界（熔化线），具体研究熔化过程中熔化焓随温度变化的热力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过修正Clausius-Clapeyron方程以考虑可变熔化焓，推导出熔化线近似为抛物线形式的标度律，并从固体非简谐性出发支持了熔化曲线的普适抛物线性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过修正Clausius-Clapeyron方程以考虑可变熔化焓，推导出熔化线近似为抛物线形式的标度律，并从固体非简谐性出发支持了熔化曲线的普适抛物线性质。；创新点：从固体非简谐性这一完全不同的理论基础出发，推导出与近期基于液体声子理论（Phonon Theory of Liquids）的普适模型一致的抛物线标度律，为熔化曲线的普适抛物线性质提供了新的理论支撑。
papers.method_zh: 基于修正的Clausius-Clapeyron关系，结合固体在熔点附近等压热容的主要非简谐、体积依赖成分，推导出控制熔化线的二阶微分方程，并通过边界条件得到近似抛物线解析解。

papers.title: Collective dynamics of active matter with orientation-weighted alignment
papers.abstract: We study an agent-based model of self-propelled particles with a velocity-dependent alignment rule. This interaction is orientation weighted and acts along the line connecting neighboring particles. Tuning the alignment strength produces several distinct collective regimes, including disordered gas-like motion, coherent flocking, jammed high-density states, and densely ordered moving clusters with active-crystal-like behavior. These results show that a simple local alignment rule can generate a broad range of nonequilibrium collective dynamics within a single microscopic model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“agent-based model”（基于智能体的模型）、“simulation”（模拟）、“microscopic model”（微观模型）。；研究对象：活性物质（active matter）的集体动力学，具体研究具有速度依赖对齐规则的自推进粒子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节粒子间取向加权的对齐强度，单一微观模型即可产生多种非平衡集体动力学相态，包括无序气体运动、相干 flocking（群集）、堵塞的高密度态以及具有活性晶体行为的有序运动团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节粒子间取向加权的对齐强度，单一微观模型即可产生多种非平衡集体动力学相态，包括无序气体运动、相干 flocking（群集）、堵塞的高密度态以及具有活性晶体行为的有序运动团簇。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但摘要指出，该工作展示了简单的局部对齐规则（而非全局或复杂相互作用）即可在单一模型中复现多种集体动力学相态，这可能是相对于以往需要不同规则或额外机制的研究的新意所在。
papers.method_zh: 基于智能体的计算模型（agent-based model），采用取向加权（orientation-weighted）的局部对齐规则，该规则沿相邻粒子连线方向作用。

papers.title: Iterative maps emerging from cohomological structure of primes
papers.abstract: Prime numbers appeared in contexts spanning statistical mechanics, quantum mechanics and dynamical systems. However, the mechanisms governing the irregularities observed in their sequence and linking them to physical systems remained unclear. Here, it is shown that prime gaps at different separation distances follow a function depending on that distance and can be described by an iterative map which predicts the primary growth of successive primes. On the other hand, the analysis of remaining fluctuations reveals the existence of a well-defined cohomological structure, where the deterministic functional relation holds for primes up to small decaying fluctuations. In consequence, the long-range correlations as well as local jumps in primes encode the underlying cohomological structure where prime numbers are states of a given system that becomes deterministic asymptotically. Remarkably, the solution to this cohomological equation turns out to be the logarithmic integral function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：cohomological structure（上同调结构）、iterative map（迭代映射）、deterministic asymptotic behavior（确定性渐近行为）。；研究对象：素数序列及其间隙（prime gaps）的统计与动力学结构，将其视为一个物理系统的状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 素数间隙随分离距离的变化遵循一个可由迭代映射描述的确定性函数，该映射预测了连续素数的主要增长；剩余涨落揭示了一个定义良好的上同调结构，其解为对数积分函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：素数间隙随分离距离的变化遵循一个可由迭代映射描述的确定性函数，该映射预测了连续素数的主要增长；剩余涨落揭示了一个定义良好的上同调结构，其解为对数积分函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析素数间隙在不同分离距离下的函数关系，构建迭代映射；利用上同调理论分析剩余涨落，求解上同调方程。

papers.title: Variational Boundary Fluctuations as a First-Principles Origin of Langevin Noise
papers.abstract: Stochastic forces are usually postulated or obtained by eliminating environmental degrees of freedom. Here we identify a variational origin: fluctuating endpoint data in Hamilton's principle induce fluctuations of the on-shell action. Hamilton--Jacobi propagation transports this boundary imprint, whose gradient generates an effective Langevin force inherited from boundary-action fluctuations. The resulting force is not freely specifiable: its amplitude is filtered by the Hessian of Hamilton's principal function, yielding multiplicative and state-dependent noise. Homogeneous additive Langevin forcing is recovered only as a Markovian coarse-grained limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational origin、Hamilton's principle、Hamilton–Jacobi propagation、Langevin force。；研究对象：随机力的起源，具体为从哈密顿原理中边界数据的涨落推导出朗之万噪声的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 变分边界涨落可以通过哈密顿-雅可比传播在壳作用量，其梯度产生有效的朗之万力，且该力不是自由指定的，而是由哈密顿主函数的Hessian矩阵滤波，产生乘性且状态依赖的噪声；均匀加性朗之万力仅在马尔可夫粗粒化极限下恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：变分边界涨落可以通过哈密顿-雅可比传播在壳作用量，其梯度产生有效的朗之万力，且该力不是自由指定的，而是由哈密顿主函数的Hessian矩阵滤波，产生乘性且状态依赖的噪声；均匀加性朗之万力仅在马尔可夫粗粒化极限下恢复。；创新点：首次从变分原理（哈密顿原理）的边界条件出发，为朗之万噪声提供了一个第一性原理的起源，而非通常的唯象引入或环境自由度消除。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于哈密顿原理中端点数据的涨落，结合哈密顿-雅可比方程分析边界印记的传播，并利用作用量的梯度构造有效随机力。

papers.title: Finite-width adiabatic shear banding and dislocation patterning in mesoscale polycrystalline aggregates
papers.abstract: Dynamic shear banding under adiabatic conditions in a mesoscale polycrystalline aggregate is studied using a model of mesoscale dislocation mechanics and experiments. The model involves a length scale related to hardening induced by excess/polar/geometrically necessary dislocation (GND) density, and utilizes a simple classical crystal plasticity model with isotropic Voce law hardening. Simulations of statistically representative volume elements of a polycrystal determined from experimental samples are conducted. Studies in 2-d (section) and 3-d capture the experimentally observed finite-width shear bands and the formation of low-angle subgrain boundaries even in the absence of heat conduction in the model, as well as size-dependent strengthening for grain sizes from 1 to 20 $μ$m. The 2-d and large-scale 3-d simulations, the latter involving 1 million finite elements, provide access to the progressive evolution of material strength, stress state, and temperature in the course of large deformations. GND distributions accumulate at grain boundaries and form patterned structures within grain interiors, offering insight into the microstructural changes that precede failure in adiabatic shear bands. Mesh-converged, delocalized and localized plastic flow to very large deformations without softening is observed for a significant range of parameters, reflecting a competition between GND hardening and thermal softening in setting the non-softening steady state in the absence of other ductile damage mechanisms in the model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（兼有实验验证）。关键词：mesoscale dislocation mechanics model、simulations、experiments。；研究对象：介观尺度多晶集合体在绝热条件下的动态剪切带行为，以及位错图案的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无热传导模型中，仍能捕捉到实验观察到的有限宽度剪切带和低角度亚晶界形成；位错分布（几何必需位错）在晶界累积并在晶粒内部形成图案结构，反映了剪切带失效前的微观结构变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无热传导模型中，仍能捕捉到实验观察到的有限宽度剪切带和低角度亚晶界形成；位错分布（几何必需位错）在晶界累积并在晶粒内部形成图案结构，反映了剪切带失效前的微观结构变化。；创新点：在无热传导的简化模型中，首次通过介观位错力学模拟再现了有限宽度绝热剪切带和低角度亚晶界形成，并揭示了几何必需位错硬化与热软化之间的竞争机制，解释了无软化稳态变形的参数范围。
papers.method_zh: 采用介观位错力学模型（包含与几何必需位错密度相关的硬化长度尺度），结合经典晶体塑性模型（各向同性Voce律硬化）。对实验样品确定的统计代表性体积单元进行二维（截面）和三维（含100万有限元）模拟。

papers.title: A comparative first-principles investigation of bilayer NbOX2 (X=Cl, Br, I) for Photocatalytic water splitting applications
papers.abstract: Motivated by our previous work on bulk NbOX2 , where we have reported its high 1dielectric polarisation and finite piezoelectric response, this work extends to its 2D homo bilayer system to explore its potential for photocatalytic water splitting. Herein, density functional theory (DFT) were employed in probing the structural, electronic, optical, and photocatalytic properties of 2D homo bilayer NbOX2 (X = Cl, Br, and I). Our results show that structurally, NbOCl2 and NbOBr2 prefer AC bilayer stacking,while AB stacking was preferred by NbOI2 . All the considered bilayers are dynamically, thermally, and mechanically stable. From the analysis of electronic structure we have found a decreasing trend in the energy band gap as X goes down the group from Cl to I, with the position of the valence band maximum shifting upward along the high symmetry points. In terms of carrier mobility, all 2D bilayer systems possess high carrier mobility comparable to known 2D materials. It also exhibits an anisotropic carrier transfer property by which charge carriers are separated efficiently. These materials show similar trends to BiOI and PtSe2 , in which photocatalytic efficiency was increased by forming the multiple layers. The materials under investigation are suitable for photocatalytic water splitting under visible and ultraviolet regions with absorption coefficients of 105 cm-1.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、first-principles investigation。；研究对象：二维同质双层NbOX₂（X = Cl, Br, I）体系，用于光催化水分解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NbOCl₂和NbOBr₂倾向于AC双层堆叠，而NbOI₂倾向于AB堆叠；所有双层体系均具有高载流子迁移率和各向异性电荷传输特性，在可见光和紫外光区域吸收系数达10⁵ cm⁻¹，适合光催化水分解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NbOCl₂和NbOBr₂倾向于AC双层堆叠，而NbOI₂倾向于AB堆叠；所有双层体系均具有高载流子迁移率和各向异性电荷传输特性，在可见光和紫外光区域吸收系数达10⁵ cm⁻¹，适合光催化水分解。；创新点：将前期对块体NbOX₂的研究拓展至二维同质双层体系，发现通过形成多层结构可提高光催化效率，类似于BiOI和PtSe₂的趋势。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于探测结构、电子、光学和光催化性质。

papers.title: Exact solution and pair correlation functions for a generalized three-chain Ising tube with multispin interactions
papers.abstract: We obtain an exact solution for a generalized three-chain Ising tube (TCGIT) of length $L$ with toroidal boundary conditions and the most general $C_3$-invariant Hamiltonian on an elementary prism, containing 20 independent coupling constants, including an external magnetic field. Using an $8\times 8$ transfer matrix, we derive the exact partition function of the finite system and obtain the free energy, internal energy, specific heat, magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and entropy in the thermodynamic limit $L\to\infty$. In the general case, $λ_{\max}$ is determined by a quartic equation, whereas in the principal special case with even-spin interactions (PSC) the spectrum simplifies substantially: the characteristic polynomial factorizes, and $λ_{\max}$ is given by the root of a quadratic equation. For mirror-symmetric subfamilies, we derive explicit formulas for the pair correlation functions and express the magnetization in terms of the components of the eigenvector associated with $λ_{\max}$; in the even-spin case with $h=0$, the magnetization vanishes. Important special cases include the width-three planar model with nearest-neighbor, next-nearest-neighbor, and plaquette interactions, including the entropy limit $S(T\to0^+)=(\ln 2)/3$ for $k\ge 0$ and $S(T\to0^+)=0$ for $k<0$, as well as the width-three planar triangular model with distinct nearest-neighbor couplings, three-spin interactions involving neighboring triangles, and an external field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“exact solution”、“transfer matrix”、“partition function”、“thermodynamic limit”。；研究对象：广义三链伊辛管（TCGIT），即具有三链结构、环面边界条件、包含多自旋相互作用的伊辛模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在包含20个独立耦合常数（含外磁场）的最一般C₃对称哈密顿量下可精确求解；在偶数自旋相互作用特殊情形下，谱分解简化，最大本征值由二次方程根给出；在镜面对称子族中，可导出对关联函数的显式公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在包含20个独立耦合常数（含外磁场）的最一般C₃对称哈密顿量下可精确求解；在偶数自旋相互作用特殊情形下，谱分解简化，最大本征值由二次方程根给出；在镜面对称子族中，可导出对关联函数的显式公式。；创新点：首次给出了包含20个独立耦合常数的最一般C₃对称三链伊辛管的精确解，并系统分析了偶数自旋相互作用、镜面对称等特殊子族下的解析性质，包括对关联函数的显式表达。
papers.method_zh: 采用8×8转移矩阵方法，精确求解有限系统的配分函数，并在热力学极限下导出自由能、内能、比热、磁化强度、磁化率和熵；通过特征多项式分解和本征向量分析处理特殊情形。

papers.title: Topological Data Analysis combined with Machine Learning for Predicting Permeability of Porous Media
papers.abstract: Flow in porous media is difficult to address using standard analytical or numerical methods due to its complexity. However, since synthetic representations of porous media are easy to produce and data from physical experiments are becoming more widely available, the problem is well-suited to studies that include machine learning (ML) techniques. We discuss a number of features that can be extracted from such data, and their utility as input variables into a standard ML algorithm. These features include structural measures describing the geometry of the porous media, topological measures describing the connectivity, and network measures obtained by modeling the porous media as simplified pore networks. These features enable the prediction of the permeability of the considered (synthetic) porous materials using ML techniques that also leverage the separately computed exact permeability (ground truth). Comparing results obtained using different input variables helps develop a better understanding of the utility of various measures for predicting permeability based on the porous media structure. We show, in particular, that topological data analysis (TDA) provides a useful set of features that can be easily combined with ML to yield meaningful results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/机器学习文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning (ML)、topological data analysis (TDA)、synthetic representations、numerical methods。；研究对象：多孔介质中的渗透率（permeability）预测问题。具体材料为合成多孔材料（synthetic porous materials）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑数据分析（TDA）能够提供一组有效的特征，这些特征易于与机器学习结合，从而基于多孔介质结构预测其渗透率，并得到有意义的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑数据分析（TDA）能够提供一组有效的特征，这些特征易于与机器学习结合，从而基于多孔介质结构预测其渗透率，并得到有意义的结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但文中指出，该工作系统比较了不同输入特征（结构、拓扑、网络度量）对渗透率预测的效用，并特别展示了拓扑数据分析（TDA）作为一种易于与机器学习结合的特征提取方法的价值。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习（ML）技术，结合从多孔介质数据中提取的多种特征作为输入变量，包括：描述几何结构的结构度量、描述连通性的拓扑度量（来自拓扑数据分析，TDA），以及将多孔介质简化为孔隙网络后得到的网络度量。同时利用单独计算得到的精确渗透率作为真实值（ground truth）进行训练和比较。

papers.title: Getting rid of the ghosts: a toy-model of membrane melting
papers.abstract: The theory of thermal fluctuations in crystalline membranes is put under scrutiny. In particular, the two critical regimes of the renormalisation group diagram, which are often left out of the discussion because of their instability in one direction, are examined in details. After studying the proper Goldstone mode counting around each of them, the properties of the fluctuations dominating the large scale spectrum are analysed. This shows that the fixed point P2 is a good candidate to describe the melting of a crystalline membrane. The properties of the melted membrane are then compared to the known properties of fluid membranes. As a byproduct of this analysis, we show that the generation of a fluid membrane by melting a bidimensional crystal allows to formulate its correlation functions without being plagued by the ghosts that inevitably show up in the usual Canham-Helfrich action relying on the Monge parametrisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theory of thermal fluctuations、renormalisation group、Goldstone mode counting、fixed point analysis。；研究对象：晶体膜的热涨落理论，特别是晶体膜熔化（melting）为流体膜的过程，以及该过程中出现的重正化群不动点与“鬼场”（ghosts）问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 重正化群图中的P2不动点是描述晶体膜熔化的良好候选；通过熔化二维晶体生成流体膜，可以避免在通常基于Monge参数化的Canham-Helfrich作用量中必然出现的鬼场问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：重正化群图中的P2不动点是描述晶体膜熔化的良好候选；通过熔化二维晶体生成流体膜，可以避免在通常基于Monge参数化的Canham-Helfrich作用量中必然出现的鬼场问题。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用重正化群（renormalisation group）理论框架，对晶体膜热涨落的不同临界区域进行Goldstone模式计数，并分析主导大尺度谱的涨落性质。

papers.title: Microstructure evolution during rapid solidification of hypoeutectic Al-Ag alloys near absolute stability
papers.abstract: Microsegregation-free microstructures can form by solidifying at velocities beyond the absolute stability limit ($V_{\text{abs}}$), where solute partitioning is suppressed by a stable, planar solid-liquid interface. Producing such microstructures is of considerable practical interest; however, $V_{\text{abs}}$ typically exceeds the ${\sim}1$ m/s growth rates encountered in additive manufacturing (AM). Here we demonstrate the absolute stability limit can be reached in sufficiently concentrated hypoeutectic Al-Ag alloys at growth rates well below the 1~m/s typically encountered in additive manufacturing. Dynamic Transmission Electron Microscopy (DTEM) of rapid solidification front evolution -- following laser spot melting of Al-Ag thin films -- combined with postmortem microstructural characterization, enables detailed quantitative comparison with both phase-field (PF) simulations and a sharp-interface linear stability analysis that uses a non-equilibrium, velocity-dependent phase diagram extracted from the PF model. The analysis predicts that $V_{\text{abs}}$ follows a trend similar to that of the miscibility gap, first increasing and then decreasing with Ag concentration. Predicted values of $V_{\text{abs}}$ are in good quantitative agreement with PF simulations over the entire hypoeutectic concentration range and with experiments for three concentrated alloys. These results inform the prediction and control of microstructural development in concentrated alloys near the absolute stability limit under AM conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：实验（Dynamic Transmission Electron Microscopy, DTEM）、计算（phase-field simulations）、理论（sharp-interface linear stability analysis）。；研究对象：亚共晶Al-Ag合金在接近绝对稳定性极限条件下的快速凝固过程中的微观结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够浓度的亚共晶Al-Ag合金中，可以在远低于增材制造典型生长速率（~1 m/s）的条件下达到绝对稳定性极限，且绝对稳定性极限随Ag浓度先增加后减小，与混溶间隙趋势相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够浓度的亚共晶Al-Ag合金中，可以在远低于增材制造典型生长速率（~1 m/s）的条件下达到绝对稳定性极限，且绝对稳定性极限随Ag浓度先增加后减小，与混溶间隙趋势相似。；创新点：首次在实验和模拟中证明，在远低于增材制造典型速率的生长速度下，足够浓度的亚共晶Al-Ag合金即可达到绝对稳定性极限，并系统揭示了绝对稳定性极限随浓度的非单调变化规律。
papers.method_zh: 动态透射电子显微镜（DTEM）实时观测激光点熔化Al-Ag薄膜后的快速凝固前沿演化；结合事后微观结构表征；相场（PF）模拟；基于从PF模型提取的非平衡、速度依赖相图的尖锐界面线性稳定性分析。

papers.title: Anomalous thermal and elastic properties of an epitaxial NiTi film exhibiting R-phase
papers.abstract: Shape memory alloys like NiTi are at the core of emerging thermal management applications, including elastocaloric refrigeration, thermoelastic harvesting, and latent heat storage. Most of these applications benefit from a small scale due to the accelerated heat exchange, but obtaining precise functional properties of films is challenging. Here we demonstrate that transient grating spectroscopy (TGS) enables characterization of elastic coefficients and thermal diffusivity of a 3 $μ$m thick epitaxial NiTi film during a thermally induced phase transformation. The in-situ measurement of a complete austenite$\rightarrow$R-phase$\rightarrow$martensite$\rightarrow$austenite temperature cycle reveals that the elastic properties exhibit a crossover of the shear moduli (from $c^\prime < c_{44}$ in austenite to $c^\prime > c_{44}$ in martensite) and that the thermal diffusivity changes by 450 $\%$ between the R-phase and austenite. This dramatic change, together with the absence of hysteresis between the R-phase and austenite, makes NiTi a promising material candidate for thermal switches. The results indicate that the change in thermal diffusivity originates from an anomalous heat capacity of the R-phase. Furthermore, our TGS study provides temperature-dependent thermal and elastic properties required for simulating thermal management microsystems using this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：transient grating spectroscopy (TGS)、in-situ measurement、characterization。；研究对象：外延生长的3微米厚NiTi薄膜，研究其在热致相变（奥氏体→R相→马氏体→奥氏体）过程中的反常热学和弹性性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现NiTi薄膜在相变过程中剪切模量发生交叉（从奥氏体的c′ < c44变为马氏体的c′ > c44），且R相与奥氏体之间的热扩散率变化高达450%，且无热滞，使NiTi成为热开关的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现NiTi薄膜在相变过程中剪切模量发生交叉（从奥氏体的c′ < c44变为马氏体的c′ > c44），且R相与奥氏体之间的热扩散率变化高达450%，且无热滞，使NiTi成为热开关的候选材料。；创新点：首次利用TGS技术对亚微米厚度的外延NiTi薄膜在完整相变循环中进行原位热学和弹性性质表征，并揭示R相与奥氏体之间巨大的热扩散率变化及其与反常热容的关联。
papers.method_zh: 瞬态光栅光谱（TGS）技术，用于原位测量薄膜的弹性系数和热扩散率随温度的变化。

papers.title: Structure of the twist-bend nematic phase with respect to the orientational molecular order of the thioether-linked dimers
papers.abstract: An analysis of the IR absorbance for the segmented functional groups of liquid crystal dimers: mesogen and linker, enabled the orientation order to be determined and information about the dipole interactions in the nematic and twist-bend nematic phases to be obtained. The long axis orientational order increases as the temperature decreases in the nematic phase, although much more slowly than for the classical nematics, and then reverses this trend in the twist-bend nematic phase due to the tilt of the molecules. In the nematic phase, the short axis of the molecule performs an isotropic uniform rotation and has a uniaxial alignment. In the twist-bend nematic phase, however, biaxial ordering occurs and grows significantly in accordance with the helical deformation of the director. Changes in the mean absorbance in the twist-bend nematic phase were observed: a decrease for the longitudinal dipole at the nematic-twist-bend nematic phase transition, thus emphasizing the antiparallel axial interaction of the dipoles, while the absorbance of the transverse dipoles remains unchanged up to 340 K, and then the latter become parallelly correlated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：IR absorbance（红外吸收）、orientation order（取向序）、dipole interactions（偶极相互作用）。；研究对象：硫醚连接液晶二聚体（thioether-linked dimers）的扭曲-弯曲向列相（twist-bend nematic phase）中分子的取向序结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲-弯曲向列相中，分子长轴取向序随温度降低而逆转（从增加变为减小），分子短轴出现双轴有序（biaxial ordering）并随螺旋形变增强；纵向偶极子在相变点处吸光度下降，表明偶极子呈反平行轴向相互作用，而横向偶极子在340 K以下开始出现平行关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲-弯曲向列相中，分子长轴取向序随温度降低而逆转（从增加变为减小），分子短轴出现双轴有序（biaxial ordering）并随螺旋形变增强；纵向偶极子在相变点处吸光度下降，表明偶极子呈反平行轴向相互作用，而横向偶极子在340 K以下开始出现平行关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用红外吸收光谱（IR absorbance）对液晶二聚体的分段官能团（介晶基团和连接基团）进行分析，从而确定取向序参数并获取偶极相互作用信息。

papers.title: Enhanced $s^\pm$-wave superconductivity in electron-doped La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: In cuprates, electron doping yields a much lower superconducting $T_c$ than hole doping. For recently discovered nickelate superconductors, the analogous doping strategies become more challenging. Consequently, while hole-doped Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates have been extensively studied, electron-doped RP nickelates remain rarely explored both experimentally and theoretically. Here we fill this gap by systematically investigating the two-orbital bilayer model for three representative systems: bulk La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ at ambient pressure and 15\,GPa, and a heterostructure La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$:La$_3$Al$_2$O$_7$ that provides a feasible experimental route to electron doping. Using first-principle calculations and large-scale dynamical cluster quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that electron doping generically enhances $s^\pm$-wave pairing superconductivity (SC) in all three cases, with the heterostructure showing the highest $T_c$ in the underdoped regime. Furthermore, our results suggest an inter-orbital cooperative mechanism that the pairing on the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital, induced by that on the $d_{z^2}$ orbital, plays vital role in the SC. This work provides the first theoretical prediction of enhanced SC in electron-doped RP nickelates and calls for future experimental verification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：first-principle calculations, large-scale dynamical cluster quantum Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：电子掺杂的Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）镍酸盐La₃Ni₂O₇，包括常压、15 GPa下的块体以及La₃Ni₂O₇:La₃Al₂O₇异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子掺杂普遍增强了三种体系中的s±波配对超导，其中异质结构在欠掺杂区域具有最高的超导转变温度Tc；配对机制涉及d_{z²}轨道诱导的d_{x²-y²}轨道上的配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子掺杂普遍增强了三种体系中的s±波配对超导，其中异质结构在欠掺杂区域具有最高的超导转变温度Tc；配对机制涉及d_{z²}轨道诱导的d_{x²-y²}轨道上的配对。；创新点：首次从理论上预测电子掺杂RP镍酸盐中可增强超导，填补了该方向实验与理论研究的空白，并提出了可行的电子掺杂实验路径（异质结构）。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principle calculations）和大规模动力学团簇量子蒙特卡洛模拟（large-scale dynamical cluster quantum Monte Carlo simulations）。

papers.title: Partial Kondo Screening Solves the Mystery of Rare Earth Tetraborides
papers.abstract: We invoke a new mechanism to account for multiple magnetization plateaus observed in rare-earth tetraborides. Using a combination of hybrid and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations of the Kondo lattice model (KLM) on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice (SSL), we find robust magnetization plateaus at fractions 1/6, 2/9, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3 and 3/4 of the saturation magnetization. We find that most of the plateau states are partially Kondo screened and emerge from the field-tuning of a complex three-way competition between the kinetic energy, the Kondo coupling, and the magnetic frustration. Most remarkably, the unusual magneto-transport reported in ErB$_4$ and TmB$_4$ admits an unexpectedly simple explanation within our mechanism. This work not only provides an elegant and simple solution to the long-standing puzzle of metamagnetism and anomalous magnetotransport in RB$_4$, but also introduces a novel mechanism to predict and discover new correlated phases in frustrated Kondo lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations of the Kondo lattice model (KLM)”。；研究对象：稀土四硼化物（rare-earth tetraborides，如ErB₄和TmB₄）中的多级磁化平台现象及其反常磁输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Shastry-Sutherland晶格上的Kondo晶格模型中，通过磁场调控动能、Kondo耦合与磁阻挫之间的三方竞争，可产生1/6、2/9、1/4、1/3、1/2、2/3和3/4饱和磁化强度的多个磁化平台，且大部分平台态处于部分Kondo屏蔽状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Shastry-Sutherland晶格上的Kondo晶格模型中，通过磁场调控动能、Kondo耦合与磁阻挫之间的三方竞争，可产生1/6、2/9、1/4、1/3、1/2、2/3和3/4饱和磁化强度的多个磁化平台，且大部分平台态处于部分Kondo屏蔽状态。；创新点：提出“部分Kondo屏蔽”（partial Kondo screening）这一新机制，统一解释了稀土四硼化物中长期未解的变磁性与反常磁输运谜题，并为在阻挫Kondo晶格中预测和发现新的关联相提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 混合蒙特卡罗与半经典蒙特卡罗模拟（hybrid and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations），基于Shastry-Sutherland晶格上的Kondo晶格模型（KLM）。

papers.title: Geometry-Driven Nonlinear Orbital Magnetoelectric Effect
papers.abstract: We propose a nonlinear orbital magnetoelectric effect, which generates orbital magnetization quadratically in centrosymmetric materials where the linear orbital magnetoelectric effect is strictly forbidden. Using extended semiclassical formulation, we derive a gauge-invariant microscopic theory that separates intrinsic and extrinsic contributions and establishes their distinct dependence on the relaxation time, providing an experimental discriminator. In two-dimensional systems the nonlinear response is far less constrained by out-of-plane rotational symmetries than the linear orbital magnetoelectric effect, substantially enlarging the materials platform. Microscopically, the dominant contributions are governed by a Hermitian-connection structure. Finally, we estimate that the magnitude of the nonlinear orbital magnetoelectric effect lies within the sensitivity of state-of-the-art magneto-optical Kerr measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“提出”“推导”“建立”“估计”等理论工作关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非线性轨道磁电效应（nonlinear orbital magnetoelectric effect），具体研究在中心对称材料中由几何驱动产生的轨道磁化二次响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称材料中，线性轨道磁电效应被严格禁止，但可产生二次（非线性）轨道磁电效应；该效应的主导贡献由一种厄米联络结构（Hermitian-connection structure）控制，且其大小处于当前磁光克尔测量技术的灵敏度范围内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称材料中，线性轨道磁电效应被严格禁止，但可产生二次（非线性）轨道磁电效应；该效应的主导贡献由一种厄米联络结构（Hermitian-connection structure）控制，且其大小处于当前磁光克尔测量技术的灵敏度范围内。；创新点：首次提出并理论描述了中心对称材料中由几何驱动的非线性轨道磁电效应；揭示了该效应在二维体系中受面外旋转对称性的约束远小于线性轨道磁电效应，从而大幅扩展了候选材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 扩展半经典形式体系（extended semiclassical formulation），推导出规范不变的微观理论，将本征贡献（intrinsic）与外禀贡献（extrinsic）分离，并建立它们对弛豫时间的不同依赖关系。

papers.title: Specific heat and susceptibility of S=1/2 antiferromagnets on square, triangular, and kagome lattices
papers.abstract: We study the temperature dependence of the thermodynamic properties of spin-1/2 antiferromagnets on two-dimensional lattices. Our analysis employs the sine-square deformation (SSD), in which a real-space envelope function is applied to the Hamiltonian so that the local energy scale is smoothly reduced to zero at the system boundaries. The quantum eigenstates of the SSD Hamiltonian exhibit bulk-like behavior near the system center, effectively mimicking the thermodynamic limit even in small finite-size calculations. Using these fictitious bulk states, we compute the energy density, specific heat, and magnetic susceptibility as functions of temperature. We find that both the triangular- and kagome-lattice antiferromagnets show either a shoulder or a pronounced double-peak structure in the low-temperature specific heat, whereas the kagome case particularly shows a strong enhancement of magnetic susceptibility down to the lowest temperature range. These direct comparisons, together with the square-lattice and one-dimensional cases, reveal that although both frustrated systems retain a substantial amount of entropy, the low-energy excitations below ~ 0.5J of the kagome lattice are predominantly governed by the magnetic excited states, whereas not much for the triangular lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：sine-square deformation (SSD)、quantum eigenstates、finite-size calculations。；研究对象：自旋1/2反铁磁体在二维晶格（正方、三角、kagome晶格）上的热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角晶格和kagome晶格反铁磁体在低温比热中均出现肩峰或明显的双峰结构；其中kagome晶格在极低温下磁化率显著增强，表明其低能激发主要由磁性激发态主导，而三角晶格则不然。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角晶格和kagome晶格反铁磁体在低温比热中均出现肩峰或明显的双峰结构；其中kagome晶格在极低温下磁化率显著增强，表明其低能激发主要由磁性激发态主导，而三角晶格则不然。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用正弦平方变形（SSD）方法，对哈密顿量施加实空间包络函数，使边界处局域能量尺度平滑降至零。利用SSD哈密顿量的量子本征态模拟热力学极限下的体态行为，计算能量密度、比热和磁化率随温度的变化。

papers.title: Enhancement of superconductivity by polarization of magnetic impurities in disordered films
papers.abstract: Dirty superconducting films with magnetic impurities can exhibit nontrivial behavior in a magnetic field that polarizes the impurity spins. As predicted by Kharitonov and Feigelman (KF) [JETP Lett. 82, 421 (2005)], this polarization reduces the exchange scattering rate. Consequently, a parallel magnetic field can enhance the critical temperature $T_c$ when magnetic-field pair breaking is weak, as realized for strong spin-orbit scattering and small film thickness. Recently, Llanos et al. [Nat. Phys. (2026)] observed a pronounced enhancement of $T_c$ consistent with the KF theory. The same experiment also reported an enhancement of the perpendicular upper critical field $H_{c2}^{\perp}$ and a suppression of the London penetration depth $λ_L$ by a parallel magnetic field. These quantities were not considered in the original KF theory. To address this gap, we develop a theoretical framework based on Gor'kov's diagrammatic technique for dirty superconductors. We extend the KF theory in two experimentally relevant directions: (i) to arbitrary temperatures $T<T_c$ and several superconducting observables, and (ii) to arbitrary magnetic-field orientations. As a result, we demonstrate theoretically the suppression of $λ_L$ and the enhancement of $H_{c2}^{\perp}$ by a parallel magnetic field, in agreement with experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a theoretical framework based on Gor'kov's diagrammatic technique”，并“extend the KF theory”，属于理论推导与模型扩展。；研究对象：含磁杂质的无序超导薄膜在磁场中的超导增强现象，具体涉及平行磁场对临界温度 \(T_c\)、垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\) 和伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平行磁场通过极化磁杂质自旋，可抑制交换散射率，从而在强自旋-轨道散射和薄膜厚度小的条件下增强超导临界温度 \(T_c\)；同时，该理论框架还预言了平行磁场会抑制伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 并增强垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\)，与近期实验一致。
