papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平行磁场通过极化磁杂质自旋，可抑制交换散射率，从而在强自旋-轨道散射和薄膜厚度小的条件下增强超导临界温度 \(T_c\)；同时，该理论框架还预言了平行磁场会抑制伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 并增强垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\)，与近期实验一致。；创新点：将原有仅关注临界温度 \(T_c\) 的 KF 理论，拓展到对伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 和垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\) 的理论描述，并考虑了任意磁场取向，填补了原理论在这些实验可观测量上的空白。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Gor'kov 图解法（Gor'kov's diagrammatic technique）构建脏超导体的理论框架，将 Kharitonov-Feigelman (KF) 理论扩展到任意温度 \(T<T_c\) 及多种超导可观测量，并推广到任意磁场方向。

papers.title: Durable Enhancement of $\mathbf{MoS_2}$ Single-Layer Photoluminescence by Ultraviolet Laser Treatment Under Ambient Conditions
papers.abstract: Single-layer molybdenum disulfide ($MoS_2$) possesses significant potential for nanoscale optoelectronics, but achieving high-intensity, long-term-stable photoluminescence (PL) emission remains a challenge. In this work, we demonstrate a remarkably robust, more than 8-fold maximum enhancement in the PL intensity of exfoliated and CVD-grown single-layer $MoS_2$ via a non-destructive ultraviolet (UV) laser treatment method. This substantial increase in radiative efficiency is accompanied by a trion-to-neutral exciton transition in the PL signal and a corresponding blue shift of the Raman $E_{2g}^1$ and $A_{1g}$ vibrational modes, signaling successful electron depletion (p-doping) and formation of Mo-O bonds, respectively. Furthermore, we demonstrate precise spatial control over PL properties by confining PL treatment exclusively to the UV laser-treated area. Crucially, the enhanced PL performance shows exceptional longevity; the CVD sample and the exfoliated sample remained stable for the entire monitoring period (72 and 32 days, respectively) under ambient conditions. We further investigated UV laser treatment in a controlled-environment chamber under argon, nitrogen, and oxygen atmospheres, distinguishing the influence of oxygen as the PL treatment agent. These findings establish a reliable pathway for the permanent treatment of single-layer $MoS_2$ PL properties, an essential step toward practical, high-performance nanophotonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、UV laser treatment、PL intensity、Raman modes、controlled-environment chamber。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（MoS₂）的光致发光（PL）特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非破坏性紫外激光处理，在环境条件下实现了单层MoS₂光致发光强度超过8倍的持久增强，且增强效果在长达72天（CVD样品）和32天（剥离样品）的监测期内保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非破坏性紫外激光处理，在环境条件下实现了单层MoS₂光致发光强度超过8倍的持久增强，且增强效果在长达72天（CVD样品）和32天（剥离样品）的监测期内保持稳定。；创新点：实现了对单层MoS₂光致发光性能的永久性、空间可控增强，并揭示了氧作为处理剂的关键作用，为实用化纳米光子器件提供了可靠路径。
papers.method_zh: 使用紫外激光处理剥离法和CVD生长的单层MoS₂样品；通过光致发光（PL）光谱和拉曼光谱表征电子结构变化；在可控气氛（氩气、氮气、氧气）下进行对比实验以区分氧的作用。

papers.title: Global space correlations of polarization, charge density, and electric field in electrolytes under the fixed-potential condition
papers.abstract: We examine the thermal fluctuations of the polarization $p$, the charge density $ρ$, and the electric field $E$ in dilute electrolytes inserted between pararell metallic electrodes, where we fix the applied potential difference $Φ_a$ between the two electrodes. If the film thickness $H$ is shorter than the Debye screening length $κ^{-1}$, the space correlation of the polarization $p_z$ and the electric field $E_z$ along the surface normal (in the $z$ direction) acuire global components inversely proportional to the film volume $V$, which vary slowly along the $z$ axis and are homogeneous in the $xy$ plane. The areal charge density on each electrode surface also has a component homogeneous on the surface, which produces the global electric fluctuations. On the other hand, if $H$ much exceeds $κ^{-1}$, the global correlations of $p_z$ and $ρ$ become small in the bulk region outside the electric double layers, but that of $E_z$ remains almost unchanged by ions in the whole cell at fixed $Φ_a$. The dielectric constant $ε_{\rm eff}$ depends on $H$ and $κ$ and is expressed in terms of the fluctuation variances of $p_z$ and $ρ$ and that of the noblocal surface charge density at fixed $Φ_a$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We examine”“We fix”“is expressed in terms of”等理论推导与公式表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：稀释电解质在平行金属电极之间的热涨落行为，具体研究极化 \( p \)、电荷密度 \( \rho \) 和电场 \( E \) 的空间关联，以及固定外加电势差 \( \Phi_a \) 条件下的介电响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当电解质膜厚度 \( H \) 小于德拜屏蔽长度 \( \kappa^{-1} \) 时，极化 \( p_z \) 和电场 \( E_z \) 沿法向的空间关联出现与膜体积 \( V \) 成反比的全局分量；当 \( H \) 远大于 \( \kappa^{-1} \) 时，体相中极化与电荷密度的全局关联变小，但电场 \( E_z \) 的全局关联在固定电势差下几乎不受离子影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当电解质膜厚度 \( H \) 小于德拜屏蔽长度 \( \kappa^{-1} \) 时，极化 \( p_z \) 和电场 \( E_z \) 沿法向的空间关联出现与膜体积 \( V \) 成反比的全局分量；当 \( H \) 远大于 \( \kappa^{-1} \) 时，体相中极化与电荷密度的全局关联变小，但电场 \( E_z \) 的全局关联在固定电势差下几乎不受离子影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用热涨落统计理论，在固定电势差边界条件下分析平行金属电极间稀释电解质的极化、电荷密度和电场的空间关联函数，并推导有效介电常数 \( \varepsilon_{\rm eff} \) 与膜厚 \( H \)、德拜波数 \( \kappa \) 及涨落方差的关系。

papers.title: At Most Two Infinite Blue Clusters in the CMR Representation of the Edwards-Anderson Spin Glass
papers.abstract: The two-replica Chayes-Machta-Redner (CMR) representation is one of the main proposed geometric signatures of spin-glass order in the short-range Edwards-Anderson model. Mean-field arguments and recent numerics suggest that the low-temperature phase should exhibit two macroscopic blue clusters carrying opposite overlap signs. We prove a rigorous structural constraint in this direction. For any translation-invariant joint Gibbs measure on disorder, two spin replicas, and CMR bond variables on Z^d, the blue subgraph contains at most two infinite connected components; if two exist, then they lie in a common infinite grey cluster and belong to opposite overlap-parity classes. The main obstacle is that the blue-bond process is neither insertion-tolerant nor positively associated, so the usual Burton-Keane and random-cluster arguments do not apply. We circumvent this by working in the full joint measure and using a finite-box merge operation together with the mass-transport bound on ends of translation-invariant subgraphs. As auxiliary input, we establish finite energy and a percolation transition for the grey subgraph via Bayesian resampling of couplings and a parity-based Peierls estimate. These results do not prove the existence of infinite blue clusters or a spin-glass phase transition, but they give a rigorous upper bound compatible with the two-cluster picture for short-range spin glasses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：rigorous proof、structural constraint、mass-transport bound、Peierls estimate。；研究对象：短程Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃模型中的Chayes-Machta-Redner (CMR)表示，具体研究该表示中蓝色子图（blue subgraph）的无限连通分量结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在任意平移不变的联合Gibbs测度下，CMR表示中的蓝色子图至多包含两个无限连通分量；若存在两个，则它们位于同一个无限灰色团簇中且属于相反的overlap奇偶类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在任意平移不变的联合Gibbs测度下，CMR表示中的蓝色子图至多包含两个无限连通分量；若存在两个，则它们位于同一个无限灰色团簇中且属于相反的overlap奇偶类。；创新点：克服了蓝色键过程既非插入容忍（insertion-tolerant）也非正关联（positively associated）的困难，从而绕过了通常的Burton-Keane和随机团簇论证，首次给出了短程自旋玻璃中两团簇图像（two-cluster picture）的严格上界约束。摘要未突出说明该结果是否首次证明该约束。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格的数学物理证明方法：利用联合测度框架、有限盒子合并操作（finite-box merge operation）、平移不变子图端点的质量输运界（mass-transport bound on ends），以及通过贝叶斯重采样耦合（Bayesian resampling of couplings）和基于奇偶性的Peierls估计（parity-based Peierls estimate）建立灰色子图的有限能量性质和渗流转变。

papers.title: Observation of a Mott quantum spin Hall insulator in twisted WSe2
papers.abstract: Quantum spin Hall (QSH) insulators and Mott insulators are conventionally regarded as distinct insulating phases, arising from band topology and strong Coulomb interactions, respectively. Here, we report the observation of QSH edge transport in a magnetic-field-stabilized Mott insulating state at half filling of the second moire band in a 2.29 degree twisted WSe2 device. This state exhibits a resistance plateau identical to that of the single-particle QSH state at full filling of the first moire valence band, indicating the same number of helical edge channels. Electrical transport measurements reveal nearly quantized resistance that is insensitive to vertical electric field, out-of-plane magnetic field, and temperature below 5 K. Pronounced nonlocal transport and strong negative in-plane magnetoconductance further support helical edge conduction, establishing robust edge transport in the strongly correlated regime. Temperature-dependent Hall measurements reveal a characteristic temperature scale of approximately 10 K, corresponding to an energy scale of about 1 meV. Our results demonstrate that spin-conserved QSH edge states can persist in a half filled, strongly correlated insulating phase and under external magnetic field, opening a route toward interaction-resilient topological transport in moire quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“report the observation”“Electrical transport measurements”“Temperature-dependent Hall measurements”等实验关键词。；研究对象：扭曲双层二硒化钨（twisted WSe2）器件，具体为转角2.29度的莫尔超晶格体系，研究其第二莫尔能带半填充时在磁场稳定下的Mott绝缘态中的量子自旋霍尔（QSH）边缘输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强关联Mott绝缘态中观测到了与单粒子QSH态相同的边缘输运行为，表现为近乎量子化的电阻、对电场和磁场不敏感、以及非局域输运和负面内磁电导，证明自旋守恒的QSH边缘态可以在半填充的强关联绝缘相中稳定存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强关联Mott绝缘态中观测到了与单粒子QSH态相同的边缘输运行为，表现为近乎量子化的电阻、对电场和磁场不敏感、以及非局域输运和负面内磁电导，证明自旋守恒的QSH边缘态可以在半填充的强关联绝缘相中稳定存在。；创新点：首次在强关联Mott绝缘态（而非传统能带拓扑绝缘体）中观测到量子自旋霍尔边缘输运，证明拓扑边缘态可以在强关联和外部磁场条件下保持鲁棒性，为在莫尔量子材料中实现抗相互作用的拓扑输运开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 电输运测量（包括电阻测量、非局域输运、面内磁电导测量）、温度依赖的霍尔测量。具体器件为2.29度扭曲WSe2，通过外加磁场稳定Mott绝缘态。

papers.title: Causal Anomaly Detection for Lithium-Ion Battery Degradation
papers.abstract: Reliable early detection of lithium-ion battery degradation requires health indicators that are physically interpretable and computable from routine cycler telemetry without access to the degradation region. We introduce \textsc{CausalHealth}, a framework that applies causal graph discovery and $k$-nearest-neighbour transfer entropy to per-cycle voltage, current, temperature, and resistance time series, and organises twelve resulting anomaly scores into three signal-class bundles (Magnitude-shift, Predictive-residual, Complexity-entropy) -- with Isolation Forest reported separately as it falls below the bundle reliability threshold -- to characterise detection sensitivity across ten commissioning fractions (5--30\,\%). The Magnitude-shift class achieves 100\,\% detection across all seven tested cells spanning LFP (MIT--Stanford MATR) and LCO (NASA PCoE, CALCE CS2) chemistries, with a lead time of up to 402 cycles before conventional capacity-threshold failure on gradual-fade cells. A Reliability-Weighted Master Health Index (RWMHI) -- a cross-bundle fusion of five high-reliability detectors weighted by inverse coefficient of variation -- improves lead time by 15--52 cycles over the class median on long-lived cells while maintaining 100\,\% detection. Validation against electrochemical impedance spectroscopy on an NMC prismatic cell provides independent physical grounding: transfer entropy $\mathrm{TE}(R \!\to\! V)$ correlates with charge-transfer resistance $R_{\mathrm{ct}}$ (pooled $r = +0.990$; temperature-controlled partial $r = +0.898$), and an Arrhenius analysis of both quantities yields an activation energy consistent with published NMC charge-transfer kinetics. These results are evaluated on seven cells across three benchmark datasets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：cycler telemetry、benchmark datasets、electrochemical impedance spectroscopy validation）；研究对象：锂离子电池退化过程中的早期异常检测，涵盖LFP（磷酸铁锂）、LCO（钴酸锂）和NMC（镍锰钴）三种正极化学体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于因果图发现和k近邻传递熵构建的CausalHealth框架，在七种电池上实现了100%的退化早期检测，领先传统容量阈值失效最多402个循环；传递熵TE(R→V)与电荷转移电阻Rct高度相关（r=+0.990），且两者的Arrhenius活化能与已发表的NMC电荷转移动力学一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于因果图发现和k近邻传递熵构建的CausalHealth框架，在七种电池上实现了100%的退化早期检测，领先传统容量阈值失效最多402个循环；传递熵TE(R→V)与电荷转移电阻Rct高度相关（r=+0.990），且两者的Arrhenius活化能与已发表的NMC电荷转移动力学一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 因果图发现、k近邻传递熵（k-nearest-neighbour transfer entropy）、Isolation Forest异常检测、Reliability-Weighted Master Health Index（RWMHI）多探测器融合、电化学阻抗谱（EIS）验证、Arrhenius分析。

papers.title: Frequency renormalization and its effects in nonlinear phononics with $Q_RQ_{IR}^{2}$-type coupling
papers.abstract: A two-phonon system with lowest-order coupling of form $Q_RQ_{IR}^2$ is studied by perturbation method, and analytic results for both phonon displacements and frequencies are obtained. The frequency renormalization of infrared (IR) active mode brings the rectification of Raman mode to saturate at high pump field. For degenerate IR mode with coupling of form $Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2)$, the frequency of IR mode will split when resonantly pumped by elliptically or linearly polarized ultrashort mid-IR pulse, realizing Raman rectification and magnetization simultaneously. Our results reveal a dynamical effect of nonlinear phononics not captured by first-principles calculation, extend the dynamical multiferroicity to systems with coupling $Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2)$, and the method can be readily applied to higher-order couplings. The amplitude saturation under strong pump field stimulates future researches to overcome this nonlinear effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“perturbation method”（微扰方法）、“analytic results”（解析结果）。；研究对象：具有 \( Q_R Q_{IR}^2 \) 型最低阶耦合的双声子系统，特别是红外（IR）活性模式与拉曼（Raman）模式之间的非线性声子动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 红外活性模式的频率重整化导致拉曼模式的整流在高泵浦场下饱和；对于简并红外模式，在椭圆或线偏振超短中红外脉冲共振泵浦下，红外模式频率会发生分裂，同时实现拉曼整流和磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：红外活性模式的频率重整化导致拉曼模式的整流在高泵浦场下饱和；对于简并红外模式，在椭圆或线偏振超短中红外脉冲共振泵浦下，红外模式频率会发生分裂，同时实现拉曼整流和磁化。；创新点：揭示了第一性原理计算未能捕捉到的非线性声子学的动力学效应；将动力学多铁性（dynamical multiferroicity）推广到具有 \( Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2) \) 型耦合的系统中；所采用的方法可推广至更高阶耦合。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰方法对双声子耦合系统进行解析求解，得到声子位移和频率的解析结果。

papers.title: Disorder effect on the superfluid density and the origin of the pseudogap end point in the cuprate superconductors
papers.abstract: A major puzzle in the study of the cuprate superconductivity is the origin of the pseudogap end point. Intriguingly, such a critical doping is also where the superfluid density of the system reaches its maximum. A non-monotonic doping dependence of the superfluid density is rather unusual since the Drude weight of the cuprate system is found to increase monotonically with the doping concentration. It is generally believed that such a peculiar behavior should be attributed to both the strongly correlated nature of the cuprate system and the disorder effect. In this work, we develop a variational theory for the zero temperature superfluid density of the disordered $t-J$ model. This is achieved in two steps. First, we perform an unrestricted variational optimization of an RVB variational ground state for the disordered $t-J$ model. Second, we construct the variational state that describes the paramagnetic current response on such an RVB state. The zero temperature superfluid density $ρ_{s}(0)$ is then extracted from the curvature of the variational ground state energy of the system as a function of the external electromagnetic field. We find that $ρ_{s}(0)$ computed in this way is remarkably robust against the disorder effect. More specifically, we find that $ρ_{s}(0)$ is a monotonically increasing function of doping concentration $x$ and scales linearly with the total optical weight. This is consistent with the observation in the underdoped cuprates but is strongly at odd with the behavior in the overdoped cuprates. The strong contrast between the disorder effect in the underdoped and the overdoped regime lends strong support to our previous proposal that there exist a Mott transition between a doped-Mott-insulating metal in the underdoped regime and a fermi-liquid-like metal in the overdoped regime around the pseudogap end point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational theory（变分理论）、RVB variational ground state（RVB变分基态）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体中的超流密度与赝能隙终点（pseudogap end point）的起源，具体研究无序效应对超流密度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过变分理论计算发现，零温超流密度ρ_s(0)对无序效应具有显著鲁棒性，随掺杂浓度x单调增加并与总光学权重呈线性关系。这一行为与欠掺杂铜氧化物一致，但与过掺杂区行为强烈矛盾，支持了赝能隙终点附近存在从掺杂莫特绝缘体金属到费米液体金属的莫特转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过变分理论计算发现，零温超流密度ρ_s(0)对无序效应具有显著鲁棒性，随掺杂浓度x单调增加并与总光学权重呈线性关系。这一行为与欠掺杂铜氧化物一致，但与过掺杂区行为强烈矛盾，支持了赝能隙终点附近存在从掺杂莫特绝缘体金属到费米液体金属的莫特转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于无序t-J模型，采用两步变分方法：1）对无序t-J模型进行无限制变分优化，得到RVB变分基态；2）构造描述顺磁电流响应的变分态，通过系统基态能量对外部电磁场的曲率提取零温超流密度ρ_s(0)。

papers.title: On-chip detection of anisotropic thermopolarization in quartz
papers.abstract: Temperature gradients are widely used to drive and probe transport phenomena in solids, forming the basis of heat-to-charge conversion processes. In typical experiments, local heating is introduced to generate a temperature gradient, and the resulting electrical response is detected by separate electrodes. Such measurements usually regard heating purely as a source of thermal excitation. Here, we show that heating inherently generates mechanical stress through thermal expansion, which in turn produces measurable electrical signals via electromechanical coupling. Using quartz as a model piezoelectric system, we demonstrate that heat can be converted to electrical currents via thermally generated stress. The on-chip device used in our experiment enables us to probe the anisotropy of the piezoelectric tensor through the thermally generated current, exhibiting twofold and threefold responses for X-cut and Z-cut crystals, respectively. We further show that the response can be detected in both current and voltage modes. These results reveal a thermomechanical pathway for heat-to-charge conversion and establish a general platform for electrically probing thermomechanical responses in insulating materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验装置（on-chip device）、测量模式（current and voltage modes）以及具体晶体（X-cut和Z-cut石英）的测量结果。；研究对象：石英（quartz）中的热电各向异性现象，具体研究热膨胀产生的机械应力通过压电效应转化为电信号的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 加热通过热膨胀产生机械应力，进而通过压电耦合产生可测量的电信号；在石英中，该热电响应表现出晶体取向依赖的各向异性（X-cut为二重对称，Z-cut为三重对称）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：加热通过热膨胀产生机械应力，进而通过压电耦合产生可测量的电信号；在石英中，该热电响应表现出晶体取向依赖的各向异性（X-cut为二重对称，Z-cut为三重对称）。；创新点：传统热电实验将加热仅视为热激发源，而本工作揭示加热通过热膨胀产生机械应力这一被忽略的路径，并利用压电效应实现热-电转换，同时建立了在绝缘材料中电学探测热机械响应的通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 片上（on-chip）器件实验，通过局部加热产生温度梯度，同时检测热致电流或电压信号，利用不同切向（X-cut和Z-cut）的石英晶体探测压电张量的各向异性。

papers.title: Observation of universal thermopolarization effect in insulators
papers.abstract: Heat-to-charge conversion has traditionally been realized via the Seebeck effect in conductors and pyroelectricity in polar insulators. Here, we demonstrate that temperature gradients generate electrical polarization, namely thermopolarization, in a wide range of insulators through a thermomechanical pathway. We identify a mechanism where thermal expansion under a temperature gradient produces strain gradients that induce polarization via the flexoelectric effect. Using a device with an on-chip heater, we detect the heat-induced polarization in crystalline, polymeric, and amorphous systems, including MgO, Al$_2$O$_3$, MnO, mica, PET, PEN, polyimide, and soda-lime glass. The magnitude of the response exhibits a robust scaling with the coefficient of thermal expansion, which is reproduced by finite-element simulations. Furthermore, we identify two routes to enhance the response: reducing the sample thickness and exploiting structural instabilities such as glass and antiferromagnetic phase transitions, where more than an order-of-magnitude enhancement is observed. These results establish a symmetry-independent route for heat-to-charge conversion in insulators and provide a device-compatible platform for electrically probing lattice responses, with potential for enhancement in nanoscale systems such as two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、detect、device、finite-element simulations）；研究对象：绝缘体中的热极化效应（thermopolarization effect），具体材料包括MgO、Al₂O₃、MnO、云母、PET、PEN、聚酰亚胺和钠钙玻璃等晶体、聚合物和非晶体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 温度梯度可通过热机械路径在多种绝缘体中产生电极化（热极化效应），其响应幅度与热膨胀系数呈稳健标度关系，并在玻璃转变和反铁磁相变附近可增强一个数量级以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：温度梯度可通过热机械路径在多种绝缘体中产生电极化（热极化效应），其响应幅度与热膨胀系数呈稳健标度关系，并在玻璃转变和反铁磁相变附近可增强一个数量级以上。；创新点：首次在非极性绝缘体中通过热膨胀-应变梯度-挠曲电效应（flexoelectric effect）实现热-电转换，建立了一种不依赖对称性的热-电转换新机制，区别于传统的塞贝克效应（导体）和热释电效应（极性绝缘体）。
papers.method_zh: 使用片上加热器（on-chip heater）器件检测热致极化；结合有限元模拟（finite-element simulations）复现实验结果；通过改变样品厚度和利用结构不稳定性（玻璃相变、反铁磁相变）探索增强途径。

papers.title: Structure of Molten FeCl2 and FeCl3
papers.abstract: Molten iron chlorides are central to emerging energy technologies, including electrochemical iron production and redox flow batteries. Optimizing their electrochemical performance and transport properties requires atomic-scale structural understanding, yet detailed data for molten FeCl2 and its differences from FeCl3 remain scarce. Here, we determined the structures of molten FeCl2 and FeCl3 using High Energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD), Empirical Potential Structure Refinement (EPSR), and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). HEXRD measurements provided structure factors and total radial distribution functions (RDFs), which were quantitatively reproduced through EPSR refinement directly constrained by experimental data. MD simulations using MACE foundation and fine-tuned models reproduced experimental structure factors as well as total and partial RDFs, capturing key structural differences between the melts. The models resolved the octahedral to tetrahedral coordination transition of Fe upon melting in FeCl3 and predicted a similar transition in FeCl2. Analysis of MD trajectories quantified coordination environments, bridging Cl populations, bond-angle distributions, and connectivity patterns, revealing distinct degrees of polymerization and local geometry. Polymer chain statistics further showed that, contrary to prior reports, both liquids predominantly consist of extended chains containing six or more Fe centers rather than discrete Fe2Cl6 units. Finally, diffusion coefficients of the two melts calculated from the MACE-MD simulations were compared. Together, these results establish atomic-scale structural benchmarks for molten FeCl2 and FeCl3 and demonstrate the reliability of MACE-based MLIPs for predictive modeling of high-temperature molten salts, while providing practical guidance for MLIP development in complex ionic liquids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用了High Energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD)实验测量，并结合Empirical Potential Structure Refinement (EPSR)和分子动力学（MD）模拟（含机器学习势MLIPs）进行结构解析。；研究对象：熔融态氯化亚铁（FeCl2）和氯化铁（FeCl3）的原子尺度结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了熔融FeCl2和FeCl3的原子级结构，发现两者均主要由包含六个或更多Fe中心的长链构成，而非此前报道的离散Fe2Cl6单元；并解析了FeCl3中Fe从八面体配位到四面体配位的熔化转变，预测了FeCl2中类似的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了熔融FeCl2和FeCl3的原子级结构，发现两者均主要由包含六个或更多Fe中心的长链构成，而非此前报道的离散Fe2Cl6单元；并解析了FeCl3中Fe从八面体配位到四面体配位的熔化转变，预测了FeCl2中类似的转变。；创新点：首次提供了熔融FeCl2和FeCl3的详细原子尺度结构基准，并纠正了此前关于其由离散Fe2Cl6单元组成的认知；同时验证了基于MACE的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在高温熔盐预测建模中的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高能X射线衍射（HEXRD）测量结构因子和总径向分布函数（RDFs）；计算上使用经验势结构精修（EPSR）直接约束实验数据，以及基于MACE基础模型和微调模型的分子动力学（MD）模拟。

papers.title: Optical, vibrational, and electronic properties of semiconducting YbN
papers.abstract: We investigate the vibrational, optical, and electronic properties of insulating YbN thin films using Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, and electrical transport measurements, supported by density functional theory. Raman spectra reveal the LO($Γ$) phonon and a cation-vacancy mode, while the optical conductivity identifies the TO phonon and an absorption edge corresponding to a 1.7 eV N 2p{$\rightarrow$}Yb 5d transition. The films exhibit thermally activated resistivity consistent with an insulating ground state. An additional defect induced absorption tail below the intrinsic band gap is observed, which in combination with the electrical measurements indicates the Fermi energy resides in a disordered conduction band minimum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以理论计算）。判断依据：Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, electrical transport measurements（实验手段），density functional theory（理论计算）。；研究对象：绝缘态YbN薄膜的光学、振动和电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YbN薄膜为绝缘体，其光学吸收边对应1.7 eV的N 2p→Yb 5d跃迁，且费米能级位于无序的导带底中，导致带隙以下存在缺陷诱导的吸收尾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YbN薄膜为绝缘体，其光学吸收边对应1.7 eV的N 2p→Yb 5d跃迁，且费米能级位于无序的导带底中，导致带隙以下存在缺陷诱导的吸收尾。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 拉曼光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、电输运测量，以及密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Spatial statistics for screening molecular structures
papers.abstract: The dominant paradigm in computational materials discovery relies on heavily parameterized deep architectures, including message-passing graph networks and equivariant models, that require millions of DFT-labeled training structures and produce non-convex latent representations that complicate continuous optimization for inverse design. These architectures are impractical in data-scarce regimes, which is the typical case in molecular screening, and exhibit well-documented limitations in capturing chemically disordered configurations and chiral geometries. This review presents feature engineering based on spatial statistics as a physically rigorous and immediately deployable alternative. Molecular structures are encoded as voxelized scalar fields, and two-point auto- and cross-correlations are evaluated deterministically via Fast Fourier Transforms, explicitly transferring the burden of spatial pattern recognition from the learning algorithm to a closed-form, physics-informed operation. Principal component analysis of the resulting correlation maps yields low-dimensional, strictly convex representations that support lean neural networks (<100k trainable parameters) and non-parametric surrogate models, achieving sub-2% prediction error with as few as 10 training samples. Demonstrated across periodic crystals, chemically disordered high-entropy alloys, and non-periodic organic molecules, this framework enables Bayesian active learning and zero-shot extrapolation on commodity hardware, which current large-scale architectures cannot replicate at equivalent data budgets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“feature engineering”、“spatial statistics”、“Fast Fourier Transforms”、“principal component analysis”、“surrogate models”。；研究对象：分子与材料的结构筛选，具体涵盖周期性晶体、化学无序高熵合金以及非周期性有机分子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于空间统计学的特征工程方法（通过快速傅里叶变换计算两点自相关与互相关）能够生成低维、严格凸的表示，从而在极少量训练样本（如10个）下实现亚2%的预测误差，并支持贝叶斯主动学习与零样本外推。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于空间统计学的特征工程方法（通过快速傅里叶变换计算两点自相关与互相关）能够生成低维、严格凸的表示，从而在极少量训练样本（如10个）下实现亚2%的预测误差，并支持贝叶斯主动学习与零样本外推。；创新点：将空间模式识别的负担从学习算法显式转移到封闭形式的、物理信息驱动的操作（FFT相关计算），从而在数据稀缺场景下实现高效筛选，克服了传统深度架构（如消息传递图网络、等变模型）在捕获化学无序构型和手性几何方面的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 空间统计学特征工程：将分子结构体素化为标量场，通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）确定性计算两点自相关与互相关图；对相关图进行主成分分析（PCA）得到低维凸表示；使用轻量级神经网络（<10万可训练参数）或非参数代理模型进行预测。

papers.title: Path-Extrema Upper Bounds on Mean Entropy Production
papers.abstract: Fluctuation relations imply the second-law inequality $\langleΣ_T\rangle\ge0$, but path extrema can also constrain how large the mean entropy production can be. For steady-state processes with entropy-production martingale $M_t=e^{-Σ_t}$, we show that knowing only the positive running maximum of $Σ_t$ gives no improvement over the trivial endpoint bound: rare negative entropy-production excursions can still carry the exponential weight required by the fluctuation relation. Using the running extrema $L_T=\inf M_t$ and $H_T=\sup M_t$, we derive a path-extrema upper envelope $\mathcal{U}_{\rm ext}$. The relaxed envelope problem ranks realized intervals by the entropy gain per martingale cost, $\ln(H_T/L_T)/(H_T-L_T)$, giving a continuous knapsack problem. The actual mean satisfies the exact identity $\langleΣ_T\rangle=\mathcal{U}_{\rm ext}-\mathcal{A}-\mathcal{C}$, where $\mathcal{A}$ is an allocation gap across realized envelopes and $\mathcal{C}$ is a curvature gap within each envelope. Thus path extrema set the upper envelope, while the two gaps quantify how actual dynamics allocate terminal outcomes across envelope classes and place terminal values within each realized envelope. This turns path-extrema information into a quantitative upper-bound theory for entropy production, complementary to the usual lower-bound role of fluctuation relations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学推导（如“derive a path-extrema upper envelope”“exact identity”），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：随机过程（稳态过程）中平均熵产生（mean entropy production）的路径极值上界问题，属于非平衡统计物理中的涨落理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 路径极值（running extrema）可以给出平均熵产生的上界，但仅知道熵产生正极值无法改进平凡端点界；通过引入熵产生鞅的极小值与极大值，推导出路径极值上包络线，并得到平均熵产生的精确恒等式，从而将路径极值信息转化为熵产生的定量上界理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：路径极值（running extrema）可以给出平均熵产生的上界，但仅知道熵产生正极值无法改进平凡端点界；通过引入熵产生鞅的极小值与极大值，推导出路径极值上包络线，并得到平均熵产生的精确恒等式，从而将路径极值信息转化为熵产生的定量上界理论。；创新点：将路径极值信息从通常的涨落关系下界约束拓展为平均熵产生的上界理论，并引入分配间隙（allocation gap）和曲率间隙（curvature gap）来量化实际动力学与上包络线之间的偏差。
papers.method_zh: 基于熵产生鞅（martingale）\( M_t = e^{-\Sigma_t} \) 的路径极值（\( L_T = \inf M_t \)，\( H_T = \sup M_t \)），通过连续背包问题（continuous knapsack problem）分析熵增益与鞅成本的比值，推导出上包络线 \( \mathcal{U}_{\rm ext} \) 及精确恒等式 \( \langle\Sigma_T\rangle = \mathcal{U}_{\rm ext} - \mathcal{A} - \mathcal{C} \)。

papers.title: Dynamic Many-Body Theory: The dynamics of atomic impurities in $^4$He
papers.abstract: We implement manifestly microscopic many-body methods to study the dynamics of atomic impurities in a host quantum fluid, specifically $^4$He. Our investigations are motivated by experiments of muonium atoms within $^4$He with the goal of testing the universality of free fall by neutral bound states using unstable particles. Structure calculations are performed using standard semi-analytic methods; we extend here the calculations of our previos work (Journal of Low Temperature Physics {\bf 93}, 415-449 (1993)) to muonic \he4, antiprotonic \he4 and mounium atoms within \he4. We find that the muonium impurity probes, due to its large zero-point motion, the atomic interaction at rather short distances. Its chemical potential is estimated to be about 19 meV. Antiprotonic \he4 has, on the other hand, a negative chemical potential. Dynamics is treated by making all correlation functions time-dependent. In analogy to the derivation of the dynamics of the background liquid, we derive a working formula for the impurity self-energy that includes the most relevant physical effects. Results for the effective mass of \he3 and hydrogen atoms agree well with available experiments. The dispersion relations of muonic \he4 and antiprotonic \he4 pass through under the roton minimum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：manifestly microscopic many-body methods、semi-analytic methods、self-energy、dispersion relations。；研究对象：在量子流体⁴He中作为杂质的原子（具体包括muonic ⁴He、antiprotonic ⁴He、muonium原子、³He和氢原子）的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Muonium杂质由于零点运动较大，探测到原子间短程相互作用，其化学势约为19 meV；而antiprotonic ⁴He的化学势为负。muonic ⁴He和antiprotonic ⁴He的色散关系穿过旋子极小值下方。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Muonium杂质由于零点运动较大，探测到原子间短程相互作用，其化学势约为19 meV；而antiprotonic ⁴He的化学势为负。muonic ⁴He和antiprotonic ⁴He的色散关系穿过旋子极小值下方。；创新点：将先前工作中对⁴He中杂质结构的计算方法（Journal of Low Temperature Physics 93, 415-449 (1993)）扩展到muonic ⁴He、antiprotonic ⁴He和muonium原子体系，并首次给出这些杂质的动力学性质（如有效质量、色散关系）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用显式微观多体方法，包括：标准半解析方法进行结构计算；将关联函数推广为时间依赖以处理动力学；类比背景液体的动力学推导出杂质自能的实用公式。

papers.title: Supercurrent spin Hall effect enabled nanopillar Josephson diodes
papers.abstract: In the recent years it has been possible to achieve diode-like, non-reciprocal current-voltage response in Josephson junctions, despite the intrinsic symmetry of the Josephson effect itself. This is typically achieved by incorporating Rashba spin-orbit coupling into the Josephson junction as a strong inversion symmetry breaking component, and external magnetic field as a tuneable time-reversal symmetry breaking component. However, the efficiencies of the external field tuneable Josephson-diodes have remained limited to less than 10 \%, often measured below 100 mK temperature. In this work we take a new approach where non-reciprocity is induced by intrinsic SOC in a heavy metal Josephson barrier via the predicted supercurrent spin-Hall effect. By measuring a series of Nb-Pt-Nb nanopillar junctions we demonstrated field tuneable Josephson diode efficiencies as high as 17\%, measured above liquid Helium temperature. This was possible by the realization of a net non-equilibrium spin segregation in the Pt barrier, due to the supercurrent spin-Hall effect in the Pt barrier, analogous to the normal spin-Hall effect. As the direction of the induced spin moment is determined by the bias current, an external magnetic field causes the associated phases to add with opposite signs for opposite current directions, resulting in a nonreciprocal supercurrent across the junction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了测量过程（“measuring a series of Nb-Pt-Nb nanopillar junctions”），并给出了具体的实验数据（“demonstrated... efficiencies as high as 17%”）。；研究对象：基于超流自旋霍尔效应的纳米柱约瑟夫森二极管。具体体系为Nb-Pt-Nb纳米柱结，物理现象为约瑟夫森结中的非互易超流（二极管效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在重金属（Pt）约瑟夫森势垒中利用超流自旋霍尔效应，实现了在液氦温度以上（>4.2 K）可调谐的约瑟夫森二极管，其效率高达17%，显著优于此前通常低于10%且需在100 mK以下测量的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在重金属（Pt）约瑟夫森势垒中利用超流自旋霍尔效应，实现了在液氦温度以上（>4.2 K）可调谐的约瑟夫森二极管，其效率高达17%，显著优于此前通常低于10%且需在100 mK以下测量的结果。；创新点：首次利用超流自旋霍尔效应（而非传统的Rashba自旋轨道耦合）作为主要的反演对称性破缺机制，在约瑟夫森结中实现高效的二极管效应，并显著提高了工作温度（液氦温度以上）。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了Nb-Pt-Nb纳米柱结的电流-电压特性。通过设计纳米柱结构，在Pt势垒中实现超流自旋霍尔效应，从而产生非平衡自旋积累，并利用外加磁场调控该自旋积累导致的相位差，实现二极管效应。

papers.title: Bogoliubov sum rules and the Knight-shift ellipsoid in noncentrosymmetric superconductors
papers.abstract: We show that the residual $T=0$ Knight shift of a noncentrosymmetric superconductor in the strong-locking regime is completely determined by a single Fermi-surface average -- the projector $Π_{μν}=\langle\hat n_μ\hat n_ν\rangle_{\rm FS}$ of the spin-locking direction $\hat n_{\mathbf{k}}$ -- giving the tensor identity $χ_{μν}(0)=χ_{N}[δ_{μν}-Π_{μν}]$ independently of pairing symmetry, gap magnitude, and Fermi-surface shape. Because $\mathrm{Tr}\,Π=1$, the three principal Knight shifts at $T=0$ lie on a two-dimensional simplex of locking textures, the \emph{Knight-shift ellipsoid}, whose vertices, edges, and interior classify every canonical pairing class. The identity follows from a Bogoliubov sum rule, $\sum|M_{ph,O}|^{2}+\sum|M_{pp,O}|^{2}=\mathrm{Tr}_{s}(O^{2})$, valid at every momentum for every Hermitian single-particle operator $O$ as the BdG-doubled form of unitary invariance. Around the central theorem we develop controlled departures (a closed-form $s$-wave SOC interpolation, a finite-field strong-locking identity), a dynamical counterpart (a spin Ferrell--Glover--Tinkham sum rule and a rigorous vanishing-projection theorem for $1/T_{1}$), and a decoupled-pocket multiband baseline, packaged into six experimental protocols. Applied to the $^{75}$As NMR data on K$_{2}$Cr$_{3}$As$_{3}$, the observed ellipsoid sits at the oblate-axial vertex $(0,0,1)$ and saturates the trace bound; the decoupled-pocket SOC-texture baseline is excluded by $\sim 0.5$ in normalized units, requiring a common $\hat c$-axis locking on all three pockets, and the suppression of $1/T_{1}\parallel\hat c$ is identified, via the vanishing-projection theorem, as a fingerprint of finite-$\mathbf{q}$ ferromagnetic spin-fluctuation gap formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要主要推导了Bogoliubov求和规则、张量恒等式、Knight-shift椭球等理论结果，并基于理论分析对实验数据进行了重新解释，未涉及新的实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非中心对称超导体的残余Knight位移（Knight shift）及其与自旋锁定方向、费米面几何、配对对称性的关系，具体以K₂Cr₃As₃的⁷⁵As核磁共振（NMR）数据为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强锁定（strong-locking）机制下，非中心对称超导体在零温下的残余Knight位移完全由自旋锁定方向在费米面上的投影张量Π_μν决定，与配对对称性、能隙大小和费米面形状无关，并由此定义了“Knight-shift椭球”来分类所有正则配对类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强锁定（strong-locking）机制下，非中心对称超导体在零温下的残余Knight位移完全由自旋锁定方向在费米面上的投影张量Π_μν决定，与配对对称性、能隙大小和费米面形状无关，并由此定义了“Knight-shift椭球”来分类所有正则配对类。；创新点：首次证明残余Knight位移与配对对称性无关的普适性，并引入“Knight-shift椭球”作为分类非中心对称超导体配对类的几何工具；同时建立了动力学求和规则和1/T₁的消失投影定理，为识别有限q铁磁自旋涨落能隙的形成提供了指纹特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Bogoliubov求和规则（∑|M_ph,O|²+∑|M_pp,O|²=Tr_s(O²)）推导出张量恒等式χ_μν(0)=χ_N[δ_μν-Π_μν]；发展了有限场下的强锁定恒等式、动力学对应（自旋Ferrell-Glover-Tinkham求和规则及1/T₁的严格消失投影定理），以及解耦多带基线模型。实验对照：应用上述理论框架分析K₂Cr₃As₃的⁷⁵As NMR数据。

papers.title: Model of Simplicial Complexes with dimension-wise preferential attachment
papers.abstract: Network science is a powerful framework allowing to model complex systems, it is capable to describe and take into account the intricate web of connections existing among the constituting basic element of the system. Recently scholars have brought to the fore the relevance of higher-order networks, namely structures allowing to encode for many-body interaction, differently from the pairwise case handled by networks. This novel research field opens new avenues of research with applications ranging from neurosciences to social sciences; there is thus a need for generative models of higher-order network capable to reproduce features present in empirical data. In this work we present a model for growing simplicial complex rooted on a preferential attachment process acting dimension-wise, i.e., returning a power law distribution for the generalized degree of simplexes of different dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present a model”（提出模型）、“generative models”（生成模型）、“preferential attachment process”（优先连接过程），属于理论建模工作。；研究对象：高阶网络（higher-order networks），具体为单纯复形（simplicial complexes）的生成模型，用于描述多体相互作用系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于维度优先连接（dimension-wise preferential attachment）的单纯复形生长模型，该模型能够使不同维度的单纯形（simplex）的广义度（generalized degree）服从幂律分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于维度优先连接（dimension-wise preferential attachment）的单纯复形生长模型，该模型能够使不同维度的单纯形（simplex）的广义度（generalized degree）服从幂律分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于优先连接机制（preferential attachment）构建单纯复形的生长模型，该机制按维度（dimension-wise）作用，即对不同维度的单纯形分别施加优先连接规则。

papers.title: Incommensurate Antiferromagnetic Order in the Fe-substituted Bi-2201 Cuprate in the Heavily Overdoped Regime
papers.abstract: Elastic neutron scattering experiments showed incommensurate antiferromagnetic peaks in 5% Fe-substituted Bi-2201 cuprate in the non-superconducting heavily overdoped regime. The incommensurability delta~0.21 is comparable to that observed in Fe-substituted Bi-2201 in the overdoped regime. [Hiraka et al., Phys. Rev. B 81, 144501 (2010).] The magnetic correlation length is comparable between the overdoped and non-superconducting heavily overdoped regimes. It is plausible that incommensurate antiferromagnetic order is induced and stabilized by Fe in the heavily overdoped regime, which suggests a robust antiferromagnetic correlation beyond the superconducting dome in the phase diagram.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Elastic neutron scattering experiments”（弹性中子散射实验）。；研究对象：Fe替代的Bi-2201铜氧化物超导体在重过掺杂非超导区域的非公度反铁磁序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在重过掺杂非超导区域的Fe替代Bi-2201中观测到非公度反铁磁峰，其非公度性δ~0.21与过掺杂区域相当，且磁关联长度在过掺杂与重过掺杂区域相近。这表明Fe在重过掺杂区域诱导并稳定了非公度反铁磁序，暗示在超导穹顶之外仍存在稳健的反铁磁关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在重过掺杂非超导区域的Fe替代Bi-2201中观测到非公度反铁磁峰，其非公度性δ~0.21与过掺杂区域相当，且磁关联长度在过掺杂与重过掺杂区域相近。这表明Fe在重过掺杂区域诱导并稳定了非公度反铁磁序，暗示在超导穹顶之外仍存在稳健的反铁磁关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 弹性中子散射实验。

papers.title: Percolation transition of strongly connected clusters in finite dimensions and on complete graphs
papers.abstract: We study the percolation of strongly connected clusters (SCCs), in which sites are mutually reachable through directed paths, in systems with randomly oriented bonds by extensive simulations on hypercubic lattices from dimension $d=2$ to $7$ and complete graphs. Below the upper critical dimension $d_u=6$, the critical SCCs exhibit nontrivial fractal dimension $d_{\rm SCC}$, and the size distribution scales as $\sim s^{-τ_{\rm SCC}}$ with the hyperscaling relation $τ_{\rm SCC}=1+d/d_{\rm SCC}$. For $d \ge d_u$, mean-field behavior is recovered with $d_{\rm SCC}/d=1/3$, consistent with complete-graph results. However, in contrast to hypercubic lattices, complete graphs exhibit a double-scaling structure in the SCC size distribution: large SCCs are governed by mean-field value $τ_{\rm SCC}=4$, while small SCCs follow a distinct power law with exponent $τ'=1$. At criticality, the giant in- and out-clusters are also fractal, sharing the same dimension as standard percolation clusters. These results show that critical SCCs remain well-defined fractal objects across dimensions, while their approach to the mean-field limit involves nontrivial changes in cluster statistics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“extensive simulations”、“hypercubic lattices”、“complete graphs”、“mean-field behavior”、“hyperscaling relation”。；研究对象：强连通簇（SCC）在随机取向键系统中的逾渗转变，具体研究体系为有限维度（d=2至7）的超立方晶格和完全图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低于上临界维度d_u=6时，临界强连通簇具有非平凡的分形维数d_SCC，并满足超标度关系；在d≥6时恢复平均场行为，但完全图上的SCC尺寸分布呈现双标度结构，与超立方晶格行为不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低于上临界维度d_u=6时，临界强连通簇具有非平凡的分形维数d_SCC，并满足超标度关系；在d≥6时恢复平均场行为，但完全图上的SCC尺寸分布呈现双标度结构，与超立方晶格行为不同。；创新点：首次系统揭示了强连通簇在从有限维度到平均场极限（完全图）的逾渗转变中，其临界分形性质保持良好定义，但簇统计量（如尺寸分布的双标度结构）在趋近平均场极限时发生非平凡变化。
papers.method_zh: 通过大规模数值模拟，在d=2至7的超立方晶格和完全图上研究随机取向键系统中强连通簇的逾渗行为，并采用有限尺寸标度分析、分形维数计算和尺寸分布幂律拟合。

papers.title: First-principles calculations of electrical conductivities of edge-modified graphene nanoribbons: strain effect
papers.abstract: We investigate the influence of strain on the electrical properties of graphene nanoribbons that have potential applications in making sensors and other optoelectronic devices. In particular, we chose pristine armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges (7aGNRsH), boron doped armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges (7aGNRsH-B) and armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges that have one carbon atom vacancy (7aGNRsH-V). Based on first-principles calculations, results show that pristine unstrained 7aGNRsH is electrically nonconductive but turns to be electrically conductive in a wide range of energy spectrum, e.g., from IR to visible to UV, due to the application of strain engineering. In metallic unstrained and strained 7aGNRsH-B and 7aGNRsH-V, non-vanishing electrical conductivity in the IR, visible and UV energy spectrum regimes are observed. We also investigate the influence of strain on the Berry curvature of 7aGNRsH, 7aGNRsH-B and 7aGNRsH-V nanoribbons. The results show that fermions are spread through out the Brillion zone in the reciprocal space for semiconducting unstrained 7aGNRsH but localized near the $Γ$-point for strained 7aGNRsH that have out-of-plane deformations due to strain engineering. For metallics 7aGNRsH-B and 7aGNRsH-V, Berry curvature plots show that fermions are localized far away from the $Γ$-point. In two atom boron doped p-type armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges (7aGNRsH-2B), large peaks in electrical conductivity at IR energy spectrum regimes can be observed. These peaks of electrical conductivities in 7aGNRSH-2B may be detectable in experimentally synthesized structure in Reference, JACS 137, 8872 (2016).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、strain effect（应变效应）。；研究对象：边缘修饰的石墨烯纳米带（edge-modified graphene nanoribbons），具体包括：原始扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（7aGNRsH）、硼掺杂的扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（7aGNRsH-B）、含一个碳原子空位的扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（7aGNRsH-V），以及双硼掺杂的p型扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（7aGNRsH-2B）。研究重点是应变对这些体系电导率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始无应变的7aGNRsH为电绝缘体，但施加应变工程后，其在红外到紫外宽光谱范围内转变为导电态。对于金属性的掺杂/缺陷体系（7aGNRsH-B、7aGNRsH-V），应变下在红外、可见光和紫外区均观察到非零电导率。此外，双硼掺杂体系（7aGNRsH-2B）在红外光谱区出现电导率大峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始无应变的7aGNRsH为电绝缘体，但施加应变工程后，其在红外到紫外宽光谱范围内转变为导电态。对于金属性的掺杂/缺陷体系（7aGNRsH-B、7aGNRsH-V），应变下在红外、可见光和紫外区均观察到非零电导率。此外，双硼掺杂体系（7aGNRsH-2B）在红外光谱区出现电导率大峰。；创新点：系统研究了应变对不同类型边缘修饰石墨烯纳米带（原始、掺杂、缺陷）电导率及贝里曲率的影响，揭示了应变可诱导半导体-导体转变，并发现双硼掺杂体系在红外区的电导率大峰可能具有实验可检测性。摘要未突出说明与已有研究相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否采用DFT、具体泛函或软件包等）。

papers.title: An Efficient Approach for Calculating Free Energy in Molecular Dynamics: Demineralization of Hydroxyapatite as a Case Study
papers.abstract: Despite the strength of Molecular Dynamics simulations in providing insights into the microscopic details of phenomenon in many fields in materials science, physics and biology, the biggest barrier is its limited timescale which is several orders of magnitude lower than the timescale of the real-world processes and phenomena being modeled. Free energy calculations are designed as a remedy to this problem that in theory can overcome this barrier. This is particularly relevant for biomineralisation processes such as tooth mineral formation and dissolution, while reflecting a broader challenge in accurately modelling rare events and long-timescale phenomena across complex molecular systems. However, due to the novelty of the field, a number of questions remain outstanding pertaining to the best practice of applying this method. The non-equilibrium work approach based on the Jarzynski equation is one of the most promising free energy calculation methods. However, the biggest challenge for the broader use of this method is the question of how many simulations are required for an accurate free energy estimation. Comparing the free energy results with very long reversible pulling simulations of atom clusters from the surface, each taking 75 days on the 48-core Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 CPUs, in this study we showed that this question is irrelevant and higher quality and better equilibrated initial structures is the proper approach than simply based on the number of simulations. We designed a new adaptive free energy calculation methodology which combines high quality, high computational cost free energy values with lower quality, lower cost values to build up the entire free energy profile. In the best case scenario this method lowers manifold the computational cost required for the non-equilibrium work free energy calculations compared to both the regular method and the reversible simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Molecular Dynamics simulations”、“free energy calculations”、“non-equilibrium work approach”、“Jarzynski equation”。；研究对象：羟基磷灰石的脱矿过程（demineralization of hydroxyapatite），属于生物矿化（biomineralisation）中的牙齿矿物形成与溶解过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于非平衡功自由能计算方法，提高初始结构的平衡质量比单纯增加模拟次数更能准确估算自由能；新提出的自适应方法可大幅降低计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于非平衡功自由能计算方法，提高初始结构的平衡质量比单纯增加模拟次数更能准确估算自由能；新提出的自适应方法可大幅降低计算成本。；创新点：提出“初始结构平衡质量优于模拟次数”的观点，并设计了一种自适应自由能计算方法，在最佳情况下将计算成本降低数倍。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟，采用基于Jarzynski方程的非平衡功方法（non-equilibrium work approach）进行自由能计算，并与可逆拉动模拟（reversible pulling simulations）结果对比。新方法结合高质量高计算成本与低质量低计算成本的自由能值，构建完整自由能曲线。

papers.title: New Source of Spin-hot spot in displaced silicon double quantum dots
papers.abstract: Controlling electron spins in double quantum dots allows individual electrons to be trapped and manipulated for next-generation solid-state qubit devices. In this paper, the study analyzes spin relaxation due to deformation potentials of acoustic phonon in single and double quantum dots under in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields, showing that in single quantum dots the relaxation rate is highly sensitive to low in-plane magnetic fields ($<1T$) but converges near a spin-hot-spot region. In a single quantum dot, the spin-hot spot arises from well-understood level crossings between singlet and triplet states. In double quantum dots, a new and unusual spin-hot spot appears as the dots are pulled apart from the origin, with spin-relaxation rates three orders of magnitude lower than conventional single quantum dots. In displaced quantum dots dominated by magnetic confinement, two distinct spin-hot spots appear at different in-plane magnetic field strengths, where spin-relaxation time varies from millisecond to picosecond. When quantum dots are separated by about 60 nm, calculations predict oscillations in spin-hot spots as the in-plane magnetic field changes. These unusual spin-hot spot oscillations occur at low magnetic fields ($<1T$), resulting in spin-relaxation rates about four orders of magnitude lower than those of conventional high-field spin-hot spots ($\approx 4.5T$). The extremely low spin-relaxation rate at the spin-hot spot enables the preparation of qubit superposition states for quantum computing and information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“analyzes”、“calculations predict”等关键词，主要基于理论模型进行计算分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：硅双量子点中的电子自旋弛豫现象，特别是由声子形变势引起的自旋热点的行为。具体体系为平面内和垂直磁场下的单量子点和双量子点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在分离的双量子点中发现了一种新型自旋热点，其自旋弛豫率比传统单量子点低约三个数量级。当量子点间距约为60纳米时，该自旋热点在低磁场（<1T）下出现振荡行为，弛豫率比传统高场自旋热点（约4.5T）低约四个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在分离的双量子点中发现了一种新型自旋热点，其自旋弛豫率比传统单量子点低约三个数量级。当量子点间距约为60纳米时，该自旋热点在低磁场（<1T）下出现振荡行为，弛豫率比传统高场自旋热点（约4.5T）低约四个数量级。；创新点：发现了在分离的双量子点中，由磁约束主导时出现的一种全新的、不同于传统单量子点中单态-三重态能级交叉机制的自旋热点。该热点在低磁场下表现出独特的振荡行为，且弛豫率极低，有利于量子比特叠加态的制备。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架为：基于声子形变势模型，计算了单量子点和双量子点在平面内和垂直磁场下的自旋弛豫率。通过分析能级交叉（单态与三重态）来识别自旋热点。

papers.title: Reprogrammable magnonic logic in a multiferroic heterostructure via magnetoelectric coupling
papers.abstract: The realization of fully reconfigurable, voltage-controlled, and programmable on-chip magnonic devices is essential to fully harness the potential of spin waves for signal processing, logic and neuromorphic computing. Yet, existing demonstrations of electrical tuning of magnonic responses are either volatile, current-driven and thus energy-inefficient, or rely on local strain modification limiting their scalability for wafer-scale integration. Here, we address this challenge using a BiFeO3/La0.67Sr0.33MnO3 multiferroic thin film heterostructure. We show that ferroelectric domain engineering in BiFeO3 enables deterministic tuning of the magnon dispersion of La0.67Sr0.33MnO3, producing frequency shifts up to $\sim 150 MHz$ and allowing reconfigurable waveguiding. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering directly images these effects, revealing electrically defined magnonic waveguides and spatially programmable dispersion. Compared to conventional approaches, this method provides non-volatile and reversible control. Furthermore, using an inverse-design simulation code, we demonstrate the capability of our platform to perform advanced magnonic functions such as frequency demultiplexing. Our results open a new avenue for using magnetoelectric heterostructures for magnonic logic, with further applicability to reservoir and neuromorphic computing and AI driven magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：multiferroic thin film heterostructure、micro-focused Brillouin light scattering、inverse-design simulation code，包含实验与计算模拟的混合类型）；研究对象：BiFeO₃/La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃ 多铁异质结中的磁振子（自旋波）逻辑器件，具体研究通过磁电耦合实现磁振子色散的可编程调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过BiFeO₃中的铁电畴工程，实现了对La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃磁振子色散的确定性调控，产生约150 MHz的频率移动，并实现了可重构的磁振子波导和空间可编程色散。该平台还可实现频率解复用等高级磁振子功能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过BiFeO₃中的铁电畴工程，实现了对La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃磁振子色散的确定性调控，产生约150 MHz的频率移动，并实现了可重构的磁振子波导和空间可编程色散。该平台还可实现频率解复用等高级磁振子功能。；创新点：相比现有电调磁振子方法（易失性、电流驱动能耗高或依赖局域应变限制可扩展性），本工作实现了非易失、可逆、电压控制的磁振子逻辑调控，且适用于晶圆级集成。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用微聚焦布里渊光散射（micro-focused Brillouin light scattering）直接成像磁振子响应；理论上结合逆向设计模拟代码（inverse-design simulation code）演示功能实现。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal impurity scattering as a probe for pairing symmetries in kagome superconductors
papers.abstract: The superconducting (SC) pairing symmetry and its link to time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) in the vanadium-based kagome superconductors remain unresolved, with ambiguities stemming from sublattice interference and charge-density-wave (CDW) entanglement with superconductivity. Using two representative SC pairings, i.e., the conventional on-site $s$-wave and the TRSB $d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{xy}$-wave, as a model study, we theoretically show that while single magnetic impurity yield qualitatively identical spectral behavior of local density of states (LDOS) for these two symmetries, two magnetic impurities give rise to distinct LDOS patterns. For the conventional on-site $s$-wave pairing, time-reversal symmetry (TRS) enforces equivalent forward and backward scattering between two impurities across all impurity configurations, leading to near disappearance of a Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) state pair along the line connecting the two impurities. However, for the TRSB $d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{xy}$-wave pairing, this scattering equivalence holds only for inversion-symmetric impurity configurations, with a pair of YSR disappearance restricted to this case. These distinct spectral features are resolvable in scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) experiments, providing a direct avenue to discriminate TRSB and non-TRSB SC pairing symmetries in kagome superconductors and an alternative method to probe SC nonreciprocity that circumvents the ambiguities of conventional critical current-based techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically show”、“model study”、“provide a direct avenue”。；研究对象：钒基笼目超导体（kagome superconductors）中的超导配对对称性，特别是时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）与非TRSB配对对称性的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于笼目超导体，单个磁性杂质产生的局域态密度（LDOS）谱在常规s波和TRSB d+id波配对下定性相同，但两个磁性杂质会因非互易散射效应产生截然不同的LDOS图案：s波配对下，两个杂质间的正向与反向散射始终等价，导致沿连线方向的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）态对几乎消失；而TRSB d+id波配对下，该等价性仅存在于反演对称的杂质构型中，YSR态对的消失也仅限于此情况。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于笼目超导体，单个磁性杂质产生的局域态密度（LDOS）谱在常规s波和TRSB d+id波配对下定性相同，但两个磁性杂质会因非互易散射效应产生截然不同的LDOS图案：s波配对下，两个杂质间的正向与反向散射始终等价，导致沿连线方向的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）态对几乎消失；而TRSB d+id波配对下，该等价性仅存在于反演对称的杂质构型中，YSR态对的消失也仅限于此情况。；创新点：提出利用两个磁性杂质产生的非互易散射效应作为探针，通过扫描隧道显微镜（STM）可分辨的LDOS特征来区分笼目超导体中是否具有时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）的配对对称性，从而规避传统基于临界电流方法中因子格干涉和电荷密度波（CDW）与超导纠缠带来的歧义。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：采用两种代表性超导配对（常规在位s波和TRSB d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{xy}波）作为模型研究，计算单个和两个磁性杂质下的局域态密度（LDOS）谱，并分析其空间分布特征。

papers.title: Interface engineering of the anomalous Hall effect in Ni-based heterostructures
papers.abstract: Using a combined experimental and first-principles theoretical approach, we demonstrate interface engineering of the anomalous Hall effect in Ni-based epitaxial thin-film heterostructures. Ferromagnetic Ni thin films are grown on (001)-oriented single-crystal LaAlO$_3$, SrTiO$_3$, and MgO substrates, which impose different biaxial tensile strains of 0.3%, 0.6%, and 0.8%, respectively. Our room-temperature Hall transport measurements reveal a pronounced substrate-dependent modulation of the anomalous Hall conductivity. Interestingly, our calculations show that strain alone cannot account for the experimentally observed trends. Instead, we identify interfacial inversion-symmetry breaking, which induces Rashba spin-orbit interaction, as the key mechanism governing the anomalous Hall conductivity across different interfaces. Building on this understanding, we further demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally that the anomalous Hall conductivity can be continuously tuned by an external electric field. These findings establish the critical role of substrate-induced interfacial effects in controlling the anomalous Hall effect in engineered heterostructures and provide a viable pathway toward electrically tunable room-temperature spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and first-principles theoretical approach”，包含实验生长、输运测量和理论计算。；研究对象：Ni基外延薄膜异质结构中的反常霍尔效应。具体材料体系为Ni薄膜分别生长在LaAlO₃(001)、SrTiO₃(001)和MgO(001)单晶衬底上，研究界面工程对反常霍尔效应的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面反演对称性破缺诱导的Rashba自旋-轨道相互作用是调控反常霍尔电导率的关键机制，而非单纯应变效应；并且反常霍尔电导率可通过外加电场连续调谐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面反演对称性破缺诱导的Rashba自旋-轨道相互作用是调控反常霍尔电导率的关键机制，而非单纯应变效应；并且反常霍尔电导率可通过外加电场连续调谐。；创新点：揭示了衬底诱导的界面反演对称性破缺（而非单纯应变）对反常霍尔效应的主导作用，并首次在Ni基异质结构中实现了电场对反常霍尔电导率的连续调控，为电控室温自旋电子器件提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：分子束外延生长Ni薄膜于不同衬底上，室温霍尔输运测量。理论方面：第一性原理计算（具体方法如DFT，摘要未明确说明具体泛函或赝势类型），用于分析应变效应与界面Rashba相互作用。

papers.title: Finite-Temperature Spin Exchange-Correlation Kernel of the Uniform Electron Gas
papers.abstract: The finite-temperature spin response of the uniform electron gas (UEG) is a fundamental reference for spin-polarized and magnetized electron liquids, including warm dense matter (WDM), yet it remains far less constrained than charge response. Using variational diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we compute the static spin exchange--correlation (XC) kernel $K_{xc}(q;T)$ of the unpolarized UEG at metallic densities across the quantum-degenerate, warm-dense, and classical regimes. The kernel connects smoothly to zero-temperature spin-response parametrizations at low temperature, while heating suppresses the Fermi-surface-scale spin-correlation structure and weakens the XC-driven Stoner enhancement. Its long-wavelength limit provides a direct response test of the spin stiffness implied by thermal local-spin-density-approximation (LSDA) parametrizations, showing low-temperature consistency while exposing a resolved warm-dense residual in current LSDA parametrizations. In the classical regime, the spin XC kernel becomes nearly local on the Fermi-momentum scale, in sharp contrast to the corresponding charge XC kernel. These results provide a first-principles basis for finite-temperature spin-response theory and magnetized WDM modeling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“variational diagrammatic Monte Carlo”（变分图解蒙特卡洛）计算方法，并构建理论模型（spin exchange-correlation kernel）。；研究对象：均匀电子气（UEG）在有限温度下的自旋响应，特别是其静态自旋交换关联核（$K_{xc}(q;T)$）。该研究覆盖了从量子简并、温稠密物质到经典极限的金属密度范围。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1. 加热会抑制费米面尺度的自旋关联结构，并削弱由交换关联驱动的Stoner增强效应。2. 在经典极限下，自旋交换关联核在费米动量尺度上变得近乎局域，这与电荷交换关联核的行为形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1. 加热会抑制费米面尺度的自旋关联结构，并削弱由交换关联驱动的Stoner增强效应。2. 在经典极限下，自旋交换关联核在费米动量尺度上变得近乎局域，这与电荷交换关联核的行为形成鲜明对比。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次系统地计算了均匀电子气在宽温度范围内（从低温到经典极限）的静态自旋交换关联核，为有限温度自旋响应理论和磁化温稠密物质建模提供了第一性原理基础，并揭示了当前局域自旋密度近似（LSDA）参数化在温稠密区域存在的残余误差。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分图解蒙特卡洛（variational diagrammatic Monte Carlo）方法，计算了非极化均匀电子气在有限温度下的静态自旋交换关联核。

papers.title: Learning inelastic constitutive models from stress-strain data under hard thermodynamic constraints
papers.abstract: Machine learning approaches informed by physics have offered new insights into the discovery of constitutive models from data, helping overcome some limitations of traditional constitutive modelling while reducing the cost of otherwise computationally intensive simulations. Yet, most existing approaches only partially enforce the requirements of physics and thermodynamics, leaving open questions about their consistency across a broad range of material behaviours and their ability to generalise robustly to unseen loading paths when only limited measurements are available. This work establishes a thermodynamics-constrained learning framework whose architecture embeds the principles of non-equilibrium thermodynamics, objectivity and stability as hard, scalable constraints to learn constitutive models from standard macroscopic data. Analytical benchmarks involving stress-strain loading paths demonstrate that the method learns thermodynamically consistent and robust constitutive models for a range of inelastic materials of increasing complexity. At inference, the resulting models generalise to more demanding, unobserved paths and can autonomously recover interpretable internal variables that capture path-dependent evolution. The framework is then applied to granular media, prototypical heterogeneous and history-dependent materials for which constitutive modelling remains challenging. Trained on numerically simulated experiments based on the discrete element method, the model discovers the underlying constitutive equations and predicts responses under cyclic loading, including the emergence of hysteresis absent from the training data, relying solely on macroscopic stress-strain histories. The findings indicate that enforcing non-equilibrium thermodynamics through hard constraints represents a principled route to robust, consistent, and scalable data-driven discovery of constitutive models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning approaches、thermodynamics-constrained learning framework、numerically simulated experiments。；研究对象：非弹性本构模型（inelastic constitutive models），具体应用于颗粒介质（granular media）等异质、历史依赖材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将非平衡热力学、客观性和稳定性作为硬约束嵌入机器学习架构，可以从宏观应力-应变数据中学习到热力学一致且鲁棒的本构模型，并能在未见加载路径下泛化，自主恢复可解释的内变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将非平衡热力学、客观性和稳定性作为硬约束嵌入机器学习架构，可以从宏观应力-应变数据中学习到热力学一致且鲁棒的本构模型，并能在未见加载路径下泛化，自主恢复可解释的内变量。；创新点：现有方法仅部分满足物理和热力学要求，该工作首次将非平衡热力学作为硬约束（而非软惩罚）系统性地嵌入学习框架，实现了可扩展、一致且鲁棒的数据驱动本构模型发现，并能从训练数据中未出现的循环加载中预测滞回行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用热力学约束的机器学习框架，将非平衡热力学原理、客观性和稳定性作为硬约束（hard constraints）嵌入网络架构；使用解析基准应力-应变加载路径进行验证，并基于离散元方法（Discrete Element Method, DEM）的数值模拟实验生成训练数据。

papers.title: Relativistic theory for coupled orbital and spin angular momentum dynamics in magnetic systems
papers.abstract: We develop a complete relativistic theory to describe the dynamics of electronic angular momentum including both spin (S) and orbital (L) contributions in magnetic systems. We start with the relativistic Dirac-Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian under the influence of an electromagnetic field and apply a unitary transformation to formulate the extended Pauli Hamiltonian. Using the transformed semirelativistic Hamiltonian, we derive the angular momentum dynamics for the orbital and spin angular momenta. Thereby, we formulate the coupled dynamics of orbital and spin moments consistent with the relativistic Dirac framework. Considering especially the conservation of the total angular momentum, J = S +L, we show first that J is conserved in the absence of a spin-polarized Kohn-Sham exchange field, but is no longer conserved under the application of an electromagnetic field, e.g., laser pulse, THz field, etc. Second, considering magnetic systems with atomic spin and orbital momenta, we derive the coupled equations of motion of angular momenta dynamics whilst making the atomistic Heisenberg approximation for the exchange interaction. Our results suggest that, under these assumptions, the total angular momentum remains conserved, even with electromagnetic field, but atomic spin and orbital angular momenta individually are not conserved.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“develop a complete relativistic theory”、“derive”、“formulate”，属于理论推导。；研究对象：磁性系统中电子自旋角动量（S）与轨道角动量（L）的耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无自旋极化的Kohn-Sham交换场时，总角动量J=S+L守恒，但在外加电磁场（如激光脉冲、太赫兹场）下不再守恒；而在原子尺度Heisenberg近似下，即使存在电磁场，总角动量仍守恒，但自旋和轨道角动量各自不守恒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无自旋极化的Kohn-Sham交换场时，总角动量J=S+L守恒，但在外加电磁场（如激光脉冲、太赫兹场）下不再守恒；而在原子尺度Heisenberg近似下，即使存在电磁场，总角动量仍守恒，但自旋和轨道角动量各自不守恒。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于相对论性Dirac-Kohn-Sham哈密顿量，通过幺正变换得到扩展的Pauli哈密顿量，进而推导半相对论框架下的轨道与自旋角动量动力学方程，并引入原子尺度Heisenberg近似处理交换相互作用。

papers.title: Emergent impedance due to antiferromagnetic domain wall dynamics
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate emergent impedance induced by domain-wall dynamics in antiferromagnets. Emergent impedance, arising from a combined action of spin-transfer torque and spinmotive force, was previously predicted and observed in spiral magnets. Here we develop a formalism for the electrical response of an antiferromagnetic domain wall under ac currents, and obtain analytical expressions for the resulting emergent impedance. We find that two dynamical modes play separate roles in the emergent impedance: Translational motion of the domain-wall center generates a contribution proportional to its velocity, analogous to that arising from the corresponding motion of a spiral magnet. Another contribution, unique to antiferromagnetic domain walls, originates from the time-dependent canting of the sublattice magnetizations localized within the moving domain wall, whose magnitude is inversely proportional to the antiferromagnetic exchange coupling constant. The competition between these two distinct contributions determines the sign and magnitude of the imaginary part of the emergent impedance at sub-resonant frequencies. Our results provide a fundamental insight into electron transport in antiferromagnets, and open avenues for novel antiferromagnet-based spintronics devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“develop a formalism”、“obtain analytical expressions”。；研究对象：反铁磁体中由畴壁动力学引发的涌现阻抗（emergent impedance）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁畴壁在交流电流下产生两种动力学模式贡献的涌现阻抗：一种来自畴壁中心的平移运动（类似螺旋磁体），另一种来自畴壁内亚晶格磁化的时间依赖倾斜（反铁磁特有，大小与交换耦合常数成反比）。这两种贡献的竞争决定了亚共振频率下涌现阻抗虚部的符号和大小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁畴壁在交流电流下产生两种动力学模式贡献的涌现阻抗：一种来自畴壁中心的平移运动（类似螺旋磁体），另一种来自畴壁内亚晶格磁化的时间依赖倾斜（反铁磁特有，大小与交换耦合常数成反比）。这两种贡献的竞争决定了亚共振频率下涌现阻抗虚部的符号和大小。；创新点：首次在反铁磁畴壁中系统分析了涌现阻抗的两种动力学贡献，特别是发现了反铁磁特有的、源于畴壁内亚晶格磁化倾斜的贡献，并揭示了其与反铁磁交换耦合常数的依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于自旋转移矩（spin-transfer torque）和自旋动电力（spinmotive force）的联合作用，建立反铁磁畴壁在交流电流下的电响应理论形式，并推导出涌现阻抗的解析表达式。

papers.title: Systematic dynamical mean-field theory study of 3d perovskite oxides with uniform Coulomb interactions
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated transition-metal perovskite oxides pose a fundamental challenge for electronic-structure theory and for large-scale, data-driven materials discovery. While DFT+DMFT provides a quantitatively accurate description of such systems, its high-throughput application is hindered by the need to determine material-specific Coulomb interaction parameters ($U$). First-principles approaches such as the cRPA predict a highly nonlinear and non-transferable evolution of the interaction strength across chemically similar ABO$_3$ perovskites. Here we show that this paradigm does not extend to the large-energy-window eDMFT, which employs highly localized orbitals and treats electronic correlations and screening self-consistently within the same many-body framework. As a result, spectral properties are governed primarily by the dynamical self-energy rather than by static interaction-induced energy shifts. Recent constrained-eDMFT calculations demonstrated that, for broad classes of $3d$ transition-metal oxides, the self-consistently screened Coulomb interactions naturally fall within relatively narrow ranges for correlated metals and insulators. Motivated by these findings, we implement a high-throughput eDMFT framework employing physically derived interaction values of $U=6$ eV for metals and $U=10$ eV for insulators together with $exact$ double counting. We test this framework using systematic high-throughput eDMFT calculations for ABO$_3$ compounds (A = Ca, Sr, La; B = V--Ni) and benchmark the resulting spectral functions against photoemission experiments, where we find overall excellent agreement. Our results establish that charge self-consistent eDMFT enables robust, parameter-tuning-free high-throughput many-body calculations for correlated oxides, opening a practical pathway toward predictive electronic-structure databases for strongly correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFT+DMFT、eDMFT、high-throughput计算。；研究对象：3d过渡金属氧化物ABO₃钙钛矿（A = Ca, Sr, La; B = V–Ni）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在采用高度局域化轨道并自洽处理电子关联与屏蔽的eDMFT框架下，光谱性质主要由动态自能而非静态相互作用能移决定；通过使用统一的库仑相互作用参数（金属U=6 eV，绝缘体U=10 eV）结合精确的双计数，可实现无需参数调节的高通量计算，且所得谱函数与光发射实验高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在采用高度局域化轨道并自洽处理电子关联与屏蔽的eDMFT框架下，光谱性质主要由动态自能而非静态相互作用能移决定；通过使用统一的库仑相互作用参数（金属U=6 eV，绝缘体U=10 eV）结合精确的双计数，可实现无需参数调节的高通量计算，且所得谱函数与光发射实验高度吻合。；创新点：提出并验证了在eDMFT框架下，对于3d钙钛矿氧化物，无需材料特定的库仑相互作用参数（U），仅使用两类统一的U值即可实现高通量、参数免调节的精确多体计算，为建立强关联材料电子结构数据库开辟了实用路径。
papers.method_zh: 电荷自洽的扩展动力学平均场理论（eDMFT），采用高度局域化轨道，自洽处理电子关联与屏蔽，并使用基于物理推导的固定U值（金属6 eV，绝缘体10 eV）及精确双计数方案。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic cascade drives tumbling in sheared colloidal rod suspensions
papers.abstract: Modeling the dynamics of colloidal rods remains a central challenge in soft-matter physics due to the anisotropic and long-ranged nature of their interactions. Hydrodynamic interactions in rods suspensions are often assumed to be screened or too week to play any role in semi-dilute regimes, yet we find here these assumptions to break down at shear rates and concentrations that are often attained in experiments. Using particle-based simulations and scaling analysis, we uncover a cascade of tumbling events driven by hydrodynamic coupling among neighboring rods. This collective dynamics disrupts flow alignment and leads to a pronounced increase in viscosity and normal stress differences, in qualitative agreement with recent experiments. The discovery of this hydrodynamically-promoted cascade effect calls for a revision of existing constitutive models for colloidal rods and highlights hydrodynamic coupling as a key mechanism governing collective dynamics in highly anisotropic suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：particle-based simulations（基于粒子的模拟）、scaling analysis（标度分析）。；研究对象：剪切流作用下胶体棒状颗粒悬浮液中的动力学行为，具体为半稀薄悬浮液中由流体动力学相互作用驱动的翻滚级联现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在实验常见的剪切速率和浓度下，相邻棒状颗粒之间的流体动力学耦合会触发一种翻滚级联效应，该集体动力学破坏了流动取向，并导致粘度和法向应力差显著增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在实验常见的剪切速率和浓度下，相邻棒状颗粒之间的流体动力学耦合会触发一种翻滚级联效应，该集体动力学破坏了流动取向，并导致粘度和法向应力差显著增加。；创新点：推翻了半稀薄胶体棒悬浮液中流体动力学相互作用通常被屏蔽或太弱而不起作用的传统假设，揭示了流体动力学耦合是驱动各向异性悬浮液集体动力学的关键机制，并指出需要修正现有的本构模型。
papers.method_zh: 基于粒子的模拟（particle-based simulations）和标度分析（scaling analysis）。

papers.title: Euler-Maruyama method for non-Wiener processes
papers.abstract: Descriptions of complex physical or biological systems often include stochastic contributions, and these are commonly simulated using Wiener processes. In many cases however, non-Gaussian fluctuations may originate from non-Wiener processes which remain less explored. The Euler-Maruyama method of discretising stochastic differential equations to non-Wiener processes is generalised. Non-Gaussian noise generated from a subset of Lévy processes can be used simply and often with more physical justification, for both additive and multiplicative noise. An example of this is provided that gives superior physical results compared to using geometric Brownian motion. Finally the results of the additive noise are shown to be equivalent to a derived master equation via the Kramers-Moyal expansion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalised、derived、Kramers-Moyal expansion。；研究对象：非Wiener过程（非高斯噪声）驱动的随机微分方程，以及其在复杂物理或生物系统描述中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将Euler-Maruyama方法推广至非Wiener过程，使得来自Lévy过程子集的非高斯噪声可被简单且物理上更合理地用于加性和乘性噪声模拟，并给出了一个优于几何布朗运动的物理实例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将Euler-Maruyama方法推广至非Wiener过程，使得来自Lévy过程子集的非高斯噪声可被简单且物理上更合理地用于加性和乘性噪声模拟，并给出了一个优于几何布朗运动的物理实例。；创新点：将经典的Euler-Maruyama数值方法从Wiener过程推广到更一般的非Wiener过程（Lévy过程子集），为非高斯噪声的随机模拟提供了更简单且物理上更合理的途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推广：将离散化随机微分方程的Euler-Maruyama方法推广到非Wiener过程；通过Kramers-Moyal展开推导了加性噪声情形下的主方程。

papers.title: Non-linear diffusion and inhomogeneity of the magnetic field in single-turn coils: Insights from 3D multiphysics modeling
papers.abstract: The single-turn coil method is a destructive pulsed magnet for generating over 100 T with a few $μ$-second pulse duration, and it inevitably causes the coil to explode. The temporal and spatial distributions of the electric current and magnetic field are highly inhomogeneous, arising from the skin effect, rapid temperature rise, and coil deformation. To grasp the dynamic phenomena in the single-turn coil, we conducted a finite element analysis using multiphysics simulation. We employed finite element method calculations using a fully 3D model of the single-turn coil with broken cylindrical symmetry. The calculated result revealed highly nonlinear diffusion of electric current, temperature, and magnetic fields, which are the sources of the inhomogeneous magnetic fields inside the single-turn coil in time and space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：finite element analysis、multiphysics simulation、finite element method calculations、3D model。；研究对象：单匝线圈（single-turn coil）在脉冲强磁场产生过程中的非线性扩散与磁场不均匀性，具体涉及电流、温度、磁场的时空分布动态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三维多物理场有限元模拟，揭示了单匝线圈中电流、温度和磁场的强非线性扩散行为，这些行为是导致线圈内部磁场在时间和空间上高度不均匀的根本原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三维多物理场有限元模拟，揭示了单匝线圈中电流、温度和磁场的强非线性扩散行为，这些行为是导致线圈内部磁场在时间和空间上高度不均匀的根本原因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元方法（FEM）进行多物理场耦合模拟，构建了具有破缺圆柱对称性的全三维单匝线圈模型，计算了电流、温度与磁场的时空演化。

papers.title: Berry-phase in a periodically driven single molecule magnet transistor
papers.abstract: We consider the electron transport through a single molecule magnet transistor in the presence of a local transverse magnetic field and ac-driven gate voltage. We calculate the conductance as a function of the electron energy and transverse magnetic field by using the Floquet and Landauer formalism. We show that the time periodic potential causes zero transmission resonances that oscillate as a function of the transverse magnetic field due to the Berry phase interference associated with two quantum tunneling paths. We find that these Berry phase oscillations can be detected in the conductance as a function of the transverse magnetic field for an incoming electron with a specific energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet formalism、Landauer formalism、Berry phase interference。；研究对象：单分子磁体晶体管（single molecule magnet transistor）在局域横向磁场和交流驱动栅压下的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间周期势（交流驱动栅压）会导致零透射共振，该共振随横向磁场振荡，其振荡源于与两个量子隧穿路径相关的贝里相位干涉。这种贝里相位振荡可在特定能量入射电子的电导随横向磁场的变化中被探测到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时间周期势（交流驱动栅压）会导致零透射共振，该共振随横向磁场振荡，其振荡源于与两个量子隧穿路径相关的贝里相位干涉。这种贝里相位振荡可在特定能量入射电子的电导随横向磁场的变化中被探测到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet形式论和Landauer形式论计算电导随电子能量和横向磁场的变化。

papers.title: Bipolaronic High-Temperature Superconductivity from Phonon-Modulated Hopping: A Perspective
papers.abstract: Phonon-mediated superconductivity is conventionally thought to be capped at a transition temperature $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ no larger than roughly one-tenth of the phonon frequency $Ω$, a bound rooted in the breakdown of Migdal-Eliashberg theory at intermediate coupling and in the heaviness of bipolarons formed in standard models with phonons that couple to the electron density. In this review I describe a route to phonon-mediated high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity that bypasses this bound. The key ingredient is a class of electron-phonon couplings in which lattice distortions modulate the electron hopping and therefore its kinetic energy rather than its potential energy, known as the Peierls model (also known as Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model). In these models phonon exchange generates an interaction that binds two electrons into a small but unusually light bipolaron. Using sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a bond-Peierls model on the square and cubic lattices, my collaborators and I have shown that a dilute liquid of such bipolarons forms an $s$-wave superconductor with a $T_{\mathrm{c}}/Ω$ that significantly exceeds the conventional bound, that this conclusion is robust against screened Coulomb repulsion, and that $T_{\mathrm{c}}/Ω$ -- despite being reduced -- remains above bound in presence of strong long-range Coulomb repulsion. A semi-classical instanton analysis explains why, at strong coupling, bipolarons in models with phonon-modulated hopping are lighter than their density-coupled (Holstein) counterparts. I close with a discussion of materials in which this physics may be operative, in particular the iron-based pnictide superconductors, and of design principles that follow from it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“review”、“sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations”、“semi-classical instanton analysis”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：论文研究的是基于声子调制电子跳跃（Peierls模型/SSH模型）的电子-声子耦合体系中的双极化子与高温超导电性，具体涉及正方晶格和立方晶格上的键-Peierls模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在声子调制跳跃的Peierls模型中，双极化子异常轻，其稀液体可形成s波超导体，且超导转变温度与声子频率之比（T_c/Ω）显著超过传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论所认为的上限（约0.1），该结论在考虑屏蔽和非屏蔽库仑排斥后仍然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在声子调制跳跃的Peierls模型中，双极化子异常轻，其稀液体可形成s波超导体，且超导转变温度与声子频率之比（T_c/Ω）显著超过传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论所认为的上限（约0.1），该结论在考虑屏蔽和非屏蔽库仑排斥后仍然成立。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统密度耦合（Holstein）模型相比的具体创新点，但明确指出该工作系统展示了通过声子调制跳跃机制绕过传统超导温度上限的可行路径，并提供了数值和解析证据。
papers.method_zh: 使用无符号问题的量子蒙特卡洛模拟（sign-problem-free QMC）对正方和立方晶格上的键-Peierls模型进行数值计算；采用半经典瞬子（instanton）分析解释强耦合下双极化子比Holstein模型更轻的机制。

papers.title: Machine Learning Approaches to Point Defects in Non-Metallic Materials: A Review of Methods
papers.abstract: We review recent machine-learning (ML) approaches for point defects in non-metallic materials, with an emphasis on defect formation energies. Existing studies largely fall into two categories: direct ML models that predict defect energetics from local structural representations, and machine-learning potentials (MLPs) that approximate the defect-containing potential energy surface. We summarize key achievements as well as persistent bottlenecks, emphasizing that dataset quality often dominates practical model performance. We further identify charged-defect formation energies as a central frontier, where Fermi-level alignment, finite-size corrections, and long-range electrostatics must be handled carefully and consistently to enable meaningful comparisons and transferable predictions across different materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。判断依据：标题中明确标注“A Review of Methods”，摘要内容为对已有研究的分类总结与前沿问题识别。；研究对象：非金属材料中的点缺陷，重点聚焦于缺陷形成能的计算与预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有机器学习方法主要分为两类：基于局部结构表示直接预测缺陷能量的直接模型，以及近似含缺陷势能面的机器学习势函数。数据集质量是制约实际模型性能的关键瓶颈；带电缺陷形成能的计算是当前核心前沿，需谨慎处理费米能级对齐、有限尺寸修正和长程静电相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有机器学习方法主要分为两类：基于局部结构表示直接预测缺陷能量的直接模型，以及近似含缺陷势能面的机器学习势函数。数据集质量是制约实际模型性能的关键瓶颈；带电缺陷形成能的计算是当前核心前沿，需谨慎处理费米能级对齐、有限尺寸修正和长程静电相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该综述系统梳理了非金属材料中点缺陷机器学习方法的两大主流路径，并明确指出了带电缺陷形成能计算中尚未被充分解决的跨材料可迁移性挑战。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习方法，包括直接预测模型（基于局部结构表示）和机器学习势函数（MLPs）。摘要未明确说明具体使用的机器学习算法类型（如神经网络、高斯过程回归等）。

papers.title: Crystal growth and characterization of the ultra-high temperature substrate $\mathrm{Ta_{1-x}Hf_{x}C_{0.5}}$
papers.abstract: Incorporation of $\mathrm{Al_{y}Ga_{1-y}N}$ (AGN) semiconductors into high power electronics offers efficiency improvements in power transmission, generation, and use, if approaches to eliminate the defects arising from film-lattice mismatch can be established. Here, we report the optical floating zone crystal growth of $\mathrm{Ta_{1-x}Hf_{x}C_{0.5}}$ (x = 0.2), a new metallic substrate material family lattice matched to the ultra-wide-band-gap, Al-rich side (y = 0.91) of the AGN solid solution. Laue diffraction demonstrates large single crystal domains in the as-grown boule. Single crystal x-ray diffraction at T = 213 K in conjunction with first principles calculations shows that the material adopts a layered crystal structure with AA-type stacking of (Ta/Hf)-C-(Ta/Hf) trilayers described in the trigonal space group P-3m1 (#164), with a = 3.1168(4) Å, c = 4.9644(4) Å, and $β$ = 120.0°. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurements show the Hf:Ta ratio to be close to the nominal value of 0.8:0.2 in the grown crystal. Density Functional Theory calculations reveal that this structure is stabilized by the low energy of carbon-vacancy formation of a hypothetical $\mathrm{(Ta/Hf)_{1}C_{1}}$ anti-NiAs structure type, and imply flexibility in interface structure with an overlayer nitride film. A surface preparation/polishing procedure is developed that reduces root mean square (RMS) surface roughness from as-cut 130 nm to 7 nm as measured by atomic force microscopy. Scanning electron microscopy shows the presence of a native surface oxide, removed by polishing, along with carbon-rich pits. Time-domain thermoreflectance measurements show a room temperature thermal conductivity of $κ$ = 18.1(4) W m-1 K-1. These results provide key first steps for utilizing metallic, lattice matched, substrates for the growth of Al-rich AGN semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：crystal growth, characterization, X-ray diffraction, XPS, AFM, SEM, thermal conductivity measurement）；研究对象：超高温衬底材料 Ta₁₋ₓHfₓC₀.₅（x=0.2），一种与富铝 AlGaN 半导体晶格匹配的新型金属衬底。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功生长出大尺寸单晶 Ta₀.₈Hf₀.₂C₀.₅，其具有层状晶体结构（空间群 P-3m1），室温热导率为 18.1 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，并可通过抛光将表面粗糙度降至 7 nm，为富铝 AlGaN 半导体提供了晶格匹配的金属衬底候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功生长出大尺寸单晶 Ta₀.₈Hf₀.₂C₀.₅，其具有层状晶体结构（空间群 P-3m1），室温热导率为 18.1 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，并可通过抛光将表面粗糙度降至 7 nm，为富铝 AlGaN 半导体提供了晶格匹配的金属衬底候选材料。；创新点：首次报道了与富铝 AlGaN（y=0.91）晶格匹配的金属衬底 Ta₁₋ₓHfₓC₀.₅ 的晶体生长与全面表征，并揭示了其由碳空位稳定化的层状结构及与氮化物薄膜的界面兼容性。
papers.method_zh: 光学浮区法晶体生长、劳厄衍射、单晶 X 射线衍射（T=213 K）、第一性原理计算（DFT）、X 射线光电子能谱（XPS）、原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、时域热反射法（TDTR）测量热导率。

papers.title: Revealing Hund superdispersion with tunneling spectroscopy
