papers.abstract: In cuprate superconductors, electron-electron repulsion results in characteristic spectroscopic features known as `waterfalls', where the sharp quasiparticle dispersion transitions into broad Hubbard bands. However, in multi-orbital systems, the additional Hund coupling results in behavior that defies the conventional Mott--Hubbard paradigm, creating qualitatively distinct `superdispersive' features in the spectral function. Here, we use tunneling spectroscopy to reveal this signature of Hund physics in Sr$_2$RuO$_4$. By combining density functional theory, dynamical mean-field theory, and continuum local density of states calculations, we show that the experimental features are in excellent agreement with theoretical predictions and intimately linked to the non-monotonous energy dependence of the real part of the self-energy in a Hund metal. Our results provide direct experimental evidence for Hund-induced spectroscopic features and open a new route to probing correlation effects in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：结合了隧道谱实验、密度泛函理论（DFT）、动力学平均场理论（DMFT）以及连续局域态密度计算。；研究对象：多轨道 Hund 金属 Sr₂RuO₄ 中的“超色散”（superdispersion）光谱特征，以及 Hund 耦合导致的非传统 Mott-Hubbard 行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Sr₂RuO₄ 中，隧道谱实验揭示了由 Hund 耦合引起的“超色散”特征，该特征与理论预测高度一致，并源于 Hund 金属中自能实部的非单调能量依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Sr₂RuO₄ 中，隧道谱实验揭示了由 Hund 耦合引起的“超色散”特征，该特征与理论预测高度一致，并源于 Hund 金属中自能实部的非单调能量依赖关系。；创新点：首次通过隧道谱实验直接观测到 Hund 耦合诱导的光谱特征（超色散），为探测量子材料中的关联效应提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 隧道谱实验；密度泛函理论（DFT）；动力学平均场理论（DMFT）；连续局域态密度（continuum local density of states）计算。

papers.title: Data-driven analysis of metastability in a stochastic bistable system
papers.abstract: We study the metastability properties of a simple prototypical bistable system using the formalism of the Koopman operator. Instead of studying noise-induced transitions by following the trajectories of the system, we track them by studying the time evolution and the decay rate of the subdominant mode of the Koopman operator, thus in a geometry-agnostic framework. We find agreement with the predictions - both the exponential and subexponential ones - of large deviation theory in the weak-noise limit for the statistics of escape time, both in equilibrium and nonequilibrium conditions. The subdominant Koopman mode also allows for an accurate reconstruction of the competing basins of attraction. Going deeper in the Koopman spectrum, we are able to recognise modes that are associated with intrawell variability as well as with the escape of trajectories from the saddle towards the attractor, both in the equilibrium and nonequilibrium case. Our methodology, being grounded in purely data-driven techniques, could be helpful for studying high-dimensional metastable systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Koopman operator formalism, data-driven techniques, large deviation theory。；研究对象：一个简单的随机双稳系统的亚稳态特性。具体是一个典型的双稳系统，研究其在噪声诱导下的跃迁行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Koopman算子框架，在弱噪声极限下，系统逃逸时间的统计（包括指数和次指数行为）与大偏差理论的预测一致，无论是在平衡态还是非平衡态条件下。此外，次主导Koopman模式能准确重建竞争吸引域，而更深层的模式则与势阱内变化及从鞍点到吸引子的逃逸轨迹相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Koopman算子框架，在弱噪声极限下，系统逃逸时间的统计（包括指数和次指数行为）与大偏差理论的预测一致，无论是在平衡态还是非平衡态条件下。此外，次主导Koopman模式能准确重建竞争吸引域，而更深层的模式则与势阱内变化及从鞍点到吸引子的逃逸轨迹相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该方法的核心创新在于：1）使用Koopman算子（一种无几何框架）而非直接追踪系统轨迹来研究亚稳态；2）该方法完全基于数据驱动，有望应用于高维亚稳态系统。
papers.method_zh: 采用Koopman算子的形式主义，通过研究该算子次主导模式的时间演化和衰减率来追踪噪声诱导的跃迁，这是一种与几何无关的框架。该方法完全基于数据驱动技术。

papers.title: Ultrasonic determination of crystallographic texture by transmitted field fitting regardless of medium dispersivity
papers.abstract: The determination of crystallographic texture through elastic wave propagation offers a cost-effective, nondestructive means of obtaining through-thickness information with minimal sample preparation. Existing ultrasonic approaches rely on either bulk-wave or guided-wave velocity measurements for texture inversion. These strategies impose geometric constraints: bulk-wave methods become impractical for thin specimens, whereas guided-wave techniques are limited to relatively small thicknesses. Furthermore, many formulations assume orthotropic symmetry of the aggregate, thereby restricting their applicability to materials with higher anisotropy. In this work, a full-field wave fitting strategy is developed in which the transmitted ultrasonic field is simulated and directly compared to experimental measurements. Because the approach does not rely on bulk-wave or plate-wave approximations, it remains applicable across a broad range of specimen thicknesses. Furthermore, no macroscopic symmetry assumptions are imposed on the aggregate, enabling the characterization of generally anisotropic materials. The effective elastic response is computed using a Hashin-Shtrikman homogenization framework, which provides tighter bounds than classical Voigt-Reuss-Hill averages and constrains the admissible search space during optimization, thereby improving convergence. The nonlinear inverse problem is solved using a GPU-accelerated optimization scheme. The methodology is validated on materials with hexagonal and cubic crystal symmetry over a range of specimen thicknesses. The inferred texture coefficients show consistent agreement with independent diffraction measurements. Additionally, textures with weak elastic anisotropy are successfully recovered, demonstrating the robustness and versatility of the proposed method. Complete measurement and inversion are achieved within approximately 10 minutes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与实验混合类型。关键词：full-field wave fitting strategy（全场波拟合策略）、GPU-accelerated optimization scheme（GPU加速优化方案）、validated on materials（在材料上验证）。；研究对象：多晶材料的晶体学织构（crystallographic texture）。具体涉及具有六方和立方晶体对称性的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于透射超声全场拟合的织构测定方法，该方法不受样品厚度和介质色散的限制，能成功恢复弱弹性各向异性材料的织构系数，结果与独立衍射测量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于透射超声全场拟合的织构测定方法，该方法不受样品厚度和介质色散的限制，能成功恢复弱弹性各向异性材料的织构系数，结果与独立衍射测量一致。；创新点：1. 提出的全场波拟合方法不依赖于体波或板波近似，因此适用于从薄到厚的广泛样品厚度范围，克服了传统超声方法的几何限制。2. 无需对多晶集合体施加宏观对称性假设（如正交各向异性），能够表征一般各向异性材料。3. 利用Hashin-Shtrikman界限约束优化搜索空间，提高了反演收敛性。
papers.method_zh: 1. **实验手段**：透射超声全场测量（transmitted ultrasonic field）。2. **计算方法**：全场波拟合策略，直接模拟透射超声场并与实验测量对比；采用Hashin-Shtrikman均匀化框架计算有效弹性响应，以提供比经典Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均更紧的界限；使用GPU加速的非线性优化方案求解逆问题。

papers.title: Correlation-Driven Spin Reorientation via Competing Anisotropy Channels in CrPS4
papers.abstract: We identify a correlation-driven mechanism for the temperature-induced spin reorientation in the quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS4. Magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) analysis resolves the local spin direction and shows that ferromagnetic intrachain correlations persist far above TN. Combining these correlations with a DFT-derived spin Hamiltonian reveals competing single-ion and exchange-anisotropy channels, with single-ion anisotropy remaining local while exchange anisotropy is renormalized as intersite correlations decay. This differential renormalization rotates the effective easy axis and captures the ordered-state canting. Above TN, the continued rotation beyond the model prediction delineates the limits of the dominant-chain approximation. These results establish mPDF-derived correlations as direct inputs to microscopic Hamiltonians and show how low-dimensional correlations can control magnetic anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) analysis、DFT-derived spin Hamiltonian。；研究对象：准一维范德华反铁磁体 CrPS₄ 中温度诱导的自旋重取向现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出一种关联驱动的自旋重取向机制：单离子各向异性保持局域，而交换各向异性随层间关联衰减发生重整化，导致有效易轴旋转并解释有序态下的自旋倾斜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出一种关联驱动的自旋重取向机制：单离子各向异性保持局域，而交换各向异性随层间关联衰减发生重整化，导致有效易轴旋转并解释有序态下的自旋倾斜。；创新点：将 mPDF 导出的磁关联作为微观哈密顿量的直接输入，展示了低维关联如何控制磁各向异性。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 磁对分布函数（mPDF）分析解析局域自旋方向；结合 DFT 导出自旋哈密顿量进行理论建模。

papers.title: From bulk to interface dynamics, in and out of equilibrium
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of weakly deformed interfaces separating two stable phases, starting from the fluctuating hydrodynamics of the phase-separating fields. Using a well-chosen definition for the interface and the dynamical-action formalism to represent path probabilities, we derive the linear relaxation of the interface and the fluctuations around it for a large class of models. Our method applies to equilibrium dynamics, where it recovers and complements existing results, but also extends to their non-equilibrium counterparts. We explain how non-linear terms can be systematically computed and illustrate their derivations in the case of (active) model A. We highlight the danger of a popular ansatz used to derive interface dynamics, which was rigorously established in equilibrium but is uncontrolled for active field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“fluctuating hydrodynamics”、“dynamical-action formalism”、“derive the linear relaxation”等理论推导和形式化方法，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：弱形变界面（weakly deformed interfaces）的动力学，特别是分离两个稳定相的界面在平衡态和非平衡态下的弛豫与涨落行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义合适的界面和路径概率的动力学作用量形式，推导了一类广泛模型中界面的线性弛豫及其涨落，并将该方法从平衡态动力学推广到非平衡态。同时指出，在活性场理论中，一个在平衡态中严格成立的常用界面动力学假设（ansatz）是失控的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义合适的界面和路径概率的动力学作用量形式，推导了一类广泛模型中界面的线性弛豫及其涨落，并将该方法从平衡态动力学推广到非平衡态。同时指出，在活性场理论中，一个在平衡态中严格成立的常用界面动力学假设（ansatz）是失控的。；创新点：将界面动力学的推导方法从平衡态系统扩展到非平衡系统（如活性场理论），并揭示了平衡态中常用的界面动力学假设在非平衡情况下的不适用性。
papers.method_zh: 采用涨落流体力学（fluctuating hydrodynamics）描述相分离场，利用动力学作用量形式（dynamical-action formalism）表示路径概率，推导界面线性弛豫和涨落。非线性项可通过系统化方法计算，并以（活性）模型A为例进行说明。

papers.title: Universal dynamics from a single-particle dark state
papers.abstract: Open quantum systems can host dark or subradiant states whose decay is highly suppressed. While these states have been extensively studied in the few-excitation regime, their impact on the many-body dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here, we study a spin chain subject to correlated dissipation on neighboring sites, which admits a single-particle dark state at zero momentum. We show that the single-particle dark state qualitatively alters the many-body dynamics at long times, and identify its distinct universal behavior. While the zero-momentum mode is dark at the single-particle level, it decays slowly as $1/\log t$ as it becomes dressed by other modes through a dissipation-induced nonlinearity. We demonstrate that the momentum distribution takes a universal scaling form in $k\sqrt{t}$, and the total density decays as $1/\sqrt{t}\log t$. Our results further elucidate the origin of the conflicting results in recent works. Finally, we corroborate the analytics with matrix product state simulations and show that the same universal behavior persists for soft-core interactions, underscoring the universality of the emergent dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：open quantum systems, many-body dynamics, analytics, matrix product state simulations）；研究对象：具有相邻位点关联耗散的自旋链，以及其中由单粒子暗态主导的多体动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单粒子暗态在耗散诱导的非线性作用下会被其他模式“修饰”，导致其缓慢衰减（1/log t），并产生普适的标度行为：动量分布呈k√t的标度形式，总密度按1/√t log t衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单粒子暗态在耗散诱导的非线性作用下会被其他模式“修饰”，导致其缓慢衰减（1/log t），并产生普适的标度行为：动量分布呈k√t的标度形式，总密度按1/√t log t衰减。；创新点：揭示了单粒子暗态在长时间多体动力学中产生普适标度行为，并澄清了近期工作中相互矛盾的结果的起源。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（耗散诱导非线性、标度论证）结合矩阵乘积态（MPS）数值模拟，并考虑了软核相互作用以验证普适性。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and statistical properties of a multifractional modified dispersion relation via the grand-canonical ensemble
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamic and statistical properties of a gas governed by a multifractional modified dispersion relation of the form $ω^{2}=k^{2}+4E_{*}^{-1/2}k^{5/2}$, where $E_{*}$ sets the characteristic scale of the multifractional correction. Working within the grand-canonical ensemble, we derive the modified density of states, the grand potential, the partition function, and the main thermodynamic quantities for both bosonic and fermionic sectors. The deformation changes the available phase-space distribution and produces nonstandard thermal scalings controlled by the ratio $T/E_{*}$. In the infrared regime, the usual relativistic gas behavior is recovered with leading corrections proportional to powers of $(T/E_{*})^{1/2}$. In the ultraviolet regime, the density of states scales as $\varrho(ω)\propto ω^{7/5}$, corresponding to an effective density-of-states dimension $d_{\mathrm{eff}}=12/5$. As a consequence, the Stefan-Boltzmann law is deformed from $u\propto T^{4}$ to $u\propto E_{*}^{3/5}T^{17/5}$, while the equation-of-state parameter approaches $w=5/12$ instead of the standard radiation value $w=1/3$. We also analyze thermal stability, particle number and energy fluctuations, Bose-Einstein condensation, and the degenerate Fermi gas limit. The multifractional correction increases the critical temperature of a conserved bosonic gas and modifies the Fermi energy, pressure, sound speed, and low-temperature heat capacity of degenerate fermions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：grand-canonical ensemble（巨正则系综）、derived（推导）、modified dispersion relation（修正色散关系）。；研究对象：一种受多分形修正色散关系（形式为 ω² = k² + 4E₋¹/² k⁵/²）支配的气体，其中 E* 为多分形修正的特征能标。研究涵盖玻色子和费米子两种统计下的热力学与统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多分形修正改变了态密度标度，导致紫外区有效态密度维度为 d_eff = 12/5，从而将斯蒂芬-玻尔兹曼定律从 u ∝ T⁴ 修正为 u ∝ E₋³/⁵ T¹⁷/⁵，并将辐射状态方程参数从 w = 1/3 修正为 w = 5/12。此外，该修正提高了守恒玻色气体的临界温度，并改变了简并费米气体的费米能、压强、声速及低温热容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多分形修正改变了态密度标度，导致紫外区有效态密度维度为 d_eff = 12/5，从而将斯蒂芬-玻尔兹曼定律从 u ∝ T⁴ 修正为 u ∝ E₋³/⁵ T¹⁷/⁵，并将辐射状态方程参数从 w = 1/3 修正为 w = 5/12。此外，该修正提高了守恒玻色气体的临界温度，并改变了简并费米气体的费米能、压强、声速及低温热容。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用巨正则系综理论框架，推导了修正色散关系下的态密度、巨势、配分函数以及玻色子和费米子体系的主要热力学量，并分析了红外与紫外极限下的标度行为。

papers.title: The problem of relaxation to equilibrium
papers.abstract: When a thermodynamic system is released from any constraint, after some time its evolution will render it into an equilibrium state. Although the description of this relaxation to thermodynamic equilibrium has been attempted through both classical (Hamilton's equations) or quantum (Schrödinger equation) approaches, no success has been achieved without recurring to additional hypotheses. The present work demonstrates the possibility of reaching equilibrium states in a simple classical gaseous system, by imposing non-strict boundary conditions, in the sense that all interactions with the container walls must occur according to Heisenberg's uncertainty principle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：经典气体系统、哈密顿方程、海森堡不确定性原理、非严格边界条件。；研究对象：经典气体系统从非平衡态向热力学平衡态的弛豫过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入基于海森堡不确定性原理的非严格边界条件（即气体与容器壁的相互作用必须遵循该原理），可以在经典气体系统中实现向平衡态的弛豫，而无需额外假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入基于海森堡不确定性原理的非严格边界条件（即气体与容器壁的相互作用必须遵循该原理），可以在经典气体系统中实现向平衡态的弛豫，而无需额外假设。；创新点：提出并论证了通过非严格边界条件（而非传统严格边界条件）解决经典系统弛豫到平衡态这一长期难题的可能性，避免了引入额外假设。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。采用经典力学（哈密顿方程）框架，但将容器壁的相互作用条件修改为符合海森堡不确定性原理的非严格边界条件。

papers.title: Irreversibility from Self-Reference: Gradient Flow and an H-Theorem for a Self-Referential Statistical Operator Framework
papers.abstract: This paper is a direct companion to arXiv:2605.06705, where the self-referential operator Omega was introduced and the Tsallis index q = alpha + beta was derived as a fixed-point condition within the local kernel approximation (LKA). Here we address four aspects deferred from the previous work. First, we carry out the first-order perturbative expansion of Omega beyond the LKA and demonstrate structural stability of q = alpha + beta at leading order in (xi/L)^2. Second, we define the iterative dynamical scheme Psi_(n+1) = Omega[Psi_n] and analyze convergence via Frechet spectral radius. Third, and centrally, we establish an H-theorem rigorously within the LKA for both the discrete iteration and the continuous gradient flow: we compute dF/dtau explicitly along the flow, identify the negative semi-definite dissipation term, establish the result rigorously in the LKA using strict convexity of F proved in the companion paper, and provide numerical evidence showing monotone decrease of F[Psi_n] across 53 iterations on an N = 80 discrete system. Fourth, we characterize the non-perturbative role of the self-coupling parameter kappa, identifying a re-entrant disordered phase at kappa > kappa* approximately 0.50 +/- 0.05. The paper is explicit about what is proved, what is established numerically, and what open problems remain for a complete analytical proof beyond the LKA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：自指统计算符框架、梯度流、H定理、解析证明与数值验证结合）；研究对象：自指统计算符Ω框架下的不可逆性起源，具体涉及Tsallis指数q的固定点条件、迭代动力学收敛性、H定理以及自耦合参数κ导致的再入无序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域核近似（LKA）内严格证明了离散迭代与连续梯度流下的H定理（自由能F单调递减），并发现自耦合参数κ超过临界值κ*≈0.50±0.05时系统出现再入无序相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域核近似（LKA）内严格证明了离散迭代与连续梯度流下的H定理（自由能F单调递减），并发现自耦合参数κ超过临界值κ*≈0.50±0.05时系统出现再入无序相。；创新点：首次在自指统计算符框架内建立严格的H定理（LKA内），并揭示κ驱动的再入无序相这一非微扰效应；同时验证了q=α+β在次领头阶的结构稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 采用自指统计算符Ω的微扰展开（超越LKA的一阶修正）、Frechet谱半径分析迭代收敛性、解析计算梯度流耗散项并利用严格凸性证明H定理，辅以N=80离散系统53次迭代的数值模拟。

papers.title: Long Spin Relaxation Times in CVD-Grown Nanodiamonds
papers.abstract: Currently, the primary applications of fluorescent nanodiamonds (FNDs) are in the area of biosensing, by using photoluminescence or spin properties of colour centres, mainly represented by the Nitrogen Vacancy (NV) point defect. The sensitivity of NV-FNDs to external fields is, however, limited by crystallographic defects, which influence their key quantum state characteristics - the spin longitudinal (\textit{T$_1$}) and spin transversal (\textit{T$_2$}) relaxation and coherence times, respectively. We report on utilising an advanced FND growth technique consisting of heterogeneous nucleation on pre-engineered sites to create FNDs averaging around 60 nm in size, with mean longitudinal coherence times of 800 $μ$s and a maximum over 1.8 ms, close to bulk theoretical values. This is a major, nearly ten-fold improvement over commercially available nanodiamonds for the same size range of 50 to 150 nm. Heavy-N doped nanodiamond shells, important for sensing events in nm proximity to the diamond surface, are fabricated and discussed in terms of re-nucleation and twinning on \{111\} crystal facets. We also discuss scalability issues in order to enable the production of FND volumes matching the needs of sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了利用先进生长技术制备纳米金刚石，并测量了其自旋弛豫时间等实验数据。；研究对象：化学气相沉积（CVD）生长的荧光纳米金刚石（FNDs），具体研究其氮空位（NV）色心的自旋纵向弛豫时间（T₁）和自旋横向弛豫时间（T₂）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过异质成核于预设计位点的先进生长技术，制备出平均尺寸约60 nm的纳米金刚石，其平均纵向相干时间（T₁）达到800 μs，最大值超过1.8 ms，接近块体理论值，比同等尺寸范围的商用纳米金刚石提升了近十倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过异质成核于预设计位点的先进生长技术，制备出平均尺寸约60 nm的纳米金刚石，其平均纵向相干时间（T₁）达到800 μs，最大值超过1.8 ms，接近块体理论值，比同等尺寸范围的商用纳米金刚石提升了近十倍。；创新点：实现了纳米金刚石自旋弛豫时间的大幅提升（近十倍于商用产品），使其接近块体理论值，并探讨了重氮掺杂壳层的制备及其在近表面传感中的应用潜力。摘要未明确说明与已有研究相比的其他具体创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用异质成核于预设计位点的先进CVD生长技术，制备了平均尺寸约60 nm的纳米金刚石，并测量了其自旋纵向弛豫时间（T₁）和自旋横向弛豫时间（T₂）。此外，还制备了重氮掺杂的纳米金刚石壳层，并讨论了其在{111}晶面上的再成核与孪晶现象。

papers.title: A Unified Critical Scaling Theory for Macroscopic Lightning and Quantum Avalanches: From Three-Dimensional Directed Percolation to Testable Predictions
papers.abstract: Lightning, the most colossal discharge in nature, and flux avalanches in quantum superconductors--phenomena separated by twenty orders of magnitude in scale--display striking fractal similarity. We demonstrate that this is no mere analogy but reveals a deep physical unity. Here, we establish a universal theoretical framework that connects them. By mapping both onto the same three-dimensional reaction-diffusion-advection equation grounded in non-equilibrium statistical physics, we show they belong to the same critical universality class. We demonstrate that both systems belong to the three-dimensional Directed Percolation (3D-DP) universality class near their critical point, sharing a unified set of universal critical exponents (e.g., avalanche size distribution exponent $τ\approx 1.41$ , fractal dimension $D_f \approx 2.5$). Furthermore, by incorporating the anisotropy and turbulence coupling intrinsic to real thunderstorm environments, we predict novel effects such as anisotropic fractality of lightning channels and the systematic shift of critical exponents by turbulence. The core theoretical breakthrough lies in proposing a geometric correspondence of quantum phase information: through a rigorous mapping, the microscopic quantum phase coherence of superconductors is translated into the curvature and torsion distributions of macroscopic lightning channels, revealing a quantum statistical fingerprint emergent in classical geometry. This framework not only provides a unified paradigm for understanding dissipative structures across scales but also, via seven testable predictions, opens avenues for simulating natural lightning with laboratory quantum systems and developing novel physical early-warning methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mapping、universal theoretical framework、critical universality class、theoretical breakthrough。；研究对象：宏观闪电（自然雷电）与量子超导体中的磁通雪崩现象，两者跨越约20个数量级的尺度，均属于非平衡统计物理中的耗散结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 闪电与量子雪崩属于同一个临界普适类——三维有向渗流（3D-DP）普适类，共享统一的临界指数（如雪崩尺寸分布指数τ≈1.41，分形维数D_f≈2.5）。通过严格的几何对应，超导体的微观量子相位相干性可映射为宏观闪电通道的曲率和扭转分布，揭示出经典几何中涌现的量子统计指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：闪电与量子雪崩属于同一个临界普适类——三维有向渗流（3D-DP）普适类，共享统一的临界指数（如雪崩尺寸分布指数τ≈1.41，分形维数D_f≈2.5）。通过严格的几何对应，超导体的微观量子相位相干性可映射为宏观闪电通道的曲率和扭转分布，揭示出经典几何中涌现的量子统计指纹。；创新点：首次建立闪电与量子雪崩的统一临界标度理论，提出量子相位信息的几何对应映射，将微观量子相干性翻译为宏观闪电通道的几何特征，并给出七条可检验的实验预测。
papers.method_zh: 基于非平衡统计物理，将两个系统映射到同一个三维反应-扩散-平流方程；通过临界点分析确定其属于三维有向渗流普适类；并引入真实雷暴环境中的各向异性和湍流耦合，预测各向异性分形和临界指数系统性偏移等新效应。

papers.title: Nonlinear Ohmic electromagnetic response
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate nonlinear Ohmic responses in second-harmonic generation and bilinear magnetoelectric effects within the Matsubara Green's function formalism. The optical nonlinear Ohmic conductivity is shown to consist of a nonlinear Drude-like part and an intrinsic term determined by the fully symmetrized normalized quantum metric dipole. Notably, we predict a previously unrecognized intrinsic Ohmic conductivity arising from band geometry in the bilinear magnetoelectric response, which exhibits transverse behavior similar to its optical counterpart. Using a two-dimensional Dirac model, we demonstrate that this geometrically induced nonlinear Ohmic response is observable in materials with high Fermi velocity and narrow band gaps. Our work provides a systematic quantum field-theoretic framework for describing nonlinear Ohmic transport in condensed matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据：摘要中明确使用了“Matsubara Green's function formalism”（松原格林函数形式）、“quantum field-theoretic framework”（量子场论框架）等理论方法关键词。；研究对象：凝聚态系统中的非线性欧姆响应，具体包括二次谐波产生（second-harmonic generation）和双线性磁电效应（bilinear magnetoelectric effects）中的非线性输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文揭示了非线性欧姆电导率由两部分构成：一个类似Drude模型的非线性部分，以及一个由完全对称归一化量子度量偶极子（fully symmetrized normalized quantum metric dipole）决定的本质部分。此外，在双线性磁电响应中，预测了一种此前未被认识到的、源于能带几何（band geometry）的本质欧姆电导率，其行为类似于光学响应中的横向效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文揭示了非线性欧姆电导率由两部分构成：一个类似Drude模型的非线性部分，以及一个由完全对称归一化量子度量偶极子（fully symmetrized normalized quantum metric dipole）决定的本质部分。此外，在双线性磁电响应中，预测了一种此前未被认识到的、源于能带几何（band geometry）的本质欧姆电导率，其行为类似于光学响应中的横向效应。；创新点：1. 首次在双线性磁电效应中预测了由能带几何（量子度量）诱导的本质非线性欧姆电导率。2. 为描述凝聚态系统中的非线性欧姆输运提供了一个系统的量子场论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用松原格林函数形式（Matsubara Green’s function formalism）进行系统的量子场论分析。通过一个二维狄拉克模型（two-dimensional Dirac model）进行具体计算和演示。

papers.title: Anomalous Diffusion as Structural Memory: An Extended Structural Dynamics Approach
papers.abstract: Sub-diffusion in biological systems is conventionally treated as anomalous, requiring fractional derivatives, heavy-tailed waiting times, or fitted memory kernels. We argue that this anomaly is an artifact of an incomplete phase space. Standard frameworks model diffusing particles as points. Biological molecules are not points. They are three-dimensional deformable entities whose position, orientation, and internal structure are irreducible physical properties, not modeling conveniences appended to a point mass. Within the Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) framework, each particle is a primitive structured entity with translational, orientational, and deformational degrees of freedom. When dynamics on this full phase space are projected onto the translational subspace alone, a memory kernel emerges from the projection without phenomenological postulate. The subdiffusion exponent is determined by the internal mode spectrum, independently measurable from B-factors, NMR order parameters, or molecular dynamics simulations, without fitting to transport data. Four falsifiable predictions follow: subdiffusion strength correlates with molecular flexibility; temperature drives crossover to normal diffusion at a characteristic energy scale set by internal mode frequencies; a non-zero rotation-translation cross-correlation spectrum encodes internal dynamics, identically zero in point-particle models; and memory timescales scale as the square of particle size. Quantitative consistency with experimental observations for proteins in crowded media is demonstrated using independently estimated structural parameters. What appears anomalous from the point-particle perspective is the expected behavior of structured matter projected onto an impoverished description. The anomaly is not in the physics. It is in the phase space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论框架（Extended Structural Dynamics, ESD），进行数学推导（投影、记忆核），并给出可验证的预测，未提及实验或计算模拟的具体实施。；研究对象：生物大分子（如蛋白质）在拥挤介质中的亚扩散（sub-diffusion）现象，以及其与分子内部结构自由度（平移、取向、形变）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统观点视为“反常”的亚扩散，实际上是忽略分子三维可变形结构（取向、形变自由度）后，将完整相空间动力学投影到平移子空间时自然产生的记忆效应，并非物理本质的异常。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统观点视为“反常”的亚扩散，实际上是忽略分子三维可变形结构（取向、形变自由度）后，将完整相空间动力学投影到平移子空间时自然产生的记忆效应，并非物理本质的异常。；创新点：提出亚扩散并非需要分数阶导数或拟合记忆核的“反常”现象，而是由于相空间描述不完整（将分子视为质点）导致的人为假象；首次将亚扩散指数与分子内部结构参数（如柔性、内部模式频率）直接定量关联，无需拟合输运数据即可预测。
papers.method_zh: Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) 理论框架：将每个粒子视为具有平移、取向和形变自由度的原始结构化实体，通过将完整相空间动力学投影到平移子空间，自然导出记忆核，并利用内部模式谱（可从B因子、NMR序参数或分子动力学模拟独立测量）确定亚扩散指数。

papers.title: Resonant two-cluster scattering in a quasi-one-dimensional Bose gas
papers.abstract: We investigate two-cluster scattering in a quasi-one-dimensional Bose gas. We focus on the effective three-body interaction induced by transverse confinement, which is the leading term for breaking integrability in the quasi-one-dimensional setting. Exploiting the Lüscher formula and the integrability of the Lieb-Liniger Bose gas, we find a finite and positive scattering length for elastic two-cluster scattering. The resulting scattering lengths indicate the emergence of a resonance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate, exploiting the Lüscher formula, integrability。；研究对象：准一维玻色气体中的两团簇散射过程，特别是由横向束缚诱导的有效三体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用Lüscher公式和Lieb-Liniger模型的可积性，发现弹性两团簇散射的散射长度是有限且为正的，这表明存在一个共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用Lüscher公式和Lieb-Liniger模型的可积性，发现弹性两团簇散射的散射长度是有限且为正的，这表明存在一个共振。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体利用了Lüscher公式（一种将有限体积能谱与无限体积散射长度联系起来的理论工具）和Lieb-Liniger模型（一维可积玻色气体的精确解）的可积性。

papers.title: Field Theory Models for a Holographic Superconductor in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: We investigate field theory models of holographic superconductors in which the condensation of the order parameter is induced by a Robin boundary condition. Assuming large-$c$ factorization, we study the phase diagram of a two-dimensional CFT deformed by a relevant double-trace perturbation. Using modular invariance, we relate the high- and low-temperature phases, reproducing analytically the results for the zero-winding sector of the holographic model. Moreover, we match the near-critical behaviour of the condensate with an effective Ginzburg--Landau field theory description. Another important feature of the holographic superconductor is the presence of vortices that carry fractional magnetic flux. We investigate a field theory toy model with similar properties and interpret it as a fractional Little--Parks effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：field theory models、holographic superconductor、modular invariance、Ginzburg--Landau field theory。；研究对象：二维全息超导体的场论模型，具体研究由Robin边界条件诱导的序参量凝聚、双迹形变下的二维CFT相图、以及携带分数磁通涡旋的Little–Parks效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过模不变性解析地重现了全息模型中零绕数扇区的结果，并发现凝聚体的近临界行为可用有效Ginzburg–Landau场论描述；此外，在场论玩具模型中实现了类似全息超导体的分数磁通涡旋，解释为分数Little–Parks效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过模不变性解析地重现了全息模型中零绕数扇区的结果，并发现凝聚体的近临界行为可用有效Ginzburg–Landau场论描述；此外，在场论玩具模型中实现了类似全息超导体的分数磁通涡旋，解释为分数Little–Parks效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用大c因子化假设下的二维CFT双迹形变理论，利用模不变性关联高低温相，并结合有效Ginzburg–Landau场论描述近临界行为；对涡旋部分构建了具有类似性质的场论玩具模型。

papers.title: Pointwise Generalization in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We address the fundamental question of why deep neural networks generalize by establishing a pointwise generalization theory for fully connected networks. This framework resolves long-standing barriers to characterizing the rich nonlinear feature-learning regime and builds a new statistical foundation for representation learning. For each trained model, we characterize the hypothesis via a pointwise Riemannian Dimension, derived from the eigenvalues of the learned feature representations across layers. This establishes a principled framework for deriving hypothesis-dependent, representation-aware generalization bounds. These bounds offer a systematic upgrade over approaches based on model size, products of norms, and infinite-width linearizations, yielding guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter in both theory and experiment. Analytically, we identify the structural properties and mathematical principles that explain the tractability of deep networks. Empirically, the pointwise Riemannian Dimension exhibits substantial feature compression, decreases with increased over-parameterization, and captures the implicit bias of optimizers. Taken together, our results indicate that deep networks are mathematically tractable in practical regimes and that their generalization is sharply explained by pointwise, feature-spectrum-aware complexity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：generalization theory, statistical foundation, analytical identification）；研究对象：深度神经网络（全连接网络）的泛化能力，属于机器学习理论范畴，非传统凝聚态物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于逐点黎曼维数（pointwise Riemannian Dimension）的泛化理论，该理论能够解释深度神经网络在非线性特征学习机制下的泛化行为，并给出比传统方法（如基于模型大小、范数乘积等）紧致数个数量级的泛化界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于逐点黎曼维数（pointwise Riemannian Dimension）的泛化理论，该理论能够解释深度神经网络在非线性特征学习机制下的泛化行为，并给出比传统方法（如基于模型大小、范数乘积等）紧致数个数量级的泛化界。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统凝聚态物理理论的直接关联，但其核心创新在于：1）建立了一个能够描述深度网络丰富非线性特征学习机制的逐点泛化理论框架；2）提出了一个可计算的、依赖于具体训练模型（假设）和特征表示的复杂度度量（逐点黎曼维数），从而实现了比现有理论（如无限宽线性化）更紧致的泛化保证。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过分析训练后网络各层学习到的特征表示的谱（特征值），定义逐点黎曼维数，并以此构建依赖于假设和表示结构的泛化界。实验验证：在训练后的网络上计算该维数，观察其随过参数化程度增加而降低、捕捉优化器隐式偏差等特性。

papers.title: Krylov complexity and fidelity susceptibility in two-band Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: We investigate Krylov spread complexity for the ground state of two-band Hamiltonians, where the reference state is a generic state on the Bloch sphere. The spread complexity is obtained by using a purely geometric formulation in terms of Bloch sphere data without constructing the circuit Hamiltonian. For generic reference states, the derivative of the spread complexity is logarithmically divergent at the topological phase transition in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. We demonstrate that the derivative of the spread complexity is bounded by fidelity susceptibility for general two-band models, indicating the sensitivity of the spread complexity to any gap closing (topological or trivial). This is illustrated in the massive Dirac Hamiltonian with a trivial gap closing. Finally, we introduce a non-unitary duality in the SSH model between the topological and trivial phases, which manifests itself in the spread complexity and fidelity susceptibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：几何公式、非幺正对偶性、模型分析（无实验或计算模拟细节）。；研究对象：两带哈密顿量（如Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型、大质量狄拉克哈密顿量）中的基态Krylov扩展复杂度与保真度磁化率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SSH模型拓扑相变处，扩展复杂度的导数呈对数发散；对于一般两带模型，扩展复杂度的导数受保真度磁化率上界约束，表明其对任何能隙闭合（拓扑或平庸）均敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SSH模型拓扑相变处，扩展复杂度的导数呈对数发散；对于一般两带模型，扩展复杂度的导数受保真度磁化率上界约束，表明其对任何能隙闭合（拓扑或平庸）均敏感。；创新点：建立了Krylov扩展复杂度与保真度磁化率之间的解析上界关系，并揭示了SSH模型中拓扑/平庸相之间的非幺正对偶性在扩展复杂度与保真度磁化率中的体现。
papers.method_zh: 基于布洛赫球数据的纯几何公式推导Krylov扩展复杂度，无需构造电路哈密顿量；通过SSH模型和大质量狄拉克哈密顿量进行理论验证；引入非幺正对偶性联系拓扑相与平庸相。

papers.title: A Practical Noise2Noise Denoising Pipeline for High-Throughput Raman Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: A lightweight and reproducible denoising pipeline for high-throughput Raman spectroscopy is presented. The approach relies on a one-dimensional convolutional autoencoder trained using a Noise2Noise strategy, requiring neither external spectral libraries nor high signal-to-noise reference spectra for training. From a reduced training subset composed of repeated short-exposure acquisitions, the model learns to reconstruct Raman spectra while efficiently suppressing stochastic noise. The method is evaluated on a heterogeneous mineral sample, using both quantitative spectral fidelity metrics (RMSE, SNR, SSIM) and task-oriented criteria based on unsupervised K-means classification. Results demonstrate that integration times as short as 5 ms per spectrum, which are typically insufficient for reliable interpretation, yield denoised spectra with high fidelity to the reference data while preserving chemically coherent maps. This work provides a practical trade-off between spectral quality and acquisition speed, enabling fast, adaptable Raman workflows compatible with routine laboratory use. It also offers a transferable framework for other one-dimensional spectroscopic modalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：denoising pipeline、Raman spectroscopy、experimental evaluation。；研究对象：高吞吐量拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy），具体应用于异质矿物样品（heterogeneous mineral sample）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于Noise2Noise策略的一维卷积自编码器去噪流程，能够在仅使用短曝光重复采集数据（如每光谱5毫秒）的情况下，有效抑制随机噪声，重建出与参考数据高度保真的拉曼光谱，并保持化学一致性图谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于Noise2Noise策略的一维卷积自编码器去噪流程，能够在仅使用短曝光重复采集数据（如每光谱5毫秒）的情况下，有效抑制随机噪声，重建出与参考数据高度保真的拉曼光谱，并保持化学一致性图谱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用一维卷积自编码器（1D convolutional autoencoder），通过Noise2Noise策略进行训练，无需外部光谱库或高信噪比参考光谱。训练数据来自重复短曝光采集的缩减子集。评估使用定量光谱保真度指标（RMSE、SNR、SSIM）和基于无监督K-means分类的任务导向标准。

papers.title: Quantum Emitters at Telecommunication Wavelengths based on Carbon Defects in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional materials have emerged as promising hosts for quantum emitters, whose emission typically arises from either strain-induced band bending or defect-induced two-level systems. Among these materials, transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers have attracted particular attention; however, their performance is limited by strong photoluminescence (PL) quenching at room temperature. As TMDs transition from a direct to an indirect bandgap when moving from monolayers to multilayers, we herein propose a strategy to overcome this quenching limitation by exploiting the indirect bandgap of TMD bilayers in combination with a point defect doping. The indirect gap suppresses excitonic PL, while specific defects enable robust defect-mediated quantum emission. Using hybrid-functional density functional theory, we investigate substitutional carbon defects at chalcogen sites (S and Se) in WS2, WSe2, MoS2, and MoSe2 bilayers and comprehensively characterize their optical properties. Both neutral and singly negative charge states are found to be thermodynamically stable. Neutral defects exhibit singlet configurations with emission in the O- and C-band telecommunication windows, whereas negatively charged defects adopt doublet configurations featuring spin-selective transitions and near-infrared emission. The electron-phonon coupling strength, radiative lifetime, and dipole orientation are found to depend sensitively on both the host material and defect site, providing distinct fingerprints for experimental identification. Our findings, therefore, establish carbon-doped TMD bilayers as promising platforms for room-temperature defect-based quantum emitters operating at telecommunication wavelengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“hybrid-functional density functional theory”（杂化泛函密度泛函理论）、“investigate”、“comprehensively characterize”。；研究对象：过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）双层中的替位碳缺陷（取代硫族元素S或Se），具体材料体系包括WS₂、WSe₂、MoS₂和MoSe₂双层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碳掺杂的TMD双层在室温下可成为基于缺陷的量子发射体，其发射波长覆盖电信O波段和C波段，且中性缺陷和带负电缺陷分别表现出单重态和双重态构型，具有不同的光学特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碳掺杂的TMD双层在室温下可成为基于缺陷的量子发射体，其发射波长覆盖电信O波段和C波段，且中性缺陷和带负电缺陷分别表现出单重态和双重态构型，具有不同的光学特性。；创新点：提出利用TMD双层从直接带隙转变为间接带隙的特性，结合点缺陷掺杂，克服单层TMD在室温下光致发光淬灭的局限，从而实现室温电信波段量子发射。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函密度泛函理论（hybrid-functional DFT）计算，系统研究了碳缺陷在四种TMD双层中的电子结构、光学跃迁、电子-声子耦合强度、辐射寿命和偶极取向。

papers.title: Quantum magic of strongly correlated fermions $-$ the Hubbard dimer
papers.abstract: We study the non-stabilizerness (quantum magic) content of the Hubbard dimer, an analytically solvable, yet completely non-trivial, model of strongly correlated fermions. We can access zero- and finite-temperature properties as well as the time evolution in a quantum quench protocol. We evaluate local and nonlocal non-stabilizerness using both the robustness of magic and the stabilizer Renyi entropy, demonstrating how the latter often fails in detecting the mixed stabilizer states that are typically found in this kind of systems. Finally, we compare the non-stabilizerness with other genuine resources of quantum-state complexity, i.e., the fermionic non-Gaussianity and the superselected two-site entanglement. Our findings corroborate the notion of non-stabilizerness as a fundamentally different quantum resource, able to give profound insights that are missed by more traditional information-theoretic quantities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically solvable（可解析求解）、evaluate（评估）、compare（比较）。；研究对象：Hubbard dimer（哈伯德二聚体），一个可解析求解但非平凡的强关联费米子模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文揭示了强关联费米子体系中非稳定化子（quantum magic）与费米子非高斯性、超选择两体纠缠等量子态复杂性资源本质不同，能够提供传统信息论量所遗漏的深刻见解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文揭示了强关联费米子体系中非稳定化子（quantum magic）与费米子非高斯性、超选择两体纠缠等量子态复杂性资源本质不同，能够提供传统信息论量所遗漏的深刻见解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析求解方法，计算了零温、有限温性质以及量子淬火协议下的时间演化；使用鲁棒性（robustness of magic）和稳定子Rényi熵（stabilizer Renyi entropy）两种度量来评估局域和非局域的非稳定化子含量。

papers.title: Topologically protected long-range correlations in steady states of driven-dissipative bosonic chains
papers.abstract: Driven-dissipative quantum systems can exhibit robust transport and amplification in topological regimes, yet the connection between topology and the extent of correlations remains largely unexplored. In this work, we develop a general framework that links topological phases in driven-dissipative systems to bosonic correlations via the singular value decomposition (SVD). In essence, we claim that non-Hermitian topology in quadratic Liouvillians is directly encoded in steady-state correlations, providing an intrinsic characterization of topology without external probes. We show that topological amplification induces disorder-robust long-range order (LRO) in steady-state correlations at fixed frequency, establishing frequency-resolved correlations as direct signatures of non-Hermitian topological phases. We introduce a vector-valued topological invariant that captures the total number of singular-value gap closings across the frequency axis, extending the concept of adiabatic deformation from topological insulators to the case of topological phases of quadratic Liouvillians. Within this framework, we further demonstrate that the spatial structure of equal-time correlations encodes global topological information, manifested as a Gaussian spatial decay with distance in the topological phase, in contrast to the exponential decay characteristic of trivial phases. These findings open new avenues for quantum sensing and correlation engineering in non-Hermitian systems, with feasible implementations in platforms such as trapped ions and superconducting circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a general framework、claim、introduce、demonstrate。；研究对象：驱动-耗散玻色子链的稳态，具体研究非厄米拓扑相与玻色子关联函数之间的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米拓扑相直接编码在稳态关联函数中，拓扑放大效应可在固定频率下产生抗无序的长程有序（LRO），而等时关联函数的空间结构在拓扑相中呈现高斯衰减，在平庸相中则是指数衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米拓扑相直接编码在稳态关联函数中，拓扑放大效应可在固定频率下产生抗无序的长程有序（LRO），而等时关联函数的空间结构在拓扑相中呈现高斯衰减，在平庸相中则是指数衰减。；创新点：首次提出非厄米拓扑相可直接从稳态关联函数中内在表征，无需外部探针；建立了频率分辨关联作为非厄米拓扑相直接标志的理论；揭示了等时关联的空间结构携带全局拓扑信息。
papers.method_zh: 通过奇异值分解（SVD）建立驱动-耗散系统中拓扑相与玻色子关联之间的通用理论框架；引入矢量值拓扑不变量来刻画频率轴上奇异值能隙闭合的总数，将拓扑绝缘体中的绝热形变概念推广至二次Liouvillian的拓扑相。

papers.title: A single multi-configuration Direct Electron Detector for various electron imaging and diffraction-based techniques in SEM
papers.abstract: Addressing the need for efficient and integrated multiscale crystallographic and defect analyses of advanced materials, this paper presents the implementation of a new multi-configuration detection system, integrating a single Timepix3-based direct electron detector (DED) in a scanning electron microscope (SEM). By combining precise translation and rotation movements, this system enables, for the first time, the use of the same detector to realize all principal diffraction geometries. These include conventional Electron BackScatter Diffraction (EBSD), off-axis Reflexion Kikuchi Diffraction (RKD), and Transmission Kikuchi Diffraction (TKD) in on-, off- and near-axis configurations. Furthermore, transitions between all these geometries are accomplished without hardware modification. On the other hand, this work presents efficient reconstruction of electron images using the detector data-driven feature, extending thus its applicability to BackScattered Electron imaging (BSE), Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging (ECCI) and Scanning Transmission Electron Imaging in SEM (STEM-in-SEM) characterizations. High-quality Kikuchi patterns easily indexable were acquired across all geometries as well as micrographs of dislocations in both reflection and transmission modes. This is achieved thanks to the flexibility of the implemented detector, the optimizations made in acquisition parameters, such as energy filtering settings, and the efficiency of the developed custom approach used for electron data post-processing. Through this work, it is demonstrated that with a single DED assisted by an orientable support, it is possible to perform multiple advanced microstructural characterizations of both bulk samples and thin foils in the same SEM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：implementation、detection system、acquired、micrographs。；研究对象：扫描电子显微镜（SEM）中用于多尺度晶体学和缺陷分析的多构型直接电子探测器（DED）系统，涉及块体样品和薄箔的多种电子成像与衍射技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将单个基于Timepix3的直接电子探测器与可定向支撑（平移和旋转）结合，首次实现了在同一SEM中使用同一探测器完成所有主要衍射几何（包括EBSD、RKD、TKD的多种构型）以及多种电子成像模式（BSE、ECCI、STEM-in-SEM），且无需硬件修改即可切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将单个基于Timepix3的直接电子探测器与可定向支撑（平移和旋转）结合，首次实现了在同一SEM中使用同一探测器完成所有主要衍射几何（包括EBSD、RKD、TKD的多种构型）以及多种电子成像模式（BSE、ECCI、STEM-in-SEM），且无需硬件修改即可切换。；创新点：首次使用单个直接电子探测器（DED）结合可定向支撑，在不修改硬件的情况下实现所有主要衍射几何的切换，并同时覆盖多种电子成像模式，实现了同一SEM中对块体和薄箔样品的高效多尺度微结构表征。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：在SEM中集成基于Timepix3的直接电子探测器，配合精确平移和旋转运动；优化采集参数（如能量过滤设置）；开发自定义电子数据后处理方法。具体技术包括：EBSD、RKD、TKD（on-/off-/near-axis）、BSE、ECCI、STEM-in-SEM。

papers.title: Physics in the Public Square: University Extension as a Strategy for Integrating Physics Education and Science Communication
papers.abstract: University extension activities play a fundamental role in bridging the gap between academia and society by fostering the socialization of scientific knowledge. This study reports and analyzes an outreach activity conducted in a public space, involving undergraduate students enrolled in Physics I, Physics III, and Physics IV courses within the Physics Teacher Education Program at the State University of the Tocantina Region of Maranhao (UEMASUL). The activity was developed through the design and presentation of didactic experiments using low-cost materials. Its main objectives were to disseminate fundamental physics concepts to the community, stimulate public interest in science, and provide pre-service teachers with a formative experience integrating theory, practice, and social responsibility. Data were collected from questionnaires adminisvelopment of communication skills, and the strengthening of the university's social role, while also fostering scientific curitered to visitors (n = 52). The results indicate that the activity significantly contributed to student learning, the deosity among participants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（教育实践与科学传播研究）。关键词：outreach activity（外展活动）、questionnaires（问卷调查）、data collected（数据收集）。；研究对象：大学物理教育中的科学传播活动，具体为巴西马拉尼昂州托坎廷纳地区州立大学（UEMASUL）物理教师教育项目中本科生在公共空间开展的物理实验演示与互动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该外展活动显著促进了本科生的学习、沟通技能发展以及大学社会角色的强化，同时提升了参与公众的科学好奇心。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该外展活动显著促进了本科生的学习、沟通技能发展以及大学社会角色的强化，同时提升了参与公众的科学好奇心。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用低成本的教具实验设计与演示，结合问卷调查（n=52）收集访客反馈数据，对活动效果进行定量与定性分析。

papers.title: Dissipation-assisted preparation of Floquet-Laughlin states in superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) are lattice analogs of fractional quantum Hall systems, where the interplay of strong interactions with a frustrated tunnelling kinetics leads to the emergence of a gapped ground state with long-range entanglement and anyonic excitations. The highly correlated nature of such systems makes their adiabatic preparation challenging already beyond the minimal system size of two particles. Considering Floquet implementations of the bosonic Harper-Hofstadter-Hubbard model of few photons in superconducting circuits, we design protocols for the driven-dissipative stabilization of its FCI ground state at half filling via quantum bath engineering. Dissipation control is achieved through the coupling to driven leaky cavity modes, which realize a tuneable artificial environment having the Floquet-FCI as its approximate fixed point. For systems of two, three and six particles, we show numerically how the flexibility of the control scheme further allows for the detection of fractional quantum Hall signatures in the stabilized steady states, including bulk incompressibility, Hall response and the trapping of fractional charges. Our results provide a concrete pathway to dissipation-assisted preparation of strongly correlated states in quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：设计协议、数值展示、量子浴工程。；研究对象：基于超导电路的Floquet实现中的玻色子Harper-Hofstadter-Hubbard模型，具体研究其分数量子霍尔（FQH）基态（即Floquet-Laughlin态）的耗散辅助制备。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将Floquet分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）态设计为可调谐人工环境的近似不动点，利用驱动-耗散稳定化协议，可以在2、3和6个粒子的系统中数值上实现该强关联基态，并观测到体态不可压缩性、霍尔响应和分数电荷俘获等分数量子霍尔特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将Floquet分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）态设计为可调谐人工环境的近似不动点，利用驱动-耗散稳定化协议，可以在2、3和6个粒子的系统中数值上实现该强关联基态，并观测到体态不可压缩性、霍尔响应和分数电荷俘获等分数量子霍尔特征。；创新点：提出了一种通过耗散辅助而非绝热过程来制备Floquet-FCI基态的具体协议，并展示了其在超导电路量子模拟器中的可行性，克服了强关联系统绝热制备的困难。摘要未突出说明与以往耗散制备方案相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子浴工程方法，通过将系统耦合到驱动的有损耗腔模来构建可调谐人工环境，实现耗散控制。使用数值模拟验证协议在有限粒子数系统中的有效性。

papers.title: Localization of a quantum particle in a classical one-component plasma. Fluctuation-induced random potential and the Coulomb logarithm
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of disorder-induced localization for a quantum particle moving in a fully ionized classical one-component plasma, within the static-fluctuation approximation. The random potential acting on the particle originates from equilibrium thermal fluctuations of the ionic charge density, described within the random phase approximation (RPA). The resulting potential correlation function exhibits an unscreened $1/r$ tail at large distances, leading to a logarithmic divergence of the integrated disorder strength. Using the Feynman path-integral representation of the retarded Green's function and performing the Gaussian average over the fluctuations exactly, we obtain closed-form expressions for the length scale $\ell(k)$ that characterizes the exponential decay of the disorder-averaged Green's function, with Planck's constant fully restored. In the weak-disorder (high-energy) regime, $\ell(k) = \hbar^4 k^2 / [m^2 k_B T q_0^2 \ln(κL)]$; in the strong-disorder (low-energy) limit, $\ell = \frac{4\sqrt[3]{2}}{3} \big( \hbar^4 / [m^2 k_B T q_0^2 \ln(κL)] \big)^{1/3}$. Both limits contain the Coulomb logarithm $\ln(κL)$, providing a direct link between quantum localization and classical plasma kinetic theory. We also discuss the limitations of the static-disorder approximation and the role of dynamic screening in real plasmas.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：微观理论、静态涨落近似、费曼路径积分、高斯平均。；研究对象：经典单组分等离子体中一个量子粒子的无序诱导局域化现象，具体研究由离子电荷密度热涨落产生的随机势对量子粒子局域化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱无序（高能）和强无序（低能）两种极限下，无序平均格林函数的指数衰减长度均包含库仑对数项 \(\ln(κL)\)，建立了量子局域化与经典等离子体动理论之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱无序（高能）和强无序（低能）两种极限下，无序平均格林函数的指数衰减长度均包含库仑对数项 \(\ln(κL)\)，建立了量子局域化与经典等离子体动理论之间的直接联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用静态涨落近似，利用随机相位近似描述离子电荷密度的平衡热涨落，通过费曼路径积分表示推迟格林函数，并对涨落进行精确高斯平均，推导出衰减长度 \(\ell(k)\) 的闭合表达式。

papers.title: Where solitons are in a KdV soliton gas
papers.abstract: The Korteweg-De Vries (KdV) equation is a paradigmatic model of integrable classical fields, admitting solitoning solutions. When many solitons are near to each other, their shapes are modified, and it is not manifest, from the KdV field, where they are. This is a key problem in the analysis of a soliton gas, as its main object, the density of states, is a number of solitons per unit length. How to define solitons' positions at finite densities in the macroscopic limit? A sensible criterium is that, projecting out solitons lying outside a mesoscopic region, the KdV field is unchanged in this region, and the result is a multi-soliton field supported there. In the context of emergent hydrodynamics, this is referred to as a fluid-cell projection. In this paper we solve this problem. We define solitons' positions and a fluid-cell projection, and show that it has these properties, without introducing radiative corrections. We show that the weak limit of conserved densities can be evaluated using the density of states. On large scales the solitons' positions satisfy the semi-classical Bethe equations introduced in the context Generalised Hydrodynamics, that accounts for the two-body scattering shift and encodes factorised scattering. A non-rigorous derivation reproduces the kinetic equation of the KdV soliton gas, first proposed by Gennady El in 2003 using Witham modulation theory from finite-gap solutions. The results hold under simple conditions on spectral parameters, and certain physically natural conditions on impact parameters. No randomness is required. Our proof is based on a novel tau function for the multi-soliton KdV field, which also allows us to obtain new bounds on the growth of the multi-soliton support and on the supremum of the field and its derivatives. We believe the methods are generalisable to other solitonic models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：KdV方程、可积系统、孤子气体、流体元投影、半经典Bethe方程、动力学方程、tau函数。；研究对象：KdV孤子气体中孤子的位置定义问题，即在有限密度下如何从KdV场中确定每个孤子的空间位置，以及如何构建流体元投影。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需引入辐射修正的孤子位置定义和流体元投影方法，证明了该投影下KdV场在流体元内保持不变；并证明在大尺度下孤子位置满足广义流体动力学中的半经典Bethe方程，从而非严格地推导出KdV孤子气体的动力学方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需引入辐射修正的孤子位置定义和流体元投影方法，证明了该投影下KdV场在流体元内保持不变；并证明在大尺度下孤子位置满足广义流体动力学中的半经典Bethe方程，从而非严格地推导出KdV孤子气体的动力学方程。；创新点：首次严格解决了KdV孤子气体中孤子位置的定义问题，并建立了流体元投影的数学框架，无需随机性假设；引入的新型tau函数还给出了多孤子支撑增长及场及其导数上界的新界限。
papers.method_zh: 基于多孤子KdV场的tau函数新形式，利用弱极限和密度泛函分析，在宏观极限下定义孤子位置和流体元投影，并证明其性质；通过半经典Bethe方程描述两体散射位移，推导出孤子气体的动力学方程。

papers.title: Chern classes of Laughlin bundles on the quasihole moduli space
papers.abstract: We study fractional quantum Hall states with quasihole excitations, on Riemann surfaces of arbitrary genus. For configurations with $m$ quasiholes we construct a vector bundle above the $m$-th symmetric power of the curve so that the fiber at a point $\lbrace w_1,\dots,w_m \rbrace$ corresponds to the state with quasiholes localized at these positions. We determine the Chern character of this bundle via the Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem and show that in the completely filled state, i.e. when the number of particles is maximal, the vector bundle is compatible with the condition of projective flatness. Furthermore, we obtain a generalization of this result to the case of multiple layers and multiple quasihole types. In genus zero and one, we construct explicit wave-functions and verify that the curvature of the associated Chern connection reproduces the predicted Chern classes. The Chern classes obtained match, term by term, the predicted decomposition of the Berry phase under quasihole exchange, into an extensive Aharonov--Bohm contribution and a fractional statistical contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“construct a vector bundle”“determine the Chern character via the Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem”“construct explicit wave-functions”等理论构造与数学推导方法。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应中的准空穴激发态，特别是定义在任意亏格黎曼曲面上的分数量子霍尔态，以及准空穴模空间上的向量丛结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch定理确定了准空穴模空间上向量丛的陈特征，并证明在完全填充态（粒子数最大时）该向量丛满足投影平坦性条件；所得陈类与准空穴交换下Berry相位的分解（广延Aharonov-Bohm贡献与分数统计贡献）逐项匹配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch定理确定了准空穴模空间上向量丛的陈特征，并证明在完全填充态（粒子数最大时）该向量丛满足投影平坦性条件；所得陈类与准空穴交换下Berry相位的分解（广延Aharonov-Bohm贡献与分数统计贡献）逐项匹配。；创新点：将准空穴模空间上的向量丛构造推广到任意亏格黎曼曲面，并进一步推广到多层与多类准空穴情形；首次在一般亏格下严格证明投影平坦性条件与陈类分解的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用代数几何中的向量丛构造与Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch定理计算陈特征；在亏格0和1情形下构造显式波函数，并验证Chern联络的曲率与预测陈类一致。

papers.title: Parameterized 4-Qubit EWL Quantum Game Circuits with Dirac-Solow-Swan Hamiltonian Integration for Quadruple Helix Disruptive Innovation Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: We present a novel parameterized 4-qubit Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein (EWL) quantum game circuit for recommender systems in quadruple helix innovation ecosystems (academia, industry, government, and civil society). The local strategy operators $U_{i} = R_y(θ_{i})$ for each helix actor are directly tuned by normalized dominance weights extracted from real participant funding data (\texit{ecContribution}) in the European Commission CORDIS Horizon Europe database (project COVend, ID 101045956). The circuit employs a multi-qubit EWL entangler followed by parameterized local rotations, inverse entangler, and full measurement, achieving only 22 gates and circuit depth 11 while scaling as $O(n)$ for $n$-round helix communications. Measurement probabilities after the quantum game serve as recommender scores for disruptive versus sustaining innovation trends. These scores are subsequently mapped into the diagonal Dirac potential of a Dirac-Solow-Swan Hamiltonian, enabling time-evolution simulation of capital accumulation and bifurcation dynamics under disruptive innovation. Numerical experiments on real CORDIS quadruple-helix collaboration networks demonstrate the circuit's NISQ compatibility and its ability to forecast disruptive capital trajectories with high fidelity. The proposed framework bridges quantum game theory, parameterized quantum circuits, and relativistic economic growth models, offering a computationally efficient tool for innovation policy and strategic decision-making in complex socio-economic ecosystems. Complexity analysis and reproducibility are provided through open Qiskit implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。关键词：量子博弈电路、参数化量子电路、数值实验、Qiskit实现。；研究对象：论文研究的是基于4量子比特EWL量子博弈电路的推荐系统，应用于四螺旋创新生态系统（学术界、产业界、政府、公民社会）中的颠覆性创新预测与资本演化动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该参数化量子电路仅用22个门和深度11即可实现O(n)扩展，并在真实CORDIS四螺旋合作网络数据上成功预测颠覆性资本轨迹，具有高保真度和NISQ兼容性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该参数化量子电路仅用22个门和深度11即可实现O(n)扩展，并在真实CORDIS四螺旋合作网络数据上成功预测颠覆性资本轨迹，具有高保真度和NISQ兼容性。；创新点：将量子博弈理论、参数化量子电路与相对论经济增长模型（Dirac-Solow-Swan哈密顿量）相结合，构建了一个用于复杂社会经济生态系统创新政策与战略决策的计算高效工具。摘要未突出说明与已有量子推荐系统或经济模型相比的具体改进。
papers.method_zh: 采用Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein（EWL）量子博弈框架，构建4量子比特参数化电路；局域策略算符U_i = R_y(θ_i)由来自欧盟CORDIS Horizon Europe数据库的真实参与者资助数据（ecContribution）提取的归一化支配权重直接调节；电路包含多量子比特纠缠器、参数化局域旋转、逆纠缠器及全测量；测量概率作为推荐分数，映射到Dirac-Solow-Swan哈密顿量的对角Dirac势中，用于模拟资本积累与分岔动力学的时间演化。数值实验基于真实CORDIS四螺旋合作网络数据，并提供了开源Qiskit实现。

papers.title: Electrolyte flows under magnetic fields: Manning-like counterion condensation in one dimension
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical framework for unidirectional electromagnetohydrodynamic flow of dilute electrolytes under perpendicular magnetic fields. Starting from the Navier--Stokes equation coupled with the Poisson--Nernst--Planck formulation, we show that the problem admits a sequential decoupling: the Stokes equation is solved first to obtain the velocity profile, which defines a hydrodynamic potential entering the Nernst--Planck description of ions. This Lorentz-force-induced potential competes with electrostatic attraction and significantly alters ionic distributions. We analyze this mechanism in two canonical geometries. In planar Couette shear, it produces a Manning--Oosawa-like condensation transition in one dimension, a phenomenon absent in classical electrostatics. We derive an eigenvalue equation predicting a sharp threshold between counterion enrichment and depletion at the charged wall. In cylindrical Taylor--Couette flow, the same effect shifts the classical Manning criterion by a magnetic parameter, enabling tunable control of condensation. These findings extend Manning--Oosawa phenomenology to driven, non-equilibrium systems and provide a basis for magnetic manipulation of screening in electrolytes, with implications for microfluidics, electrochemical systems, and nonlinear boundary-value theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”、“we show”、“we derive”、“we analyze”。；研究对象：稀薄电解质在垂直磁场作用下的单向电磁流体动力学流动，具体研究平面Couette剪切流和圆柱Taylor-Couette流两种几何构型中的离子分布与凝聚行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在平面Couette剪切流中，洛伦兹力诱导的流体动力学势与静电吸引竞争，导致一维Manning-Oosawa-like反离子凝聚转变；在圆柱Taylor-Couette流中，该效应通过一个磁参数移动经典Manning判据，实现对凝聚的可调控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在平面Couette剪切流中，洛伦兹力诱导的流体动力学势与静电吸引竞争，导致一维Manning-Oosawa-like反离子凝聚转变；在圆柱Taylor-Couette流中，该效应通过一个磁参数移动经典Manning判据，实现对凝聚的可调控制。；创新点：将Manning-Oosawa凝聚现象从平衡态静电学扩展至非平衡驱动系统，揭示了磁场诱导的流体动力学势可产生经典静电学中不存在的一维凝聚转变，并提供了通过磁场调控电解质屏蔽效应的理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用Navier-Stokes方程与Poisson-Nernst-Planck公式耦合的理论框架，通过顺序解耦方法：先求解Stokes方程获得速度剖面，再定义流体动力学势进入Nernst-Planck描述，最终推导出预测反离子富集与耗尽之间尖锐阈值的本征值方程。

papers.title: Probing Tensor Singularities and Their Euler-Class Descendants via Non-Abelian Quantum Geometry Measurement
papers.abstract: We report the theoretical prediction and experimental observation of a new class of four-dimensional (4D) tensor singularities and their three-dimensional (3D) Euler-class descendants, protected by chiral and spacetime inversion symmetries on a superconducting circuit platform. The 4D point-like singularity/monopole, characterized by the Dixmier-Douady class of a real bundle gerbe associated with tensor gauge fields, is observed to evolve into a nodal ring carrying an additional first Euler class charge under symmetry-preserving perturbations. Dimensional reduction reveals 3D Euler and Euler curvature dipoles, exhibiting nontrivial Euler topology and a topological sum rule that ensures zero-energy flat bands inherit nontrivial topology even without interactions. Crucially, these high-dimensional degenerate systems are mapped and reconstructed using a hybrid analog-digital protocol designed for non-Abelian quantum geometry measurement within a superconducting qubit array. Our work not only expands the family of topological monopoles but also establishes a robust experimental framework for exploring high-order gauge theory and real-bundle topology across diverse quantum platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论预测 + 实验观测）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical prediction and experimental observation”，并描述了在超导电路平台上的实验实现。；研究对象：四维（4D）张量奇点及其三维（3D）欧拉类衍生拓扑结构，具体在超导量子比特阵列平台上实现，受手性和时空反演对称性保护。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类由Dixmier-Douady类表征的四维点状张量奇点/单极子，在对称性保持微扰下可演化为携带第一欧拉类电荷的节环；通过维度约化得到三维欧尔偶极子，并揭示零能平带继承非平凡拓扑的拓扑求和规则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类由Dixmier-Douady类表征的四维点状张量奇点/单极子，在对称性保持微扰下可演化为携带第一欧拉类电荷的节环；通过维度约化得到三维欧尔偶极子，并揭示零能平带继承非平凡拓扑的拓扑求和规则。；创新点：首次在实验上观测到四维张量奇点及其欧拉类衍生结构，并建立了基于非阿贝尔量子几何测量的通用实验框架，用于探索高阶规范理论和实丛拓扑。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：实丛格（real bundle gerbe）与Dixmier-Douady类、欧拉类拓扑理论；实验手段：超导量子比特阵列上的混合模数混合协议（hybrid analog-digital protocol），用于非阿贝尔量子几何测量。

papers.title: Pole Skipping, Avoided Crossing, and Resonant Excitation in Kerr Quasinormal Modes near Algebraically Special Frequencies
papers.abstract: Kerr quasinormal modes near algebraically special frequencies exhibit anomalous behavior, including apparent bifurcation, disappearance, and a nonsmooth connection to the Schwarzschild limit, which has remained puzzling for decades. Tracking poles and zeros of Green-function building blocks across different Riemann sheets, we show that the bifurcation is due to an avoided crossing accompanied by resonant excitation, while the disappearance is due to pole skipping caused by cancellation of a quasinormal-mode pole by a Matsubara-mode zero. This resolves the physical origin of these long-standing anomalies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quasinormal modes（准正则模）、Green-function building blocks（格林函数构建块）、Riemann sheets（黎曼面）。；研究对象：克尔黑洞（Kerr black hole）的准正则模在代数特殊频率附近的反常行为，包括分叉、消失以及与史瓦西极限的非光滑连接。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 克尔准正则模在代数特殊频率附近的分叉现象源于避免交叉（avoided crossing）伴随共振激发，而消失现象则是由极跳过（pole skipping）导致——准正则模极点被松原模零点抵消。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：克尔准正则模在代数特殊频率附近的分叉现象源于避免交叉（avoided crossing）伴随共振激发，而消失现象则是由极跳过（pole skipping）导致——准正则模极点被松原模零点抵消。；创新点：首次从格林函数极点和零点的角度，揭示了克尔准正则模在代数特殊频率附近长期令人困惑的分叉与消失现象的物理起源，即避免交叉与极跳过机制。
papers.method_zh: 通过追踪格林函数构建块在不同黎曼面上的极点和零点，分析准正则模与松原模的相互作用机制。未使用具体实验或数值计算手段，属于解析理论分析。

papers.title: Limit theorems for random walks with spatio-temporal drift
papers.abstract: We study a class of discrete-time random walks in $\mathbb{R}^d$ whose conditional drift decays polynomially in time and grows polynomially with the distance from the origin to the current position. This class is related to several models of self-interacting random processes. We determine the asymptotic behavior of the walk under the assumption that its increments have moments of order $p$ for some $p>2$. In the linear case, where the drift depends linearly on the current position, we establish a phase transition in the convergence in distribution of the normalized process to Gaussian limits. In the nonlinear case, we identify three distinct regimes separated by a critical line and show that the normalized process exhibits qualitatively different behaviors in each regime, including convergence in distribution to a Gaussian law, convergence to a non-Gaussian limit given by the stationary distribution of a stochastic differential equation, and almost sure localization on a hypersphere.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：随机游走、极限定理、随机微分方程、相变。；研究对象：具有时空依赖漂移的离散时间随机游走，属于自相互作用随机过程模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在线性漂移情形下，归一化过程的分布收敛到高斯极限时存在相变；在非线性漂移情形下，存在三个不同行为区域，分别对应收敛到高斯分布、收敛到随机微分方程平稳分布的非高斯极限，以及几乎必然局域在超球面上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在线性漂移情形下，归一化过程的分布收敛到高斯极限时存在相变；在非线性漂移情形下，存在三个不同行为区域，分别对应收敛到高斯分布、收敛到随机微分方程平稳分布的非高斯极限，以及几乎必然局域在超球面上。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于矩条件（增量具有p>2阶矩）的概率极限理论分析，包括线性与非线性漂移情形下的渐近行为推导。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap on AI-Assisted Scientific Software Development Through Transparency and Traceability
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of AI-assisted development in scientific software is not a future concern -- it is a present reality. Researchers are already using large language models to write code, generate test cases, and draft documentation, yet this practice remains largely unacknowledged and unguided in formal workflows and published work. This ad hoc, ungoverned use of AI represents a systemic risk to scientific software quality, particularly in safety-relevant modeling and simulation tools subject to strict Software Quality Assurance (SQA), or even Nuclear Quality Assurance Level 1 (NQA-1) standards, for which traceability, independent verification, and documented procedures are paramount. The question facing the scientific software community is, therefore, not whether to permit AI-assisted development, but how to govern it responsibly. This paper proposes guidance for AI-assisted code development in the context of strict software quality assurance. Using TMAP8 -- an open-source tritium migration code for fusion energy -- as a demonstration platform, we propose a structured framework for AI-assisted verification and validation (V&V) case development. V&V case development represents the ideal proving ground for establishing that governance: because validation cases have known solutions, correctness is objectively measurable, errors are identifiable by design, and the artifacts are fully auditable. The proposed guidance, developed based on practical experience described herein, operates within NQA-1 requirements, preserves human accountability, and establishes the disclosure and review standards that responsible AI-assisted scientific software development demands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（政策/方法论+实践演示）。判断依据：论文提出了一套关于AI辅助科学软件开发的管理框架和指导方针，并基于一个开源代码（TMAP8）进行了实践演示，属于方法论与案例研究的结合。；研究对象：论文的研究对象并非具体的物理材料或现象，而是**科学软件（特别是核聚变能源领域的氚迁移模拟代码TMAP8）的开发流程**，以及**AI（大语言模型）在此类软件质量保证（SQA）和验证与确认（V&V）过程中的应用治理**。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现。核心结论是：科学软件社区必须正视AI辅助开发的现状，并建立一套基于透明性和可追溯性的治理框架，该框架需符合严格的软件质量保证标准（如NQA-1），以确保AI生成代码的正确性和人类问责制。

papers.title: Schedule-dependent basin occupation in a programmable quantum annealer
papers.abstract: On a mixed-frustration 12-qubit Ising instance (seed 14029) run on two D-Wave generations, Advantage2 Zephyr and Advantage_system6.4 Pegasus, the late-time subsystem autocorrelation under cycled reverse annealing sits strictly between two equilibrium reference processes at the device-calibrated effective temperature: localized parallel tempering, and delocalized equilibrated path-integral simulated quantum annealing at a fixed Advantage2 pause-point transverse-field scale. The bracket holds on all three tested schedules and at both hardware calibrations. We obtain this result through two ingredients: a cycled reverse-anneal protocol (reinitialize_state=False, 50 cycles per submission) used as a Markov-chain probe of the device's pause-point dynamics, and a parallel-tempering falsification framework with bias-corrected and accelerated bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. Of eighteen tested (seed, schedule) combinations on Advantage2, three are PT-unmatched and correspond to two distinct Ising instances; an independent native-graph control with no minor embedding on a third mixed-frustration instance reproduces the same direction of mismatch. Among twenty random training instances, schedule shape modulates basin occupation on six of the thirteen multi-basin-in-readout instances, with dominant-configuration shifts of up to 38 percentage points including changes of the dominant configuration. A pre-registered linear predictor of schedule sensitivity from exhaustively computable landscape features fails on ten held-out instances, indicating that schedule sensitivity is not captured by simple linear functions of the tested landscape moments. The bracketing result revises an earlier two-pause-enhancement claim and reframes reverse-anneal schedules as instance-specific basin-occupation probes rather than universal quantum-enhancement knobs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：D-Wave量子退火器、硬件校准、循环反向退火协议、马尔可夫链探针。；研究对象：混合阻挫12量子比特伊辛模型实例（种子14029），以及多个多盆地伊辛实例；运行于D-Wave Advantage2 Zephyr和Advantage_system6.4 Pegasus两种量子退火硬件上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在循环反向退火协议下，子系统晚时自关联严格介于两个平衡参考过程（局域并行回火与离域平衡路径积分模拟量子退火）之间，表明反向退火调度是实例特定的盆地占据探针，而非通用的量子增强旋钮。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在循环反向退火协议下，子系统晚时自关联严格介于两个平衡参考过程（局域并行回火与离域平衡路径积分模拟量子退火）之间，表明反向退火调度是实例特定的盆地占据探针，而非通用的量子增强旋钮。；创新点：修正了此前关于“双暂停增强”的论断，将反向退火调度重新定义为实例特定的盆地占据探针，并发现调度敏感性无法被简单线性函数（基于可计算景观矩）捕获。
papers.method_zh: 使用循环反向退火协议（reinitialize_state=False，每次提交50个循环）作为马尔可夫链探针，探测设备暂停点动力学；采用并行回火证伪框架，结合偏差校正加速自助法95%置信区间；对20个随机训练实例计算可穷举的景观特征，并预注册线性预测器。

papers.title: Variational derivation of the Flamant solution for a nonlinear elastic wedge
papers.abstract: Concentrated forces acting at the tip of a two-dimensional wedge give rise to the classical Flamant solution to linear elasticity, whose displacement and strain are singular at the tip of the wedge. Starting from nonlinear elasticity, we prove that the Flamant solution gives the leading order response of a slightly truncated wedge to small boundary displacements or loads. This asymptotic result holds for general hyperelastic energies with super-quadratic growth at infinity; it also holds in the borderline case of quadratic growth at infinity, so long as the tip of the wedge is subjected to small enough displacements or loads. A main point of the proof is to restore compactness to low-energy sequences. We do so by applying a logarithmic change of variables sufficiently far from the tip. To justify this change of variables, we prove a geometric rigidity inequality in $L^p$ for truncated wedge domains with a constant that is uniform in the truncation length. This follows from the bi-Lipschitz invariance of the constant in the $L^p$ Friesecke--James--Müller inequality. Using this change of variables, we derive an asymptotic variational principle characterizing the Flamant solution in the singular limit of an ideal wedge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“从非线性弹性出发证明”“渐近结果”“变分推导”“几何刚性不等式”等理论推导和证明方法。；研究对象：二维楔形体（wedge）在尖端受集中力作用时的弹性响应，即经典Flamant解在非线性弹性框架下的渐近有效性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了经典线性弹性Flamant解是非线性弹性楔形体在尖端受小边界位移或载荷时的主导阶响应，该结果对具有超二次增长的一般超弹性能量成立，且在二次增长边界情形下只要位移或载荷足够小也成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了经典线性弹性Flamant解是非线性弹性楔形体在尖端受小边界位移或载荷时的主导阶响应，该结果对具有超二次增长的一般超弹性能量成立，且在二次增长边界情形下只要位移或载荷足够小也成立。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分方法，通过引入对数变量变换恢复低能序列的紧致性，并证明截断楔形域上Lp几何刚性不等式（常数对截断长度一致），该不等式基于Friesecke–James–Müller不等式的双Lipschitz不变性。

papers.title: Strain-free, symmetrical, InGaAs quantum dots as single photon emitters in the telecomC-band
papers.abstract: Non-classical photon sources made of semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) emitting in the telecommunication C-band are crucial components for low-loss, long-distance photonic quantum communication networks. Here we designed and fabricated strain--free In$_{0.7}$Ga$_{0.3}$As/In$_{0.7}$Al$_{0.3}$As QDs grown on GaAs(111)A substrates working as single-photon emitters in the 1550 nm window. The QDs were grown via local droplet etching method in a molecular beam epitaxy environment, employing a thin In$_{0.7}$Al$_{0.3}$As metamorphic buffer layer with the same lattice constant of the QD material, thus allowing for a completely strain--free self-assembly of the QDs. The QDs exhibit a C$_{3v}$ symmetry with a ground state emission in the 1400--1600 nm range. The exciton lifetimes of $\approx$ 1.3--1.9 ns and linewidths as low as $\approx$ 300 $μ$eV show the good quality of the fabricated QDs. Second-order autocorrelation measurements under pulsed excitation confirmed the single-photon purity of the emitters, yielding a $g^{(2)}(0)$ value of $0.141 \pm 0.027$
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabricated、molecular beam epitaxy、second-order autocorrelation measurements。；研究对象：InGaAs/InAlAs量子点，具体为In₀.₇Ga₀.₃As/In₀.₇Al₀.₃As量子点，生长在GaAs(111)A衬底上，作为电信C波段（1550 nm窗口）的单光子发射器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过无应变自组装方法制备的InGaAs量子点实现了电信C波段（1550 nm）的单光子发射，具有C₃ᵥ对称性、窄线宽（约300 μeV）和良好的单光子纯度（g⁽²⁾(0)=0.141±0.027）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过无应变自组装方法制备的InGaAs量子点实现了电信C波段（1550 nm）的单光子发射，具有C₃ᵥ对称性、窄线宽（约300 μeV）和良好的单光子纯度（g⁽²⁾(0)=0.141±0.027）。；创新点：实现了完全无应变（strain-free）的InGaAs量子点自组装，避免了传统应变量子点中的应力效应，同时将发射波长精确控制在电信C波段（1550 nm），且保持了C₃ᵥ对称性。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）环境中的局部液滴刻蚀法生长量子点，使用与量子点材料晶格常数相同的薄In₀.₇Al₀.₃As变质缓冲层实现完全无应变自组装。通过光致发光测量获取发射波长和线宽，通过二阶自相关测量（脉冲激发）表征单光子纯度。

papers.title: Maximum Likelihood Decoding of Quantum Error Correction Codes
papers.abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) is indispensable for realizing fault-tolerant quantum computation, yet its effectiveness hinges critically on the classical decoding algorithm that interprets noisy syndrome measurements. Among all possible decoding strategies, maximum likelihood decoding (MLD) is provably optimal, since it identifies the logical group with largest likelihood by summing over all possible errors within logical class consistent with the observed syndrome. Despite its optimality, MLD is computationally intractable in general (#P-hard), motivating a rich landscape of exact and approximate algorithms. In this topical review, we provide a unified perspective on MLD by surveying recent advances through three complementary lenses: statistical mechanics, tensor networks, and artificial intelligence. From the statistical mechanics viewpoint, the MLD problem maps onto evaluating partition functions of disordered spin models, enabling exact solutions for certain codes and noise models as well as threshold estimation via phase-transition analysis. From the tensor network perspective, approximate contraction of tensor networks on the code's factor graph yields decoders that closely approach MLD accuracy with polynomial computational cost. From the artificial intelligence perspective, neural-network-based decoders, including autoregressive generative models and recurrent transformers, learn to approximate the MLD distribution from data, achieving high accuracy with the parallelism afforded by modern hardware accelerators. We discuss the connections among these three approaches, review their application to both simulated and experimental quantum hardware, and outline open challenges including real-time decoding, scalability to large code distances, and generalization to high-rate quantum low-density parity-check codes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：topical review、survey、mapping、evaluating partition functions、approximate contraction、neural-network-based decoders）；研究对象：量子纠错码的最大似然解码问题，具体涉及统计力学、张量网络和人工智能三种方法对解码算法的研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最大似然解码（MLD）在理论上是最优的解码策略，但计算上通常是#P-难的；通过统计力学、张量网络和人工智能三种互补视角，可以发展出接近MLD精度的近似解码算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最大似然解码（MLD）在理论上是最优的解码策略，但计算上通常是#P-难的；通过统计力学、张量网络和人工智能三种互补视角，可以发展出接近MLD精度的近似解码算法。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（该文为综述，主要创新在于统一梳理了三种不同方法在MLD问题上的联系与应用进展，而非提出单一新方法）。
papers.method_zh: 从三个视角综述：1）统计力学：将MLD映射为无序自旋模型的配分函数计算，用于精确求解特定码型和噪声模型，并通过相变分析估计阈值；2）张量网络：在码的因子图上对张量网络进行近似收缩，以多项式计算代价逼近MLD精度；3）人工智能：基于神经网络的解码器（包括自回归生成模型和循环变换器）从数据中学习近似MLD分布，利用现代硬件加速实现高精度。

papers.title: Geometric Phase Transition Enables Extreme Hippocampal Memory Capacity
papers.abstract: Memory systems can store vastly different amounts of information despite similar hardware constraints. Here, we show that superior spatial memory emerges from a discrete stiffening of hippocampal population geometry-a transition from disorganized to crystalline collective coding. Comparing food-caching chickadees to non-caching zebra finches, we found that the caching hippocampus maintains a topologically rigid, "crystalline" geometry with significantly higher geometric stability (Shesha 0.245 v 0.166) and nearly two-fold greater temporal coherence (Shesha 0.393 v 0.209), while the non-caching hippocampus resembles a disorganized "mist." This stability is actively constructed by synergistic circuit dynamics: excitatory neurons form the spatial scaffold while inhibitory populations contribute orthogonal decorrelation, a circuit motif in which excitatory and inhibitory populations occupy largely non-overlapping representational subspaces. A double dissociation with Valiant's Stable Memory Allocator, a model predicting that dedicated neuron ensembles underlie each memory, confirms this advantage reflects continuous topological organization rather than discrete neuron allocation: caching networks exhibit near-zero split-half allocation reliability despite their geometric superiority. Computational modeling across 10k configurations reveals topological rigidity as the mathematical prerequisite for scale: crystalline codes sustain high-fidelity readout beyond M=1k locations while mist codes fail below M=10, a >100-fold capacity advantage. This capacity requires a 169fold representational redundancy: a "geometric tax" stabilizing the manifold against biological noise. These results establish geometric stability as a candidate organizing principle of biological memory: evolution achieves high-capacity memory not by proliferating neurons, but by engineering the geometry of the neural code itself.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含对生物（山雀、斑胸草雀）的实验数据比较（“Shesha”指标），以及基于10k配置的计算建模。；研究对象：海马体（hippocampus）的神经群体编码几何结构，具体比较了储食山雀（food-caching chickadees）与非储食斑胸草雀（non-caching zebra finches）的海马体空间记忆编码方式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现储食山雀海马体通过一种从无序“雾态”到有序“晶体态”的几何相变，实现了远超非储食鸟类的空间记忆容量（>100倍优势）。这种容量优势源于神经群体编码的拓扑刚性（topological rigidity），而非单纯增加神经元数量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现储食山雀海马体通过一种从无序“雾态”到有序“晶体态”的几何相变，实现了远超非储食鸟类的空间记忆容量（>100倍优势）。这种容量优势源于神经群体编码的拓扑刚性（topological rigidity），而非单纯增加神经元数量。；创新点：首次将凝聚态物理中的“几何相变”和“拓扑刚性”概念引入神经科学，提出生物记忆容量的提升并非依赖神经元增殖，而是通过主动改变神经群体编码的几何结构（从无序到有序的晶体化）来实现。同时揭示了兴奋性-抑制性神经元回路中“正交去相关”的协同机制是构建这种稳定几何结构的关键。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：比较两种鸟类（储食山雀与斑胸草雀）海马体的神经活动记录，计算几何稳定性指标（Shesha值）和时间相干性（Shesha值）。

papers.title: Basis-free neural-network geminal and Jastrow factors for variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Neural-network quantum states offer a flexible route to compact many-electron wave functions, but their practical accuracy depends strongly on how fermionic antisymmetry, electron correlation, and optimization noise are treated. Here we combine an antisymmetrized geminal power (AGP) determinant with feed-forward neural networks that replace conventional basis-set expansions in the geminal and in two Jastrow-factor constructions. The resulting basis-free Jastrow--AGP ansatz is optimized by variational Monte Carlo and is designed to separate two tasks: the AGP part defines the nodal surface, while the neural-network Jastrow factor recovers dynamical correlation at fixed nodes. This separation makes it possible to distinguish errors associated with dynamical correlation from those caused by static, multireference correlation. Applications to the hydrogen molecule and the rectangular hydrogen tetramer show sub-millihartree accuracy when the AGP nodes are adequate, and expose the residual nodal limitation near the large-radius square geometry of the hydrogen tetramer. These results clarify where neural-network building blocks can improve a compact geminal ansatz and where additional nodal flexibility is required.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“neural-network quantum states”、“variational Monte Carlo”、“ansatz”等计算与理论方法关键词。；研究对象：多电子量子系统，具体包括氢分子（H₂）和矩形氢四聚体（rectangular hydrogen tetramer）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当AGP部分定义的节点面足够准确时，结合无基组神经网络geminal和Jastrow因子的变分蒙特卡洛方法可实现亚毫哈特级精度；但在氢四聚体的大半径方形几何构型下，节点面的局限性仍然存在，表明需要额外的节点灵活性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当AGP部分定义的节点面足够准确时，结合无基组神经网络geminal和Jastrow因子的变分蒙特卡洛方法可实现亚毫哈特级精度；但在氢四聚体的大半径方形几何构型下，节点面的局限性仍然存在，表明需要额外的节点灵活性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）方法，结合无基组（basis-free）的前馈神经网络，用于替代传统基组展开构造geminal和Jastrow因子，形成Jastrow-AGP变分波函数。

papers.title: Exact nonequilibrium steady states of boundary driven circuit with XYZ gates
papers.abstract: We obtain the exact many-body density operator of a boundary-driven XXZ quantum circuit via a spatially inhomogeneous matrix product Ansatz. The Ansatz has formally infinite bond-dimension and generalizes authors' previous construction \cite{2025XXZcircuit} for the XXZ interactions. The boundary qubits are coupled to reset quantum channels that project them toward arbitrary pure target states. We find and describe a family of relatively robust separable chiral nonequilibrium steady states (NESS), which are elliptic analogs of spin helices for the circuit, and which are particularly attractive from an experimental perspective.
