These results establish local symmetry as a flexible and practical design principle for product-formula simulation, opening a route to more accurate and hardware-efficient simulations of broader classes of many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：product formula、Trotter decomposition、SU(2) symmetry、numerical simulations）；研究对象：数字量子模拟中的多体量子系统，具体以Kagome海森堡模型（含三角自旋手性相互作用）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于局域SU(2)对称性的Trotter分解新原理，将哈密顿量项分组为局域三格点簇，可大幅抑制对易子引起的误差和电路深度，在Kagome海森堡模型中使态保真度和平均自旋手性偏差降低三个数量级以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于局域SU(2)对称性的Trotter分解新原理，将哈密顿量项分组为局域三格点簇，可大幅抑制对易子引起的误差和电路深度，在Kagome海森堡模型中使态保真度和平均自旋手性偏差降低三个数量级以上。；创新点：突破传统基于对易性的分解原则，首次利用局域对称性（而非直接对易性）指导哈密顿量分组，使二阶乘积公式无需加倍电路深度即可实现，并保持被对易性分解可能破坏的物理结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟：基于SU(2)对称性对三格点生成元进行分类（最多四类），利用有效两比特SU(4)表示实现精确高效分解；在自旋晶格模型上进行数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Networks: Harnessing Non-Equilibrium Steady States for Computation
papers.abstract: We introduce thermodynamic networks, a general framework for autonomous, physics-based computation using non-equilibrium steady states. These networks are modeled as a collection of finite-size reservoirs that exchange conserved quantities--such as electric charge or molecular number--while relaxing to a non-equilibrium steady state, which encodes the solution of a computational problem. We identify Negative Differential Conductance (NDC) as the critical physical property governing the computational expressivity of the thermodynamic network. While networks lacking NDC are restricted to computing monotonic functions, the presence of NDC enables universal function approximation. For the training of the network, we use protocols that take advantage of the natural tendency of the system to equilibrate. We illustrate the versatility of our approach via two different platforms: quantum dot networks and enzymatic reaction networks. Both systems can be engineered to have NDC, enabling high performance in standard benchmarks, including sine function approximation and MNIST digit classification. Overall, our work establishes a rigorous link between non-equilibrium steady states and computational expressivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出“thermodynamic networks”这一理论框架，并基于非平衡稳态进行计算建模，未涉及具体实验操作或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非平衡稳态下的热力学网络，具体包括量子点网络和酶反应网络两种物理系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 负微分电导（NDC）是决定热力学网络计算表达能力的关键物理性质：缺乏NDC的网络只能计算单调函数，而具有NDC的网络能够实现通用函数逼近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：负微分电导（NDC）是决定热力学网络计算表达能力的关键物理性质：缺乏NDC的网络只能计算单调函数，而具有NDC的网络能够实现通用函数逼近。；创新点：建立了非平衡稳态与计算表达能力之间的严格理论联系，并识别出负微分电导（NDC）作为决定计算普适性的关键物理属性。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与框架构建：将网络建模为有限大小储库的集合，通过交换守恒量（如电荷或分子数）弛豫至非平衡稳态，并利用系统自然趋向平衡的协议进行训练。

papers.title: Quantum mechanics for classical transport equations
papers.abstract: Classical transport equations with probabilistic initial conditions can be viewed as quantum systems. In a discrete version they are probabilistic automata. The time-local probabilistic information is encoded in a classical wave function. Its unitary evolution obeys a Schrödinger equation. Statistical observables are represented by operators which do not commute with the ones associated to classical observables. Examples are functions of the quantum energy or the quantum angular momentum. They are important conserved quantities. We construct a complex functional integral for the quantum system which describes the probabilistic classical transport equation. The characteristic features of quantum mechanics, as the superposition of wave functions, interference, the importance of phases, non-commuting operators or a unitary time evolution, are realized by probabilistic classical transport equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“量子系统”“薛定谔方程”“酉演化”“复泛函积分”等理论框架关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：经典输运方程（具有概率性初始条件）及其与量子力学的对应关系。具体体系为离散版本的概率自动机。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典输运方程在概率性初始条件下可被视作量子系统，其时间局域概率信息由经典波函数编码，并服从薛定谔方程的酉演化。量子力学中的特征（如波函数叠加、干涉、相位重要性、非对易算符、酉时间演化）均可由经典输运方程实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典输运方程在概率性初始条件下可被视作量子系统，其时间局域概率信息由经典波函数编码，并服从薛定谔方程的酉演化。量子力学中的特征（如波函数叠加、干涉、相位重要性、非对易算符、酉时间演化）均可由经典输运方程实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与形式化构造：通过定义经典波函数及其酉演化，将经典输运方程映射为量子力学系统；并构造描述该量子系统的复泛函积分。

papers.title: Anomalous Transport from Effective Field Theory
papers.abstract: A systematic study of chiral effects is presented using an Effective Field Theory framework. By integrating out a massive Dirac fermion at finite temperature in presence of vector and axial background fields, the currents and their anomalies are computed from the path-integral. Chiral effects previously considered separately naturally arise in a unified computation, including new mass corrections. The link between each anomalous transport effect and the anomalies is clearly established, beyond the identification of their coefficients. In particular, we can appreciate how these effects are sourced by the anomalous nature of the theory even in configurations where the anomaly itself vanishes. The consistent and covariant anomalies are both encapsulated in master formulae for the currents which result from a careful treatment of the regularisation. It is finally found that, at finite temperature, the physical currents cannot be inferred simply from the Chern-Simons terms whose divergence reproduce the chiral anomalies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Effective Field Theory framework”“path-integral”“regularisation”等理论方法关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：手征效应（chiral effects）及其在有限温度、矢量与轴矢背景场下的反常输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过有效场论框架统一计算了有限温度下手征效应的电流与反常，揭示了各反常输运效应与量子反常之间的直接联系，并发现即使在反常本身为零的构型中，输运效应仍可由反常性质驱动；此外，物理电流不能简单从Chern-Simons项推导得出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过有效场论框架统一计算了有限温度下手征效应的电流与反常，揭示了各反常输运效应与量子反常之间的直接联系，并发现即使在反常本身为零的构型中，输运效应仍可由反常性质驱动；此外，物理电流不能简单从Chern-Simons项推导得出。；创新点：将此前被分别处理的手征效应纳入统一计算框架，并给出了新的质量修正项；明确建立了每个反常输运效应与反常之间的直接联系，超越了仅识别系数的层面；指出有限温度下物理电流不能仅从Chern-Simons项推断。
papers.method_zh: 有效场论（Effective Field Theory），具体通过路径积分在有限温度下积掉有质量狄拉克费米子，并仔细处理正则化以得到协变与一致反常的电流主公式。

papers.title: Optimized near-field optical response via adaptive tip illumination
papers.abstract: The performance of tip-enhanced optical microscopy is often limited by inefficient coupling of the excitation field to the plasmonic tip apex, as well as by thermal drift and optical aberrations. Here, we demonstrate that adaptive wavefront shaping based on Zernike mode provides a practical approach to achieving robust near-field optimisation at the tip apex. Using a sequential feedback algorithm, initially using the near-field signal, we narrow the illumination point-spread function and suppress sidelobes. This demonstrates that Zernike-mode control can be used for both aberration correction and field engineering. In tip-enhanced Raman measurements of a Janus MoSSe monolayer, conventional near-field optimisation increases the signal intensity by around 1.4 fold. A second optimisation step based directly on the Raman-band intensity yields a further 5 to 15 fold enhancement, depending on the specific tips used. These results establish a systematic, optics-based strategy for optimising tip fields, providing a transferable framework for improving tip-enhanced and related near-field spectroscopies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验过程（如“使用顺序反馈算法”、“在Janus MoSSe单层上进行尖端增强拉曼测量”），并给出了具体的实验数据（信号增强倍数）。；研究对象：尖端增强光学显微镜/光谱学中的近场光学响应，具体以Janus MoSSe单层为测试样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于Zernike模式的自适应波前整形，可以显著优化尖端增强光学显微镜的激发场耦合效率，实现近场信号的稳健增强。在尖端增强拉曼测量中，该方法可将信号强度提升5至15倍（取决于具体针尖）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于Zernike模式的自适应波前整形，可以显著优化尖端增强光学显微镜的激发场耦合效率，实现近场信号的稳健增强。在尖端增强拉曼测量中，该方法可将信号强度提升5至15倍（取决于具体针尖）。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种基于Zernike模式的自适应光学策略，用于系统性地优化针尖近场。该方法不仅能校正像差，还能进行场工程，并且通过两步优化（先优化近场信号，再优化拉曼信号）实现了比传统方法（约1.4倍）更显著的信号增强（5-15倍）。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：自适应波前整形技术（基于Zernike模式），结合顺序反馈算法。具体步骤包括：第一步利用近场信号优化照明点扩散函数并抑制旁瓣；第二步直接基于拉曼谱带强度进行二次优化。测量手段为尖端增强拉曼光谱。

papers.title: Symmetry breaking and high-dimensional chaos in sparse random networks of exact firing rate models
papers.abstract: Exact firing rate models, also known as next-generation neural mass models (NG-NMMs), provide a rigorous description of the dynamics of neural populations. While in its simplest form a single population only displays fixed-point activity, multi-population models may display a range of different behaviors. In this work, we study the dynamics of all-excitatory or all-inhibitory NG-NMMs coupled through sparse random networks with row-normalized network topology. Linear stability analysis of the homogeneous states of the system, representing asynchronous neural activity, provides a dispersion relation linking the emergence of spatiotemporal dynamics to the spectra of the connectivity matrix. Using bounds from random matrix theory, we identify the parameter regions where instabilities occur. In undirected networks, only inhibitory systems produce heterogeneous stationary patterns, corresponding to a winner-takes-all mechanism. In directed networks, exotic rhythmic states with high frequencies emerge in both, excitatory and inhibitory systems. Numerical simulations reveal that these hectic oscillatory states correspond to high-dimensional chaos with extensive properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：linear stability analysis, random matrix theory, numerical simulations）；研究对象：稀疏随机网络中的精确发放率模型（exact firing rate models，亦称下一代神经群体模型NG-NMMs），具体为全兴奋性或全抑制性耦合网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无向网络中，仅抑制性系统能产生异质稳态斑图（对应胜者全得机制）；在有向网络中，兴奋性和抑制性系统均能产生高频节律态，且这些状态对应具有广延性质的高维混沌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无向网络中，仅抑制性系统能产生异质稳态斑图（对应胜者全得机制）；在有向网络中，兴奋性和抑制性系统均能产生高频节律态，且这些状态对应具有广延性质的高维混沌。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 线性稳定性分析（推导色散关系，关联时空动力学与连接矩阵谱）、随机矩阵理论（界定失稳参数区域）、数值模拟（验证高频振荡态的高维混沌性质）。

papers.title: Event-based spatiotemporal networks for modelling emergent phenomena in complex systems
papers.abstract: Complex systems display emergent phenomena that vary significantly across spatial and temporal scales. These variations originate from fine-grained system processes, yet arriving at macroscopic dynamics from micro-level data -- particularly when large, high-resolution datasets are available -- remains a persistent challenge. Here we develop event-based spatiotemporal networks, a computational modelling framework that encodes system processes as discrete events anchored in space and time. Event-based spatiotemporal networks offer a unified, flexible and efficient approach to generate emergent behaviour in complex systems across space and time from these events. We demonstrate the effectiveness of event-based spatiotemporal networks through two illustrative real-world applications. First, following a local outbreak of a novel respiratory pathogen in the Netherlands, spatiotemporal networks enable fine-grained tracking of transmission routes and infection patterns through space and time. Second, we use spatiotemporal networks to model propagation of delays in a public transportation system (S-bahn) around Zürich, Switzerland. We also discuss broader uses of event-based spatiotemporal networks in fields like developmental biology and community ecology, where focusing on events rather than static system states can improve data analysis, simulation, and collection strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：computational modelling framework、encoding system processes、generate emergent behaviour。；研究对象：复杂系统中的涌现现象，具体包括呼吸道病原体传播（荷兰）和公共交通系统延误传播（瑞士苏黎世S-bahn）两个实际案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于事件的时空网络框架，能够从离散事件出发统一、灵活且高效地生成复杂系统在空间和时间上的涌现行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于事件的时空网络框架，能够从离散事件出发统一、灵活且高效地生成复杂系统在空间和时间上的涌现行为。；创新点：提出以“事件”而非静态系统状态为核心的计算建模方法，为从微观数据推导宏观动力学提供统一框架，并展示了在发育生物学和群落生态学等领域的潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 事件驱动的时空网络建模框架（event-based spatiotemporal networks），将系统过程编码为锚定在空间和时间中的离散事件，并通过两个真实世界应用（病原体传播追踪、公共交通延误传播）验证其有效性。

papers.title: Dynamical aspects of steady-state subradiance: Detailed balance and its breakdown
papers.abstract: The dynamics of dissipative many-body quantum systems sometimes admit an emergent classical description in terms of a Markov chain even though the corresponding state space contains highly entangled states. In particular, a bad-cavity laser is a paradigm system whose dynamics can be formulated as a Markov chain in a two-dimensional state space spanned by collective angular momentum states. In this article, we investigate the connection between a dissipative phase transition that occurs in the subradiant regime of this system in the large atom number limit, and the properties of the underlying Markov chain. In one of the phases, the Markov chain approaches the detailed-balance condition with increasing atom number $N$ and hence becomes effectively time-reversible. This is caused by a collective atomic emission process that effectively reduces the Markov chain to one dimension. In the other phase, we find the emergence of time-asymmetric probability currents in the two-dimensional state space that signals a breakdown of detailed balance. This is accompanied by a macroscopic internal entropy production rate in the Markov chain that scales extensively with the atom number $N$. An observable consequence of the probability currents is a self-pulsing of the cavity light output in this phase, which can be detected as an anti-correlation dip in the intensity correlation function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Markov chain、detailed-balance condition、entropy production rate、theoretical framework。；研究对象：耗散多体量子系统中的亚辐射稳态动力学，具体以坏腔激光器（bad-cavity laser）为范例，研究其集体角动量态空间中的马尔可夫链行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子数很大的极限下，亚辐射区域中的耗散相变与底层马尔可夫链的性质密切相关：一个相中马尔可夫链趋近细致平衡条件（时间可逆），另一相中细致平衡被破坏，出现时间不对称的概率流，并伴随宏观内熵产生率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子数很大的极限下，亚辐射区域中的耗散相变与底层马尔可夫链的性质密切相关：一个相中马尔可夫链趋近细致平衡条件（时间可逆），另一相中细致平衡被破坏，出现时间不对称的概率流，并伴随宏观内熵产生率。；创新点：揭示了亚辐射稳态中耗散相变与马尔可夫链细致平衡破缺之间的直接联系，并指出概率流可导致腔光输出的自脉动现象，该现象可通过强度关联函数的反关联谷进行实验检测。
papers.method_zh: 采用马尔可夫链理论分析二维态空间（由集体角动量态张成）中的动力学，通过细致平衡条件的满足与否、概率流的时间不对称性以及熵产生率的标度行为来刻画相变。

papers.title: Nonlocal Optical Response and Surface Susceptibilities: A Systematic Derivation via Spatial Moment Expansion
papers.abstract: We present a systematic theory connecting the nonlocal response kernel of a homogeneous medium to its effective surface susceptibilities for an arbitrary curved interface. Starting from the most general tensorial nonlocal constitutive relation and combining a spatial moment expansion with a distributional thin-layer limit, we show that the full complexity of the interfacial response condenses, at leading order, into a single scalar: the surface susceptibility $χ^s$, equal for the tangential and normal components of the electric field. These quantities provide a constructive generalization of the Feibelman $d$-parameters to interfaces of arbitrary curvature, and the curvature corrections, proportional to the geometric invariants $H$ (mean curvature) and $K$ (Gaussian curvature), are derived explicitly. The formalism is illustrated on a comprehensive set of analytically tractable cases (planar, spherical, cylindrical, and ellipsoidal interfaces) for several kernel choices (Gaussian, Yukawa, tensorial Lorentz). Generalized Maxwell boundary conditions are established and compared with the classical Fresnel results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：systematic theory, derivation, formalism。；研究对象：均匀介质中任意弯曲界面处的非局域光学响应，以及如何用有效表面磁化率来描述这种响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空间矩展开和分布薄层极限，证明在领头阶，界面响应的全部复杂性可归结为一个标量：表面磁化率 χ^s，它对电场的切向和法向分量相等。该理论提供了Feibelman d-参数到任意曲率界面的建设性推广，并显式推导了与平均曲率H和高斯曲率K成正比的曲率修正项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空间矩展开和分布薄层极限，证明在领头阶，界面响应的全部复杂性可归结为一个标量：表面磁化率 χ^s，它对电场的切向和法向分量相等。该理论提供了Feibelman d-参数到任意曲率界面的建设性推广，并显式推导了与平均曲率H和高斯曲率K成正比的曲率修正项。；创新点：该工作提供了一个系统性的理论框架，将非局域响应核与任意弯曲界面的有效表面磁化率联系起来，是对原有仅适用于平面界面的Feibelman d-参数方法的建设性推广，并显式包含了曲率修正。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。从最一般的张量非局域本构关系出发，结合空间矩展开（spatial moment expansion）和分布薄层极限（distributional thin-layer limit），推导出有效表面磁化率。在平面、球面、柱面和椭球面等可解析处理的界面上，对高斯、汤川、张量洛伦兹等核函数进行了验证，并建立了广义麦克斯韦边界条件。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Invariants of Coupled Channels: A Many-Channel Tolman-Ehrenfest Effect
papers.abstract: When multiple thermodynamic channels are coupled, single-channel equilibrium conditions fail. Extending the Tolman--Ehrenfest effect to the entropy manifold, we derive the unique $n$-channel invariant $ζ_i T_i = C$, where $ζ_i$ is the holonomy of the Ruppeiner connection. For the granular volume--stress ensemble, Rowe's dilatancy ratio and energy restriction emerge as geometric consequences of the off-diagonal curvature $g_{Vσ}$, and the 60-year puzzle of state-dependent $K_μ$ is resolved: the correction $ζ_V$ reaches $O(1)$ near jamming. The prediction $ζ_Vχ=\mathrm{const}$ across a shear band is experimentally testable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“extending the Tolman--Ehrenfest effect”、“derive the unique n-channel invariant”、“geometric consequences”。；研究对象：多热力学通道耦合系统中的平衡条件，具体以颗粒物质的体积-应力系综为例，研究其几何性质与状态依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多通道耦合系统中，单通道平衡条件失效，存在唯一的n通道不变量ζ_i T_i = C，其中ζ_i是Ruppeiner联络的完整量。对于颗粒物质，该几何框架自然导出Rowe剪胀比和能量约束，并解决了状态依赖的K_μ这一60年未解之谜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多通道耦合系统中，单通道平衡条件失效，存在唯一的n通道不变量ζ_i T_i = C，其中ζ_i是Ruppeiner联络的完整量。对于颗粒物质，该几何框架自然导出Rowe剪胀比和能量约束，并解决了状态依赖的K_μ这一60年未解之谜。；创新点：首次将Tolman-Ehrenfest效应从单通道推广到多通道熵流形，揭示了颗粒物质中剪胀比和K_μ的几何起源，并预言了跨剪切带的ζ_Vχ=const关系，该预言具有实验可检验性。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何热力学方法，将Tolman-Ehrenfest效应推广到熵流形，利用Ruppeiner联络的完整量（holonomy）推导多通道不变量，并通过颗粒体积-应力系综的度规张量g_{Vσ}的曲率分析解释实验现象。

papers.title: Reweighting free energy profiles between universal machine learning interatomic potentials for fast consensus building
papers.abstract: Free energy profiles serve as a fundamental bridge between microscopic atomic fluctuations and macroscopic thermodynamic observables. Estimating the free energy profile along a reaction coordinate, referred to as the potential of mean force (PMF), with density functional theory (DFT) accuracy is computationally expensive. Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) drastically reduce this cost, but their accuracy is strongly determined by their training data and hence can be uncertain for a given system. In this work, we present a systematic and scalable framework for reweighting PMFs, initially sampled with a single 'source' MLIP, across a representative suite of target MLIPs. Because traditional direct exponential reweighting fails for large system sizes due to low phase-space overlap between potentials, we deploy robust analytical corrections. Applying this to a complex 601-atom system of Li$^+$ transport in a nanoconfined electrolyte, we demonstrate that a mean energy-gap approximation effectively bypasses statistical collapse, producing a highly stable PMF matching the target PMF. Using this approach, we recover high-fidelity target thermodynamics across multiple DFT reference levels (PBE+D3, PBE-sol, r$^2$SCAN,r$^2$SCAN-D4) at a fraction of the computational cost of full simulations. Furthermore, thermodynamic analysis reveals that the studied MLIPs partition into two distinct clusters driven by their training data. Our reweighting framework successfully recovers target thermodynamic properties--specifically, reaction and activation free energies--even when the phase-space overlap between potentials is critically low. Ultimately, this approach establishes a vital diagnostic protocol to achieve affordable cross-model consensus on materials chemistry properties without redundant, resource-intensive simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、reweighting、free energy profiles、density functional theory (DFT)。；研究对象：纳米限域电解质中Li⁺离子输运的复杂体系（601个原子），具体研究其沿反应坐标的平均力势（PMF）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于平均能隙近似的重加权框架，能够有效克服不同势函数之间相空间重叠不足导致的统计崩溃问题，以极低计算代价恢复高保真度的目标热力学性质（如反应自由能和活化自由能），并揭示不同MLIPs因训练数据差异而分为两个聚类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于平均能隙近似的重加权框架，能够有效克服不同势函数之间相空间重叠不足导致的统计崩溃问题，以极低计算代价恢复高保真度的目标热力学性质（如反应自由能和活化自由能），并揭示不同MLIPs因训练数据差异而分为两个聚类。；创新点：提出一种系统化、可扩展的重加权框架，用于在多个通用MLIPs之间快速达成热力学共识，避免了冗余的高成本全模拟，并建立了跨模型一致性的诊断协议。
papers.method_zh: 采用通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）进行初始采样，结合直接指数重加权（失败后）的解析修正方法——平均能隙近似，对PMF进行重加权。目标势函数包括多个DFT参考级别（PBE+D3、PBE-sol、r²SCAN、r²SCAN-D4）。

papers.title: ColPackAgent: Agent-Skill-Guided Hard-Particle Monte Carlo Workflows for Colloidal Packing
papers.abstract: We introduce ColPackAgent, an agent framework that autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and an agent skill, whether as a standalone agent or inside an existing agent system. By harnessing the MCP server and agent skill, ColPackAgent executes a structured workflow for colloidal packing simulations, which are central to studies of phase behavior, self-assembly, and materials design. Without dedicated simulation tools and workflow instructions, general-purpose Large Language Model (LLM) agents tend to describe such workflows rather than execute them reliably. The MCP server exposes a custom-built colpack Python package that wraps HOOMD-blue hard-particle Monte Carlo, and the skill encodes a four-stage workflow contract. ColPackAgent can carry out the workflow interactively with human feedback, autonomously from an end-to-end prompt, or as autoresearch following a provided program file. We demonstrate the system in different modes with several colloidal packing simulation examples such as cube particles in 3D, a binary system of disks and capsules in 2D, and the 2D hard-disk freezing transition using autoresearch. We also compare model performance on this workflow across a panel of LLMs with 17 stage-specific prompts. This benchmark provides a stage-level check of how reliably different models follow the setup, planning, and analysis workflow. Together, these results show that pairing a domain Python package with MCP tools and a portable agent skill provides a practical route for turning a simulation toolkit into an agent-assisted research workflow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、agent framework、workflow。；研究对象：胶体堆积（colloidal packing）的蒙特卡洛模拟，包括三维立方体颗粒、二维圆盘与胶囊二元体系、二维硬圆盘冻结相变等体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将领域Python包（colpack）与MCP工具及智能体技能（agent skill）结合，可以可靠地将模拟工具包转化为智能体辅助的研究工作流，使大语言模型代理能够自主执行胶体堆积模拟，而非仅描述流程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将领域Python包（colpack）与MCP工具及智能体技能（agent skill）结合，可以可靠地将模拟工具包转化为智能体辅助的研究工作流，使大语言模型代理能够自主执行胶体堆积模拟，而非仅描述流程。；创新点：提出了一个将领域专用Python包与MCP工具及可移植智能体技能配对的实用路线，使通用大语言模型代理能够可靠地执行而非仅描述胶体堆积模拟工作流，并提供了17个阶段特定提示的LLM性能基准测试。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于HOOMD-blue硬颗粒蒙特卡洛（hard-particle Monte Carlo）的colpack Python包，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）工具服务器和智能体技能（agent skill）构建ColPackAgent框架，实现四阶段工作流（setup、planning、analysis等）的自主执行，支持交互式、端到端提示或自动研究模式。

papers.title: Interface Piezoelectric Loss in Superconducting Qubits
papers.abstract: Dissipation remains a central obstacle to improving superconducting quantum circuits, yet the microscopic origins of loss in widely used materials platforms are not fully understood. Here, we report the observation of interface piezoelectricity-induced dissipation in superconducting qubits fabricated on high-resistivity silicon. Our devices use a transmon qubit with a shunt capacitor that simultaneously serves as an interdigital transducer embedded in a surface acoustic wave resonator. By tuning the qubit transition into resonance with discrete mechanical modes, we observe up to a factor-of-two reduction in qubit lifetime, consistent with energy exchange between the qubit and mechanical modes mediated by piezoelectric coupling at the aluminum-silicon interface. Our findings provide direct evidence for interface piezoelectricity as a distinct loss channel in superconducting qubits. Combined with multiphysics simulations, these findings suggest that interface piezoelectric loss can dominate over loss from two-level systems at sufficiently high frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observation, devices, measurements, multiphysics simulations）；研究对象：超导量子比特中的界面压电损耗，具体为高阻硅衬底上铝-硅界面处的压电耦合导致的耗散机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 观察到超导量子比特与表面声波谐振器中离散机械模式共振时，量子比特寿命降低至原来的二分之一，证实界面压电效应是超导量子比特中一种独立的损耗通道，且在高频下可能超过双能级系统损耗。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：观察到超导量子比特与表面声波谐振器中离散机械模式共振时，量子比特寿命降低至原来的二分之一，证实界面压电效应是超导量子比特中一种独立的损耗通道，且在高频下可能超过双能级系统损耗。；创新点：首次直接实验观测到界面压电效应作为超导量子比特中独立的耗散通道，并指出其在高频下可能主导损耗。
papers.method_zh: 制备了同时作为叉指换能器的分流电容的transmon量子比特，嵌入表面声波谐振器中；通过调谐量子比特跃迁频率与机械模式共振，测量量子比特寿命变化；结合多物理场仿真进行分析。

papers.title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) have attracted increasing attention as a means of accelerating scientific discovery; however, developing SDL software remains technically demanding. To improve accessibility, orchestration software frameworks have been proposed to coordinate SDL components. Nevertheless, existing frameworks are primarily designed for human interaction and do not provide standardized interfaces suitable for AI agents. In this work, we propose an SDL software architecture based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), in which all SDL functionalities are exposed through MCP servers. Following this design principle, we introduce an MCP-based SDL orchestrator, named NIMO Controller. It provides a visual programming interface automatically generated through MCP-based tool discovery, allowing human users to design experimental workflows without writing code. The same MCP backend can also be accessed by AI agents, providing a unified interface for both human users and AI agents. We demonstrate the proposed system through a case study on a color-matching SDL. The results validate the usability of the proposed MCP-based SDL architecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（软件架构设计与实验验证）。判断依据：提出了一种基于MCP的SDL软件架构，并通过颜色匹配SDL案例研究进行了实验验证。；研究对象：自驱动实验室（SDL）的软件架构与协调器，具体以颜色匹配实验为案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的SDL架构能够为人类用户和AI智能体提供统一的标准化接口，并通过自动生成的视觉编程界面实现无需编写代码的实验工作流设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的SDL架构能够为人类用户和AI智能体提供统一的标准化接口，并通过自动生成的视觉编程界面实现无需编写代码的实验工作流设计。；创新点：提出了一种基于MCP的SDL软件架构，首次实现了人类用户与AI智能体通过同一标准化接口访问SDL功能，并利用MCP工具发现自动生成可视化编程界面，降低了SDL的使用门槛。
papers.method_zh: 采用MCP协议将所有SDL功能暴露为MCP服务器，开发了名为NIMO Controller的协调器，通过MCP工具发现自动生成可视化编程界面，并在颜色匹配SDL上进行案例验证。

papers.title: Lattice-Spring Analogy for Isotropic Elasticity
papers.abstract: This study introduces an innovative Isotropic Elastic Lattice Spring Model (IELSM) that addresses the fundamental limitation of classical lattice spring models: the constraint of fixed Poisson's ratio. By amending the total strain energy within the Lattice Spring Model (LSM), IELSM provides a self-consistent formulation for simulating isotropic elastic materials with arbitrary Poisson's ratios. The model's core innovation lies in augmenting classical axial spring frameworks with additional volumetric constraints, establishing a direct and exact mapping between IELSM's parameters and macroscopic elastic constants. This enables simulation across the full admissible Poisson's ratio: -1 < ν < 1 under plane stress and -1 < ν< 0.5 under plane strain conditions. Eigenvalue analysis indicates that the IELSM has better numerical stability compared to the standard bilinear quadrilateral element and the constant strain triangular element. The characteristic of the numerical implementation lies in directly decomposing the additional volumetric constraints into an equivalent combination of standard mechanical components (axial, shear and rotational springs), laying the foundation for the realization of fracture simulation based on discrete methods. Comprehensive validation through uniaxial tension, pure shear, stress concentration around a circular hole, and stress singularity analyses for central and crucifix-shaped cracks demonstrates IELSM's exceptional accuracy, convergence and computational robustness. The model exhibits excellent performance in stress intensity factor calculations at crack tips, validating its effectiveness for singular stress field analysis. This work bridges the gap between LSM and continuum mechanics, establishing an analog framework that maintains theoretical consistency while offering computational accuracy for the solution of elastic boundary value problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入模型”、“公式推导”、“数值实现”、“特征值分析”等关键词，属于理论建模与数值计算方法研究。；研究对象：各向同性弹性材料。具体研究的是如何通过一种新的晶格弹簧模型（IELSM）来模拟具有任意泊松比的各向同性弹性体，并验证其在断裂力学问题（如裂纹尖端应力强度因子计算）中的有效性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为各向同性弹性晶格弹簧模型（IELSM）的新方法，通过引入额外的体积约束，成功突破了经典晶格弹簧模型泊松比固定的限制，能够精确模拟从-1到0.5（平面应变）或-1到1（平面应力）全范围泊松比的各向同性弹性材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为各向同性弹性晶格弹簧模型（IELSM）的新方法，通过引入额外的体积约束，成功突破了经典晶格弹簧模型泊松比固定的限制，能够精确模拟从-1到0.5（平面应变）或-1到1（平面应力）全范围泊松比的各向同性弹性材料。；创新点：该工作的核心创新在于解决了经典晶格弹簧模型（LSM）的一个根本性局限——泊松比固定。IELSM通过自洽的公式，首次实现了用一个统一的晶格弹簧框架模拟任意泊松比的各向同性弹性材料，并建立了与连续介质力学之间的精确类比桥梁，为基于离散方法的断裂模拟奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟。具体包括：
